name: Son of a Bun
desc:
Son of a Bun is the creation of Hat and Pat. Born from a passion for fried chicken with an extensive background in streetfood, we aim to bring you the crispiest, juciest, most succulent burgers in the west. 

Our newly converted Bun truck is always happy to get on the road. Its a modern conversion, with all the bells and whistles, and is sure to look great at your event.

name: AROMA Grill
desc: AROMA prides itself in using the most basic ingredients however with the most flavoursome result! I know it doesn’t sound possible but it’s true.

name: Queen of the Crepes
desc:
Introducing Queen of The Crepes – your ultimate destination for exquisite street food experiences! Our delightful menu features an enticing array of both sweet and savoury crepes, tailored to accommodate gluten-free and vegan preferences.
With our versatile options, you can choose between our fabulous catering trailer, complete with the added luxury of teas and coffees, or opt for our pop-up stall…

name: Basement 17
desc:
Basement 17 was forged in our tiny basement flat in Bristol during the covid pandemic. It started with tacos for our neighbours every Wednesday and has since evolved into a catering company with fire at its core. 

Carlos and Emily both share a passion for delivering the highest service and food.

name: Dookies Grill
desc: We are specialists in modern and exciting British and Caribbean dishes. We have provided delicious flame-grilled food and memorable catering experiences for more than 7 years to functions of 50-400 all over the Southeast.

name: Azahar
desc: Azahar are an independent Spanish English family business with a passion for bringing the traditional flavours of Spain, combined with a canny modern twist, to your next event!

name: Nanny Bill's Burgers
desc: Starting as a street food venture, from their home kitchen in North London, in homage to their Nan, Nanny Bill and the cafe she ran in the '70s & '80s. Nanny Bill’s opened the hatch to its vintage food truck for the first time in Spring 2015, feeding the hungry patrons at East London food market Night Tales.

name: Crosstown
tagline: Sourdough Doughnuts, Handcrafted Cookies and Small-Batch Ice Cream
desc:
Crosstown Doughnuts is an independent, London-based scratch bakery which focuses on bringing high-quality ingredients together cumulating in delicious sourdough doughnuts. The Crosstown bakers use their artful skill to create amazing housemade jams, compotes, glazes, creams, and toppings.

Crosstown prides itself on a seven-year legacy which has seen them become a staple in the London food scene.

name: Wanderers Kneaded
desc:
## Wood-Fired Pizza for Every Occasion

At Wanderers Kneaded, we bring authentic wood-fired Neapolitan pizza to events of every size—from intimate garden parties and weddings to large-scale corporate events, stadium concerts and some of Scotland's biggest festivals.

Whether we're serving 30 guests at a private celebration or thousands of people at events such as the Royal Highland Show, the Edinb…

name: Oh My Dog!
desc:
* "London's hottest dogs!" - Timeout

* "There's a hot dog revolution happening, leading the way is Oh My Dog!" - Metro UK

* "Hot dog perfection" - "The Guardian

We’re Oh My Dog!

We specialise in making hot dogs the best they possibly can be.

We’ve been dishing up dogs since the early days of the street food boom (2013!) and our mission has remained the same from day 1 - to give as many people…

name: The Hogless Roast
desc:
Winners of the Best Vegan Menu at the British Takeaway Awards, and 2025's UberEats Trailblazer Award, The Hogless Roast bring life-changing burgers, 100% plant-based! 

As well as their trademark plant-based hog roast, they've got an award-winning, fully plant-based menu, with everything from canapés and desserts, to gourmet cheese boards, and everything in between!

name: Velocefresco Pop Up Pizzas
desc: Our pizzas are cooked to perfection in our scorching wood fired oven that reaches in excess of 450 degrees, creating a mesmerising experience for your guests. Our pizzas are cut into slices and served buffet style, allowing your guests to take away their own slice of deliciousness.

name: BEYRoots Lebanese Street Food
desc: BEYRoots is the first Authentic Lebanese Street Food Company in the UK. and we are proud to do things the right way. We bring a completely authentic and sumptuous Lebanese taste experience to every person we serve, whether that is a guest at our restaurant in Tooting or a Lunchtime worker outside the Gherkin grabbing a wrap!

name: Bhajis LDN
desc:
Bhajis LDN was founded out of a deep passion for soul food, offering a contemporary twist on Indian street food that sets us apart from traditional restaurant menus. Our unique approach infuses modern elements into classic North Indian (Punjabi) cuisine.
We started trading in November 2019 as a side project, operating one day a week in East London's Hackney and St Katharine Docks.

name: East Coast Pizza Company
desc:
Greetings! I'm Chris, and I'm thrilled to welcome you to East Coast Pizza Company.
We're passionate about crafting delectable pizzas using only the finest flavours and ingredients available.

name: Hush Hush Chefs
desc:
Hush Hush Chefs are an artisan bakery who create unique butter free filo pastry savoury quiches and pies that are rarely seen in UK food markets. All of their products are made from scratch with fresh ingredients and they serve them with choice of six different healthy salads. 

The team are proud to have worked with major events and business across the country.

name: Rolling Dough
desc:
At Rolling Dough, we make wood-fired pizza out of our beautifully converted vintage horse box, catering at all sorts of events, including birthday parties, corporate events, festivals, and markets. Basically, anywhere that wants really great pizza, we're there!

Our pizza is handmade to order, with only the finest ingredients all sourced from local specialist suppliers.

name: LOKI POKE
desc:
We're LOKI POKE, Bristol-based street food experts serving up award-winning poke bowls!

Book us for healthy, freshly-made rice bowls served with sushi rice, our made-in-house sauces, pickles, fresh veg and poké.

We cater at events and festivals across the UK - everything from large events including Glastonbury Festival and Latitude, to small corporate and private events.

We offer a couple of di…

name: Wilson's Street Food
tagline: Bistro in a Bun Street Food
desc:
Established in 2018, Wilson’s Street Food is an independent family run business that is led by Steve, a professional classically trained chef with many years of experience and a passion for creating some of the best street food in the UK! 

The business has fast grown from humble roots operating from a gazebo to a specially converted food truck, which has been kitted out to be able to provide for …

name: Proove Pizza
desc:
Proove Pizza started in 2015 after a incredible pizza odyssey to Naples, Italy.
There we learned to make the best pizza in the world and brought it back to the UK.
We started getting our pizza out there on small local popups before opening our 1st restaurant.
We still love getting out and about to festivals, parties and weddings with our external catering setup. 
Why choose Proove?

name: Killa Waffles
desc: At Killa Waffles, we’re not just another food vendor, we’re waffle artists with a passion for bold flavours, fresh ingredients, and unforgettable experiences. Born from a love of street food and a drive to create something truly different, we set out to reinvent what a waffle could be.

name: Paella Garcia
desc:
We are Paella Garcia, a Spanish family-owned paellaria with a long history of providing delicious, authentic Spanish cuisine in England for over 50 years. Our recipes have been lovingly curated alongside Spanish paella chefs within our own family using traditional ingredients and techniques. 

At Paella Garcia, we prioritize flavour and authenticity to bring the traditional taste of Spain to you.

name: Aria Artisan Pizza
desc:
Hello! I'm Alessandro, and I'm the proud owner of "Honey," our vintage 1972 Citroen street van where we serve freshly made Neapolitan-style pizzas. As a Pizza Chef since 2011, I've traveled the world, serving my delicious pizzas in cities like Rome, New York, Qatar, Tokyo, and Manchester, where I was honored with an award for the best casual dining experience.

Certified by the A.O.C.R.I.

name: Triple Scoop
tagline: Ice Cream Van With a Twist
desc:
Triple Scoop is a third-generation family business with a deep-rooted passion for ice cream. With a combined industry experience of over 100 years, we take immense pride in delivering exceptional service and high-quality desserts. Our journey is built on tradition, expertise, and a genuine love for what we do.

What sets us apart is our commitment to excellence.

name: Gavin’s Pizza Co.
desc:
We’re passionate about authentic hand-crafted pizza and with our mobile pizza pod that’s what we’ll bring straight to your home, workplace or event venue. 

Our dough is fermented for a minimum of 24 hours, resulting in a light and airy texture that will leave you craving more.

name: Fender pizza
desc: Flour, sea salt, water and wild yeast; the four ingredients that began our journey into creating exceptional wood fired sourdough pizzas.  Fender Pizza are fired directly from our fully restored Landrover Defender and allow us to create a unique experiance to enjoy our hand-crafted pizzas in stunning design.

name: TriBeCa Deli & Chophouse
desc:
TriBeCa Deli - An American deli offering a range of hot sandwiches, breakfast & delicatessen favorites. 

TriBeCa Chophouse - New York steakhouse, high quality steaks with fresh sauces

Since 2017 we have been serving up sandwiches from our food truck all over London at your favorite markets, events and festivals.

name: The Proof
desc:
WE'LL BRING PUDDING. 

The Proof is a female-led dessert business based in Dalston, East-London. Famous for our Proofiteroles, award-winning mince pies and bold and beautiful shag cakes, we can make your pudding dreams come to life. From dessert tables, to layer cakes, to large events and corporate hospitality, we can bring pudding for your event no matter the size.

name: Rosto
desc:
Rosto is an event catering company based in Cheshire, UK. We trade mainly from our flagship American Food Truck at Festivals, Private Parties, Corporate Events. You will see us at Glastonbury, Goodwood and Wilderness Festival just to name a few!
Our fabulous 'STEAK FRITES' Food Truck is kitted out with a state of the art, Solar powered, commercial grade fire kitchen.

name: Crepes Masters
desc:
Crepes Masters is a charming little London-based crepe business that brings delight to your events! Our vintage Citroen HY crepe van is perfect for adding a delightful and unique touch to any occasion. 

Whether you’re looking for catering an intimate gathering or a large celebration, we offer delicious and freshly made crepes, with a variety of sweet and savoury toppings.

name: The Pizza Maker
desc:
Authentic stone baked pizza company, "The Pizza Maker" have been trading since 2014 servicing all types of events from artisan markets and festivals to corporate/private parties, including weddings. 

Along with set ups available to service all events small or large, The Pizza Maker prides themselves on the consistent quality of their pizza, ingredients and a highly competitive price point.

From …

name: Get Wurst
desc: Get Wurst serve up the best authentic German bratwurst, currywurst and vegan wurst. Their top sausages are inspired by loads of trips to Berlin and only being able to get their currywurst fix at a Christmas market in the UK, where it often isn't done very well.

name: Cafe 77 - Smash Burgers & Breakfast Buns
desc:
We’re a husband and wife team – Rowan & Hannah – and we run Cafe 77 together with a crew who have the same passion for street food that we do!

Our obsession and concept is pretty simple: Breakfast Buns and Smash Burgers using locally sourced ingredients from Hertfordshire.

name: Diplos Pizza Events
desc:
Nominated Best Newcomer 2023/24 by Togather, we are taking pizzas to a whole new level. 

We’re are a passionate family run business who are we are proud to offer our unique blend of Neapolitan and New York-style pizza that you won’t find elsewhere! 

At Diplos, we believe that the best pizzas start with the best ingredients.

name: Pura Vida Tacos
desc: Our story starts long before our trip through Mexico, it starts as childhood friends who developed a passion for entrepreneurship and other cultures and cuisines. We have always had a shared love of food and family, and were drawn to the colorful, fresh ingredients used in Mexican cuisine as well as the unity that surrounds it.

name: Heritage Dulwich
desc:
At Heritage, inspired by our ancestry and cultural past, Rich
and varied traditional-inspired cooking is re-imagined into
modern Indian dining.

We pay homage to India’s diverse culinary culture and put
a contemporary spin on traditionally grounded recipes.

name: It’s All Gravy
desc: It’s All Gravy is the ultimate celebration of one of Britain’s most iconic and comforting foods, GRAVY!

name: Chef in Jar
desc: Chef In Jar is an emerging small business founded by Zeynep Yalman. You can choose Chef In Jar for all your celebrations, parties, outdoor organizations, and family gatherings, as well as for cakes that will be specially designed for you.

name: da ja
desc:
Experience the Vibrant Flavors of the Far East with Da Ja Street Food!

Founded in 2016 by Lani Lam, a passionate travel and food enthusiast, Da Ja Street Food is more than just a business—it’s a culinary adventure that brings the electrifying flavors of the Far East to the streets of London.

name: Big Slice
desc:
About Big Slice Ltd

Big Slice was founded out of a passion for creating exceptional pizzas that deliver the perfect taste experience every time.

name: That Ziki
desc:
That Ziki, a Greek street food business that wants you to Get Your Greek On!

We are two brothers who were sick of corporate life, quit our jobs, and bought a food truck in 2021.

name: Zest Kitchen
desc:
Feel-Good Food for Every Occasion

Zest Kitchen delivers vibrant, entirely plant-based catering for corporate events, weddings and private celebrations.

Founded by Saskia and led by a passionate female team, we create bold, beautifully presented dishes inspired by global flavours and crafted with fresh, seasonal ingredients.

name: The Wedding Pizza Company
desc:
The Wedding Pizza Company has been making their delicious pizzas for weddings, parties, and corporate events since 2017.  We cover the Midlands down to central London.

Our dough is made with a starter "born" in 1908 and Caputo flour imported from Naples, a pinch of salt and purified water. No thing else!

We are capable of producing up to 100 made to order sourdough pizzas per hour.

name: Love’s Pizza Co.
desc:
Since 2022, we've been regularly visiting breweries and taprooms throughout Sussex slinging our take on Neapolitan pizza. As well as these pop-ups, we have catered for weddings, birthday parties and more in our converted street food trailer.

Good pizza starts with good dough. Our recipe uses all-organic grains milled in the UK and is given up to 48-hours to achieve a light, airy and tasty crust.

name: GUASA'
desc: GUASA' offers delicious Venezuelan Arepa buns; grilled and gluten-free corn pockets opened and filled up with a variety of fillings. They can be stuffed with all kinds of delicious things including beef, chicken, pork, and a variety of vegetarian and vegan options.

name: Persian Delights
desc: We are authentic Persian street food traders. We regularly cater for some of the top 15 festivals across the UK every year as well as lunch markets, private and corporate events across London.

name: Will's Pizza Revolution
desc:
I'm Tom Will, a 24 y/o professional chef who has converted a Vintage horse trailer into a fully equipped, lean mean pizza machine!

We provide the best Oak Fired Pizzas in Wiltshire with something for everyone! Dips, sides and desserts are also on the menu!

name: Bombayish
desc: Started by husband and wife team Nilesh and Dana, Bombayish brings refined, authentic and inventive home-style Indian street food to our customers.

name: Reyt Good Burger Co.
desc: ‘Ere at Reyt Good Burger Co. we know a thing or two about burgers made from fresh and quality locally sourced ingredients. Our burger truck is available for hire to cater for your event. From weddings to corporate do’s, festivals to private shin-digs – we’re the reyt tasty Sheffield burger truck.

name: The Wandering Pizza Co.
desc: The brilliant Wandering Pizza Co were born out of a combined love of vintage vehicles and wood-fired pizzas.

name: Serious Schnitzel - Fried Chicken
desc:
Serious Schnitzel serves up the BEST fried chicken!  

We are based in Sheffield but travel all over the UK serving up at street food events, festivals, corporates or private events where you mght need some seriously tasty street food!

name: Terra trattoria
desc:
We are Terra. Alex and Hannah Italian/English husband and wife who own and run terra we have a restaurant as well as rustic Italian style catering made with love. 
We can design bespoke menus based on the event, Canapes, buffets or sit down meal. 

Everything we make comes from our kitchen and every bit of the menu is handmade.

name: Buen Apetito Catering
desc:
Myself and Debbie started Buen Apetito on our return to the UK, having spent nearly nine years looking after the many VIP's frequenting Ibiza and Formentera between 2000 and 2009, with a fabulous team.

We took care of literally 100's of clients over those years, including regular clients.....

name: Naughty Roti
desc: The brilliant Naughty Roti were founded by the remarkable Rebecca Dean, who was motivated by a desire to showcase her grandmother's Gujurati home recipe amazing curries.

name: Berry Blue
desc: Berry Blue was born out of a passion for seasonal produce and delicious food. It started life at Louise Brown’s farm in Gloucestershire where fruit and vegetables are still grown today to use in our catering kitchens.

name: Pizza Addicts
tagline: Wood Fired Pizza in a Landy
desc:
Wood-fired pizza anyone? All pizzas are cooked in our stylish wood-fired oven in the back of a Land Rover Defender and served in slices on serving platters allowing guests to pick and choose which pizzas to enjoy. The service is typically around 2 hours.

We are a husband and wife run business and have a combined experience of 39 years in the restaurant trade.

name: Eat Momo
desc: Momo are Nepalese bite sized dumplings, addictive and moreish because they are made with care and lots of love.

name: Triple B - by Eat New York
desc: Voted Best Street Food Vendor in Manchester 2017, Triple B serve up bagels, burgers, hot dogs and fries to their adoring fanbase all over the north of England.

name: Graft Pizza
desc:
Trained in the traditional Neapolitan style under a multi award winning pizza world champion. We honed our craft at Salami Social Club. A sourdough pizzeria, rated Berlin’s #1 pizza place on TripAdvisor for 5 years running.

We specialise in catering for weddings, garden parties and corporate events.

name: Smash N' Slide
desc: Smash N' Slide a food truck based out of West London, run by a husband and wife duo slinging burgers since 2020. We started our business during lockdown at local markets and have since been serving our food at street food markets, private & corporate events and festivals.

name: Goodtimes Tacos
desc: Based in Newcastle upon Tyne, Goodtimes Tacos is a L.A. inspired street food truck. We started our business from our love of Baja (fish) tacos, and things grew from there!

name: Tanio Pizza
desc: After losing his job due to Covid in 2020, co-founder Seb went all in on something he’d wanted to do for a while, street food. It was a case of ‘if not now, when?’. With the support of his wife Kara-Jessica, Tanio was born.

name: Basili.co
tagline: Best food this side of Naples
desc:
At Basilico we travel, we taste and we toil with one unapologetic aim; to recreate the ultimate taste of Naples. 
Our state of the art van has been  working alongside everyone from Italy’s most iconic old-school "Pizzaiolo" to the young rising-star chef and the local micro-producers guarantee the quality of our craft so that you can enjoy the sublime difference of authentic Neapolitan pizza.

name: Cheeky Clucker
desc:
We're a multi-award winning Fried Chicken and Cocktails brand based in Kent.

All of our fried chicken is brined and seasoned in buttermilk for a minimum of 24 hours to make sure its packed with juice and flavour before being breaded!

name: North West Pizza
desc: North West Pizza is a family-run, professional catering company near Lancaster, covering the surrounding areas!

name: Eat Argentina
desc: Looking to bring the vibrant flavours of Argentina to your next event? Our Argentine food company specialises in delivering an authentic culinary experience that transports your guests straight to the heart of Buenos Aires.

name: Italian Recipe
desc:
Welcome to Italian Recipe: Where Artisanal Delights Come to Life! 

Italian Recipe is a delightful patisserie that brings you the true essence of traditional Italian desserts such as Tiramisu and Panna cotta  and the enchanting flavours of Sicilian Cannoli.

name: Redheads Mac 'N' Cheese
desc:
Redheads Mac ‘N’ Cheese are the only mac and cheese vendor in the North East of the UK! 

They serve up the finest mac and cheese around using the best quality ingredients available to make sure that they serve up the finest mac ‘N’ cheese you will ever have.

name: Sicily StrEATS
desc: At Sicily StrEATS we pride ourselves on using fresh ingredients to create exciting and indulgent arancini. From our rustic converted HorseBox, our Arancini is cooked fresh to order, creating a crispy golden coating. We are a modern take on a staple of Sicilian cuisine.

name: RockIT-Indian Style Street Food
desc: We provide handmade burgers packed with flavour without compromising on the quality of our freshly cooked patties, mixing traditional Indian flavours with hearty burger classics. All of our products are created to give you authentic yet tasty fusion cuisine using only local produce. We have plenty of vegan & veggie selections along with exciting lamb & chicken options.

name: Persian Deeg
desc: My name is Mina and I am the founder of Persian Deeg, London’s first Persian street food trailer. Growing up in Iran, a country with many restrictions, my mum taught me to find the beauty and art in everything. There was always a lack of avenues to indulge in creativity and express individuality. So I sought to find my creative outlet through cooking Every country expresses itself with food.

name: Hanoi Cà Phê
desc:
Hanoï Cà Phê bring you the authentic flavours of Vietnamese street food right to your next event!

They’re a Vietnamese, family-run London eatery who have been cooking up some of the most traditional street food you could ever imagine, using time-worn recipes that are guaranteed to get your guests talking!

In Vietnam, street food is about so much more than the food itself, it’s about a culture of…

name: Pizza Inferno
desc: Pizza Inferno is a family-run business bringing the fire of authentic Neapolitan pizza to the UK's markets, streets, and events. Inspired by the rich culinary heritage of Naples, we trained in Italy to perfect the art of traditional pizza-making.

name: Lady  Crepington
desc:
Lady Crepington is a lockdown success story. Set up by Rachel Done-Johnson as a project to keep her busy when her beauty business was forced to close through the pandemic, Lady Crepington has become the ‘go to’ mobile creperie.
Served from our quirky vintage horsebox, we offer a wide range of sweet and savoury crepes which are popular with children and adults alike - all made to order and using th…

name: Stoked Food
desc:
We're alll about tasty plant-based food and a professional friendly service.

Stoked Food offer all types of catering services from weddings to festivals, street food to corporate events, or film sets to birthday parties!

name: Chicken Bandits
desc: Fried chicken with south London attitude. Fried chicken lovers you are in the safest hands possible. With years of experience slinging chicken all around the UK. Chicken Bandits coming through as Londons freshest new chicken burger. Chicken Bandits have made a racquet since inception at the end of '22.

name: Little Red Food Truck
desc:
Little Red Food Truck is a friendly, fun family team that uses locally sourced ingredients to produce top quality fresh food to serve from it's vintage food truck, Ziggy.

Specialising in handmade Burgers & crispy Fried Chicken we can tailor any menu to suit any event where service will be speedy, professional and friendly.

name: Mocha & Latte Catering
desc: At Mocha & Latte Catering, our mission is to provide exceptional catering services that exceed our clients' expectations. We offer a diverse range of services to cater to all your culinary needs, whilst ensuring a seamless and unforgettable dining experience for you and your guests.

name: Patels Pies
desc: Steve’s passion for cooking began in childhood, inspired by the incredible Indian meals his grandmother lovingly prepared. That early influence led him to experiment with cooking, recreating those cherished dishes and developing his own unique take on them.

name: 1415 Asado
desc: At 1415 Asado, our specialty is open fire BBQ with a passion for South American cuisine.  Our pit master Matias, is from Buenos Aires and is leading the way in bringing the flavours of an Argentinean asado (BBQ) and the culture of open fire, to the UK.

name: Van Dough
desc:
Van Dough bake beautiful handmade sourdough pizza in a wood fired oven, all in the back of their mobile pizza van. 

Above all, they strive to make delicious pizza, and delicious pizza is made by using the best quality natural ingredients.

All their dough is made in small batches and slow risen for at least 48 hours.

name: Pan-n-Ice
desc: Pan-n-Ice is the UK’s fastest growing ice cream company, known globally for our world-famous ice cream rolls. Rolled ice cream is our signature experiential format, made fresh from scratch in under two minutes using our bespoke –30° freezing pans.

name: The Crepe Stop
desc: Based in Watford and run by the brilliant Karim, The Crepe Stop are devoted to creating the ultimate crepe experience for life’s celebrations.

name: Artisan Street Food
desc: Artisan Street Food serve up utterly delicious fresh Neapolitan pizzas from an Italian clay wood fired oven in a state of the art mobile pizzeria.

name: Smokin' Griddle
desc:
The boys at Smokin’ Griddle are known for their highly-acclaimed gourmet burgers that pack an outrageous flavour punch! 

After running their permanent site in Romford for the past 8 years and achieving local notoriety and national recognition, Smokin’ Griddle decided to bring their burgers to events.

name: Sliced Pizza Van
desc: Meet our wood-fired pizza van, based in Surrey! We’re your go-to for all things pizza, from birthdays and anniversaries to weddings and christenings. We also cater to corporate events like team-building days, employee recognition days, awards ceremonies, trade shows, leaving parties, conferences, Christmas parties, launch events, board meetings, film crew catering, and charity events.

name: Ceylon & Beyond
desc: The team at Ceylon and Beyond share a vision: to provide meaningful, quality catering for events across the spectrum.

name: The Pizza Host
desc: Our pizza van hire service is perfect for all types of special occasions, whether it’s a wedding, birthday party, corporate event, or any other celebration. Our mobile pizza van is fully equipped with everything needed to serve piping hot and freshly made pizzas on-site.

name: The Ice Chef
desc:
At The Ice Chef we bring theatre to food and drink. 

Which means added entertainment, value and something out of the ordinary to your next event. 

Check out our packages and lets work together to build memories and to get people talking.

From rolled ice cream, frozen cocktail bar , interactive desserts and smoking cocktails here at THE ICE CHEF we have it covered.

name: SliceBros Pizza
desc: SliceBros Pizza bring a taste of Italy to your event – straight from our gazebo! We specialise in crafting traditional, hand-stretched pizzas, made with the finest ingredients and cooked to perfection. Our signature black-spot crust is a testament to our dedication to Neapolitan style pizza making.

name: Bigmouths
desc: Bigmouths Catering is a bespoke catering business based in Worcestershire offering catering services for weddings, corporate events, private dining, and more.  At Bigmouths Catering, we are passionate about bringing people together over delicious food.

name: TWO ALS  BODEGA BITES
desc: The true flavours and textures of New York are found in the delis, pizza parlours and bodegas, offering up world famous, good value food for their local communities. Two Al’s Bodega Bites was conceptualised in 2022 with the goal of bringing some of these ideas and passion for affordable high quality food to the people of London for the very first time.

name: The Tikka Wrap Company
desc:
EXPERIENCED IN FESTIVAL CATERING FOR 9+ YEARS!

TRADED HIGH PROFILE MUSIC FESTIVALS - GLASTONBURY, BOOMTOWN, ISLE OF WIGHT, DOWNLOAD AND LEEDS!

The Tikka Wrap Company has been serving fresh, authentic street food across the UK's festival and events circuit since 2017.

name: Grace & Skye
desc: Grace & Skye is a dynamic catering company based in South East London focusing on unique and creative dining experiences. The start of our culinary adventure was born when we discovered our shared love of food and community. We decided to extend the invitation and host unforgettable events focusing on delectable food and great company.

name: Nina’s Taqueria
desc: Hola! We’re Nina’s, a husband and wife team spreading love with incredible plant based Mexican goodness.

name: Olarossi Kitchen - Events and Catering
desc:
Who We Are

Olarossi Kitchen is led by Keith McDowell, our Founder and Executive Chef. Keith has spent over 30 years perfecting his craft in the culinary world, bringing a wealth of experience and passion to every event we cater.

name: Kebab Cartel
desc:
Over the past 14+ years trading at street food events and major music festivals across the UK, we have built up a great reputation with our customers. 

Our food takes inspiration from pretty much anywhere we can find it, but with a bias towards the ingredients and tastes of Turkey and the Middle East. 

We love simple, honest cooking with loud colours and big bold flavours.

name: Press & Melt Grilled Cheese
desc:
I established Press & Melt Gourmet Grilled Cheese in 2014  A love of cooking and entertaining guests, and the desire to create something unique was my driving force & helped me focus on my recovery from back surgery, whilst also fulfilling my creative ambition.

We craft each sandwich with the same love & attention as the next and believe we have perfected the art of grilled cheese.

name: ¡HELADO!
desc: As a husband and wife team with both British and Mexican roots, we’re introducing the overlooked tradition of Mexican ice-cream to London’s food scene. We craft all natural, small batch, luxury ice-cream (or helado) that celebrates the wide range of vibrant flavours found across the different regions of México.

name: Dough & Deer
desc:
Born in 2015, Dough&Deer are a Land Rover Mobile Pizzeria based next to Bushy Park in Hampton, South West London. 

Dough&Deer fitted out their first military Green Land Rover Defender which they rescued from an airfield in Somerset and custom fit it with a fantastic wood-fired Pizza oven.

name: Senor Tigre
desc:
Senor Tigre is a food truck business based in Shropshire, UK that specializes in serving delicious Mexican street food. Our menu features authentic and fresh tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and other Mexican delicacies, all made with high-quality ingredients and a focus on flavor.

We provide catering services for a variety of events including weddings, festivals, and corporate gatherings.

name: CHIM CHIM
desc:
OUR BRAND

The term "Chim Chim" in Thai loosely translates to 'taste', but it holds a deeper meaning. It's an invitation to share and enjoy your food.

OUR STORY

We met in Bangkok in 2013, where Joe was teaching. We bonded over our
love for Asian cuisine and animals.

Finding it difficult to maintain a plant-based diet, Joe found himself heavily reliant on staples like Pad Thai.

name: La Pitta/The Greeks

we want to create indelible memories for you.

name: Deeney's

Next level grilled cheese toasties, burgers, and side dishes ideal for parties, corporate events and festivals.

name: What The Pitta

name: Urban Spice Box

Urban Spice Box was born out of a deep-rooted love for Punjabi cuisine and a desire to share its rich flavours with the world.

Eat Lah is all about bringing Malaysian flavours and colour to each and every dish we serve. From a well balanced blue rice bowl (Nasi Kerabu) to a rich and decadent Malaysian stable, Nasi Lemak or simply some Malaysian spice fried wings and assorted local sweet treats like kuih-muih or Malaysian inspired dessert.

Our inspiration & passion for Elote is drawn from many trips to the USA and Mexico, forming a love of the cuisine & admiration towards the culture & people,

Casual dining  with a focus towards a friendly service & authentic dishes bursting with the flavours of Mexico.

name: ProperSlices

Welcome to ProperSlices Pizza Van!

We're a young, vibrant team bringing authentic Italian pizza to your events. As a mobile pizza van, we serve delicious pizzas across South London and beyond.

- Mobile Flexibility: We bring the pizza party to you!

Sweet Treats is a family run ice cream business. We use our carts to cater for weddings, civil partnerships, corporate events and parties.
Our traditional ice cream carts are real show-pieces. Every part of the ice cream experience is bespoke, so you can choose exactly what you would like. You can select your flavours from our extensive list of award winning ice cream.

My name is Jay and I am delighted to introduce you to some of the best food in London The Suya Pit.

Homespun Pizza brings the art of Neapolitan-style pizza to match the vibe of your event.

name: The Icicle Bicycle

We're The Icicle Bicycle, with over a decade of high end pastry experience, we create small batch gelato and sorbets that suit all pallets and dietary needs to ensure that all your guests have a great gelato, a must have for any summer event!

All this packaged in a fun and whimsical bicycle to bring a really unique element to your event that will not be soon forgotten by your guests.

Ideal for t…

desc:
Please allow me to introduce you to The StreetBaller - Birmingham's latest (and only) meatball based street food trader, purveyors of delicious meatball creations, served with a smile and a lot of passion right across the Midlands and further afield.

As a long-time lover of Brum’s vibrant street food scene, I knew I wanted to someday be a part of the community.

name: Oh Babu

MiaMel’s delicacies are made with love, with the freshest ingredients and elegance.

Our slow-roasted, succulent pork, cooked to perfection with crispy crackling, is the centerpiece of a feast that will leave your guests raving.

name: FEAST.London

FEAST. concept is all about great meat and big flavours. To create our dishes, we only use premium cuts of Angus beef to gourmet grills and the best British lamb or chicken that we can find.

We take simple ingredients and make them seriously tasty. As a promise to you,  FEAST.

Brilliant head chef Henning makes annual trips to Mexico each year to further increase his taco inspiration and sources his ingredients from local suppliers to make sure that they're as fresh as anything could ever be!

At OPA, we don’t just serve Greek-inspired food. We serve food that is Greek.

The meat is all slow-cooked and smoked after being marinated in a bespoke spice rub, making it deli…

name: Man in Pasta
desc: We are a group of Italian friends that has been working in fine Dining Restaurant for many years. We have been working for institution restaurant such as Locanda Locatelli,  Sartoria, Ivy ....

name: Ehla
desc:
With family roots in Cyprus, Ehla is inspired by the flavours of this region. 

Mezze platters, feasting tables, pitta wraps and mezze bowls. Slow cooked meats, seasonal and sensational salads, homemade dips and sauces, handmade pastries, grilled vegetables Ehla has something for every occasion.

name: Freewheelin' Pizza
desc:
The fantastic brother and sister owned Freewheelin' serve authentic wood-fired pizza using locally sourced, seasonal produce. They strive to find the best ethical suppliers of meat, fish and dairy for a unique yet classic menu of amazing toppings.

Their colourful and vibrant van is fully equipped with a wood-fired oven installed.

name: Rice Bandits
desc:
We offer authentic Malaysian/Singaporean rice and noodle bowls, such as our signature beef rendang and braised pork belly. In London, these
dishes are typically served in Asian sit-down restaurants, however, we like to stick to our rootsand serve these dishes as a fast takeaway, as how it is done in Singapore/Malaysia.

name: Jrk Bros.
desc:
Born from a love of Grandma's cooking, Jrk Bros puts a modern twist on the traditional Caribbean classic. The perfect balance of culture, creativity and JRK makes sure that every dish is authentic, tasty and original. 

From our JRK Chicken, Sweet N Spicy Fried Wings to our array of irresistible fusion burgers, our JRK BROS.

name: Chop & Chip Co
desc:
Chop and Chip Co is a specialist BBQ catering company, founded in 2013 with a street food heritage.

Fuelled by their desire to offer restaurant quality dishes on-the-go, they set out to create a new and unique BBQ style food concept and Chop and Chip Co was born.

name: Crepe Salut
desc: At Crepe Salut, we’re more than just a catering service—we’re a culinary adventure on wheels. Our six stunning vintage Citroën HY Vans bring a touch of retro charm and gourmet flair to every event across London, Surrey, Kent, and Sussex.

name: Parma Medics
desc:
After many years running Michelin starred restaurants, Russell has launched his food truck serving Australian cuisine from a converted NHS ambulance. 
We’re excited to be the first Australian street food truck in London, serving Chicken Parmas , Aubergine Parmas, fried chicken Dim Sims and Golden Gaytime ice cream.

name: The Ultimate Gourmet Burger Company
desc:
Since we founded UGBC (Ultimate Gourmet Burger Co.) in 2021, our mission has been simple—bringing people together over fantastic food. Whether it’s at a festival, sports event, or corporate gathering, there’s nothing we love more than seeing that first-bite smile.
But we’re not just here to serve gourmet burgers; we’re here to make your event memorable.

name: Tin Box Pizza
desc: At Tin Box Pizza, we are a family-owned business in the Holme Valley, dedicated to serving mouth-watering wood-fired sourdough pizzas.

name: Ansum Food Co.
desc: Ansum food co. is our beautiful vintage food truck specialising in wood fired food and based on the North coast of Cornwall. And us, Amie and John.

name: Northern Bloc. Ice Cream Truck
desc:
Join us on this mouthwatering journey as we spread the joy of Northern Bloc ice cream across the UK. From Festivals to  Corporate Events, Weddings, Brand Activations, Product Launches and sporting events. We're determined to elevate the ice cream van experience at events. 
We have 2 super cool Northern Bloc.

name: The Bonobo British Street Food
desc:
The Bonobo is a grilled cheese company that prides itself on using only the finest British ingredients to create delicious sandwiches that are sure to satisfy any craving. Each sandwich is made with sourdough bread, which is known for its tangy flavor and firm texture that perfectly complements the gooey melted cheese.

What sets The Bonobo apart is commitment to sustainability.

name: 10GS Events
desc: At 10GS Events, sister company to Soho favorite 10 Greek Street, we create delicious, modern European food focusing on seasonal ingredients sourced, where possible, locally and with a strong emphasize on sharing. We emphasize minimal to zero wastage and both our wine and food have a long earned reputation for being reasonably priced, full of flavour and innovation but with a nod to the classics.

name: RDG EVENTS
desc:
RDG Events – Family-Run, Passionately Served  

At RDG Events, we’re a  family-run business  led by myself and my husband, with the support of wonderful family and friends. We take pride in bringing  great food and warm hospitality to every event we attend.  

Our first trailer,  Little Flo , a beautifully converted vintage horsebox, is named in honour of my late mother 'Veronica Florence'.

name: Original Greek Souvlaki
desc:
We are Original Souvlaki.

Our menu is packed with traditional mouth-watering souvlaki (Pork, Chicken,  Vegan Gyros, Lamb), traditional Greek salads, and other Greek delights.

We are committed to maintaining high standards of food quality and ensuring sustainable practices in all aspects of our business.

Providing exceptional customer service is at the heart of our business.

We understand the i…

name: Beaufort & Barley
desc:
We are Beaufort & Barley. A bespoke catering company based in Worthing, West Sussex, specialising in using high quality and sustainable produce.
Growing up in Sussex meant for us as chefs, we got to appreciate the high quality of produce locally grown all around us.

name: Lemon Grove Catering
tagline: Gourmet Burgers, Kebabs, Bowl Food & More
desc:
Lemon Grove Catering offer a brilliant catering service combining handmade, fresh menus and their passion for presentation and hospitality all from the rustic kitchen of their converted 1978 Bedford CF motorhome.

They take inspiration from all areas of cuisine and are able to offer a wide range of different menus from street food gourmet burgers to formal canapés and three-course meals.

name: Nha Trang Kitchen
desc:
The wonderful Nha Trang serve up utterly delicious, completely authentic Vietnamese food using only family recipes.

The food is fresh, vibrant and incredibly well sourced.

name: Edwards Event Catering Limited
desc: I’m the proud founder and director of Edwards Event Catering, an ice cream specialist company built on over a decade of experience in the event catering industry. From an early age, I was inspired by the buzz and excitement of live events and knew I wanted to create something of my own.

name: Fat Annie's Stateside Street Food
desc: Fat Annie’s have been slinging their wares from a custom built New York style hot dog cart since 2014.  After an inspirational trip to America the owner James set up Fat Annie's to bring the flavours and atmosphere he experienced to the UK.

name: Los Churros Amigos
desc: Since 2012, Los Churros Amigos have been serving the freshest churros and melted Belgian chocolate. They aim to excel in two key aspects: quality and efficiency. To do this they come armed with the right equipment, the hardest working and friendliest staff, and almost an infinite amount of churros!

name: Harissa and Lemon
desc:
ABOUT US
Harissa & Lemon serves Moroccan street food as no other. We combine fresh, locally sourced ingredients with traditional Moroccan recipes to create some mouthwatering dishes.

We want people to properly experience the richness and great variety of the Moroccan kitchen. We feel it has been misrepresented for too long and people have been missing out on some great stuff.

name: High Steaks
desc:
High Steaks use the very best local ingredients alongside inspiration from years of travel and research to create uniquely delicious steak sandwiches on the streets of Bristol and the West Country.

All of the beef used in our steak sandwiches is sourced from pasture fed herds which have been reared in the fields of the south west!

name: Red Chutney
desc: Red Chutney is a location catering company with over 15 years experience in Film & Television Catering. Chutney is full to the brim of people with a passion for delivering innovative, fresh, locally sourced food. We all take pride in what we do and our team are the heart and soul of every event that we cater for.

name: Plantain Kitchen
desc:
Plantain Kitchen, a West African street food brand based in London, was founded by Toby due to his frustration with the lack of representation of West African food in the UK.

Specializing in West African combination bowls inspired by the fusion of Ghanaian and Nigerian cuisine, our goal is to innovate and deliver our products to the UK consumer base while focusing on the exciting flavors our food…

name: Burger Burger
desc:
burgerbuger  London-based streetfood pop-up.

Founded during lockdown, starting its journey in Norwich and quickly making a name at London Festivals such as Brockwell Summer Series and South Facing. 

What makes us stand out? 
It's our unwavering commitment to quality. We proudly source our beef from a local Bermondsey butcher, ensuring it's free-range, grass-fed, and always top-tier.

name: Lime Hut
desc: Lime Hut are a contemporary Caribbean BBQ brand with a focus on FEEL-GOOD FOOD with wonderful Caribbean, Mediterranean and British twists.

name: The Outdoor Gourmets
desc:
Wood fired pizza direct from Juddy our Land Rover Defender 

Juddy's oven cooks delicious homemade Neapolitan pizza in 90 secs. Reaching temperatures of over 450 degrees. He is the perfect catering option for any party and a real head turner and talking point.

name: SmokeBox
desc:
SmokeBox is a BBQ street food business that was set up after numerous trips to South America.  After trying my first asado cooked by Uruguayan relatives, I was hooked and decided to bring some of the techniques and flavours back to use in my street food.
Since starting in 2020 I have cooked for many private events as well as food and drink festivals.

name: The Family Meal
desc:
WHATS ON OFFER
From family style feasts, to pizza oven nights, fire cooked banquets, fine dining sit down meals, big sharing buffets or canapé parties. Ian loves working with his clients to produce a personalised and remarkable food experience. He also offers cookery and food experience with plenty of areas to choose from such as sourdough, foraging, fermenting or just good ol cooking!

name: Naan and Sizzle
desc: At Naan & Sizzle our traditional methods bring the rich flavors of the bustling streets to your event.

name: Good Food Cartel
desc:
Good Food Cartel is an independent mobile kitchen specialising in  Mexican Street Food cuisine.
Our business was born out of a desire to create a quality and fun dining experience with great food.

name: Gyro Guys
desc:
A family run business that was set up pre lockdown, Gyro Guys aims to give customers the taste of Athens whilst being in the UK.

After leaving school, Ireland and myself have built Gyro Guys into what it is today, we haven’t been employed by anyone else other than ourselves, as we have strived to make Gyro Guys the best it can be.

This has led us to do amazing events, such as Bite Street and Tol…

name: Puff Puff Ministry
desc:
Puff Puff Ministry is a sister-run business shaking up the UK dessert scene with our delicious West African doughnuts (known as puff puff) – made with mum's 20-year old recipe.

Brands like Google, Netflix, TikTok, Peloton, Salesforce and Meta have already fallen in love with our puff puff.

name: Belly's
desc:
Bellys is a street food caterers business owned by 2 close friends who have a passion for food, inspired by simple and punchy flavours using only locally sourced, organic and artisan ingredients.

We specialise in Burgers but also have a long line of specials that we can serve.

Our meat is sourced from the only certified organic butchers in Norfolk (Harvey's Pure Meat).

name: Destination Burger (Midlands)
desc:
The Street Meat Vans of Wall Street, New York City, 2004.
I can remember it like it was yesterday.

Adam's journey started over 20 years ago on. The smells, the vibrant flavours, the food trucks thrilling with their grilling, the passion and energy oozing from the guys dishing up these incredible edibles. 
I was hooked. And fascinated.

name: Absolutely Delicious Ltd
desc:
At Absolutely Delicious Ltd, we’re a family-run food business rooted in rich Jamaican heritage and a deep love for soulful, flavour-filled cooking. Our story is one of tradition, passion and professional excellence, a blend of generations-old recipes and the refined skills of trained chefs.

Every dish we serve begins with our foundation; the bold, vibrant flavours of Jamaica.

name: In Pizza We Crust
desc:
The Crust that Unites.
In Pizza We Crust is  the Perfect Pizza for Every Event!
 
Choose the most authentic pizza experience for your function and impress your guests with our eye-catching Mobile Pizzeria. 

Authenticity - Our brand emerges from a true love for our pizza bases, hand-stretched with care by skilled pizzaiolos in the Italian Village of San Severino Marche.

name: Pasta Evangelists Catering
desc:
Pasta Evangelists serves the finest artisan pasta dishes. From pappardelle with wild boar ragu to lobster tortelloni or orecchiette with pistachio pesto, the team pride themselves on delighting with their fresh, handmade pasta & authentic tastes of Italy.

Pasta Evangelists have a permanent concession within the newly-refurbished Harrods Food Hall, where they serve hundreds of customers (and perha…

name: Acai Girls
desc:
Acai Girls offers a selection of healthy & plant-based dishes for all-day dining. The perfect answer to nutritious flavoursome food. 

Our menu is specifically designed with the micronutrients in mind in order to nourish and maintain a healthy mindset and body. The menu is a celebration of all the fresh, delicious, local food inspired by our travels around the world.

name: Joe's Diner
desc: Joe's Diner is a family-run food truck based in Redhill, Surrey, serving up the most delicious and mouth-watering gourmet 6oz and 12oz loaded steak burgers, loaded gourmet skin-on fries, curly fries, cajun fries, halloumi fries, southern fried chicken wraps and burgers, and much more.

name: Stag Bites The Hog
desc:
The brilliant Stag Bites The Hog serve up some of the very best street food.  Specialising in BBQ slow cooked & smoked dishes, they can cook up all different kinds of food to your specifications whatever your event, be a wedding, festival, market or birthday!

Their bright orange retro 1973 Citroen food truck shows exactly what they are all about… creativity and fun!

name: Papi Chulo
desc: Papi Chulo is an authentic Mexican food concept drawing inspirations from real street taquerias in Mexico. Their motto is “pura calidad” which means pure quality. There is no compromise in their cooking.

name: Roxie's BBQ Spot
desc:
Roxie’s BBQ Spot serves up seriously tasty cuts of meat such as pork shoulder, beef brisket and lamb shoulder, all slow cooked for a total of 10 hours and served with a selection of mouth-watering sides including merguez-style lamb sausages, fresh seasonal salads, Ancho chilli hummus and flatbread.

The meat is all slow-cooked and smoked after being marinated in a bespoke spice rub, making it deli…

name: The Salsa Guys
desc:
Gourmet Street Food That Brings the Fiesta
Bold flavours, unforgettable salsas, & great vibes?  The Salsa Guys brings Mexican street food magic straight to your event.

We’re The Salsa Guys, your go-to Mexican street food catering crew. We cater for weddings, parties, celebrations & more.

We don’t just serve food, we serve flavour-packed experiences.

name: Chubby Dumpling
desc:
The brilliant Chubby Dumpling is brought to you by father and daughter duo Joe and Chantel. This dynamic duo serves up dumplings using original recipes passed all the way down their family tree for generations and they'd love to serve them up at your event!

Dad Joe ran his own restaurant for 31 years and has been making dumplings since he was a kid running around the streets of Hong Kong.

name: Feast Pembrokeshire
desc: Our approach to our food is simple… source high quality, local ingredients. Cook them with passion, care and attention. Be creative.

name: The Cheesy Pig
tagline: Best pulled pork in the game!
desc: The Cheesy Pig is a family run business that was set up by the business owner Sam during lockdown. As a qualified chef in the Royal Air Force he really enjoys making food for our family and friends so when he wasn't able to do this at home he thought how could he take his food to people. He wanted to create good classic food with a bit of fun twist and most importantly BIG portion sizes.

name: Hamilton Catering
desc: Like many people during the 2020 global pandemic we found ourselves reflecting on what really mattered and what we really wanted to do.

name: Fat Annie's Stateside Street Food
desc: Fat Annie’s have been slinging their wares from a custom built New York style hot dog cart since 2014.  After an inspirational trip to America the owner James set up Fat Annie's to bring the flavours and atmosphere he experienced to the UK.

desc: Stoked Eats are taking the South East by storm with their awesome bright blue food truck from which they serve epic pizzas.

desc:
We are Marvellous Medicine.
We specialise in amazing hand stretched Pizza served from our quirky vintage horse trailers!
We also offer canapés, side salads, antipasti boards and much more!  We love to create bespoke menus for your event.

name: Lime Hut
desc: Lime Hut are a contemporary Caribbean BBQ brand with a focus on FEEL-GOOD FOOD with wonderful Caribbean, Mediterranean and British twists.

name: BB Pizza
desc:
At BB Pizza , we’re more than just a pizzeria, we’re a duo of passionate pizza lovers, Eve and Karim, dedicated to crafting authentic, artisan pizzas. With over 20 years of experience in the food industry, we turned our love for great pizza into a thriving mobile pizzeria, serving up hand-stretched, high-quality pizzas from our beautiful brand New Red Airstream trailer.
Our secret?

name: La Levantina Paella
desc:
LA LEVANTINA, SPAIN ON THE MOVE

All our food is cooked by Jorge, our Spanish chef from Levante, whose family has been making delicious paellas and typical Spanish food since 1920.

La Levantina respects the tradition of authentic paella. We use the best rice, a variety called Bomba, which was created specifically for making quality paellas.

name: Siena Pizza Co
desc:
Siena Pizza Co is a proudly family-run business bringing the true taste of wood fired pizza straight to your event. Our professionally converted pizza vans feature stunning clay oven that fires out pizzas with serious flavour and flair.

As a family, food is in our blood. We’ve been in the catering world for three generations, running Italian restaurants across London and Brighton.

name: Trott & Whinny Ltd
desc: Hi, my name is Olivia. I'm the owner of Trott & Whinny Ltd, the home of delicious burgers, great energy & unbreakable entrepreneurial spirit!

name: Lo Viet
desc: Lo Viet is founded by Tammi during the Lockdown, with the help of her brother and parents. We cater for events, markets and festivals using recipes passed down from Grandma, mum and aunties! We even bake our own bánh mì baguettes - hand rolled, light, airy and golden on the outside.

name: Chennai Express
desc: In the vibrant heart of Basingstoke, a unique culinary adventure was born, thanks to the vision and passion of two chefs who shared a deep love for South Indian cuisine.

name: Select Food Trucks
desc: Select Food Trucks are a small family run company with a real passion for providing the most unique food truck experience for your event!

name: The Two Foodies Burger
desc:
There's no easier way of putting this: gourmet restaurant quality food at street food prices, prepared by top professional London chefs. The Two Foodies produce a brilliant menu using seasonal produce and offer a variety of gourmet burgers and delicious sides.

Julio and Murilo met twenty years ago while working in a top London restaurant kept in touch throughout their careers.

name: Chill Gelato
desc: Ciao, I'm Fabio and owner of Chill Gelato.  Although I may not look or sound Italian I feel I've got best of both worlds having been born here in London to Italian parents. Food has played a big part of our family and I'm now carrying on the tradition with a modern take, offing an authentic gelato that happens to be vegan friendly.

name: Junk Soul Smothered
desc: Welcome to Junk Soul Smothered, a fully independent plant-based catering experience! Established in 2020, Junk Soul Smothered has been at the forefront of revolutionizing plant-based cuisine.

name: & chill
desc: & chill is a small-batch gelato company making playful, indulgent ice cream with a twist. Founded by myself - Larissa, a lifelong dessert obsessive, & chill was born from a love of flavour and a desire to bring something a little more cheeky (and a lot more delicious) to the London ice cream scene.

name: Christies Catering
desc:
Hi, I’m Jon Christie. I have a passion for food and many years of personal top flight experience, working in Michelin starred restaurants in the UK. 

I have the expertise and knowledge to personally work with you to produce beautiful food for the party of your dreams.  

From 7 course fine dining experiences to children’s parties, we have the knowledge to bring your special gathering to life.

name: Faithful Flame
desc:
We cater all types of events from anywhere between 30 to 150 pizzas a night as well as all day events reaching up to 200 pizzas a day! 
Accommodating all types of pizza topping requests & allergens. 
Everyone should be able to eat what they want, how they want.

Our horsebox has been converted to a high standard with a modern rustic aesthetic to give you a pizza parlour on wheels.

name: Sarv's Slice
desc:
We're Sarv & Disha, a family run team, born and brought up in West London, who decided to build a business centred on bringing people together with fantastic food. 

We started by combining a passion for good rustic cooking with the fine-dining techniques Sarv picked up through his work in some of the best michelin-starred kitchens in the world.

name: Rustic Roast
desc:
About Rustic Roast
I’m Mark, a professionally trained chef with over 30 years of experience in the industry.

name: Buttercup Bus Vintage Campers
desc:
Buttercup Bus Vintage Campers is a Croydon business with a fleet of classic VW Camper food trucks, indoor themed carts and events vehicles.

Certified with a 5 star food hygiene rating, this company has been trading for over 15 years, with £10m PL cover and we are members of NCASS.

We have a fleet of 9 classic campervans and props, and trade in the events industry, providing:
- Campervan ice crea…

name: Dough with the Flow
desc:
We are a family run business based in Hemel Hempstead. A lockdown start up inspired by our dream of running our own business and our love of fresh pizza. 
We create Italian Style wood fired pizzas from our contemporary converted horse box. 
Using fresh locally sourced ingredients and cooked at 400 degrees we deliver a light crispy base topped with the finest ingredients.

name: Roll Me Up
desc:
Roll Me Up – Live Rolled Ice Cream & Dessert Theatre for Corporate Events, Exhibitions & Brand Activation

Unlike a traditional dessert station, every serving at Roll Me Up is prepared fresh in front of your guests on frozen pans using fresh Cotswold ice cream.

name: Rico Burrito
desc:
We are an independent street food business based in Camden, London, offering a unique and nutritious Mexican food experience. Our primary products are Burritos and Naked Bowls, filled with traditional rice, salad and cheese, as well as very unique fillings! 

Our food is designed to be eaten on the go and with ease, and our menu is entirely halal, with vegetarian and vegan options available.

name: Baba Dhaba
desc:
Baba Dhaba are a newly opened street food brand bringing their banging Pakistani street eats to the masses.

The stall is run by BBQ’ing Baba's. They use authentic recipes that have been passed down and tweaked ever so slightly by the duo.

name: Ranch Pizzas  & Grill
desc:
Ranch Pizzas are a mobile pizza company, making delicious hand made authentic Italian pizzas using just four ingredients! 
We have 2 large mobile wood fired ovens, so producing quality food in quick time, 

We have tasty BBQ food including gourmet burgers, chicken wings, sausages and more, all freshly made and full of flavour.

name: TGDG MIDLANDS LTD
desc:
Exceptional Street Food. Professional Chefs. Unforgettable Events.

We bring together the excitement of street food with the standards of professional catering.

name: Happy Go Souvlaki
desc:
At Happy Go Souvlaki, we're not just serving up delicious bites; we're crafting moments that'll have your guests raving long after the event. Picture this: a feast of succulent gyros wraps, vibrant salads, and tantalising tzatziki, bringing a taste of Greece to your wedding, birthday bash, or any fabulous event you're planning.

Why choose Happy Go Souvlaki for your special day?

name: Party Trays!
desc:
Our dishes are created with passion and care creating  unique  experiences for you and your guests. Our experienced and dedicated team is committed to bringing you dishes that are ethically sourced; freshly cooked daily and delivered with love to elevate your dining pleasure.

Drawing inspiration from Northern African, Indian, Caribbean, and Modern European cuisine these eclectic influences and fl…

name: Mama Sue's
desc: After a solid career in fine dining, Katie hung up her chef's whites a few years ago to bring superlative sausages and burgers to the party.  Katie and her team are super passionate about using quality local ingredients and providing a bespoke service for every event they cater. What’s more, they collaborate with their local butcher to make the sausages, so you can't get these dogs anywhere else!

name: Zindiya Streatery & Bar
desc:
Zindiya is an Indian Streatery and bar created by husband and wife team, Ajay & Shivani Kenth, who have planned this venture since their teenage years. 
Their concept was to create an immersive experience of India – drinking chai or Limca, eating chaat and gol gappe – in a casual and fun environment.
Over 15 years later, the idea came to life with ZINDIYA.

name: The Cheese Toaster
desc:
We are a London based street food company serving flat-iron cheese toasties, we combine award winning British cheese with the finest ingredients between slices of crunchy artisan sourdough.

​The Cheese Toaster was formerly a working Horse-box and has been converted into a giant toaster on wheels.

name: Sweet Lounge
desc:
At Sweet Lounge, we specialise in making your event unforgettable. With years of experience, our team provides high quality service no matter the size of your event. Our range of sweet items to hire includes an ice cream tricycle, sweet carts, fresh popcorn cart, candy floss, and more.

Looking to impress your guests? Look no further than Sweet Lounge.

name: Let's Go Street Food
desc: Let's Go Street Food is one of the largest on-the-road only street food companies in the UK. After falling in love with the street food industry as a teenager, I have been continually growing this business for the last 14 years.

name: Spanglish
desc: We're a family-owned Spanish catering business specializing in tapas and paella. Our team of culinary experts with 20+ years of experience prepares both traditional and contemporary dishes that are visually stunning and delicious. We use locally sourced ingredients to make our paellas in authentic pans and offer a variety of classic Spanish tapas.

name: Chirpy Chicken
desc:
At Chirpy Chicken, we pride ourselves on bringing to you the best buttermilk fried chicken around.

We believe  that the flavour should be all about the chicken and not just the sauce and toppings.

After working in the industry for many years, we have spent a great deal of time perfecting our mouth-watering recipe of herbs and spices for you to enjoy.

We Cater  for all types of events ranging fr…

name: Yonder Street Food
desc:
Welcome to Yonder!
We are a street food family specialising in artisan sourdough pizza, based in the beautiful county of South Lakes, Cumbria. We pride ourselves on using the highest quality meats, vegetables, flours, and cheeses.

name: Canteen
desc:
OUR STORY

Welcome to Canteen, where the vibrant flavours of Bombay meet the streets of London. Founded by local food enthusiasts Anshul Doshi and Rajat Sood, our food truck is a culinary journey inspired by the bustling roadsides of Mumbai.

name: The Smokewood Catering Company
desc: We tailor our catering services to each client's unique needs and preferences.  We are passionate about getting to know our customers and lovingly crafting a menu that is unique to each event.

name: Mamacita's Catering Services
desc:
Welcome to Mamacitas Catering Services - Where Exceptional Dining Meets Unforgettable Moments in the Heart of London!

At Mamacitas Catering, we don't just serve food; we craft experiences that linger in your memory long after the last bite.

name: The Belgian Waffle Box
desc:
Welcome to The Belgian Waffle Box. 

We serve authentic liege waffles from our quirky neon pop up! The Belgian Waffle Box was formed 9 years by two friends who had a passion for delivering quality desserts!

We specialise in waffles crafted with a sweet brioche style dough that is infused with camerlised sugar pearls that create a crunchy outside and a soft inside.They are usually topped with conf…

name: Marley's Tacos
desc:
Marley’s Tacos brings the vibrant spirit of Mexican street food to events across Manchester and beyond. Born from a love of bold flavours and a passion for sharing great food with people, we set out to create more than just tacos — we create an atmosphere that guests remember long after the last bite.

Our set-up is designed to bring a festival vibe to any occasion.

name: Meat Outdoors
desc: The wonderful Meat Outdoors offer exceptional-quality BBQ & hog roast catering at all kinds of events.

name: Hidden Pizza
desc:
Hidden Pizza are award winning caterers from North Dorset. We have 12 year experience catering everything from wedding and corporate events to large festivals like Glastonbury.
We are passionate about pizza and the planet. We use the finest ingredients, from producers and suppliers who are actively engaged with improving the sustainability of their operations.

name: Greeklicious
desc:
Greek family, street food vendor with hospitality experience in Greece and UK.

Offering Authentic Greek street food, with choices including chicken and pork gyros, Horiatiko (Village) sausage, Grilled Halloumi, Plant based gyros, our offering can cater for all dietary requirements, (GF, Dairy/Nut free, Halal).

name: Chef Lopez Events
desc: Chef Lopez Events is a renowned events company that specializes in elevating every occasion to the next level.

name: Matchbox Pizza Co.

A real link up

Naked Chips serving the best Dutch style fries.

About Us

name: The Proper Pizza Co

desc:
Antonino’s Pizza bring you the authentic taste of Neapolitan sourdough pizza served from their beautiful 1988 vintage Piaggio. Their lovely van would be an amazing addition to almost any event and the pizza that they serve from it matches how good it looks.

If Naples is the spiritual home of pizza, Antonino brings the magic of pizza to you with his authentic, hand-selected ingredients.

name: Pecoro on the Road
desc:
In 2016 we took over a run down café and transformed it into a community hub and little by little we built a great reputation for friendly service, good food and a great atmosphere. We now bring this ethos with us to events around Bedfordshire and surrounding counties with the help of our professionally converted, great looking van.

We believe memorable food helps create memorable occasions.

name: The Otley Burger Company
desc:
Perfect for any occasion, The Otley Burger Company create some of the most delicious burgers in West Yorkshire! 

After a change in career to follow his passion, since 2019 head chef and creator of the Otley Burger Company, Joe, has been perfecting what they perceive to be the ultimate burger.

desc:
Falafel Baffle offers homemade, authentic Middle Eastern cuisine. Ensuring everyone can enjoy our food, we cater for those with dietary requirements and allergies in mind. We once served a coeliac-safe wedding for 100 guests to enjoy! 

Our popular dishes include our speciality Falafel, authentic Chicken Shawarma, sweet Baklava, and our beloved Hummus.

name: The Salad Kitchen

We are an independent chain of salad shops across central London. Founded by Sam and Ross in 2014 with a mission to create the most versatile and deliciously indulgent salads on the market...

We care about the planet.

They provide a choice of flavours of amazing  ice cream and sorbets and always make sure to have both gluten and dairy free options available.

The Roast Wrap Co. – Yorkshire Pudding Wraps by The Roast Wrap Girls

Smoking daily from their award winning Smokehouse located in the centre of Oxford Burnout BBQ are guaranteed to serve you great tasting authentic BBQ food in true American style With all the food being made in house.

name: bread&truffle

Why Bread & Truffle?

Every focaccia is freshly baked using carefully selected ingredients, many sourced directly from Italy.

Our clients can choose the option of a strictly vegan / vegetarian food stall as our Veggie Guru or Guru Chef where serve also meat dishes.

name: The English Indian
desc:
Based in the Midlands and established in 2015, The English Indian brings the vibrant flavours of traditional Indian Street Food to life. Our innovative Indian Style Fish & Chips and Kashmiri Fried Chicken & Chips form the heart of our multi-award-winning menu.

The English Indian has grown into a leading Corporate Street Food Supplier.

We source our ingredients from all over the world and prepare our Gelato with artisanal skills honed over many years and learned from the Italian masters of the craft.

name: S’mores Station
desc:
Keep calm and get your s'mores on

Based on a long standing American camp fire tradition, a S'more is a toasted marshmallow placed on a square of chocolate and sandwiched between two biscuits or crackers -  it's a delicious, gooey treat that you and your guests will love. 
We bring the flame trays and you can toast your own marshmallow.

Our journey began with a passion for bringing the rich, diverse flavors of Indian street food to the heart of Staines, focusing on traditional recipes passed down through generations.

name: Hide & Greek
desc: Hide & Greek is a modern Greek street food brand built around a simple idea: doing the classics properly. The business started from a borrowed grill and a small gazebo and has grown through a focus on consistency, efficiency, and strong food.

desc:
Pig's Pizzas started in Joe's back garden in the Summer 2022 but had their first event with the Gloucestershire/World King of Sauces, Tubby Tom in October 2022. Joe & Ian have been slinging pizzas from Porky the shiny, sexy trailer since April 2023 and been non-stop since.

The arrival of Porky the airstream style trailer really enhanced our professional image and everyone absolutely loves Porky.

name: Sanjha on the Go
desc: Welcome to Sanjha on the Go, where we bring the authentic flavors of India’s vibrant street food culture straight to your table.

name: Northern Burger

We are a unique smash burger caterer based in Sheffield, making quality street food with a Northern twist (obviously smashing out Henderson’s relish related snap at every opportunity 😂) 

We have a diverse range of food options, from classic to speciality burgers, insane chips & memorable accompaniments/sides.

name: The Happy Pot
desc: I'm a Nigerian-born Londoner who's been obsessed with food since I was a kid. I started my first food stall, Rendang! Thank you ma'am, in 2018. My slow cooked coconut curry have received rave reviews from customers and critics alike.

name: Come N Go Souvlaki (GREEK)
desc: Come’N Go Souvlaki was born from a passion for authentic Greek street food and a love of bringing people together through flavour. Founded by Erint Petsani, who grew up between Greece and the UK, our food is inspired by traditional recipes passed down through family kitchens and perfected in bustling street food markets.

name: UDLÈ BURGERS
desc: Udlè Burgers is a British burger business, that first opened in 2022 at the Greenwich Market. We aim to serve the best burgers across the UK. We make everything we can ourselves, and we even press our patties ourselves so be sure our meat is 100% clean and fresh.

name: The Dough Job
tagline: New York pizza by the slice
desc: We started our business with one simple idea: festivals deserve genuinely great food. What began as a love for New York–style pizza quickly turned into an obsession with getting it right. It took us ages to perfect our dough recipe, tweaking, testing, and starting again until we landed on something we were truly proud of.

name: Scott and Wilson
desc: Well established and family run restaurant now providing outside catering in your own home or via our "SCOTT AND WILSON ON TOUR" food truck. Award winning food to cater all tastes. Burgers, pizza, bao's, Lebanese, Thai curries, design your own stir-fry, tapas, junk food, vegan food, funky food. You ask and we can provide it.

name: Cheeky Burger
desc:
Winner of best Burger of UK 2016 in British Street Street Food Awards and finalist of 2017, Cheeky Burger are definitely doing something right!

The company's run by a wonderful couple - Marta and Sebastien. The charming Seb appeared on Masterchef Professionals and is classically trained French chef while Marta's the one putting in the hard graft at all the events!

name: TWO DOTS
desc:
Who we are?
Two Dots Catering, founded by Doni Ramalho and Chef Marcilio Da Silva, is a central London-based company specialising in corporate catering, themed parties, and food pop-ups. We’re passionate about creating unique dining experiences with fresh, high-quality dishes and personalised service.

name: Barney & The Pizza
desc: Barney & The Pizza is a mobile street food company of the finest handmade wood-fired pizzas that started in January 2017 when we bought our first two horse trailers - hint - we didn’t intend on getting two but we accidentally won both auctions.

name: dumpling pimps
desc: Dumpling Pimps was born in lockdown, when two techies walked away from the 9-to-5 to focus on food. What began in a home kitchen has grown into a street food business built on bold Nepalese flavours with a Korean edge, rooted in proper craft and no shortcuts.

name: The Joint
desc:
The Joint is taking the capital by storm with their awesome and totally delicious BBQ food. They have two locations in London and were winners of the ‘Best Wild Wing’ in 2015 as well as being featured on Tom Kerridge’s ‘Best Ever Dishes’ - these guys know what's what when it comes to BBQ food!

Absolutely everything on their menu is made in-house, from their infamous bread rolls and sauces, right …

name: Pizzeria Da Giorgio!
desc:
About Giorgio’s Pizza!
Giorgio’s Pizza was set up by George self-confessed pizza enthusiast and our quality comes from the passion George has for Pizza.

We're proud to offer the highest quality of ingredients, and we put lots of love and careful attention into each Pizza.
Our Pizza dough is made fresh in house with high-quality flour and topped up with fresh ingredients from our Italian suppliers…

name: Sticky Beaks / Bento Box / DoughDealerz / TheSHABAR
desc:
Sticky Beaks is the brand name we use for our different set ups. We are a family based business with individual experiences in different aspects of hospitality of over 30 years 

The Original Sticky Beaks set up specialises in hand shredded, slow-roasted, mouth-watering meats.

name: Maestros Pizza
desc: In 2016 I grew tired of feeding my son the same processed frozen pizza day in day out. With his limited diet, I decided to make a change and embarked on a journey that in a matter of years would lead to Maestro's a pizza buissness that is focused on giving its customers the most authentic experience. A business we are truly proud of.

name: The Two Fridas
desc: The Two Fridas Vegan Mexican Street Food, brings together traditional and contemporary recipes, inspired by travels through Mexico.  Using 100% plant produce, without any sacrifice on flavour, we aim to create a dining experience that is unique and playful.

name: Dough 'N' Go
desc:
We set-up this business in 2021.  We got booked to do a lot of festivals and weddings and absolutely loved it! So we work from a 3X3 gazebo with X2 Gozney Roccbox gas ovens cooking freshly made pizza right in front of you. 

The pizzas cook in 60 seconds in the Gozney Roccbox ovens.

name: Bira Brazilian Grill - BBG
desc:
Welcome to BBG or Bira Brazilian Grill, where passion for barbecue comes to life with each flame-kissed bite. Our team, fueled by their love for barbecuing, is eager to curate the perfect meat-centric menu for your occasion – tailoring each selection to the nuances of your unique palate.
Our selection is not just premium; it’s a carnivore’s dream.

name: Maki & Bowl
desc:
Maki & Bowl will set up a station at any event and serve up their delicious customisable Poké Bowls. Each guest will receive a big bowl of deliciousness that is made to order. They will pass along the counter and choose their base, fillings, proteins, toppings and a choice of amazing sauces. 

They can cater for all dietary requests, just let them know so they know who to cater for.

name: Chip Off The Block & The Ogle Shield
desc: Chip Off The Block was born in 2013 by two friends who shared the same enthusiasm for ‘farm to festival’ produce.

name: ChickP
desc:
The amazing ChickP serve the freshest homemade hummus, falafel, schnitzel and shawarma alongside a mixture of delicious Middle Eastern salads and sauces

The food either comes wrapped in a large fluffy pita bread or served as a salad pot alongside our famous sumac salted chunky chips.

name: Pimp My Fish
desc:
We take great pride in cooking our fish & chips to absolute perfection, to be eaten just as nature intended with salt & vinegar or pimped up with our homemade sauces and sides to give a creative twist to a British classic.

Our food is cooked by chefs who have a real passion for what they do and we  make all of our own sauces and sides too, including our legendary Saturday night curry sauce.

For …

desc:
“FANCY A REALLY SMALL SANDWICH?” SAID NOBODY. EVER.

The mouths of Birmingham deserve better than limp-ass sandwiches. If it all ended tomorrow you’d want a meal to remember it by. Fresh bread, made in-house and filled edge-to-edge with premium ingredients. Cheese, so much melted cheese, forcing its way out of the sides. Toasted.

name: Meat Street BBQ
desc:
Meat Street BBQ specializes in some of the finest authentic Low and Slow BBQ in the region.

Our extensive menu caters to diverse events, including high-end corporate functions, Weddings, office lunch’s, celebrity gatherings, sporting events, and private parties…
