Through high demand, passion for cooking and gap on the market we evolved into fully self-sufficient coffee and food truck offering slow cooked meats, loaded buns/rolls and a range of other smoked vegetarian and vegan based dishes.

name: Nathan's Kitchen Co

Now I’m serving up smash burgers people can’t stop talking about — just check out 120+ five-star reviews. But it’s not just burgers.

name: Punjabi Shack

Quality, excellent customer service, professionalism and versatility are at the core of their business.

name: Bowl n Soul

At Cremoloso, we're more than just a dessert supplier; we're passionate about crafting unforgettable experiences for you and your guests. Picture treating them to artisanal gelato made with love and care, using only the finest natural ingredients.

Our mission is simple: to make Londoners fall in love with arepas and the Venezuelan food experience.

Our catering service brings fine Italian traditional food to you for any type of event.

Our team has tirelessly scoped the Italian farms & producers to ensure we can deliver the food that are fully prepared with traditional flavours and with a perf…

name: Neapolitan Style Pizza
desc: Crafted with the finest ingredients, our goal is to provide an unforgettable culinary experience. From local markets to private events, our freshly made-to-order pizzas or pizza slice bar service cater to your preferences. Our gazebo setup and over 4 years of hospitality expertise ensure a visually pleasing experience and exceptional customer service.

name: Bollywood Bites Limited
desc:
Bollywood Bites – Award-Winning Gourmet Indian Street Food

At Bollywood Bites, we bring the vibrant flavours of authentic Indian street food to life. Founded by Nisha and Avneet Riat, our journey combines heritage, passion, and expertise.

name: Main Street Tacos
desc:
Our food is inspired by my years as a teenager growing up in northern California in the 1980's when I began my professional career as a Chef.

During this time I started regularly visiting authentic Mexican estancos, burrito bars and Cinco de Mayo parties (yes, lots of tequila was consumed).

name: Urban Cheesecake
desc:
Urban Cheesecake’s aim is to share their love, passion and greed for all things cheesecake! The idea was born in 2015 by skilled pastry chef brothers, Tony and ash, who have been pushing the boundaries of cheesecake art and flavour ever since.

Their award-winning and handcrafted cheesecakes are available for all kinds of events, functions and festivals - you name it and they can probably do it!

name: Plantain Papi
desc: Plantain Papi is the world’s first plantain bar and plantain-based kitchen, rooted in Caribbean and African traditions while reimagining plantain for a modern audience.

name: Spice Club Roadshow

WHO WE ARE

Spice Club Roadshow, established 2018.

West Midlands based street food vendors who travel throughout the UK for the right events.

OUR VISION

Our vision was to take authentic Punjabi dishes and to make them unique with a modern British twist. 

Our food is made by us from scratch, we do not use any jars or pastes. We use fresh ingredients only.

name: Ele's Little Kitchen
desc: Ele's Little Kitchen was created from a dream of bringing a little taste of Spain to South Wales. We provide a mix of traditional and regional dishes, more popular in Murcia, where Elena originates from. Using recipes inherited by her family to provide an authentic Spanish experience that combines contemporary preferences with traditional cooking styles.

name: Plantain Papi

name: Curry On Naanstop
desc: Curry On Naanstop is an exciting events and catering company based in London, renowned for its appearance on BBC’s Britain’s Top Takeaway show.

name: Pizza Shack
desc:
Pizza Shack are committed to delivering the best possible pizza freshly baked in front of you.
They offer an amazing menu that includes mouth-watering pepperoni, an English cheddar & mozzarella cheese blend and the tastiest marinara sauce you will ever try .

name: De Nadas Empanadas
desc: Hand-shaped and freshly baked, we have 15 different types of Argentinian empanadas with meat, vegetarian and vegan fillings.

name: Koshari Street
desc:
Koshari Street set off with a mission to introduce the beautiful culinary delicacies of Egypt to the United Kingdom while ensuring we deliver healthy, nutrient rich & super tasty bowls & wraps to our customers.
Our founding team are British Egyptians who grew up with a dream of seeing their cuisine popularised on the high street and so took it upon themselves to bring Egypt's national dish "Koshar…

name: Kejaun Caribbean Kitchen
desc:
Growing up in the countryside of Jamaica, I had the privilege of watching my father and great-aunt create incredible meals using simple ingredients bursting with flavour.

They treated every ingredient with the same level of respect, no matter the price.

name: Whippy Ices
desc: we are a southern based ice cream company, we have been trading for 15 years, we offer the latest in ice cream experience our van are electric powered rather than fumes.

name: Bam Bam Crepe
desc:
Bam Bam Crepe was founded through a love of cooking street food at home. Crepes have always been a firm favourite being both fast and outrageously tasty.

Having pitched up for the first time in 2017 Bam Bam Crepe has come a long way. Now considered the UK's No.1 event creperie, big crowds and long queues come as standard with each crepe only taking one minute from ladle to pan to first bite.

name: The Sausage
desc: We are The Sausage, a family-run gourmet hot dog caterer trading since 2015. You will have seen us at Lord's, Twickenham, Silverstone for the British Grand Prix, Everton FC, Aintree Racecourse, Wilderness, Isle of Wight Festival and LIV Golf - 86 public events with more than 5,000 attendees -  serving more than 350 portions an hour.

name: Fat Frank's Catering
desc: Welcome to Fat Frank's Catering, where passion for pizza meets exceptional service. Our ability to provide piping hot, freshly baked pizzas from our portable pizza bar makes us the perfect choice for any event, both indoors or outdoors. Whether it's an office party, garden party, networking event, wedding, we can accommodate it all.

name: CeeZee’s
desc: At CeeZee’s, we bring a unique blend of fun and professionalism to every event, making your special occasions truly unforgettable.

name: Pop Up Greek Street Food
desc:
We serve Sizzling Souvlaki Pita Wraps, the Greek street food of choice since time began.
Your choice of Chicken, Pork, Halloumi or Mixed vegetable Souvlaki (Skewers) served in a warm pita bread wrap with tzatziki or rose harissa sauce, sliced tomato, red onion & parsley then drizzled with olive oil, lemon & oregano.
We also serve Greek salads, roasted vegetables, and potato fries.
We operate from …

name: Greedy Vegan
desc:
Welcome to Greedy Vegan!

We cater for a wide range of events  -  from full-on festivals and quirky weddings to  all-day conferences and evening canapes.

About us
We are a family business. Our love and passion for creating delicious food is at the heart of everything we do. We understand every brief is different - that's why we don't do a one-size fits all.

name: Hidden Chef Catering
desc:
Hidden Chef is a Wolverhampton based caterer delivering everything from street food to BBQ, banquet catering and private dining - it's this flexibility along with our chef's extensive knowledge of flavours & cooking techniques that set us apart.

The Hidden Chef was incorporated in 2017 by our Director, Andrew, a then freelance Chef with 20 years of experience starting from his roots in Jamaica wi…

name: Luxury Vending
desc:
Bringing Sweet Luxury to Your Events – Anywhere, Anytime

We are a premium mobile dessert business specialising in creating unforgettable experiences with our range of stylish and versatile dessert setups – perfect for corporate functions, weddings, festivals, and private events of any size.

From our multiple ice cream carts designed to serve large crowds, to our barista coffee bike and cart idea…

name: Belmonte Catering
desc:
About Belmonte Catering

Hello from Belmonte Catering - your one-stop street food specialist for all your catering requirements.

name: Bubba Ice
desc:
Here at Bubba Oasis, not only do we have our clubhouses and cocktail bars across London, but we've also popped up and served millions of cocktails & ice creams, across London, Europe and the US, regularly rebooked with event planners, creative agencies and brands alike.

In short, we handcraft ice creams &/or frozen cocktails in front of your gorgeous eyes, off our magical ice pans.

name: Chicken & Blues
desc:
Born in the southern states, raised on the South Coast!

For over a decade, Chicken & Blues has served up award-winnin’ chicken to the good people of Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole, offering dine-in, collection and delivery from 11am-10pm, daily.

name: Country Fried
desc:
Country Fried is a family-run mobile fish & chip business from Lancashire, built on a shared passion for great food, high standards and doing things properly.

Our roots are in the traditional British chippy, and we’ve taken everything people love about that experience on the road.

name: SMOKE
desc: Born from a deep-rooted love of authentic Louisiana smoked BBQ , SMOKE is a family run smokehouse built on a passion for slow-cooked, smoky goodness and bringing people together over great food.  What started as a hobby quickly turned into a full-fledged venture.

name: West Midlands Chip Van
desc: Fancy a Chip? West Midlands Chip Van is a Mobile Fish and Chip van that travels to selected areas of Walsall and is also available for Private Hire, events and festivals.

name: The Potato Pod
desc:
The Potato Pod is a self-contained mobile food trailer providing delicious oven-baked jacket potatoes. They are topped with homemade, locally sourced ingredients that are made fresh on the day including our tasty Mexican bean chilli and BBQ pulled pork.

We can offer a bespoke menu service to cater to all dietary requirements, budgets and client requests.

name: Tilly's Teas
desc:
Tilly’s Teas bring traditional home baked afternoon tea to your home or venue of choice. All you have to do as host is sit back and enjoy your chosen tea with friends and family. Tilly’s Teas will do all of the baking, setting up and clearing away!

Enjoy English afternoon tea at your next event with Tilly’s Teas.

name: Los Gordos
desc:
Hola, we’re Los Gordos, a Mexican-Colombian fusion street food caterer based in London.

Founded by Seb, a British-Colombian chef with roots in both cultures, the brand blends the comfort of Colombian home cooking with bold Mexican street food staples.

name: Foodie and Grubbies
desc:
I become a big fan of street since moving to London in 2017 coming from Bristol the street food scene wasn’t that big and I would
Always see allot of cool pops up on Instagram that I wanted to try! The street food scene has not grown allot in the past 5 years all over the country!

name: Crust N Slice
desc:
Crust N Slice – Authentic Wood-Fired Pizza on Wheels

Crust N Slice is a mobile wood-fired pizzeria, proudly family-run and based in Nelson, catering across the North West and beyond.

Our journey began in Italy, where we lived for several years and fell in love with the art of traditional pizza making.

name: Pizza Milan
desc: Pizza Milan is a family-owned company born from a deep passion for the world of food — especially our love of pizza. Having learned from the finest pizzaiolos in Italy, we craft each pizza to perfection using San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella and locally sourced herbs.

name: Epic Catering
desc: Epic Catering is a family-run business that started off during lockdown. Despite only being open for three years, our business has gone from strength to strength, with new set-ups and more staff constantly being required to keep up with demand! We’re very proud of how we’ve managed to grow our business in such a short amount of time.

name: YouBao
desc: The food served by YouBao is inspired by Asian traditions and flavours that are combined with an original London twist.

name: Mediterranean Paella
desc:
Mediterranean Paella serves delicious paella, made right in front of your guests. The paella is prepared fresh each day and it is a personal twist on our family’s recipe.

All our paellas are loaded with fresh vegetables and spices which enhances chorizo's  amazing depth of flavour. Our chorizo comes all the way from Spain!

name: The Pink Indian
desc:
Ready to make your event unforgettable? Let The Pink Indian Food Trailer roll in and ignite your celebration with the vibrant spirit of Punjab!

Whether you’re planning a dreamy wedding, a dynamic corporate event, or a cosy get-together, we bring you authentic Punjabi cuisine with a modern flair.

name: Tacoman
desc:
Tacoman is a converted 1970 Citroën HY van selling LA style tacos. It is run and owned by Nick Armitage who has 30+ years experience in hospitality.  
We chose tacos because they pretty much define what ‘street food’ is - fast, tasty, fun & inexpensive. And we use soft corn tacos so our food is gluten free!

name: Papa Ji
tagline: it's not fast food, it's fresh
desc:
From street food hustle to award-winning flavour – Papa Ji is more than just a food business, it’s a movement. 

We started with a single food truck, driven by a passion for bold, fresh cooking rooted in family recipes and South Asian spice.

name: Benissimo
desc:
Experience the joy of fresh, stone-baked pizza at your next event with Benissimo. Based in Norfolk, we provide a unique mobile pizza catering service.

The idea started between two childhood friends – Ben and James – who share a love for Italian food.

Ben dreamed of starting a food business of own; whilst James, a frequent visitor to Italy, was keen to find a way to share his Italian culinary dis…

name: Churro Boyz
desc: La Flamenca Limited trading as Churro Boyz was established in 2012. We trained in Madrid to bring the most authentic Churros to the Uk. All our sauces are home made and offer that authentic Spanish taste. We have designed so many awesome dishes over the years and we have a team of 15 staff to cater to events of any size.

name: Peeld Poke & Rice Bowls
desc:
In an event catering world filled with fried food, we're here to offer a striking alternative.

We’re all about serving poke that’s fresh, funky, and as colourful as your Pinterest feed. Inspired by the spirit of Hawaii but tailored for the pulse of London.

name: StoneRose Pizza Co & Events Co
desc: We're Mark and Rebecca, the dynamic duo behind StoneRose Events Co. We have grown from our successful pizza business, StoneRose Pizza Co. to offer even more to our customers.

name: The Hen House Kitchen
desc:
The amazing Hen House Kitchen have taken the fried chicken world by storm since launching in 2019, fusing Asian flavours with the best free-range chickens Norfolk has to offer! 

After 30 years working in some of the UKs best restaurants head chef Geoff (took over in 2025) was inspired to follow his passion and make the most deliriously delicious fried food imaginable, but in the healthiest possib…

name: Hala Pâtisserie
desc: Hala Pâtisserie is a boutique pâtisserie specialising in refined, handcrafted desserts and canapé style sweet and savoury creations for events, brands, and private occasions.

name: gwafuvegan
desc: gwafuvegan specializes in cooking and delivering affordable vegan West African food. We ensure to only use high-quality, sustainable produce that is locally sourced. Our number one aim is to spread our love of vegan food and our passion and love of West African food.

name: Churros UK
desc:
Established in 2012, we are a family run business selling our outstanding freshly made churros & chocolate, complemented by our fabulous barista blended coffees, hot chocolates and speciality teas.

We have just taken delivery of our brand new unit, designed and custom made to look great at your event and capable of high capacity output.

name: The Works Gelato
desc:
The Works Gelato brings handcrafted gelato to events across London via our iconic hand-drawn gelato bike.

We offer a hosted, two-hour unlimited gelato service that’s designed to be simple, joyful, and completely stress-free for organisers.

name: The MOB Pizza & Bar
desc:
The Mob Pizza and Bar believe that the secret to delicious pizza lies within the dough, Sauce & Passion. Their infamous Nonna had a dough recipe that used a secret ingredient that made her homemade pizza sauce zing!
With the finest San Marzano tomatoes grown in the rich soils of Mount Vesuvius, Superiore extra virgin olive oil and fragrant oregano, our pizzas are an ode to Italian authenticity.

name: Sutton Hog Roast & Events
desc: Our business started roughly ten years ago. We initially specialised in just hog roasts, however we have managed to diverge into other specialist catering sub-divisions such as Pizzas, BBQ's, Jacket Potatoes and waffles! We have taken on more staff so that we can have multiple teams either working on the same event or multiple events at the same time.

name: Cappadocia Moments Ltd
desc: We are a high-impact dessert trailer specialising in Chocolate Strawberries,Waffle sticks, Home-made Lemonade and Fresh Smoothies —designed to attract queues, increase dwell time and maximise event sales.

name: Cakehole London
desc: Founded in 2007 by baker Lara Cooke, Cakehole has been bringing joy to London’s sweet tooth for over 18 years.

name: The Cornerstone Kitchen
desc:
The Midlands’ Trendsetting Caterers For Showstopping Events

We’re not following the trends – we’re setting them.

name: Made in Puglia
desc: At Made In Puglia, we're committed to providing the best Neapolitan pizza in town. Our dough is made with high-quality, double-fermented ingredients sourced from Italy and cooked at high heat, resulting in a chewy crust that pairs perfectly with our freshly made in-store dips.

name: Peter’s Panas
desc: Peter’s Panas is a South American Food Truck based in South East London that specializes in Venezuelan Cuisine. Some of our dishes Arepas, cachapas, empanadas, tequeños, and alfajores will make you feel that you are in a trip through the caribean and Latin America.

name: Peter’s Panas
desc: Peter’s Panas is a South American Food Truck based in South East London that specializes in Venezuelan Cuisine. Some of our dishes Arepas, cachapas, empanadas, tequeños, and alfajores will make you feel that you are in a trip through the caribean and Latin America.

name: The Mex Box
desc:
We love Mexican street food! After seeing a noticeable lack of high quality Mexican food locally and at events, we decided to bring some to the table!

We combine authentic Mexican recipes with what the British public wants! We can confidently say that our carnitas is some of the best you’ll find outside of Mexico and our birria is banging!

name: Cluck Farmyard
tagline: For The Love of Fried Chicken
desc: Cluck Farmyard serves up succulent fried chicken strips and chips loaded with different sauces and toppings. For the vegans out there, they have buffalo or BBQ Vegan 'This Isn't Chicken Nuggets' with chips. Cluck serves sides of fried chicken wings, fries and loaded fries. They can also do fried chicken burgers on request with the same sauces/toppings.

name: Aupa Street Food
desc:
Hello/Kaixo...

We are Aupa...A street food airstream trailer operated by Leire and I (Selina)... ‘Aupa’ means ‘Cheers’ / ‘Welcome’ in Euskera the language of Basque Country and the home of Leire.

name: Blame Frank
desc: Planning an event, whether a wedding, corporate celebration, or milestone party, can be overwhelming. That’s where Blame Frank comes in.

name: Cheatmeals
desc:
We rely on fresh ingredients, prepared daily. Our product and brand value is our USP. Produced locally whenever possible to retain our reputation for providing the best halal and mouth- watering experience for our customers.
We are more than just a place for a bite to eat, we are a culture.

name: Forcella Wood Fired Pizza
desc:
Forcella offers tantalising and tasty pizzas influenced by the traditional cooking methods and flavours of Southern Italy. Using only the finest seasonal ingredients, they can create all kinds of tempting menus for your celebration. 

Their converted Land Rover Defender provides a unique and attention-grabbing live catering experience for your guests.

name: Fromage Fiesta!
desc:
Fromage Fiesta is a mobile catering service founded by award-winning British cheesemonger Stephen Fleming and Swiss celebrity chef GregorySJ. 

Fueled by a shared passion for cheese and hosting events, we have crafted a mouthwatering menu featuring the world’s most beloved melted cheese dishes, from gourmet grilled cheese to decadent mac 'n' cheese.

name: The Crown & Crust Co. Ltd
desc:
A pub-born pie brand with its roots deep in tradition but with its heart set 
on sharing pies far and wide.

name: Colombo Street
desc: Our brand stands out with its authentic Sri Lankan cuisine served from our vibrant pop art themed food truck. We take pride in catering to all dietary requirements, including vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, pescatarian, and dairy-free options, and our dishes can be modified to accommodate allergies.

name: B’elicious
desc: B'elicious is a food street vendor that makes freshly  made Greek Savoury &Sweet crepes. All of our crepes are made with a pure fresh ingredients right in front of our costumers. We can also  cater for  Vegan and Gluten free as we have a large range of flavours to choose from. At B'elicious creperie we try every day for the best.

name: The Roundtable Catering Company
desc: The Roundtable Catering Company is run by three sisters – Erica, Edwina & Emma. Our roots begin in Ghana where we were born and grew up before moving to the UK in 2001. Our memories of being in the kitchen with our grandmother and aunties gave us the love and confidence for cooking & hosting.

name: Howe and Co 22
desc:
With over 15 years of experience serving up classic chip shop favorites, Howe and Co 22 brings the legacy of the Howe and Co brand—in business since 1930—directly to your event.
Whether you're planning an intimate family gathering or a large-scale festival, we are experts in providing high-quality event catering for any size.

name: Knead Neapolitan Pizza
desc:
At Knead, we bring you our signature slow-proved Neapolitan dough topped with the freshest and 

finest ingredients around to create banging flavour combinations. Our pizzas are cooked at 450 degrees in less than 90 seconds to create a light and fluffy crust - just like you get in the streets of Napoli!

Knead is the pizza project of husband and wife team, Simon and Olivia.

name: The Beefsteaks
desc:
What if some of the best steak in London could be found on the street and at a reasonable price? The Beefsteaks is an exclusive 18th Century London steak club reimagined as inclusive 21st Century street food.

Our core menu is grass fed, British ex-dairy steak cooked over fire and served as either a sandwich or with hand cut, triple cooked chips and a selection of classic steak sauces.

name: Pow Events
desc:
We are Hereford based family run business! With a 5* EHO rating, which we started trading in 2013 at Lakefest in Herefordshire, with one build up gazebo serving cheese toasties and now we have various units with a variety of menu options.

We have gained lots of experience over the years and with fully train staff, and I think we have a professional attitude towards festival catering.

And we have…

name: Homemade Curries
desc:
Homemade Curries: Crafting Culinary Experiences with a Dash of Authenticity

At Homemade Curries, we're not just about food; we're about creating unforgettable culinary journeys. Our passion lies in serving up the flavors of India, straight from the bustling streets to your plate.

We specialize in authentic Indian street food, carefully curated to tantalize your taste buds.

name: Barn Events Catering Company
desc:
Led by Damon and Sarah, The barn events Co, rose from humbling beginnings, to serve as one of the leading outside caterers in Kent and the south East.

With over 25 years of combined experience cultivating their culinary expertise, including at Their own Michelin Listed Restaurant, They Pride themselves on the ability to deliver contemporary dining with a personal touch.

Whether you’re Planning a…

name: The Greek Gyros Van
desc:
We started back in 2019 with our Greek Street Food offering as we was inspired by  our trip to Athens, the passion and love that was displayed by the locals really allowed us to understand the why Greek Food is so popular. 

Greek Gyros has become a huge sensation around the world as its packed with a variety of flavours.

name: Curry Nights with Nandita
desc: Curry Nights with Nandita is a celebration of bold Punjabi flavours and heartfelt hospitality. Founded by Nandita, who grew up in India learning traditional recipes from her mother and grandmother, the business began after she moved to the UK and started recreating the food of her childhood.

name: All Dough Pizza
desc:
Our mobile pizza business is dedicated to providing delicious and authentic pizza to our customers. We use only the freshest ingredients and our pizzas are handcrafted with care. Our menu features a variety of classic and gourmet toppings, so there is something for everyone. 

At our mobile pizza business, we believe in providing excellent customer service and quality food.

name: Kitchen Street
desc: Imagine a state-of-the-art food van, designed with efficiency and customer experience in mind. This culinary haven on wheels boasts three serving hatches, allowing for simultaneous service on all sides. This not only maximizes the van's serving capacity but also reduces wait times, inviting guests to indulge in delectable dishes from multiple angles.

name: Olmec Eats
desc: My name is Adrian Anderson, and I am reaching out from Olmec Eats, a growing street food and events catering company that has been delivering exceptional food experiences since 2017.

name: Holy Pizza
desc:
My name is Andrius (otherwise Andy), and I'm the pizzaiolo behind the Holy Pizza, serving Neapolitan style pizzas across London and beyond. We can cater for markets, private events without a problem, and our reviews can vouch for that. 

We use only quality ingredients to make these mouth watering pizzas.

name: Vegan Spice
desc: We are a Vegan Food Trailer, specialising in Indian cuisine and strive towards being a fully ethical business. We bring an affordable, healthy, tasty and sustainable option and use only biodegradable and recyclable packaging. We do not use any frozen or pre packed items and use only fresh foods.

name: Dough
desc: We serve up authentic New York-style crispy pizzas, crafted by the slice and topped with premium, carefully curated ingredients. Our menu balances timeless classics with unique, bold flavour combinations that set us apart in a crowded pizza scene.

name: Brothers and Burgers
desc:
Brothers & Burgers

We’re Brothers & Burgers – a street food pop-up run by two actual brothers, Josh and James King.

name: Jikoni East Africa
desc: Jikoni is the creation of chefs Iman and James, who have been perfecting the menus since they met back in 2017.

name: Archchi's
desc: Archchi’s was founded by myself, Chloe, and my husband Mark to share the vibrant flavours of my Sri Lankan heritage. The name “Archchi” (pronounced ar-chee) means Grandma in Sinhala, and it’s a nod to the generations of recipes passed down through our family.

name: Podgers
desc:
Podgers was founded by Charlie, a chef who cut his teeth in some of the UK’s top high-end kitchens. Swapping basement brigades for a beautifully restored 1980s French Peugeot van—now transformed into a fully equipped kitchen on wheels—Charlie brings fine-dining precision to the street food scene.

At Podgers, every burger gets the same attention to detail Charlie honed during his career.

name: Tacoporium
desc:
Tacoporium are a Yorkshire based street food company specialising in soft shell tacos.

As a family business, the Tacoporium team run all of the events themselves to ensure the highest quality food and personal service.

These guys are incredibly passionate about what they do and will do whatever they can to help to make it a memorable occasion for you and your guests!

name: VIP DOG
desc:
German rustic dishes cooked fresh in front of you at your home, or your chosen venue. We know that only by using the freshest ingredients we will achieve the desired success for our clients.

We are a successful family-run mobile catering business that believes that the Finest Gourmet German Sausages and Traditional Berlin Shish Kebab deserve the coolest place to be served from, our professionally…

name: Inamo Sukoshi
desc: Inamo Sukoshi serves knockout sushi and vibrant Asian fusion street food. Born from the award-winning Inamo restaurants, we serve bold flavours inspired by Japan, Korea, China, and Thailand – including our signature Dragon Rolls, Katsu curries & bao buns. We don’t just serve food – we create experiences.

name: Pizza Geeks
desc: Pizza Geeks has been delivering event catering across Scotland for 10 years. Our experienced team caters everything from weddings, private parties and corporate events to office catering, festivals, sporting events and location filming.

name: Kickin Kreole
desc:
We are a Mauritian Inspired Street Food Vendor offering homemade Mauritian food.  

Reassembling Greatness - raised within a Mauritian household we ate traditional authentic homemade meals daily. We are from a new generation that thoroughly enjoys our culture whilst adding a modern take on Mauritian Cuisine.

name: Pizzamore
desc:
Ciao, I am Manuela ! After moving from Italy in 2016, I found myself longing for the flavors of home, this led me to train with the renowned Confraternita della Pizza, invest in a high-quality pizza oven, and start crafting pizzas from scratch for family and friends on a weekly basis.
Every PizzAmore pizza is handmade , using a 24-hour dough proofing process for a light and crispy base.

name: AMOR
desc:
AMOR was an idea born out of lockdown, we supply our customers and clients with the best gourmet loaded Belgium Waffles. We make sure to have a full compliment of vegan options so no one has to miss out! We also do delicious Cornish dairy scoop ice-cream in waffle cones!

We run from either our branded gazebo set-up or trailer with it's funky lights.

name: Los 2 Amigos
desc:
Antonio, the passionate founder of Los 2 Amigos, along with his assistant Sydney have a rich and diverse heritage.

Born in South Africa to Portuguese parents, they spent many years living on the beautiful island of Madeira, Portugal, before finally settling in the UK.

name: South African Kitchen
tagline: Street Food we do it all
desc:
Our Fresh Food Philosophy
At the heart of our business lies a real passion for fresh food. Every dish we serve is prepared onsite, and we never use processed ingredients.

name: SHOKUDŌ
desc:
Discover Japanese comfort food with a creative twist — crafted for unforgettable events.

At SHOKUDŌ, eatery is more than a word ,  it’s our ethos. Inspired by Japanese culture and the joy of sharing simple, soulful food, we bring the spirit of Japan's comfort dishes to life in London.

name: Drip & Drizzle Desserts
desc:
Welcome to Drip & Drizzle Desserts!

We are a premium mobile dessert company known for serving our delectable creations from a custom-built dessert cart, designed to bring a touch of indulgence and style to any event. Established in 2015, we first made our mark in the late-night cakes and shakes delivery business under the name The Midnight Delivery.

name: Pizza Al Forno
desc: My name is Richard Giustiniani, I'm the founder of Pizza Al Forno. With Italian heritage rooted in Larino, Molise, I have grown up surrounded by authentic southern Italian flavours.

name: Summit Tasty
desc: Born out of a love of travel and all things food, Summit Tasty is a mobile food business based in Worthing, West Sussex, specializing in gourmet loaded fries inspired by the classic Canadian dish, poutine. Their menu offers a creative twist on this iconic comfort food, featuring globally inspired toppings with plenty of vegetarian and vegan options.

name: Good Grub Monkey
desc:
Good Grub Monkey are a family run gourmet catering business, providing delicious crowd-pleasing food and excellent service - right from initial contact through to their fabulous hassle-free catering on the day.

With menus to suit all tastes, your guests will be wowed by their famous 'Goujons', Beer Battered Fish and Chips or their Gourmet Burgers and Hot Dogs; all hand prepared using quality, fre…

name: Bowman Events
desc: Bowman Events bring over a decade of catering expertise to the table, from running one of London’s largest pop-up sites on the South Bank to delivering flawless service at weddings, corporate parties, and private celebrations.

name: Harold's Hog Roast
desc:
Originating in the historic town of Hastings, you will now find Harold's Hog Roast serving their succulent hog roast baps at private parties, events and weddings across Sussex, Kent, London & the South East.

This charming family run business was born out of a passion for high-quality catering and a family history in butchery.

name: BaldiesBites
desc:
BaldiesBites was founded with a simple mission: to bring joy to as many people as possible through delicious food. We specialise in authentic Mexican street food and Tex-Mex classics.

We offer catering for all types of events, whether it's weddings, private parties, corporate events or any other occasion, BaldiesBites Is ready to cater to your needs.

name: El Chappo
desc: At El Chappo Group Ltd, we specialize in delivering bold, flavorful Mexican fusion street food that leaves a lasting impression. What started as a small venture known as Orchard 27 Events has evolved into a thriving food brand with a focus on quality, freshness, and creativity.

name: Georgie's Greek Grill
desc: Look no further if you are looking for unique and authentic homemade greek food. We are a family-owned and run business and we take great care and pride in what we do. So leave it to us to make you feel truly a part of our extended family, while you enjoy some of the most delicious Greek food you will find in the UK.

name: Chipsy
desc: Chipsy®️, established in 2017, set out to revive the food choices on offer while exploring the crossroads of street food and gourmet.

name: The Street Food Co.
desc:
Thank you for considering The Street Food Co. for the catering at your event, we make seriously good pizzas from our replica Citroen H van.

Our background is Event Catering and this business was born from regular requests to provide more casual options, either as Late Night Food or as a less formal option at events.

name: Ronnie's Black Cab
desc: Ronnie’s Black Cab brings two London icons together: traditional pie and mash served from a converted London taxi.

name: Pizza Nostra Cotswolds
desc:
Pizza Nostra is a wood-fired pizza trailer based out of Broadway, Worcestershire specialising in events and celebrations. Operating from a 4m x 2m unit, our large vintage oven can bake five 10" pizzas every 90 seconds, ensuring efficient, timely service for any gathering.

With a background in fine dining, we’ve spent the past three years refining our craft to create high-quality, artisan pizzas.

name: Dinithi Street Food
desc:
We are situated on one of Newcastle’s most beautiful streets and nestled close to the iconic Tyne Bridge on Quayside, Dinithi Restaurant is the first to bring a taste of Sri Lankan, Indian and Oriental cuisine under one roof to Newcastle.

With two internal bars in operation, diners can access a fine range of wines, spirits and cocktails.

name: Cally Munchy
desc:
Cally Munchy is an Afro fusion catering service that uses food to bring people of different cultures together. 

It all began when Ebenezer was a fresh lad out of college and had no direction to his future path. He began an apprenticeship at a culinary school since he was confident in his cooking abilities.

name: The Social Dough Company
desc:
Hi, we’re The Social Dough Company and we provide THE ULTIMATE PIZZA EXPERIENCE.

We’re a mid 20’s couple who were (like most of us!) very bored at the start of the Coronavirus pandemic. We hosted a pizza party before Covid in the summer of 2019 and it was an absolute disaster! 

So, with nothing to do and long lockdown days, we taught ourselves how to make pizza, then, after that?

name: Bar Pintxos
desc:
Combined experience of over 30 years in the catering and hospitality industry, having working in 3 rosette restaurants and michelin establishments gives the ability and knowledge for focus, flexibility and a variety of skills to execute many types cuisine and cooking style, from intimate supper clubs 
to pop up tents in fields, 
We operate from a brick and mortar venue at the heart of Preston, Lan…

name: Frenchie's Pizza
desc: We are Ryan and Hayley, and Frenchie's is a family-run pizza truck serving hand-stretched Neapolitan-style pizzas made with the finest ingredients. What began as a hobby in our garden after being gifted a pizza oven from our wedding, is now a business crafted with love and lots of fun.

name: Yeates Catering
desc: Yeates Catering was founded in 2018 by Ralph and Julie Yeates, a husband-and-wife team with a shared passion for great food and great service.

name: Bangkok Box
desc:
BANGKOK BOX is brought to you by two sisters, born and raised in central Bangkok where our mum and aunties taught us to cook delicious food with love and attention to all the details that make Thai food so famous. 

We're recreating real tastes of Bangkok in London, using recipes passed down and perfected through generations.

name: BBQ Dept
desc: BBQ DEPT is a seasonal BBQ catering business serving delicious grilled meat and veg across London and the surrounding area.

name: Lemon Squeezy
desc: We are Lemon Squeezy and our goal is to combine the discipline of fine dining with the bold flavours of street food. At Lemon Squeezy we aim to showcase local produce and prove that great dishes don't need to be complicated. As a result, everything at Lemon Squeezy is about freshness, flavour and quality.

name: Calm Indian Cow
desc:
While the name may deceive, South Indian Street food does not get more vibrant and exciting than Calm Indian Cow! 

Based out of Shoreditch, they are a vibrant and authentic catering company that serves a variety of specially selected curries and biryanis that pack a punch, yet are based on traditional recipes that have been handed down from generation to generation.

name: Mexican Fried Chicken
desc: We started off selling tacos in 2015 and was voted as one of London’s top 10 street food traders by Time Out 2 years running. As such we have an intimate knowledge of all things Mexican. Spotting a gap in the market in 2017 we decided to meld our love of big Mexican flavours with our favourite food; fried chicken.

name: Flo’s Fryer Fish & Chips
desc: Welcome to Flo’s  Fryer! We serve hot and delicious freshly cooked fish and chips covering much of the South East of England (Kent, Sussex, Surrey, London) We cater for any celebration or event including weddings, birthdays, quiz nights, parties, corporate events, product launches, team building events, work lunches and many more!

name: El Dorado Taqueria
desc: El Dorado Taqueria is a family-run street food business bringing the bold, soulful flavours of authentic Mexican cuisine to Edinburgh and beyond.

name: Afuego
desc: AFUEGO is a Latin-inspired street food business built around our love for bold flavours, great ingredients, and the vibrant culture of Latin America. Every dish we serve is made using high-quality ingredients and thoughtful combinations of authentic Latin flavours.

name: Smoke & Braai
desc:
We are a mobile events and catering business that brings customised catering experiences to you and your guests. 

Our food evolves around the worlds of  Low n Slow BBQ and live fire cooking 

Our menus can be tailored from summer BBQ parties to Winter Christmas work party.

name: Spinach & Agushi Supper Club
desc:
Ghanaian gurus Spinach and Agushi have been exposing London to the mouth-watering delights of authentic West African food for well over a decade now, starting out from a stall at Broadway Market all the way back in 2004 and have been working the streets ever since.

They were one of the original driving forces in pushing London’s street food scene into the diverse, gourmet space it now occupies an…

name: La Real Paella
desc:
We are proud to be one of the finest and most established Paella Catering companies in London. Our Chef patron Adrian Serrano prepares award-winning Paella, made fresh to order, that's perfect for any kind of event. With gluten-free and vegan options available, there are many different choices to suit every palate.

Looking to bring a touch of Spain to your special occasion?

name: KoolKata Street Food
desc:
We are Koolkata Street Food

Bringing the flavours and vibrancy from the City of Joy to the streets of the U.K

Having front of house experience in fine dining to managing boutique wedding and high-end events. It was only a matter of time before we embarked on this culinary journey to provide not only great food but great vibes to our events.

name: Made of Dough
desc:
We started out flogging pizza on the road with a wood fired oven in the back of a land rover. Three friends refining their skills from Italian chefs and trips to Naples. Now we've got a full throttle travelling pizzeria, visiting all the top festivals and wedding around the UK.

We are a small business based out of Southeast London.

name: Floatin Buka
desc: Founded in 2010, Floatin Buka is a family run business that was dreamt up by Olabisi Abe in her family home based in South East London. In 2021, like many businesses with the never ending Lockdowns, Olabisi saw a gap in the market for more accessible and healthy Nigerian takeaway food that serves the community and your guests at any function.

name: Baxter's Catering
desc: At Baxter's Catering, we pride ourselves on using top quality produce from the UK. All of our Fish comes from UK shorelines and is never frozen. This means when you book us, you are not only supporting our small business but you are also supporting the UK fisheries and fish traders.

name: Molto Bene Pizza
desc: After nearly 15 years heading up professional kitchens, including at Michelin Star level, a life long passion for pizza led our founder Liam Parr to focus on making one product as good as it can be. We make artisan, sourdough, hand stretched pizzas using our own sourdough.

name: 2 Nigerian Boys
desc: 2 Nigerian Boys is a vibrant food stall located in Spitalfields Market, Liverpool Street, dedicated to delivering authentic and flavourful Nigerian cuisine. Our menu is centred around our signature smoky jollof rice, a rich and aromatic dish that has become a customer favourite.

name: The Frying Squad
desc:
The Frying Squad are a quintessentially British traditional fish & chip business that has been operating for the last 12 years in and around London (and beyond!) serving top-notch food from their amazing food truck.

They serve classic fresh fish & chips as well battered halloumi, 100% pork sausages and some really great vegan options too, so all of your guests will be able to enjoy something!

name: Philly’s Wood Fired Pizza
desc:
We have a gorgeous converterd horsebox trailer in Stamford Bridge, York and we serve authentic neapolitan style wood fired pizza.
We hand make and stretch all our own dough usung the technique taught to us by the legend that is Marco Fuso.
We hold a 5* food hygiene rating and have had only excellent reviews since we launched earlier this year.
We can cater for most dietary requirements including v…

name: Broadway Churro Club
desc:
Hola..!

Are you craving for some churros? We do one thing, and one thing only… indulgent, crispy, filled churros. My name is Gus and allow me to introduce ourselves, Broadway Churro Club.

We specialize in creating fabulous, crispy, authentic churros.

name: the yorkie wrap co
desc: The Yorkie Wrap Co delivers bold, unmistakably British street food with proven event impact. Established in 2011, we’re proud to be the original home of the Yorkshire Pudding Wrap, bringing classic comfort food to events in a fresh, modern way.

name: Tini's Tacos
desc:
Tini's Tacos was started in the Spring of 2023 by hospitality veterans Adam and Steph. After a combined 30+ years working in hospitality in London we decided to follow our one true passion.... TACOS! 

We serve a delicious authentic soft shell corn tortillas with a range of slow cooked meat fillings along side vegan and gluten free options.

name: Peach and Pudding Catering
desc: Based in the heart of the Cotswolds near Burford, Peach & Pudding Catering specialises in crafting delectable, bespoke menus for every occasion. From intimate gatherings to grand celebrations, we transform culinary dreams into reality.

name: Gastronomy Guys
desc:
We play with our food... jaw dropping liquid nitrogen event experiences.

We specialise in interactive food and drink entertainment. Our liquid nitrogen dessert stations create both visual and sensory impact. From our billowing Kitchen Aids, churning the most delicious ice cream you'll ever taste, right in front of guests eyes.

name: Wholesome Junkies
desc:
Wholesome Junkies serve up 100% Vegan junk food with a wholesome twist. The Wholesome Junkies team are passionate foodies who want to show everyone that vegan food does not have to be bland or boring!

They advise that you ditch those falafel balls and quinoa salads as soon as possible and instead welcome their vegan Kentucky fried cauliflower burgers, wings, hot dogs and kebabs with open arms!

name: Gangsta's Peridise
desc:
Welcome to Gangsta’s Peridise – where the heat is real and the flavour’s criminal. We serve up juicy chicken thighs, marinated in our signature peri peri blend and grilled over open charcoal for that unbeatable smoky finish.

Craving something handheld?

name: Walthamstow Dogs
desc:
Family run business rooted in the heart of Walthamstow.  Launched 8 years ago by husband and wife team John and Emma, 
Serving locally sourced free range hotdogs at the back of a craft beer brewery.
Now employing nine members of staff having taken the brand through festivals, music events, street markets, weddings and wild and wonderful gigs too numerous to mention.
Walthamstow Dogs has built up a…

name: Mesa Catering - Pieminister
desc:
Mesa Catering is a Bristol based event catering service. From a simple street-food style event to a four course banquet, Mesa can bring as much, or as little, of the catering to you as you wish. 

Mesa was created by Katie in 2020, she had been working as Head of Events at Pieminister for 7 years and was now ready to set up her own catering business.

name: Crazy For Pasta
desc:
Crazy For Pasta is an Italian Fresh Pasta Factory that has been producing high-quality artisanal pasta since 2014, supplying major markets across London and the surrounding countryside.

Building on years of experience and strong customer relationships, we have expanded our operations with two branches in West London.

name: Sizzlin' Street Eats
desc:
We can cater anywhere with our fabulous pop-up street food offerings. 
All we need is a 3x3m space and we can cook for your entire party, all you need to do is chill and enjoy!

As an American national our head chef GregorySJ the Global Chef has professional BBQ training and gained OVER 10 years of experience in Texas Style BBQ.

name: Timorous Beastie Wood Fired Pizza
desc:
Timorous Beastie Events have established themselves as a leading bar and wood fired pizza provider across Scotland. We serve from our custom airstream, which acts as the centrepiece for any event, be it a wedding or corporate party. 

Our typical package allows guests to select 4 types of pizza from our menu, which would be prepared and cooked fresh on the day.

name: Jacks Smoke Shack
tagline: Smoky BBQ & Loaded Mac n Cheese.
desc:
Jacks Smoke Shack is a family run business and offer a range of different packages to cater for your event, which gives a great alternative to more traditional buffets or hog roasts and is sure to leave your guests with something to talk about and some great memories for a long time to come.

We can also  offer a more bespoke service to meet all of your events requirements and with over 27 years c…

name: Badiani
desc:
Born in 1932 in Florence, Badiani is one of the most famous gelato producers in the world. Our Gelato is crafted in the age old Italian tradition and all of
our recipes are developed by the Award Winning Gelato Maker, Paolo Pomposi.

name: Santa Bifana
desc:
Grandma's & Aunties recipes from Lisbon and the Algarve interpreted by second generation Lisboeta who grew up in the UK. 

We specialise in Grilled meat Portuguese Sandwiches & Handcut fries, nothing is precooked until we arrive at your event.

name: Erims Artistry
desc:
Taste the Difference with Our Homemade Vegan Delights!

I’m thrilled to share with you something close to my heart—my homemade vegan products.

name: Anna-Mae's Mac N Cheese
desc:
"Legendary Mac N Cheese" The Evening Standard 

Anna Mae's are the UK’s original mac n cheese dealers, famous for being one of the innovators of the London food truck scene.   

Self professed mac n cheese addicts, Anna and Tony, founded Anna Mae’s after quitting their office jobs and going on a mammoth road trip across The States collecting recipes as they went.

name: La Lola
desc:
La Lola is an independent food stall based at St Nicks, Bristol since 2021

We  would like to bring our perfect blend of crispy, golden, and delicious churros made fresh  at festivals and events 

Crafted with passion and the finest ingredients, our vegan, dairy-free, and nut-free churros are perfect for everyone to enjoy.

We love coffee!

name: Che Figo Pizza Van Hire For Weddings, Parties, Corporate & Outdoor Events
desc:
Che Figo Caterers covering Norwich, Norfolk, Suffolk, East Anglia, Specialising in Weddings, Parties, Events & Special Occasions, providing the highest levels of food quality & service for all types events.

Pizza Van Hire Serving Premium wood fired pizza & Italian Inspired cuisine, Mobile Bar Hire & Mobile Gelato for a wide range of events.

name: THP Corporate Catering - The Hungry Plaice - Pink Desserts
desc: THP Corporate Catering specialises in high-quality workplace and event catering, serving freshly prepared food from our fleet of professional mobile catering units.

name: Thai Thai
desc:
Thai Thai Wixford is a well-established family run, Thai Restaurant and Caterer, set in the beautiful Warwickshire Countryside (only 10mins from Stratford Upon Avon, Redditch and Evesham).

Using only authentic Thai ingredients, all cooked fresh by our Award Winning Thai Head Chef and her own team of trained Thai Chef.

Our Thai trailers allow us to bring our Thai offering to you and your guests.

name: Demaine Artisan LTD
desc:
The brilliant Demaine Artisan serve up authentic Dishes from around the globe, 
Asian / Mexican / Authentic Neapolitan pizza / Grill Menus are on offer

Always made with authentic Ingredients and techniques, Sean has worked with many great chefs around the globe soaking up their knowledge and enthusiasm , and translating it to His own business which was established in 2017 
The aim being to provid…

name: Demaine Artisan LTD
desc:
The brilliant Demaine Artisan serve up authentic Dishes from around the globe, 
Asian / Mexican / Authentic Neapolitan pizza / Grill Menus are on offer

Always made with authentic Ingredients and techniques, Sean has worked with many great chefs around the globe soaking up their knowledge and enthusiasm , and translating it to His own business which was established in 2017 
The aim being to provid…

name: My Favourite Sandwich
desc:
My Favourite Sandwich is redefining what a sandwich can be bold, inventive, and seriously satisfying. Born in East London, we set out to elevate the humble sarnie into something unforgettable.

From our roots in Shoreditch to our spots in Soho and now Paddington Square, we bring a flavour forward approach to the classics, pairing top tier ingredients with global influences and unexpected twists.

name: Peepal UK
desc:
Peepal UK is one of the finest catering companies offering a first class events, festival, TV and Film Location Catering service throughout the UK.

Founded in 2018, by an experienced Chef director and award winning chef, Kapil Kaushik, the business specialise in catering for Events, Film and TV having earned a reputation for providing the very high standard of cuisine in any type of location all …

name: Beef and Leaf
desc: Beef and Leaf are event catering specialists, dedicated to creating bespoke menus tailored to each unique occasion. We believe that food is at the heart of every memorable event, and our mission is to provide dishes that impress not only with flavour but also with quality and consistency.

name: Aunty Madge Caribbean Cuisine
desc: Aunty Madge Caribbean Cuisine is a proud family-run business, led by me, my husband, and our two sons.

name: Those Caterers (& That Fish Guy)
desc:
Those Caterers & That Fish Guy are caterers based in South Wales. 
We cover;
*South & Mid Wales, 
*West Wales. 
*The South West, 
*The Midlands and M4 Corridor.

name: the yellow spud machine ltd
desc: At The Yellow Spud Machine, we're not just another potato supplier – we're purveyors of culinary delight. Our journey began with a simple love for comfort food and a burning desire to create something extraordinary. Founded by a team of passionate food enthusiasts, our business was born out of the belief that even the humblest of ingredients can be transformed into something truly exceptional.

name: Veggie Republic
desc:
We are a vegan food company established in 2018 starting out as a restaurant in the heart of Liverpool city centre whilst creating a well known and popular brand amongst vegans up and down the country.

We offer all aspects of catering including traditional sit down meals with service, hot and cold buffets and street style food from our 1950s style airstream trailer.

We specialise in weddings and…

name: JAE Catering
desc: JAE Catering has 30 years experience in the food industry.  We are a family run business and all of our staff are hand selected by us and become part of our family.  We can cater to any function or event to any standard.

name: Kurbside Kitchen
desc:
Kurbside Kitchen was established in 2015 with a simple mission: to take the humble street-food classics we all know and love and make them the best they can possibly be.

Since then, we’ve grown from our street-food roots into a passionate event catering company, creating bold, generous and seriously delicious food for weddings, parties, corporate events, festivals and celebrations across the UK.
…

name: Piggy In The Middle
desc:
Hey everyone — welcome to Piggy in the Middle!

I’m so excited to finally introduce you to my passion project. After working in hospitality for over 10 years, I knew it was time to take a leap and do something for myself.

name: O'Gosht
desc: We bring delicious, fresh, crowd-pleasing food that blends the comfort and indulgence of American comfort food with a Middle Eastern presence and influence, inspired by my Kurdish background. The word gosht means meat in Kurdish, so O’Gosht literally means “Oh Meat!” — and that’s exactly the kind of reaction we aim for.

name: Kolkata Grill
desc: Talha and Aman were always destined to create something special. They first met as new recruits at a resturant in London, Both were obsessed with food and flavours, and in particular those from India.

name: The RTG Kitchen
desc: RTG Catering started as a small takeaway service from the home of a passionate young Jamaican chef, driven by a love for food and a deep commitment to authentic, bold flavours. What began as a humble venture quickly grew as the chef’s distinctive Jamaican dishes captivated the local community.

name: Sammy’s kitchen
desc: Sammy’s Kitchen is a vibrant street food brand bringing bold flavors and unforgettable experiences to festivals, events, and private functions across the UK. We specialize in serving Mex-Indian fusion street food, including loaded naan breads, quesadillas, dirty fries, and signature Dubai-style strawberry dessert cups.

name: Rock My Bowl
desc: Rock My Bowl is a tiny boutique catering company with big dreams, big plans and big love for our beautiful planet. RMB specialises in providing seasonal, nourishing and gorgeous food, for shoots, private events and intimate gatherings.

name: Teddy's Fish & Chips
desc: Teddy's Fish & Chips is a highly experienced catering company that specializes in classic, simple, and incredibly delicious fish & chips, along with a fantastic range of vegetarian options.

name: The Old Manor House Bakery
desc:
The Old Manor House Bakery are all about the sweet treats to tantalise your taste buds with their flavoursome Crêpes.

From their gorgeous vintage van, the poshest Crêperie on wheels, they serve delicious freshly made Crêpes that are sure to be a talking point for years to come, captivating your wedding guests as they are absorbed in the theatre of the crêperie.

The perfect addition to your weddi…

name: Chameleon Events
desc:
Essex and London event planning, event management, and catering. Using experienced UK multi-cuisine chefs.

Whether it’s a corporate catering, event catering, party catering, finger food catering, high tea catering, or wedding catering, we pride ourselves on delivering quality, delicious foods, specific to your needs.

Our objective is to provide our clientele with the peace of mind that their eve…

name: Total Hospitality
desc: Total Hospitality is an award winning event catering company with a passion for providing excellent, fresh, locally sourced food with friendly and attentive service.

name: Asado Fire Kitchen
desc: Asado Fire Kitchen brings live fire and food theatrics to your next event.  We've been cooking over wood and charcoal since 2018, honing South American skills with our finest local produce.  A dedicated team of fire aficionados will design a personalised menu and create a feast to suit all styles of event, be it a wedding, a party or a corporate get together.

name: The Bearded Taco
desc:
The Bearded Taco is the love child of Sian and Jake - they both love to travel and love to eat so they have attempted to create a taco menu using influences from the many countries that they have had the pleasure of visiting.

Although authentic Mexican taco's play a pivotal role in our creations, we also use international inspiration to build on a Mexican foundation.

name: Pasta e Basta
desc: We are a family-run fresh pasta company based in Hackney, east London. We make pasta, gnocchi, lasagna and ravioli from scratch using freshly cracked free range eggs and organic Shipton Mill semolina. Choose your selection of dishes and we will cook for your staff in your office to provide the true Italian pasta experience.

name: Brúm Mì
desc:
We're a group of friends that travelled South East Asia and fell in love with Vietnamese food, bánh mì in particular! During Covid we had a hankering for a bánh mì and started making our own. We quickly started offering click and collect services and then moved into street food. The rest is history!

We now offer a range of services.

name: Yamas! Gyros
desc:
Starting up in lockdown after taking inspiration from a trip to Greece, Yamas! was born & we haven’t stopped serving up our yummy Gyros since!

Served in a vintage VW camper van, our baby is designed to turn heads and offer a distinct look ideal for events of any size.

name: Little Bao Boy
desc: We are the OG Bao Streetfood traders. Starting out in 2016 when most people didn't know what a bao bun is to where we are now with 4 sites and a full event team. We care massively about everything we do. Hand-rolled bao buns and fillings all made in-house we take a fairly traditional item and do it for the masses. Flavors everyone loves are done in a way everyone can enjoy.

name: Meat & Greet BBQ
desc:
Hi all,

My name is Lee and I own a family BBQ street food business called “Meat & Greet” in Bury St Edmunds.

I started the business as a mobile butcher developing the business to a gourmet street food truck which serves: steak & chips, steak burgers & loaded loaded fries.

name: Disco Fries
desc: Having worked in office jobs for years and dreaming of one day owning our own business, we eventually in 2017 decided to buy our first food trailer. We had both spent lots of time travelling and had been inspired by the street food across the world, but we wanted to do something that we knew would be popular at events and festivals in the UK, so we decided on the humble chip.

name: Chilli Padi
desc:
Chilli Padi is a restaurant located in Newcastle that is dedicated to bringing authentic Malaysian flavours to the local community. We specialize in Halal meat dishes cooked in the traditional Malaysian street food style. Our interior design also reflects this style, with vibrant decorations and cozy furniture.

We know that in today’s busy world, time is of the essence.

name: Uncle Sam's Corndogs
desc:
Our Story: Uncle Sam's Corndogs

Uncle Sam’s Corndogs is a family-run street food stand that brings the authentic taste of American corndogs to the heart of London. Our journey began with a shared love for market culture and a passion for delicious, quality food. David, who has extensive experience running markets in London, moved to Los Angeles over 30 years ago.

name: Panda Catering Ltd
desc:
At The Panda Noodle House we offer a wide range of delicious and healthy dishes and vegan options that are made fresh on the spot. We use only the freshest ingredients, sourced from local suppliers, to ensure that our food and flavours are of the highest quality.

We only use the Biodegradable food container, wooden cutlery, paper bags, No plastic product to be used.

name: Ya’la
desc: Step into a world of flavour at Ya'la! Tired of the same old bland plant-based options? We've got the solution. Sin-free shawarma! Our menu is inspired by traditional Middle Eastern cuisine, with a vegan twist that sets us apart. We hand make our shawarma with healthy ingredients like cannellini beans and cut all of our salad daily for ultimate freshness.

name: Oyster Boy
desc: Starting as a market trader at Columbia Road Flower Market in 2012, Oyster Boy Events has grown into a bespoke catering and private events company serving up the UK’s finest oysters to a growing client list that includes Chiltern Firehouse, The Groucho Club, Soho House, Cowdray Park Polo Club, 67 Pall Mall, and Berry Bros.

name: Stonebaked with Love
desc:
We have been trading for 11 years.

We are very passionate about Pizzas’s and we like to provide an excellent service.

We use the finest Italian ingredients from Italy.

We have done many of Weddings and Events over the years so we are very experienced.

Our truck has been designed to look like a restaurant on wheels, so people love it.

name: Fancy Fries
desc:
Fancy Fries are a family run mobile catering van serving up hearty food, packed with homemade flavour!

They use only fresh ingredients to make their super tasty rustic skin-on fries, homemade burgers and their absolutely epic fish and chips (our personal favourite).

name: Scarpetta
desc: Welcome to Scarpetta, where we bring the authentic flavours of Italy to your events. Our journey began with a love for Italian cuisine and a dream to share it with others. We serve homemade fresh pasta, lovingly prepared with traditional sauces from our vibrant and beautifully decorated food truck.

name: Stuff and Bite Food Group
desc: At Stuff & Bite, we bring authentic Thai street food to the UK with a modern, sustainable twist. Run by Chef Alex , our story is built on a passion for sharing the bold, vibrant flavours of Thailand in a way that feels both authentic and approachable.

name: Blue Pepper Catering
desc:
We are a family-run caterers in Leeds, West Yorkshire covering the whole of the Yorkshire region for all your catering needs.

Catering for both corporate and private events with a range of options from formal dinners and canapés to hog roasts and barbecues.

name: Lola's Cupcakes
desc: Freshly baked delicious cupcakes and cakes, lots of vegan and gluten free options, all available to buy on our solar powered electric cupcake van. All the cakes are handmade in our London bakery using only the finest and freshest ingredients.

name: Lola Vintage Ice Cream Vans
desc: Lola the vintage van & Dolly the vintage trailer, believe it or not, were both born in the 1970s and have been serving up their luxury artisan ice creams, sorbets and lollies ever since!

name: Jerk Kitchen
desc: Jerk Kitchen Catering is a Modern Caribbean Grill located in Nottingham. We cook mouth watering Jamaican food giving everyone a taste of the flavours from back home. Situated in Nottingham 776 Mansfield Road Woodthorpe we are in the middle of the country so able to cover North and South Regions. We are Jerk Chicken Specialists and marinate our chicken in homemade seasonings for 48hrs.

name: Papelón
desc: Papelón is an award-winning Venezuelan street food brand founded by a couple in 2017 with one soulful mission: to feel closer to their homeland and bring the bold, authentic flavours of Venezuela to the streets of London. What began as a heartfelt way to reconnect with their roots quickly became a passion project that resonated with locals and Venezuelans abroad alike.

name: Pit and Plate ltd
desc: At Pit & Plate, we bring the soulful essence of open-fire cooking to your table, drawing inspiration from the ingredients and culture of our beautiful country. Our culinary journey revolves around the primal allure of fire, the art of grilling, and the celebration of quality ingredients.

name: Avila London
desc:
Inspired by the vibrant flavours of their beloved Venezuela, Avila London are passionate about creating the best Venezuelan food in the world, and sharing it with people at events here in the UK. 

A family-run business, Avila take great pride in their family recipes that have been passed down from generation to generation, using only the freshest ingredients.

name: Jeco Bowl
desc: Jeco Bowl brings fresh, vibrant, and healthy 100% vegan and gluten-free options to the UK's most prominent events. Inspired by travels, we serve tropical and colourful smoothie bowls, pancake stacks, smoothies, protein shakes, speciality coffee, and hot drinks.

name: Kura Kura
desc:
Kura Kura specialise in authentic Sri-Lankan street food. Trading from our fabulously converted orange, blue & purple 1950's horsebox, our freshly cooked, aromatic Sri Lankan street food is as delicious as it is unique and exciting!

Kura Kura offer a delicious selection of Sri-Lankan curries, including a chicken curry, cashew curry, pineapple curry, coconut dahl and homemade sauces to tweak your …

name: Seven Mile Cookery & Events
desc:
At Seven Mile, we believe that every event is an opportunity to create something extraordinary. Nestled in the picturesque Heart of England, our family-owned business brings a unique blend of local elegance and global flavours to elevate your special occasions.

Specialising in hearty, often gluten free food, every style of event and audience can be catered for.

name: Indian Summer
desc: We started as a small family food stall during lockdown, as a way to get the rich flavours of Jayanth’s aunties delicious recipes out into the world. Growing up in Chennai, she learnt from the surroundings and her fondest memories were being treated to Kati Rolls on her visits to Kolkata.

name: 1882 Events Ltd t/a Chick 'n' Sours
desc:
Chick ‘n’ Sours was born in Haggerston in May 2015 after the founders Carl & David had spent the previous two years creating pop up dining experiences in East London and wanted a bricks & mortar site to continue to deliver experiences built on mind blowing food & drink, exceptional hospitality and banging tunes.
    
The concept was simple - next level fried chicken, sour cocktails & awesome vibes…

name: Dolly Sticks
desc:
Dolly Sticks is a female led business by a self-taught baker obsessed with vintage lollies and big chocolatey flavours - they deffo taste as good as they look.

Cake pops, cookie sandos, brownies or cheesecake slabs, we have you covered! We can work with your colour scheme, branding, initials, WHATEVER!

name: 1882 Events Ltd t/a Chick 'n' Sours
desc:
Chick ‘n’ Sours was born in Haggerston in May 2015 after the founders Carl & David had spent the previous two years creating pop up dining experiences in East London and wanted a bricks & mortar site to continue to deliver experiences built on mind blowing food & drink, exceptional hospitality and banging tunes.
    
The concept was simple - next level fried chicken, sour cocktails & awesome vibes…

name: Little Cake Co.
desc: It’s time to celebrate and our West London bakery specialises in crafting incredible miniature cakes that are guaranteed to leave a lasting impression. Each and every one of our mouth-watering cakes are carefully decorated by hand by our expert team of bakers, ensuring that not only are they visually stunning but also amazingly delicious.

name: Dolly Sticks
desc:
Dolly Sticks is a female led business by a self-taught baker obsessed with vintage lollies and big chocolatey flavours - they deffo taste as good as they look.

Cake pops, cookie sandos, brownies or cheesecake slabs, we have you covered! We can work with your colour scheme, branding, initials, WHATEVER!

name: The Street Kitchen
tagline: Street Food with abit of Class
desc:
Hey You! 

We started off our journey taking over a smoked meat company (delicious I know) but we found there just wasn't enough flare to our meals. We have since rebranded after falling in love with all things STREET FOOD and have crated 'The Street Kitchen'. 

You will notice our logo states Est.

name: Handmade Pizza Co
desc:
Operating for 10 years, we only started with one little oven !

Weddings, Partys, corporate etc

Wood fired fresh pizza 

Authentic Greek gyros 

Halloumi fries and vegan burgers 

Great experience in public events such as F1, Royal Windsor, Crufts, Cheltenham festival and many more

Our food is always fresh and top quality along side great customer service.

name: Mr Hot Dog
desc: We’re an outdoor catering specialist in York. We do one thing and do it well, and that’s hot dogs. Specialising in outdoor catering, we serve up premium hot dogs from out little silver Bistro Pod to all your guests.

name: Lola Vintage Ice Cream Vans
desc: Lola the vintage van & Dolly the vintage trailer, believe it or not, were both born in the 1970s and have been serving up their luxury artisan ice creams, sorbets and lollies ever since!

name: ChilliDogs
desc:
Introducing ChilliDogs - the catering service that guarantees to add the 'WOW' factor to any event! With their one-of-a-kind hot dogs, chillidogs, and loaded nachos, your guests will be amazed by the quality and taste of their delicious, nitrite-free street food.

ChilliDogs only use 100% British rare breed super high-welfare pork, which is produced solely for them by an expert charcuterie.

name: Kurbside Kitchen
desc:
Kurbside Kitchen was established in 2015 with a simple mission: to take the humble street-food classics we all know and love and make them the best they can possibly be.

Since then, we’ve grown from our street-food roots into a passionate event catering company, creating bold, generous and seriously delicious food for weddings, parties, corporate events, festivals and celebrations across the UK.
…

name: Agua Na Boca
desc:
Agua Na Boca in English means “MOUTHWATERING” and the word says it all. The company was founded in May 2013. The owner, Andre Gailey Coutinho has been working in the Hospitality Business in London for the past 21 years. With his passion for food, he was looking to bring  some of  Brazil's most popular food to the streets of London


So here it is...  a food stall with a difference!

name: Wow Bao Club
desc:
I run a pan Asian street food pop up serving soft fluffy bao buns . 
Customer feedback is exceptional, primarily based on the tastiness of our delicious food. We spare no expense when sourcing the highest quality ingredients, from free-range chicken to our hand-made sauces and marinades - we take extreme pride in what we do.

name: The RTG Kitchen
desc: RTG Catering started as a small takeaway service from the home of a passionate young Jamaican chef, driven by a love for food and a deep commitment to authentic, bold flavours. What began as a humble venture quickly grew as the chef’s distinctive Jamaican dishes captivated the local community.

name: Broll grill
desc:
Our company is family owned, we are Brazilians from the south of Brazil, a region  known for its typical food and the best barbecue in the country.

We brought the best barbecue from Brazil to England, we serve it in the form of a sandwich to innovate and make it easier for the customer to takeaway, Our sandwich is unique and with our own recipe served with a thin and fresh wrap bread with our exc…

name: The Original Pasty House
desc:
History 
Steve and Emma met behind the Other Stage at Glastonbury in 2007, both driving for bands – Steve for Arcade Fire, Emma 
for Rufus Wainwright. After several festivals together, they parted ways but reunited in 2020. In 2022, they combined 
Emma’s catering expertise and Steve’s festival experience to launch a catering trailer, inspired by The Original Pasty House 
restaurants.

name: Bute Pizza
desc:
We are Richard & George, and together we created The Bute Pizza Co - an independent mobile pizza co bringing you pizza that is stone baked and admires Neapolitan methods whilst being new, fun and forward in its thinking.

In 2020 we started playing with dough, creating the best pizzas we could and after, it seems, our last ever holiday to the Isle of Bute, we set on our name and the business was b…

name: Traditional Ice Cream (Tricycles)
desc: Hi I’m Debs and I serve individual tubs of award winning local dairy ice creams and sorbets from my beautiful vintage Pashley tricycles.

name: Smash and grab food truck
desc:
We are 'smash and grab food truck'.  We operate in the Cambridge area, serving amazing smashburgers & fries from our groovy vintage Citroën HY van. 

As well as our smashburgers, we also offer 'earth burgers' for our vegetarian guests.

We work pub pitches, corporate events, birthday parties & even events the size of a Cambridge May Ball!

name: Duo Catering
desc:
We offer high quality products from award winning butchers and bakers. Offering 4 different styles of sausage! XXL Krakauer, Bratwurst, Frankfurter and a smoked seitan vegan dog. This is all Complimented by our fresh bakers hot dog roll and tasty toppings. 

We have high quality staff that work all year round, so understand the catering industry.

name: Tomahawk Argentinian Grill
desc: Tomahawk Argentinian Grill was born from a deep passion for authentic live-fire cooking and the rich culinary heritage of Argentina.

name: Cactus Franks
desc: We are a family-run, North London-based establishment that specializes in fresh Mexican cuisine, bringing you the most authentic street food experience possible.

name: Wahad
desc:
Our mission is to unite people through food. Wahad is a fusion of authentic 
Afghan flavours and familiar favourites, aiming to bring a fresh street food 
option to UK markets, festivals and fairs

* Culinary Heritage: Authentic Afghan recipes adapted for the UK palate
* Five-Star Expertise: Masterfully crafted by our 5* chef trained in Dubai
* Healthy Indulgence: Handmade with love in our kitchen…

name: Melts Winter Warmers
desc: Delicious Street Food and indoor served event Catering including may Festive Winter Warmers (Yorkshire pudding wraps, Turkey and all the trimmings and festive pies!)  as well as American style Giant Gourmet Hot Dogs with toppings, Mac and cheese, Greek Gyros, Juicy Burgers,  Loaded Fries with meat and veggie toppings, vegan options and lots more!

name: PICK.YOUR.OWN.
desc: PICK.YOUR.OWN. will revolutionise the daily salad with bowls packed with organic produce and masses of flavour, with wild salmon and regeneratively farmed meat roasted and slow-cooked daily on site, seasonal British veggies marinated with bold flavours and fresh organic juices made to order. P.Y.O.’s mission is to help customers choose better. Starting with the soil, P.Y.O.

name: Hyderabadi Dhaba
desc:
My name is Mujeeb and I run Hyderabadi Dhaba (street food) in Milton Keynes. I am from Hyderabad, a very famous city for food in India and Dhaba refers to “A road side food stall”. 
Hyderabadi Dhaba would like to bring the same Authentic flavour and taste in MK and areas around. I have been in catering for more than 15 years and worked as a head chef in many Asian cuisines.

name: Rizz Catering
desc:
Founded by the team behind cult rice pudding label Rizz Rice, we've grown from humble market stalls to full-scale catering for birthdays, weddings, product launches, and corporate activations. 

Our roots are in handcrafted, high quality rice-based desserts, but today, we offer everything from ice cream sandwiches and waffle wands to luxe dessert platters, rice pudding and milkshake bars.

name: Jessecco Prosecco & Pancakes
desc:
Prosecco & Pancakes served from a vintage horsebox covered in fairly lights!

Our pancakes include, buttermilk, Vegan & Gluten Free, sweet and savoury options available. 

We can also serve other drinks, including hot drinks, Tea and Coffee and why not an Amaretto Hot Choccy or Mulled Wine in the festive months!

name: Alaburrito
desc: At Alaburrito, we specialize in creating unforgettable catering experiences for every occasion. Whether it’s a wedding, corporate event, birthday, or festival, we bring the best of global flavours to your table.

name: Sixth Sense Events
desc: Sixth Sense Events creates immersive food and drink experiences for corporate events, brand activations, exhibitions and private celebrations. Originally known for our Founders ice cream brand - Whipsmiths ice cream, we have grown into a full experiential events partner, delivering theatrical catering concepts that do far more than simply serve guests.

name: Club Pizza
desc:
My experience as a chef spans everything from London theatre district eateries to exciting, new street food ventures.

Now, Club Pizza is my own business.

We’re passionate about great ingredients, preferring local options whenever possible.

name: THE PIZZA CLUB LONDON LTD
desc:
Welcome to The Pizza Club London Ltd — we don’t do it for the money, we do it for the dough.
Born from humble beginnings with just one trailer, The Pizza Club London has grown steadily over the past three years into a vibrant, much-loved pizza brand. What started as a passion project has now evolved into a fleet of two beautifully converted vintage horse boxes and a sleek, modern Airstream.

name: Crêpe Britain
desc:
I’m Julie, the owner of Crêpe Britain, which I’ve been running for over 8 years. I initially started out with vintage ice cream tricycles in 2011 & initially thought crêpes would be a winter business, but they’ve proven to be a beloved treat year-round!
