We offer freshly made crêpes from a charming vintage-style horsebox, and if space is limited, we also provide a gazebo setup.

name: Esmies Caribbean Fusion
desc: Esmie’s Caribbean Fusion is a vibrant, family-founded street food brand bringing the warmth, flavour and energy of the Caribbean to events across the Midlands and beyond. Founded by Esmie, whose roots trace back to St. Kitts & Nevis, the business began with a passion for sharing authentic island food and culture.

name: Woodfired Guys
desc:
Set up by two childhood friends from East Kilbride who are fanatical about creating the perfect pizza, Woodfired Guys bring the authentic wood-fired pizzeria to you.

They offer a selection of classic Neapolitan options, made with a special 48 hour fermentation dough that takes the flavour and crusts to the next level.

name: The Pizza Pie Guy
desc:
Hi, welcome to The Pizza Pie Guy.  We are able to cater for both smaller and larger events and have two options/set ups available.
We have our converted vintage trailer which provides wonderful aesthetics especially for weddings and corporate events and we also have our gazebo based set up which offers great practicality for events in areas where space is limited.

name: Poutinie
desc: Hi, I’m Julian, I started Poutinie because there’s a real gap in the UK for proper Canadian poutine. People actually travel from all over to our home unit in Tooting because they miss the food from home, and we love hearing their stories about Canada and why poutine means so much to them. We do it the right way: golden crispy fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich, signature gravy.

name: Maracatu grill
desc: Maracatu is a vibrant Brazilian street food and catering business born from a deep love for grilling, bold flavors, and sharing culture. Founded by a Brazilian family passionate about hospitality and authentic food, we bring the festive soul of Brazil to every event.

name: sear.
desc:
About sear.

sear. was founded in London in 2021 with a simple belief. 
Street food should never mean second best.

We started with a frustration. Too much modern food relies on shortcuts, industrial oils and ultra processed ingredients. So we built something different.

name: The Safari Social Club
desc: Here at The Safari Social Club, we're all about bringing great Wood Fired Pizza's, Burgers & Fries, Salads, Cocktails , Coffee & Draught Beer to you. We're a business with a conscience as 1% of our overall sales go to charity. Most recently, that Charity has been 'The Felix Project' which provides meals for Londoners in need.

name: El Kantina
desc:
El Kantina serve up delicious Mexican and Southern food across the UK. 

Choose Street Food from their beautiful vintage Horsebox trailer/Gazebo or choose a vibrant Multi-course Feasting Menu for a seated celebration. The choice is yours!

We have all 5 star ratings across Google and Facebook and 14 years experience in the wedding and event sector. We have even catered for Tom Cruise and Co.

name: Ice Mania
desc:
The Ice Mania team love to create phenomenal experiences at events with their brightly coloured stall and amazing rolled ice cream.

Their product of freshly made ice cream rolls not only tastes amazing but it's something that everyone loves to watch as it's being made or even have a go themselves. The whole experience creates a buzz and is definitely gets people’s attention.

name: Chows Food Trucks
desc:
Chows Eating House in Parkgate has been established for over 50 years and has been proud to be part of the Wirral and Cheshires' dining community.

Lately collaborating with the famous Parkgate Fish & chips, the Good Food Award Winners of 2023/24 serving fresh Atlantic Cod to visitors and locals alike.

Chows Eating House and Parkgate Fish & Chips introduce our mobile catering unit bringing the be…

name: A Few Scoops
desc: The Ice Cream Events Company are here to turn your ice cream dreams into reality! Whatever the weather, ice cream creates such a buzz at any event but we like to turn it up a notch.

name: Brazilian Empire
desc: Introducing the Brazilian Empire, where our culinary passion meets exceptional customer care! Step into a vibrant world of flavours at our bright gazebo.

name: BIAN DANG
desc:
My name is  Tristan,I am the owner and founder of Bian Dang UK and I am determined to deliver quantity, quality, convenience and value for money – something every hungry person can get on board with.
Bian Dang is a Taiwanese street food with a difference food in the UK that serves Rice Boxes, Bao and other dishes like mushroom fries, grilled vegetable dumplings, and salt and pepper chicken strips.…

name: Absolute Melt
desc:
Welcome to Absolute Melt! 🧀

If you love melted cheese as much as we do, you've come to the right place. From the rich, gooey goodness of melted raclette to our cheesy twists on classic street food, we aim to bring you a mouthwatering experience straight from our vibrant orange trailer.

name: Mr Whippy Soft Ice Creams
desc:
Mr Whippy Soft Ice Cream are the number one choice when it comes to Ice cream Van Hire. 

We operate from Lancashire, Yorkshire and are able to offer the very best quality ice cream vans to enhance any event or function. We hold 5 million pounds public liability insurance for your safety as well as all staff having Level 2 health and hygiene certificates.

name: Pizza Con Amore - Pizza with love ❤️
desc:
Pizza Con Amore may be new, but we’ve been serving up delicious Neapolitan wood-fired pizzas since 2019. Our founder Jamez, Founded O Vesu Van Neapolitan Pizza (also on the together.com platform) and achieved one of the highest rated on reviews and booking for pizza vans under his ownership.

We use only the freshest, Italian sourced ingredients in our pizzas.

name: Krunch
desc:
Otherwise known as gamja hot dog are a satisfying street food that's common in the night markets of Seoul in Korea. 
Quality Premium Beef & Vegi doggs or stringy mozzarella cheese are coated in a fluffy dough and rolled in a variety of toppings before being fried to a perfect Krunch and complimented with a wide variety of sauces and sprinklings.

name: Flette La Tartiflette/ Raclette
desc:
You don’t need to be on a ski slope to enjoy delicious, comforting, french food. La Tartiflette supplies authentic dishes, cooked on site in giant pans by distinguished Jean Pierre.

La Tartiflette originated in the French Alps .

name: Cabana Brasil
desc: Drawing inspiration from the vibrant Rio of the 1950s, where the Samba resonated through the streets, Bossa Nova melodies filled the air, and Havana cigar smoke lingered in late-night bars. Whether you're reserving a table for a sizable group, planning a stag/hen do, or considering private hire for a work social, we offer a variety of options to suit your needs.

name: Vudu Catering
desc: Vudu Food is a well established private catering company, with experience in corporate catering, wedding catering, intimate dinner parties, and street food. With Vudu Food you are able to tailor a bespoke catering package to perfectly suit your needs and vision for your event.

name: Spice Shack
desc: Introducing Spice Shack, the culinary sensation that's been wowing taste buds across numerous festivals, corporate events, and private gatherings.

name: THINK GREEK
desc: The idea behind the company was to create a unique taste of traditional Greek street food. As a foreigner in London, I felt homesick many times. Food was always a big love of mine whether it was to cook or eat it. Cooking the food of my home country helped me overcome that feeling. However, I realized that this is something missing from London.

name: Chunkys airstream
desc: A young girl with a dream. Ever since a young girl all i wanted was an American airstream and serve loaded burgers and fries. 4 years ago i turned my dream to reality when i brought my first airstream. Since then chunkys has grown from strength to strength serving thousands of people at some of the biggest events in the uk.

name: Mangiamo
desc: Born from a love of authentic Italian street food and a passion for creating unforgettable experiences, we launched our mobile pizza catering business to bring the magic of Neapolitan pizza to events across Scotland. With a background in hospitality and a flair for entertaining, our team is all about delivering great food with a warm, personal touch.

name: Eat Meat Cheese Repeat
desc: Eat Meat Cheese Repeat is a family-run street food business with over 17 years of experience, founded by Paul after importing a 1960s Airstream trailer from Texas.

name: Smoke Truck
desc:
Smoke Truck Ltd was bought to life in 2021 by a husband and wife duo who share the love of food.

Purchasing a VW van and converting it into a fully mobile food truck, offering the finest smash burgers, using only the best ingredients available from locally sourced suppliers.

name: Black Buck
desc: We started of as dessert vendors 4 years ago and have attended festivals, events, food shows and found that there was a gap in the market for people that had food allergies/intolerances, my wife and I are both coeliac and dairy intolerant and found it very hard to eat events and festivals.

name: Crêperie Oui!
desc:
Crêperie Oui’s iconic truck and crew will definitely charm your guests - the theatre of crepe making is a spectacle in itself- people love to stand and chat, so the queues will always be entertained - they even play music from their very cool vintage speaker!

The team can cater for vegetarians, vegans if requested, and meat eaters.

name: Dass Hospitality
desc:
Dass is a family run company founded by couple Danny and Abbi. 
With over 40 years of combined experience Dass is all about bringing the best hospitality, service & quality to any event that needs food and beverage, 

We cater to your needs and your wants. We have a can do attitude and if you're happy we're happy.

name: The Flygerians
desc:
We are Jess and Jo A.K.A The Flygerians  two larger than life sister,  bringing the Sweet taste of Nigeria to the Streets of London. 

We first started cooking from the ages of 9 and 10. Our legendary Grandma used to have us cooking up a Nigerian feast for the 5000.

name: Sud Italia
desc:
Sud Italia Neapolitan pizza offer something truly unique when it comes to their pizzas, because they use a special blend of different types of Italian flour, with 20% wheat flour.

They don’t use a secret recipe, their dough is simply made with a few simple ingredients, such as flour, water, yeast, and salt.

name: Duck + Roll
desc: Duck + Roll launched in 2023 and focuses on bold, flavour-led street food with a crispy edge, centred around duck with pan-Asian flavours.

name: ABUELOS PIZZA
desc: My name is Connor, I am the founder of Abuelos Pizza, a mobile catering business Inspired by my grandparents passion for cooking, I wanted to build something that celebrates family, food, and togetherness.

name: Seoul Food
desc:
Seoul Food brings the unique and vibrant taste of Seoul South Korea to the UK.
We started in 2022 after the pandemic. Having worked in the Korean restaurant industry most of my life I decided it's now or never and have never looked back!

We specialise in Korean Fried Chicken!

name: GRK street food
desc:
We are a family business and we have been trading over 7 years. We are Based in Northumberland however we do travel nationally for the right events!

We sell the highest quality and freshest Greek streetfood around. All our chicken is cooked fresh on site each day as well as our salads and sauces!

We have fantastic looking streetfood trucks to match our delicious food!

name: Sourdough Pizza Co.
desc:
Sourdough Pizza Co is a pizza trailer business from Stony Stratford, Buckinghamshire that covers all of the surrounding counties and more. 

We make artisan stone baked sourdough pizza straight from our unique converted horse box trailer. We specialise in timeless hits from your classic Margherita’s right the way through to the more adventurous, like our fiery nduja!

name: Arlo’s Chocolate
desc:
Indulge in a sensory delight with our chocolate fountain food stall, bought to you by two sisters, Ellie and Anna Guest who translated their love for all things sweet into a chocolate street food business,

 We bring the magic of a cascade of velvety chocolate, served with fresh juicy strawberries, fluffy marshmallows and decadent brownies.

name: STACKED
desc:
STACKED is a specialty pancake trailer serving fresh, fluffy pancakes with a choice of indulgent or healthy toppings.

We offer four different batters - classic, high-protein, vegan, and gluten-free - so every guest can enjoy something made for them.

name: Jam Jar Jesmond
desc:
Jam Jar is passionate about going the extra mile to make sure every event is  truly special. We genuinely love events as much as our customers do, and we bring that enthusiasm to everything we do.
With a strong focus on quality, a dedicated team, and extensive experience in the events industry, we pride ourselves on delivering a seamless and memorable food experience that guests will talk about lo…

name: Forno Sourdough Pizza
desc:
At Forno Pizza, our story began on the festival fields, long before we opened our Bournemouth pizzeria. We honed our craft serving crowds at events, perfecting the art of woodfired sourdough pizza and learning what makes a truly great catering experience.

Our setups are a huge part of what makes us stand out.

name: Little Baobab
desc:
The wonderful Little Baobab are all about authentic Senegalese style and soul. Head Chef Khadim serves traditional dishes with a modern twist and their grilled chicken, curries and stews are going a storm at events all across London!

Their food is fresh, flavourful and fun and goes down a treat with those looking for an interesting option at their event.

name: Andhra Ruchulu Ltd
desc: South Indian Street Food brings the authentic taste of Andhra Pradesh to London. Founded by Vara nearly four years ago, our passion is sharing traditional home-style South Indian food made using family recipes and authentic cooking methods.

name: Milan Catering & Events Ltd
desc: At Milan Catering & Events food is more than just what we serve, it’s part of our story. For over 52 years, our family-run catering business has been proudly creating delicious memories for generations of customers.

name: Del Vecchios Pizza
desc: At Del Vecchio’s Pizza you get a real taste of Italy. Set up by Ivan Del Vecchio from Puglia the ingredients and recipe, handed down many generations, are all authentically Italian. Having been bought up in the catering industry in Italy Ivan has over 10 years experience.

name: The Greedy Pig
desc:
Two friends with a love of good burgers, great beers and exceptional quality. Using locally sourced produce and 45 years worth of experience we aim to offer a a quality package no matter what the options. 

We offer gourmet burgers, pulled pork, hog roasts, dirty fries, grazing tables and sides as well as craft beer and cider.

name: Yorkshire Burrito
desc:
The amazing Yorkshire Burrito does exactly what it says on the tin: utterly delicious Sunday roast food wrapped in a classic Yorkshire Pudding as a burrito!

There's nothing in the world more delicious than a traditional British roast and we were desperate to serve it in a manner that made it easy to eat without having to host a sit down meal.

name: Rose Events Catering
desc: Rose Events is a family run events business bringing feel good vibes, friendly faces and seriously tasty treats to weddings, parties and corporate events.

name: Lime Face
desc: Lime Face is a family run business that specialises in South East Asian street foods including Fusion Bao Buns and Malaysian food. They cater for both Vegan and Vegetarians, gluten free and any dietary requirements.

name: Evelyns
desc: At Evelyn's, we believe that the heart of our business is not just in the exceptional quality of our treats but in the message they carry – an emblem of gratitude and recognition for every individual's role, from the CEO to the diligent cleaning staff.

name: Waffle Kart
desc: We started Waffle Kart in January 2023 wanting to share our love of fried chicken and waffles with the North West. Maisie has family in both New York and Hong Kong, so you'll find both of these influences on our menu. From our Chilli Crisp Chicken Sandwich, to the Waffle Prawn Toast (my Dad's recipe!) - everything is made from scratch, using quality ingredients.

name: En Root
desc: With flagship restaurants aross South London, En Root caters any event with our glorious food truck, market stall set up or on site kitchen takeover experience. With a focus on health and well-being, En Root celebrates fresh seasonal vegetables, wholesome pulses and aromatic Gujarati spices to bring nutritional joy served with a smile.

name: Tex's Smoke and Grill
desc: We are a mobile catering service specialising in Texas style craft barbecue. We use authentic American hickory hard wood to ensure maximum flavour and softness. We offer a pop up service as well as an indoor service. We can offer our full menu or a tailor made menu to suit your event needs.

name: Testi Catering
desc:
As a family-operated eatery established in 2000, we take pride in our culinary legacy. Our commitment to excellence has been recognized with the prestigious Best Restaurant Award in North and West London for both 2019 and 2023.

At our restaurant, we prioritize offering the finest cuisine available.

name: Mexi Bean Express
desc:
Hola Amigos,

Multi Award winning Mexi Bean Express established in 2020 , is renowned for its authentic Mexican cuisine, Mexi Bean Express has really made its mark across Yorkshire, with multiple stores in Huddersfield, Halifax, Brighouse, Sowerby Bridge, & Manchester.

We have an taco-tactic food truck and also a trailer that can be hired out as a dessert stop/ for smaller events!

We serve  Burr…

name: Slice One Limited
desc: Slice One is all about exceptional wood-fired pizza made with carefully sourced ingredients. We offer a diverse menu with options for vegetarians, vegans, and gluten-free diners, ensuring everyone can enjoy a slice.

name: Dough it reyt
desc: Bring the flavour and fun of authentic wood-fired pizza to your next event! Our customizable menu lets you tailor toppings and styles to match your theme and delight your guests.

name: Pompiere Pizza Co
tagline: Artisan Pizza in a Fire Engine
desc:
Looking for something unique to bring a wow-factor to your event? Then you've come to the right place.

Everyone loves pizza, and retro vans look cool in any setting, so our vintage fire engine is sure to grab the attention.

name: Amrutha On Road
desc: Innovative plant-based dishes and heart-warming classics are lovingly prepared on the premises by our chefs on a daily basis.

name: Outlaw Street Food
desc:
Outlaw Street Food believe that choosing the food and drink is one of the most fun parts of the party or wedding planning process, and we couldn't agree more.

Outlaw love a good wedding or party as much as anyone, and they work closely with their clients to make sure that everything is taken care of and that the food is exactly what you want.

The team specialise in delicious wood fired, Asian in…

name: Gopal's Curry Shack
desc:
Gopal’s Curry Shack have been bring creative, vegan, vibrant dishes to weddings, parties and street food events in the West Country for 10 years. 

We pride ourselves  on working alongside the client to produce a menu that is just right for the occasion. We enjoy celebrations with a relaxed or festival style feel where guests can collect their food.

name: Canatelz
desc: Canatelz is a street food brand bringing bold American-inspired comfort food to events across London and the South East.

name: Wood Fired Pizza Shack
desc: Prepare to experience pizza like you never have before with our delicious thin-crust pizzas at your next event. We have developed a secret formula to make our bases even thinner and crispier and our menu is the perfect mix of all time classics and a choice of tasty toppings, we are confident there is something for everyone to enjoy.

name: Degchi
desc: Degchi is a culinary venture that specializes in creating and serving delicious, aromatic, and flavorful biryani dishes. We offer a variety of biryanis, including classic chicken biryani, fragrant vegetable biryani, succulent mutton biryani, and more.

name: London Catering Services
desc:
We serve authentic, sustainable fish & chips with traditional accompaniments like pickled Gherkins and Mushy Peas from our beautifully restored Citron H van.

Fish & Chips are fun, a guilty pleasure, and a Great British old-fashioned classic.  The tempting aroma of the salt & vinegar draws you in and the crunch of the batter on the fish or the crispiness of the chips are irresistible.

name: CBP catering Ltd
desc: We are a team of large scale corporate event chefs, who turned our hands to the world of street food in 2021.

name: Smoke BBQ Kitchen 'On the Go'
desc:
Our food is made for sharing and having a good old time! 

We are an independent smokehouse and BBQ Restaurant in Bishop’s Stortford also offering street food from our food trailer and gazebo stand. 

Our meats are slow-cooked in original wood smokers for up to 12 hours and we can now bring these authentic flavours to your local area or event.

name: The Pink Elephant
desc: The Pink Elephant is a Hertfordshire/ London-based event planning and styling brand that curates bespoke, stylish experiences. From tailored event styling and sustainable wines to entertainment and bespoke catering packages whilst supporting small independent businesses. We manage every detail, acting as a single point of contact to bring your vision to life.

name: Evie’s kitchen
desc:
Evies kitchen is a business built on love and family. 

We offer full catering service. 
We've previously worked at many different events from a fete in our town to pinewood studios serving the likes of Tom Hamks on his film
'Here'

We've taken a break from events to open open our full time venue!

name: City Jollof
desc: City Jollof was initially conceived from a desire to share the vibrant flavours of West Africa with the city of London.

name: CBP catering Ltd
desc: We are a team of large scale corporate event chefs, who turned our hands to the world of street food in 2021.

name: emg events catering
desc:
we have been working in the mobile catering industry for 60 years with our grandparents being one of the originators with a mobile fish and chip bus 
traveling events in the late 60's 
a lot has changed since then and our business has grown a lot however we still have a special place for our traditional fish and chip trailer that we still batter the fish the same today
however its not all traditio…

name: Mango Indian Kitchen
desc:
We Bespoke Authentic Indian Food to Cater for all Corporate Events - Big or Small - Just talk to us we will create a menu that fits your brief and budget.

We will listen to you and deliver - Just check our reviews on Google.

We craft the menu's - this is light and tasty, fresh food. Whether its serviced or a hot delivery.

name: Amen Catering
desc: Migrating from Ethiopia as a young man, I held fond memories of my mum cooking when I was a child. Watching a cook and learning from her how all the flavours work and the art of cooking as a whole. Not only the cooking but the way it brought us altogether, in Ethiopian tradition we eat together.

name: Hope You’re Hungry!
desc:
Hope You’re Hungry is a young, passionate, female lead street food business specialising in exquisite East Asian inspired dishes. The business is owned and ran by Hope and a tightly-knit group of friends all passionate about producing top quality East Asian dishes. 

The business began in the home kitchen of Hopes mom offering takeaways to the local people in Birmingham.

name: Soul Fries
desc: Soul Fries are a small passionate team led by husband and wife, Tony and Charly. Passionate about only serving the best quality loaded fries matched with only the friendliest service.

name: Oh So Pancakes
desc:
Mini Dutch Pancakes, Ice Cream Rolls & Waffles - freshly made and served live at your event.

We specialise in premium, handcrafted desserts that add a fun, memorable and interactive experience to your special day.

Our Mini Dutch Pancakes are a consistent favourite with wedding guests, and we also serve Ice Cream Rolls, Belgian Waffle Sticks and indulgent Waffle Balls - perfect for wedding breakf…

name: Spier's Catering
desc:
At Spier’s, we’re a team of seasoned caterers with one clear mission: to serve fresh, homemade food that people actually get excited about — not a soggy sandwich platter in sight.

We create vibrant grab‑and‑go boxes, beautifully presented sharing platters, and fully bespoke menus for events of every kind.

name: Three Little Pigs-LM Caterers
desc:
My partner and I established a business with the goal of providing excellent homemade food for takeaway. Later on, we decided to purchase our first horsebox and transform it into a mobile kitchen so that we could extend our service to events and parties. 

We pride ourselves on being kind and amiable individuals who always strive to meet our customers' needs.

name: Bucci Pizza
tagline: Make your day a Bucciful day
desc:
We are a family obsessed with pizza and Americana, so we decided to create the pizza we wanted to eat and sell it from the trailer we designed.
 
We toiled and toiled until we created the pizza we wanted to eat.

name: The Bao Beast
desc: The Bao Beast is your go-to for mouthwatering Asian fusion cuisine, specialising in bao buns. Our menu features homemade, soft, pillowy bao buns filled with tantalising options like 6-hour BBQ brisket, Korean chicken, Chinese pork and plant-based shiitake mushrooms.

name: BrIce London
desc:
BrIce London is an Artisanal Italian Gelato and Sorbet manufacturer dedicated to meeting all your needs!

Combining authentic taste, smooth texture and plant-based recipes, without having to sacrifice the quality of the product.

We provide eye-catching Ice cream carts letting your guests order their gelato and watch it be scooped up in style.
Ice cream carts add some fun to any event.

name: Waffle Wands
desc: Waffle Wands are a unique, tasty, sweet treat dessert, perfect for gatherings, wedding receptions, birthday parties, outdoor events and festivals.

name: MELT HOUSE
desc: We are delighted to introduce you to MELT HOUSE, a family-run business born in 2020. I'm Pietro, the founder, originally from Italy, with over 15 years of experience in the hospitality industry.

name: Wonderful Whippy Ltd
desc:
Ice cream van hire available to cover all types of events throughout the country.
5 star hygiene rating, friendly and professional service. 
All drivers are fully uniformed, food safety trained and DBS checked. 
Fully insured to cover any type of event.
Awarding winning ice cream.

name: Original Lebanese Grill
desc:
"Experience the authentic flavours of Lebanon with a twist! Our menu features a huge variety of traditional salads, pickles, and side dishes, alongside our signature hand-marinated and perfectly cooked shawarma and freshly made falafel.

Indulge in our delicious tabbouleh, Greek salad, orzo salad, artichoke salad, and many more.

name: Wood Fired Events
tagline: Made by hand; Cooked by fire
desc: At Wood Fired Events, we offer a bespoke experience in great food made from scratch and cooked with fire. The star of our set-up is our beautifully converted Horse box trailer with our wood-fired oven on the back - a real head-turner.

name: Meat:Stack
desc: Meat:Stack is a Newcastle-based burger company that serves up insanely tasty burgers that are smashed and steamed for the real American cheeseburger experience.

name: Poke Nom
desc:
Welcome to Poke Nom - the colourful blend of Hawaiian Fusion Dishes across London and the UK

Poke Nom are all about bringing fresh, seasonal dishes to your events, tailored to match the occasion and the time of year.

name: Pretty Boy Tacos
tagline: We bring the kitchen to you.
desc:
We are two chefs and best friends that have worked along side each other for over 10 years and have dabbled with different variety of cuisines and events but decided to focus on the dish we love to cook the most which is tacos.

We believe the branding and of course the people behind it can make this brand go to the top, we specialise in unique recipes and flavours with our own modern twist, how w…

name: CakeDrop
desc:
CakeDrop is an award-winning treats supplier founded by sisters, Anna and Nicola Ward in 2017. 

CakeDrop specialises in creating innovative themed and branded treats for every corporate occasion, from workplace celebrations and internal company events, to product launches, exhibitions and brand activations.

There is nothing we love more than bringing brands to life with sugar - whether it's crea…

name: Grace & Skye
desc: Grace and Skye are a dynamic catering company based in South East London. Having worked extensively around street food and the vibrant festival scene for the last 10 years, Skye has now branched out under the iconic G&S blue truck to serve up Posh Dogs from their innovative kitchen on wheels.

name: Pedal & Push Catering
desc: Tired of the same old food truck fare? We're Pedal and Push Catering, a passionate team dedicated to elevating your events with the delightful taste of freshly-made crepes.

name: Wrap n Rolla
desc:
Wrap n Rolla serves some seriously tasty wraps and loaded Fries.  Our menu is a Caribbean Fusion delight. We make our Pineapple Jerk Sauce in house and like to smother it on everything. Think 'Dirty Rolla Jerk Fries' and Toasted Grilled Halloumi Wraps.
We started off our journey selling wraps out of a converted vintage caravan next to BUMP roller disco in Bristol.

name: Pizza Vesuvio
desc: At Pizza Vesuvio, we are a family-run catering business that started during the COVID-19 pandemic. We converted our own rice horse box to bring you the best authentic Italian cuisine on stylish wheels.

name: Jack's Bakery
desc:
A contemporary bakery that opened it's doors in 2016 in Brick Lane Market.  Since then we now cater to Farmers markets, public events & fulfil corporate orders every week all across the UK.

We cater to a wide range of corporate pop ups and events,  with our selection of fudge, cookies, brownies and cake jars baked up and served to you by our friendly & professional team, all freshly baked in hous…

name: Lazeez Street Food
desc: Lazeez Street Food, founded in June 2022, is an award-winning Lebanese street food truck, located in the heart of Edinburgh at St. James Quarter, The Pitt Market, also all festivals & events. Since our launch, we’ve quickly made a name for ourselves by offering authentic Lebanese dishes made with high-quality, fresh ingredients.

name: Amba
desc:
We’re Amba, a Middle Eastern street food business based in London. Starting post lockdown in the streets of east London, starting at broadway market hackney.

  On our street food menu, we offer a range of dishes inspired by food from a variety of Middle Eastern countries such as Israel, Iraq, Palestine, Yemen, Jordan, Iran and Syria.

name: Sarras
desc: Sarras means yummy in Gujarati and that is exactly what our food is! Our mission is to bring you authentic Indian/Gujarati street food directly from the beaches of India. We will be serving up the most colourful authentic Indian food. As Gujarat is a 86% veggie state, all the veggie lovers can rest assured there will be lots of tasty options for them.

name: PAN Sushi
desc: A small family run business, inspired and grown from a love of hand rolling fusion sushi from our home kitchen. PAN Sushi started as a weekend sushi delivery business, offering a healthy take out option delivering sushi to our small market towns people's door locally.

name: Rocco
desc: At Rocco we believe in delivering an unforgettable seafood experience. Our raw bar offers a carefully selected range of the finest oysters from around the British Isles, as well as responsibly sourced caviar of outstanding quality. Our luxury services don't end there, explore our cooked seafood options, including grilled oysters and our signature paella.

name: Hungry? Yes.
desc: Hungry? Yes! was born in 2025 after much success from our first business, The Nomadic Caterers. Our new business focuses on budget-friendly food options from around the world. We have diversified our services by incorporating hot and cold food drop-offs across the country.

name: Punjab caterers Ltd
desc: Introducing NEDehli, where the vibrant flavors of Indian street food come alive! Immerse yourself in a culinary adventure as we bring the bustling streets of India to your table with every bite.

name: Maame T's Kitchen
desc: My culinary creations draw inspiration from the rich tapestry of African culture, showcasing the continent's vibrant colors, flavors, and ingredients. While my dishes are not confined to any one region, they celebrate the diverse heritage of Africa. I pride myself on accommodating various dietary preferences, providing options for gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian, and meat-loving guests alike.

name: The Events Pizza Company
desc: We’re The Events Pizza Company — a small, independent team built from years of street food experience. After launching in 2017, we’ve grown into a full-service mobile pizza setup, bringing high-energy catering to events across London.

name: Amai Bites
desc: At Amai Bites we love flavour and variety. We are both function caterers and fine dine chefs. We create your favourite dishes for your event from the Caribbean to the Asian subcontinent, we are able to make amazing dishes. We have lots to choose from and deliver what you like rather than limiting your choices.

name: HMS Catering ltd  t/a Oriental kitchen
desc:
we are highly passionate about Japanese and Korean cuisine and  our dishes are truly authentic to their origins in terms of flavours. All dishes are freshly prepared and cooked on site and we served them direct to the customer from hot Bain Marie Counter. 
We ensure you that every aspect of our worthy menu will reflect your events. We want every bite to be memorable for you.

name: Phayao Thai Food Truck
desc: Thai Food At Home is a family-run Thai street food business founded by husband-and-wife team Neal and Tar. Tar is a Thai chef with a deep passion for authentic flavours, drawing on traditional recipes and techniques from her upbringing in Thailand, while Neal brings a strong focus on presentation, organisation, and customer experience.

name: The Chicken Strip
desc:
Hello, we are James and Jess (husband and wife team). We pride ourselves on great customer service and fantastic freshly cooked to order chicken and chips from our two food trucks "Betty" and "Hilda". 

Our buttermilk chicken is sourced from our local butcher and is all hand prepped, marinated and dusted in our gluten free signature coating, then cooked to order.

name: Truly Torta - Mexican Street Kitchen
desc:
We are Truly Torta an authentic Mexican pop up street food catering business based in Newcastle.  We offer a range of Mexican foods such as Tortas & Tacos.  Our speciality being the Mexican torta, a grilled Mexican sandwich...

After spending 9 weeks in the authentic Pacific side of Mexico we were inspired by the array of street foods available.

name: Java & Jazz
desc: At Java & Jazz, we’re more than just another catering supplier – we’re a family-run café and pizzeria at the heart of Forest Row with a passion for bringing people together through great food and music. Inspired by our love for quality stone-baked pizza, artisan coffee, and a welcoming atmosphere, we’ve taken our café experience on the road to festivals, private events, and corporate functions.

name: Nick and Greek
desc: Our aim is to bring the Greek spirit in the British market. We offer a variety of traditional meals as well as the hospitality we are popular for.

name: Nomad Waffles
desc:
Nomad Waffles are purveyors of some of the most delicious waffles around. Handcrafted on-site, their Belgian stick waffles are smothered in the finest of sauces and ingredients. The menu includes sweet and salty varieties and is ideal to share, or to indulge solo.

The Nomad menu has undergone an evolution and they have spent the last few years striving to create the ultimate menu of waffles.

name: Ronnie’s Kitchen
desc:
Hello! 

Im Lee the founder and head chef of Ronnie's Kitchen ltd! 

I am Professional chef of 13 years, who has worked in a top London restaurant, under a celebrity chef, as well as some of London's largest hospitality venues. 

I have vast experience working in the culinary world and I am passionate about food and the dishes I create!

name: Game and Flames
desc:
We are a wildly unique catering company. 
We specialize in outdoor events , festivals, weddings. pop up restaurants and corporate events. 
We focus on wild sustainable game also using farmed meats that come from farms with high welfare standards. 

We source our own venison, process it in our facility and use it for our clients.

name: Loaded Fries & Rice Bowls
desc:
At Gibney Event Catering, we’re all about delivering street food that’s big on flavour and full of personality. Whether it's a private party or a buzzing music festival, we bring a fresh, flexible approach to every event we cater.

We believe great food starts with great ingredients - that’s why we use top-quality produce and source locally whenever we can.

name: Monu's Kitchen
desc: It all began in a small town in north India, Dehradun. When a young boy was growing up in an Ashram, he loved his visits home to taste his mum's amazing parathas and dad's chicken curries. Many years later, he studied culinary arts with his soon-to-be wife in Bangalore. His passion for food was ignited after an internship in the Taj Falaknuma Palace.

name: Honey and Fig
desc: Honey and Fig was founded by two friends who swapped their careers in finance for a more creative and fulfilling path. Driven by a shared love of food, design, and bringing people together, we created a business that reflects our values and passion.

name: Gourmet Paella London
desc:
Authentic Live Paella Catering for Private & Corporate Events in London

Gourmet Paella brings the flavours and spirit of Valencia to events across London through a premium live cooking experience.

name: Pizzeria Al Forno
desc: Pizzeria Al Forno is the ultimate street food experience, bringing the best of Italian cuisine to your event. Our wood fire Napolitan Style and Roman Style pizza's are made with our secret homemade sauce, using only the freshest and most authentic ingredients.

name: Simply Hog Roast
desc:
Simply Hog Roast is a unique catering company based in Hampshire.

With many years of experience and a can-do attitude, we welcome and accommodate any and all of your requirements.

name: Hop & Roll
desc:
Hop & Roll serve up the very best Sri Lankan hoppers in London and are the first business to bring them to events across the city! 

After having the idea and inspiration for her business for over 10 years, founder Rosheana finally took the family recipes from her Sri Lankan heritage combined with her passion for introducing hoppers to the public to launch Hop & Roll.

name: Yellow bus catering
desc:
Yellow Bus Catering – Authentic New York-Style Street Food on Wheels


At Yellow Bus Catering, we bring the bold flavors of New York to your corporate events with our signature Pete Sandbergs—delicious, handcrafted burgers and pizzas served straight from our converted authentic American school buses.


For the past five years, we’ve been delivering high-energy, high-quality catering experiences fo…

name: Hungamaa
desc:
Enjoy the Taste of India at Your Venue
If you're seeking to elevate your event or outdoor gathering with the vibrant taste of authentic Indian cuisine, Hungamaa is here to offer immaculate food and service. We take immense pride in bringing the rich tapestry of Indian flavours to your special occasions from our Indian restaurant in Chorlton.

name: The Big Banh
desc:
My names Jonny and I own The Big Banh!

We are a high volume, high quality unit and have been operating since 2020. 

We specialise in Vietnamese Banh Mi & Hashbrowns. We have created a menu using influences from all over the world whilst keeping the essence of this Vietnamese street food at the core of what we do.

name: The Pizza Trio
desc: Paul, Aisling and Samin started The Pizza Trio in 2021 with one goal in mind, to make great tasting Pizzas more accessible. The key to any good meal is fresh ingredients and the key to happy family is love-combine the two and we believe we are onto a winner. We’re a mobile pizza company, and make all our pizza’s fresh on site from our stone base ovens.

name: Chaiiwala
desc: Chaiiwala is more than just a food supplier; we are a celebration of rich Indian heritage, infused with a modern twist. Founded in 1927 on the bustling streets of Delhi, our story began with a simple, yet powerful, mission: to bring the authentic flavors of India’s street food to the world.

name: Manjula
desc: Manjula provides healthy vegan twists on authentic international recipes, offering tasty alternatives that are both locally sourced and sustainable. We are dedicated to fresh ingredients sourced from the market, from our secret curry pastes to our famous pickled chillies. We are very proud to have been nominated for and won awards over the years.

name: Le Petit Moulin Traiteur
desc:
Le Petit Moulin Traiteur

For the sweetest moments in life. Innovative, creative and delicious food

Having Mastered the techniques and the subtleties of French cuisine at its finest, Le Petit Moulin Traiteur offers authentic, fresh dishes to be enjoyed at your convenience.

name: Super Whippy Ice Cream
desc:
We are mobile ice cream vendors serving tantalising ice creams to cater for all tastes. With over 25 years of experience and catering to a variety of events and shows from music festivals to county shows and horse races, corporate and VIP events.

Our journey began many many moons ago. It all began when Jawed Akhtar had a dream…to sell ice cream.

name: The Rolling Coconut
desc: Our little vegan ice cream trailer is the perfect addition to any event, from parties and weddings to festivals and more.

name: Seitan's Kebab
desc:
Seitan's Kebab are an independent vegan street food business offering tasty, healthier plant-based alternatives to our favourite takeaway kebabs.

The business started back in Summer 2018 and has gone from strength to strength since, securing a permanent spot at the University of Manchester's indoor food market and reaching the finals of the British Street Food Awards in 2020 and 2021.

Our menu i…

name: Pizzarova
desc:
The brilliant Pizzarova serve up delicious handmade sourdough pizzas from their stunning Land Rover. It really is as good as it sounds...

They will generally offer a buffet style service with guests helping themselves to slices of delicious, freshly made pizza.

name: Northern Soul Pizza Co
desc: Welcome to our family-run mobile pizza business, where passion meets tradition! Born from our love for authentic, hand stretched pizzas and quality ingredients, we bring the heart of Italy to your doorstep. With each slice, we deliver not just food, but unforgettable moments. Join us on our journey and taste the difference that family, love and dedication can make.

name: Ranv's Rasoi
desc:
Ranv's Rasoi focuses on traditional Punjabi cuisine, giving customers a taste reminiscent of a British Indian Household.

Clients typically love how our curries are cooked live & on-site, in pots bigger than the eye can imagine. We keep a very sleek menu & our ethos is to cook food the way it's intended to be, such as curries in large pots & Chicken Tikka cooked over hot coals.

name: The Rolling Stove Street Food
desc: We are The Rolling Stove Street Food, a chef-led, independent foodtruck specialising in relaxed and rustic style street food. We have been operating for 9 years (after many years of catering industry experience). We do festivals, weddings, corporate events, and everything from horse trials, garden fairs and film shoots to large scale events like The Open Golf.

name: Essence Catering
desc: Essence Catering offers a wide variety of British, Asian, Indian & Mediterranean cuisines. We cater for all kinds of Corporate & Social events and also have special menu for office lunches. Satisfying customers is our top priority - that’s why we believe in offering fair and transparent prices with no hidden fees or extra charges.

name: Pabellón
desc:
Pabellon is where tradition and passion are combined, with lots of care to deliver the best execution of our national dishes. 

Our family run business aims to maintain tradition and family recipes by sharing its flavour to the masses! With a menu that can transport you to Venezuela with a single bite, we aim to cater to a variety of customers.

name: KERALAN KARAVAN
desc: Welcome to Keralan Karavan, the ultimate destination for food lovers who are looking for a unique and flavourful food experience.

name: Flame and Dough
desc:
A mobile fully equipped pizza kitchen that looks authentic in any setting! The thoughtful touches to the conversion, quirky pizza oven, and fabulous friendly staff, all add to the unique experience and atmosphere of your event.

We serve authentic Italian style pizza’s which are cooked in up to 90 seconds from our flame roaring oven which reaches up to 500 degrees and served from our stylish and l…

name: Copper Ricebox
desc:
Two chefs bringing Asian Flavours to the North East from our professional vintage trailer.
A premium offering, focused on flavour.

name: Rice Guys
tagline: Modern Twists On Traditional Asian Dishes
desc: The Rice Guys food is originally Asian – with a twist. They modernise and recreate traditional Asian dishes using sustainably sourced and nutritious ingredients, to serve up delicious, healthy, fast, affordable meals.

name: Destination Burger
desc:
How did the fabulous feast of global flavour that is the heart of Destination Burger come to be?

I can remember it like it was yesterday - The Street Meat Vans of Wall Street, New York City, 2004.
The smells, the vibrant flavours, the food trucks thrilling with their grilling, the passion and energy oozing from the guys dishing up these incredible edibles. 
I was hooked. And fascinated.

name: Rocket Dogs Kitchen
desc:
Rocket Dogs brings serious street-food energy to your event with two bold menu options: loaded hot dogs or authentic Greek gyros.

Our loaded hot dogs are what made us famous — premium sausages piled high with big, unapologetic flavors. From classic New York–style dogs to fully stacked signature creations, every bite is built to impress.

name: Rolling Burritos
desc: Our Burritos are simply delicious as our main focus is quality and not quantity. We have been trading at the famous St Albans Charter Market for almost 3 years and with so many regulars demanding our Burritos. We meticulously source the freshest, locally-sourced ingredients, ensuring each bite explodes with tantalizing tastes and enticing aromas.

name: Whimsy Hat
desc:
Whimsy Hat is more than street food – it’s an experience. Born from a love of festivals and flavour, we serve restaurant-quality dishes from our quirky trailer with a playful twist.

Our menu includes gourmet burgers, bao buns, empanadas and sizzling steaks, made with premium New Forest meats and fresh local produce.

name: THE GREEKSTER
desc: At Greekster, we take immense pride in being your go-to source for authentic Greek street food in Newcastle and the North East. Our journey began with a deep-rooted passion for sharing the rich culinary traditions of Greece with the local community.

name: Bo Bom Gelato
desc: Bo Bom is an award winning gelato that caters for private and corporate events: weddings, pre and post weddings parties, anniversaries, birthdays, special moments with family, friends, colleagues.

name: The Indian Dish
desc:
The Indian Dish is a Multi-Award Winning Luxury Catering for Kent, Surrey, Sussex and London.

The Indian Dish is a luxury, Corporate, Party and Wedding Caterer providing delicious Indian food using handed down family recipes from our homeland, India.

name: Loraso Ice Cream
desc: Loraso Ice Cream is a family run business in that was established in 1981. They are available for events throughout most of the UK and specialise in providing their classic Whitby Morrison ice cream vans.

name: Charlie Macs Catering
desc:
At Charlie Macs, we believe every occasion should be a celebration! We are passionate about creating fun, memorable and effortless events! 

We are a daughter-mother duo with over ten years experience in the industry. We love getting to know our clients so we can create something bespoke for you.

name: Pitch-up Pizzas
desc:
If you are looking for authentic Neapolitan, wood-fired pizza, you have come to the right place. We are a fun, lively, friendly and engaging team, with a passion for pizza ready to make every event, one to remember.

Pitch-up Pizzas started after two brothers, James  and Louis, became redundant overnight due to COVID-19.

name: Fire and Hop
desc: Fire and Hop started out by sourcing a vintage 1974 Peugeot J7 from France. We brought it over to the UK, had it professionally converted and we’re now ready to bring you tasty and traditional pizzas, using only the best ingredients.

name: Banzai Kitchen
desc:
Flavour on the Move, Japan in Every Bite.

Founded in 2023 by mother and daughter duo, Sumiko and Ocean, Banzai kitchen delivers an unforgettable taste of authentic Japanese cuisine.

name: Lils Falafel
tagline: A Taste of the Middle East
desc:
Lils is a Middle Eastern street food vendor that specialises in tasty flatbread wraps filled with grilled chicken, falafel and more, made with authentic Middle Eastern ingredients and spices. We only use the freshest and highest quality ingredients to ensure that our customers get the best taste experience. 

Our wraps are perfect for those looking for a quick and satisfying meal on the go.

name: Ro Vietnamese
desc:
Australian-Vietnamese moved to London in 2015. There was no accessible and delicious Vietnamese food that I could find, so I decided to start my own. We started trading in May 2024 and were already one of the finalist in the 2025 British Street Food Awards. 
We consistently sell out of our Banh Mi and summer rolls.

name: Cut the Mustard
desc: With over 35 years of professional catering experience, I have been lucky enough to have worked in 5* international hotels, boutique country house hotels and awarded restaurants across Europe.

name: Persian Guyz
desc: Persian Guyz takes immense pride in showcasing the vibrant and diverse flavors of Persian cuisine. Starting as a humble food cart and growing into a renowned street food company, Persian Guyz has captured the hearts and palates of food enthusiasts with their tantalizing offerings.

name: Waffle Me Up
desc: My name is Oli and Waffle Me Up was born out of a simple idea, Waffles! Starting in 2020 during the first lockdown, I wasn't sure what to do, and whilst studying for my final year in University I took my passion for making food and design into making Waffles out of my small Kitchen.

name: L'Amuse Bouche
desc:
Creative crepe geniuses L’Amuse Bouche specialise in top, top quality, authentic and utterly delicious French Crepes & Galettes. Permanent residents over in the famous foodie hub of Pop Brixton, any local will be able to tell you all about just how brilliant these guys are!

Whether it’s sweet or savoury that tickles your fancy, L'Amuse Bouche have got you covered.

name: The Jerk Hub
desc: The Jerk Hub is a modern day Jerk Station on wheels that serves London and surrounding counties (Herts and Beds) and nationwide . Our airstream trailer is the talk of the town and you cannot miss us as the crowds line up for our delicious cuisine.

name: Homeboy Pizza Co
desc: We are a hip hop based, Neapolitan Style, Sourdough pizza business. Based in Leeds and started in my back garden through lockdown 1, a love of sourdough baking and good music we created a dough that is both light, fluffy, crispy and easily digestible due to the long fermentation.

name: Earth to Oven
desc:
WHO ARE WE?
At Earth to Oven, our focus is on making delicious food with an ethical and sustainable approach that celebrates local, seasonal produce.

name: Tavern Events
desc:
As part of an independent hospitality group, Tavern
Events represents our F&B events operations. After being
closed for 8 years, in 2019 we re-established an old
neighbourhood pub site – and created the Leytonstone
Tavern, serving up award winning taco’s and burgers.
Alongside the main room we have a dedicated events
space, and events garden and cabin, where we host
everything from garden bbq’s, t…

name: Meltdown Cheeseburgers
desc:
We are Meltdown Cheeseburgers!

Having spend 10 years at Patty&Bun, I decided to branch off and start my own burger brand. I took with me Shirley the truck and started putting together a menu of burgers and sides fit for any occasion. 

We work with an association called Farm Wilder who help us source our beef from farmers that use more sustainable, regenerative farming methods.

name: Waffles and Scoop
desc:
Waffles and Scoop – Elevating events with exceptional waffles


Waffles and Scoop, based in Market Harborough, Leicestershire, is a family-run catering business with eight years’ experience in large-scale wedding and private event catering, born from our work with the Horsebox Ice Cream Company.

name: Chefiesta
desc: Since 2019, Chefiesta has been redefining the culinary experience across the UK with our vibrant and flavourful catering services. Specialising in a diverse range of cuisines, including African, Caribbean, Asian, and European. We bring authentic, mouth-watering dishes like Jerk Chicken, Jollof Rice, Chicken Tikka Masala, and Thai Green Curry and many more to every event.

name: Potters Pies
desc:
Potters Pies was created by Benjamin from his love of gourmet loaded pies .

Our pies selected from the outstanding award winning Derbyshire Pie & CO  who hand craft their fine selection of pies.

name: Proper Scran Inc
desc: Proper Scran Inc is a Stockports Best Smash Burger, Fried Chicken, Mac n Cheese,  loaded fries and Deep Fried Battered OREO's street food. we serve our food from our Burger Van with Awning. All our products are supplied from local farms and bakery’s to make sure we only serve the best products.

name: Street Slice
desc:
At Street Slice, we bring the excitement of stone-baked pizza straight to your event. Whether it’s a wedding, party, or private celebration, we serve fresh, delicious pizzas made on-site, sliced on boards so everyone can enjoy a taste of everything.

We specialise in flowing buffet service, which means pizzas are cooked continuously throughout your event and adapted to what your guests love most.

name: Beigel Bake Brick Lane (Bagel)
desc: We are the first and voted the best Beigel (Bagel) Bakery in London. Everything we sell is freshly made in house, by us,  24hrs a day.

name: The Waffle Wagon
desc:
The Waffle Wagon was created three years ago. 
We are a family run business based in Basingstoke Hampshire. After converting a horse box, founder Charmaine couldn’t part with it and decided to start a business with it. As a fan of desserts and all things yummy The Waffle Wagon was born.

We serve freshly made waffles from our own hand made batter.

name: Crispy Duck Rotisserie
desc:
We've been working at events since 2010 from some of the country's biggest music festivals to Royal Ascot and smaller corporate events.

We roast our crispy duck on a large rotisserie with lots of theatre. Our English duck all comes from one East Anglian farmer and is served with an Asian twist.

name: The Pie Hole
desc: Hello we are The Pie Hole. We started out of our love for pies. After eating pies for a long time I was becoming disappointed with the pies I’d been buying for years as I felt the quality of their product was slipping so wanted to have a go myself… and The Pie Hole was born… It’s been an exciting and fun filled seven years ever since I started.

name: Yum Puff Treats
desc:
Yum Puff Treats is a celebration of culture through delectable West African desserts, served up one bite at a time.

Our inspiration comes from our beloved late grandmother who, at 83 years old, dreamed of selling 'puff puff.' Although she has passed on, her love and passion continue to live through our brand.

We infuse traditional West African treats with reinvented goodness, using quality flavo…

name: Gurt Wings
desc:
Gurt Wings are a multi-award winning business based in the West Country, cooking up delicious chicken wings, chicken strips, chicken burgers, halloumi stix and tater tots since 2017 using free-range and locally sourced ingredients. 

All of our chicken is always served fresh, having been soaked for 24hrs in buttermilk and spices for extra tenderness and flavour.

name: The Jerk Box
desc:
We are specialists in Caribbean fusion foods, blending authentic Caribbean recipes with our own original creations & flavours from around the world. We prepare all of our food from scratch making our own marinades and sauces and using only the freshest ingredients to ensure the highest standards & guarantee to make your tastebuds smile!

Aside from food, one of our greatest passions is people.

name: Pizza Lola
desc:
Welcome to Pizza Lola - a ,mobile, wood fired pizza business based in the heart of the south.

We are Lewis and Ellie, a cheffing sibling double act with a love to all things pizza - making lots, and eating just as much!
We have been chefs in award winning kitchens for close to 10 years now.

name: The Maple Crepe Company
desc:
The Maple Crêpe Company is a family-run business based in South Wales bringing you authentic crepes with a sprinkling of Canadian flavour.
We are Peter (the Canadian) and Bridget (the Welsh one) and between us have decades of experience in hospitality and business.

name: Musafari Grills
desc: At Musafari Grills, we are all about delivering an unforgettable culinary experience centred around suya, a traditional West African delicacy. Our suya, made from carefully marinated beef, chicken, or vegetarian options, is grilled to perfection and packed with bold, aromatic spices that explode with flavor in every bite.

name: Gurdev's Indian Street Food
desc:
Dear Sir/Madam

We would love to work alongside yourself please do get in touch, Gurdev’s Indian Street Food is an established family business, Our ethos is based around our core values of producing high-quality, honest authentic Indian food our artisan menus are cooked with the finest ingredients.

We specialise in various events, such as Weddings, Birthdays, Festivals, Carnivals, and much more.

name: Churros Truck
desc: want dessert? well the churros truck is your go to yellow dessert truck! serving fresh Spanish churros with a festival twist. loaded with dips such as Nutella and biscoff our crispy golden churros are pure joy in every bite! music, flavour and fun- its always a party when this truck rolls. in . whether its a business event, party or wedding get in touch to book our delicious dessert truck.

name: Scarborough Creperie/The Yorkshire Crumble Company
desc: My name is Judi, and I started Scarborough Creperie because I believe food should always be fun and shared with joy. From the very beginning, I wanted to create something interactive where people could see their food being made fresh and enjoy the theatre of the process.

name: Flats Doughnuts
desc:
Flats Doughnuts was born out of a chance encounter with a photo of a Canadian-style doughnut that I had never seen before. 

At Flats Doughnuts, all of our doughnuts are 100% plant-based and nut-free. They are all made fresh to order and served hot and fresh. We make as much as we can in-house to ensure. All of this is served from our purpose-made doughnut-making street food truck.

name: Wholefood Heaven's Buddha Bowls
desc: Since 2009 we have been offering delicious vegetarian, vegan, wheat and gluten free wholefood ‘Buddha Bowls’ from our beautiful 1973 Citroen H van. All the food is lovingly made and very high quality; using unrefined, unprocessed ingredients and organic produce wherever possible.

name: Pizza Pazzo
desc: At Pizza Pazzo, we are an Italian family-run business that is passionate about bringing the best of Italian cuisine to your special event. Our mobile woodfire oven setup means that we can enter any outside area with an access of 1.3m+ wide, delivering you delicious sourdough pizza.

name: Slackjaw’s Gourmet Burger Company
desc: Introducing Slackjaws Gourmet Burger Company, your go-to destination for the ultimate burger experience! At Slackjaws Gourmet Burger Company, we are passionate about crafting mouthwatering burgers that are as unique as they are delicious.

name: Su Casa Cuisine
desc:
We are an NCASS registered streetfood company specialising in Spanish, Latin and Mediterranean cuisine including Meat, Seafood and Vegan Paellas, Tapas dishes and Traditional Spanish dishes as well as French, Italian, Modern British & many more cuisines, bespoke to your requirements.

We have over 13 years experience of catering at the Ludlow and Shrewsbury Food Festivals, Shrewsbury Flower Show, …

name: Gelato Italia
desc: Gelato Italia is a family business operating within the Southeast and London with their Mobile Units and Gelateria Ice Cream Parlours.

name: Crepes Gourmet
desc:
Crepes Gourmet – Artisan Crepes for Every Occasion
Welcome to Crepes Gourmet, where passion meets perfection in every bite. We specialize in crafting fresh, made-from-scratch sweet and savoury crepes, cooked right before your eyes using only the finest ingredients.

Founded in 2022, Crepes Gourmet began its journey at local markets and festivals across Newcastle and the North East of England.

name: Santiagos Gelato
desc: Personalised premium Gelato and Sorbet Carts for your next wedding, private event, birthday and more. Our luxury carts provide premium quality Gelato and Sorbet with ingredients sourced straight from Italy.

name: The Street Diner
desc:
The Street Diner has a team of fully qualified chefs that have cooked everywhere from superyachts to muddy fields. The team can tailor personalised menus to suit all occasions and they can cater for all dietary requirements.

Whether you’re throwing a formal party with canapes or an informal street food feast at your wedding, The Street Diner can do it all.

name: Funthyme Ltd
desc:
For over a decade, Funthyme has been crafting unforgettable wedding and  event stories through imaginative food and drink experiences

Our passionate weddings and events team brings creative briefs to life with bespoke wedding menus and thoughtfully designed concepts for product launches, PR dinners, in-store events and brand activations.

We deliver end-to-end event production, covering everythin…

name: Churrazon
desc: We serve fresh handmade churros, using a traditional recipe that just so happens to be vegan, too! Have them Mexican style with cinnamon sugar dipped in warm chocolate, or make your own sweet combination with our wild variety of melted dips and toppings!

name: Shepherds Ice Cream
desc:
We make genuine artisan sheep's milk and dairy free ice creams and real fruit sorbets on our farm in the Black Mountains. 

The exceptional richness of sheep's milk means that you can make ice cream from the whole milk, resulting in a smooth, creamy gelato that is much lower in fat than other ice creams.

name: Elenness Events
desc: After a combined 35 years in catering between both of us here at Elenness, (Steve & Laura) theres not much we havent seen or served.

name: BA-HA
desc: BA-HA was born in 2018. Led by Co Founders Frankie Heekin and Becky Powell to explore the nature of plant based dining; The unguilty pleasures of delicious humane food. Creating an experience where the food does the talking. BA-HA reimagines, reinvents, and revitalizes, providing proof with a punch that plants really are life.

name: The Chocolate Trike
tagline: One of a kind Chocolate Trike
desc:
The Chocolate Trike uses only the finest Belgian milk chocolate within a one-of-a-kind trike set up through a converted rickshaw trike.

We can provide anything covered in chocolate! However, our usual offering of chocolate strawberry cups, waffles, pancakes, and luxury hot chocolate usually goes down a treat!

We are based in Cheshire, however, are able to travel across the UK.

name: Asiatique
desc:
We're a food van dedicated serving up fresh with high-quality ingredients and handcrafted dishes. We can be just outside your house and provide you the best experience on your special day. We have many options to fit your preference as your satisfaction is one of our core values! 

Every dishes tells our story and we only serve dishes that we would like to be served.

name: Nicholas Pitta
desc:
Nicholas Pitta ltd. proposes the development of a vibrant food and  Our vision is to create a lively destination offering delicious international cuisine, unique food, and a fun atmosphere for locals and tourists and your guest.
Concept and Offerings: A diverse selection of popular food, featuring:
*Greek Souvlaki
*Authentic and flavorful Mediterranean cuisine: Greek souvlaki is a popular dish tha…

name: Potjie Man
desc:
Inspired by my upbringing in South Africa with a melting pot of cultures & my chef background I launched Potjie Man 6 years ago.
The only concept in the world of it's kind, all my dishes come with a creamy, fragrant Cape Malay curry sauce served from a 17th century, cast iron 'Potjie pot' .
With a base of yellow rice , skin on crispy chips and delicious toppings including 12 hour Welsh lamb should…

name: Pommarola pizza gardens
desc: Pommarola Pizza is created on the concept of real Italian artisan home-made food with a unique visual impact.

name: Bake & Brew Wales
desc:
After having spinal surgery and plenty of time to think whilst recovering, we decided to venture into setting up desert and hot drink business. We are small family run business which have been operating for 3 years. 
We have an American Air Stream trailer which really stands out from the crowd and catches everyone’s attention.

name: Everytime Noodle Bar
desc: We are a fast food Oriental noodle restaurant with a licensed bar! Our tasty noodle boxes are completely customisable – simply choose your size, topping, and base by ordering via our self-serve kiosks, table QR codes, or counter service.

name: Gelatoo!
desc:
As an Italian, I grew up eating gelato and during my school years I ended up helping in one of the oldest gelateria in Milan, where I’ve learnt how to make the most amazing gelato using only the best ingredients I could get my hands on.
Not only that, I’ve started experimenting and creating all sorts of interesting flavours and combinations, including our “drunken” gelato, an alcoholic version of …

name: Petrucci's Artisan Stonebaked Pizza
desc: Having an Italian father and loving the Italian lifestyle and all things Italian, I grew up in and around the restaurant business.  I was always obsessed with good pizza and this was fuelled and inspired by my many summers spent in Italy travelling  or staying with family and  sampling the many different styles  of pizza the country had to offer.

name: The Wild Gourmet
desc:
Outstanding Food, Made to Remember
Delivering unique experiences and creating unforgettable memories

The Wild Gourmet aims to create memorable dining experiences by offering you a variety of chef-curated dining menus using nothing but local suppliers, butchers and farm shops to ensure that our ingredients are of the best quality.

name: All In A Box
desc: All In A Box was born at the beginning of lockdown from my kitchen table at my family home in Buckinghamshire.

name: SmallFry
desc: SmallFry is a mobile fish and chip shop founded by Angus Mowl, who made the bold decision to leave the stability of a career in fashion retail and pursue his true passion for food and drink. Growing up in a pub where his mum was the landlady, Angus spent much of his childhood behind the bar and in the kitchen, developing a genuine love for cooking and serving customers.

name: AJ's Cakes and Bakes
desc: An artisan micro bakery located in West London producing the finest chocolate Belgium brownies, heart warming blondies (a brownie relative) and seasonal cakes to feed the masses.

name: La Kordun
desc:
La Kordun Catering operate from charming shepherds hut trailer serving authentic French sweet and savoury crepes as well as barista style coffee.

Family run business with years of experience serving delicious food at all kinds of events including festivals, sporting events, food festivals, weddings, corporate and birthdays so you and your guests will be in great hands!

name: Carnival Ices
desc:
Carnival Ices provide Ice cream van hire for all media events and family functions, with a large fleet of modern and vintage ice cream vans for hire. In Eastbourne, East Sussex and around the UK.
 
We are specialists in customising van livery for commercial media events and promotions. 

Carnival Ices has been a family run business since 1980 - with heritage going back to 1965.

name: Seawise
desc:
Seawise are an established traditional fish and chip restaurant in Camden who have built up a hugely impressive reputation for themselves over the years!

After deciding that bringing the seaside flavours to Camden Town wasn’t quite enough, they realised that their delicious seafood dishes needed to hit the road.

name: Boxed Catering
desc: We started out as Boxed Pizza just over 5 years ago but as time went on we were asked to cater for more than our humble, but highly rated pizzas, we offered beautiful grazing platters as wedding table centre pieces and small but full of flavour buffets, so recently has felt like the right time to offer this as a package as a whole so Boxed Catering we born!

name: Weirdough Pizza
desc: Weirdough Pizza is a sister company of Vudu Food, a well-known and well-respected street food and private catering company.

name: Mum & Son's
desc:
We are a family-run business that started trading at local markets; fast-forward 4 years and we have a Café in the heart of trendy Stoke Newington. We take inspiration from our roots and find delicious flavours that have been passed down by generations. 

We believe in sustainability and delicious!

name: Streat Scullery
desc:
EVENT CATERING IN GLASGOW & THROUGHOUT UK:

Outstanding and versatile event catering by Streat Scullery ( the sister brand of the well-established Papamacs Gourmet Kitchen), working at events, weddings, parties and TV shoots in Glasgow, all over Scotland, and throughout the UK.

name: Dosa Kitchen
desc:
We grew up on farms in the foothills of the Nilgiri Hills in Tamil Nadu. We are passionate about our food, it's provenance, and love introducing our food to folk who haven't tried it before. It's the food we grew up with. It's the food we serve our families. 

Dosa Kitchen originally started life as a pop-up residency in Newcastle’s west end.

name: Waffle+Co
desc:
Imagine a beautifully converted black horse box or stylish modern truck; epic lighting, geometric tiles with the smell of freshly cooked waffles and an array of delicious sweet and savoury toppings… you’ve got Waffle+Co.

Their Chicken+Waffle menu has to be their most popular.

name: Materia Lab
desc:
We are a dedicate ad passionate Italian couple from Puglia, Andrea & Enza.
We are specialize in curating private events, dedication and passion, delicate and tasty dishes is what makes our events a masterpiece.

name: Frosty's Mobile Chippy
desc:
Frosty's Fish & Chips is a locally-owned business in Northumberland that is ran by Cameron. My  primary focus is on preparing and serving freshly cooked fish and chips using traditional beef dripping, crispy batter, and fresh chips to complement the fish.

Our business operates two mobile fish and chip vans, which make weekly rounds (Monday to Saturday) to various villages around Northumberland.

name: Vudu Food
desc:
Vudu Food offers a delicious British take on creole cuisine specialising in utterly delicious low-and-slow smoked meats as well as creative vegan dishes.

They are dedicated to using exclusively top quality ingredients and working with an excellent team to produce their outrageously mouthwatering menu.

name: Warm & Toastie
desc: Warm & Toastie sell gourmet cheese toasties from their pop up cheese bar, Horsebox or classic food truck.

name: Horseradish Catering
desc: Horseradish Catering in Chester epitomizes culinary excellence, offering a bespoke dining experience that transcends expectations. Nestled in the heart of this historic city, our passion for food and hospitality shines through in every dish we craft and every event we host.

name: Unclebeef
desc: Our main Business is a Butcher Shop in Crayford and we showcase our Quality Meats and Hand Pressed burgers in style by cooking it on the Braai (South African term for BBQ) . Our beef is grass-fed and come directly from a farm in Scotland. We cater for private events and major festivals. Our food is incredibly tasty and literally from farm to fork.

name: ChicP
desc:
The wonderful ChicP Hummus serve up a variety of delicious, natural, fresh and sustainable hummus-based dishes from surplus fruit and vegetables. They've been founded on a passionate commitment to reducing food waste!

They hummus itself is beautifully coloured and hugely versatile.

name: Hola Guacamole
desc: Hola Guacamole are one of London's very best, and certainly most authentic, Mexican street food traders; a wonderful fusion of passion and culinary skill.

name: Taiga Burger Kitchen
desc:
The newest addition to our business is our bright orange, 1984 American step van which came runner up in the 2024 British street food of the year awards for best food truck! 

We offer various menus but all using fresh, authentic ingredients and our experience of the biggest UK festivals helps us to keep queues down to a minimum.

name: Stuffed
desc: Stuffed bring a classic British food experience to events up and down the country with delicious baked goods.

name: Good & Proper Tea Co.
desc: Meet Good & Proper Tea’s beloved 'Watson,' the UK's most beautiful Tea Van. An original 1974 Citroen within whom the team have been travelling the country with and serving the best loose leaf tea and delicious homemade sourdough crumpets for half a decade now!

name: Belly N Bao
tagline: Bao Buns, Gyoza and much more
desc: Belly N Bao are a fresh, innovative street food vendor serving up some of the very best Bao buns out there!

name: Wood Chop Pizza
desc: Wood Chop Pizza have been a regular at street-food markets around Bristol for over four years and have built up an incredible reputation during that time.

name: Meat The Chef
desc: The name really does say it all! Meat The Chef are absolute masters of their trade, cooking up what they refer to as 'Big Bold Badass' chicken from their awesome no nonsense truck. With over 24 years in professional kitchens the brilliant Christian decided it was time to get mobile and bring their amazing dishes to people all round the country.

name: The Organic Meat Company
desc:
At The Organic Meat Company, we’re on a mission to bring you the juiciest, most delicious organic burgers under the sun—straight to your taste buds at the UK's best festivals! 

A family business created by Jo and Matt first steming from working at UK festivals on a vegan food van for years to then starting our award winning catered chalet company in the Southern Alps in Winters.

name: The Peel: Wood Fired Kitchen
desc:
The Peel: Wood Fired Kitchen are a fully converted mobile catering van, fitted with an authentic Italian wood-fired oven.

They are a family run business that cover the East Midlands and are available for events of all shapes and sizes.

name: Uncle G's
desc:
Uncle G's is all about non GMO products.  Everything is 100% homemade with no artificial  flavors and strictly NO MSG and is gluten Free!

We are very passionate about our food! Prepared with TLC (tender loving chicken)...the proof is in the taste.

name: Oreno
desc:
Japanese for ‘my’, Oreno specialises in kushiyaki and robatayaki, cooking food over hot binchotan charcoal.
​
Our menu offerings include:
* Kushiyaki - Grilled skewers on open charcoal fire.
* Robatayaki - Seasoned meat and vegetables cooked on a griddle over charcoal fire.
* Sushi - Various stylings of sashimi, rolls, nigiri, maki with Oreno signature rice seasoning.
* Poke Bowl - Vegetable toppe…

name: Dough Boyz Collective
desc: We are Dough Boyz. Finding a passion for pizza ignited a flame, and during lockdown I started my own takeaway pizza business from my own back garden, with my partner delivering pizza to our locals all whilst working full time jobs and juggling looking after our 2 year old son.

name: Grate Gourmet Rosti
desc:
Two University friends have come together to create Grate - one previously a chef followed by a career in food publishing for leading magazines BBC Good Food, and Olive. The other a keen foodie with a background in Asian flavours.

Grate was founded on true love for the humble potato.

name: Walls & Lyle
desc:
Lou and Viv can cater for just about any event from their wonderfully colourful converted caravan 'Lorraine'.

Their specialities are drinks and slices but their menu changes depending on what the clients want. This could be roasted coffee or refreshing teas and a selection of homemade cakes, flapjacks and muffins, or it could be grilled Raclette on sourdough toast - the perfect savoury snack.

name: Happy Dumplings
desc: Happy Dumplings is a vibrant Chinese street food company specialising in fresh, flavour-packed dumplings served hot and ready to enjoy. Inspired by traditional family recipes and the bustling street food culture of China, we set out to share proper dumplings with a wider audience here in Scotland.

name: Anna Loka / Plant Based Paradise
desc: We are Wales’s first vegan multi watering restaurant establishing 2015 based in Cardiff we close the restaurant last year and we now pray for a Food Truck in the heart of Cardiff on working street our food is based on the fact that our family cultural is half Indian and half alongside being British we have covered or food aspects as we have to offer food that can take off everyone being a vegan bu…

name: New York Street Food Ltd
desc:
We are an established festival and event catering company who have been delighting revellers across the UK with our legendary foot-long pizza slices since 2016.

As veteran festival goers, we know just what’s needed from field based eateries: lots of hot, tasty food - NOW! And ideally some change left over for the bar, thanks.

name: Vaso Kitchen
desc:
Vaso Kitchen was kicked off in 2016 by Steven Patel, whose grandmother always cooked wonderful Indian cuisine for him as a child which inspired him to have a go at cooking many of the amazing dishes himself.

Steven takes any given opportunity to pack his bags and go to India to find amazing street food dishes that he can bring back to Manchester.

name: The Cheese Guys
desc:
We are The Cheese Guys a food truck set up by a real cheese shop. We know good cheese. 

In our menu we only ever use farmhouse cheese and artisanal sourdough bread creating the most luxurious ‘loaded’ toasties.

We are also famed for our Raclette Fries, like "cheesey chips" but better!
