name: Daisy Ice Cream Van
desc:
Daisy is a unique, beautifully restored 1972 Bedford vintage ice cream van, that will bring charm, style and, most importantly, delicious ice cream to your event.  

Serving Marshfield Farm ice cream, which is hand-scooped into crisp sugar cones or tubs, in addition, the team can serve up yummy home-made chocolate brownie bites to complement the ice creams and sorbets.

name: Poptata
desc:
Marco and Luca, with over 14 years of experience in the luxury Hospitality industry, decided they wanted to go back to basics and offer Londoners something that is both familiar and comforting but done in a fun and inventive way.

Taking one of the best-loved beacons of British culinary tradition, the (Italian) pair stole a march on their homegrown rivals and decided to celebrate the humble chip.

name: Northern Soul Grilled Cheese
desc: Hire Northern Soul Grilled Cheese for food that moves the needle and moves the queue. We’re Manchester-born operators running busy restaurants and high-output stadium concessions, so we know how to keep guests smiling and service flying.

name: The Caravan of Courage
desc:
It’s all in the name. The Caravan of Courage create courageous, feel-good vegetarian & vegan food from their awesome 80's caravan, available for events of all shapes and sizes.

These root-loving guys started in 2018 and had a brilliant year serving their food from their caravan at events in Edinburgh including Underbelly at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival.

name: Barbican Bao
desc: The team at Barbican Bao is led by Edd & Tom who collectively have over 23 years experience in the catering industry and have a passion for food especially Asian cusine. We specialise in soft fluffy steamed Bao buns with various flavours and cater for a range of dietary requirements.

name: Fundi Pizza
desc: We pride ourselves on providing delicious neapolitan style pizzas made with our special slow proved dough. Fully handcrafted pizzas, individually stretched by real pizzaiolos! We source all materials and ingredients responsibly.

name: The Fish & Chip Trailer
desc:
The vintage fish & chips catering trailer is backed by a busy, loved fish & chip shop on the South coast, and the trailer will be no different in serving the same quality fish & chips at events.

The Vintage trailer is a mobile fish & chip shop on wheels, which features many of the favourites you expect from your local fish & chip shop.

Many of the items are produced in-house at Stubbington Fish …

name: Yu-ca-taco
desc: Yu-ca-taco’s founding philosophy is to provide high quality traditional Mexican food (to those who might otherwise not have access to it) at an affordable price.

name: Twist & Grill
desc: Twist & Grill are a London based Street Food supplier who specialise in creating delicious and authentic Greek style Gyros wraps.

name: Jerk + Grind
desc: Father and Son Stephen + Georgie started the business back in 09. Started out on street food markets in London then grew and moved onto to cater at all types of events. We are a family business and only employ staff with the right energy and vibe the culture of our business is very important we always keep it as independent and authentic as possible giving the customer great food and service.

name: Shawarma Collective
desc:
We are a new and exciting street food brand, brought to you from the creative minds of Rad Burger. Seasoned event and festival traders having pulled off high turnover at over 5 Glastonbury's, secret cinema and other big sporting events and festivals. 

Serving Shawarma wraps, Shawarma loaded salads and fries.

name: Icey Creams
desc: Icey Creams is a business founded on inspiration from a famous dessert in the streets of Thailand. One short trip was all that it took to convince us that this incredible product had to make its way to the UK.

name: Holy Cow Organic
desc: Fresh, fun & tasty food. Our ethos is great food delivered fresh at a consistent high standard. We prepare and cook all food on-site and work with the festival audience to deliver what they want. We also believe in affordable quality and use the highest levels of ingredients we can source.

name: Souvlaki Street
desc: Souvlaki Street began in East London in 2014 and was the first stall of its kind, serving authentic Greek souvlaki to hungry Londoners.

name: Vinn Goute
desc:
‘Vinn Goute’ translates as ‘Come and taste’ in Seychelles Kreol, and that’s exactly what we recommend you do with this totally unique and totally delicious street food trader.

They serve authentic Seychelles cuisine out of their gorgeous gazebo set-up, which means delicious curries (options range from goat to octopus), wraps stuffed to the brim with chicken and fish and delicious bite sized snack…

name: Phát Boi Hot Bread
desc:
Phát Boi Hot Bread – Proper Bánh Mì Catering

Born from the Aussie-Asian hot bread tradition and baked fresh daily in London.

name: Carbonis
desc: We are CARBONIS and specialise on cooking on live lumpwood charcoal using Josper Ovens.  We have two Mobiles and a moveable Kitchen.  We focus on high Quality Food and specialities include Rib Eye Steak Sandwiches on Sourdough, Baby Chicken cooked on a Rotissol, Chicken Burgers, Falafel Burgers, Whole  Baby Back Ribs, Pulled Pork, Calamari, Vegetarian Options, Kiddies Options, Fries and all sorts …

name: Rotipan Kitchen
desc:
Roti Pan Kitchen are bringing you the explosive flavours of the Caribbean all in a delicious roti wrap!

They specialise in dal puri Roti which is flatbread filled yellow split peas and spices accompanied with succulent grilled meat or aromatic vegetarian dishes rolled into a wrap.

name: RiceON.LDN
desc:
RiceON.LDN is a Modern Korean Kitchen that serves Authentic dishes in minutes. 

We opened our 1st stall in Mercato Metropolitano right before the 1st lockdown and have been growing ever since to become the fan favourite. 

We are now in KERB and trading in their markets throughout London.  
We proud ourselves as doing everything right.

name: Surrey Hills Wood Fired Pizza
desc:
Surrey Hills Wood Fired Pizza cook sourdough pizza that’s not only delicious but also environmentally conscious and seasonal!

After travelling the world as chefs, William and his team decided to make the stunning Surrey Hills their home.

name: The Big Cheese Toastie
desc: We’re The Big Cheese Toastie, serving mouthwatering gourmet cheese toasties on thick farmhouse bread, crisp skin-on fries, and freshly squeezed orange juice.

name: Rebel Town Pizza
desc:
We are Rebel Town Pizza, an independent wood-fired pizzeria based in East Devon. We specialise in creating high-quality, homemade pizzas using locally sourced ingredients, and we have been successfully trading for over nine years at various festivals and events across the South West.

Our unique open kitchen design not only attracts onlookers but also provides a memorable experience for attendees …

name: Thin & Crispy - Artisan Turkish Pizza
desc:
Fresh. Innovative. Different - These are the pillars to which we strive towards.
Thin & Crispy provides Fresh, Crispy, Hot Turkish pizza's (Known as Lahmacun) wrapped with our signature salads and sauces. 

We offer a broad selection of Mediterranean sides & Beverages to perfectly compliment our pizzas which we're hugely passionate about!

name: Prickly Pear Kitchen
desc:
Prickly Pear Kitchen is run by Maricela Bautista & husband James Cheeseman. Maricela is from Mexico City and lends her authentic hand to the menu, which is complimented by James’ 15 years of experience as a chef.

Prickly Pear celebrates local businesses, great quality local ingredients, and sustainable farming practices, supporting their vision of a healthy food industry, soil to plate.

name: Oink BBQ Ltd
desc:
Hello from Oink!

We are an American style BBQ, outdoor event catering company based in Chelmsford Essex.

We are currently looking for vendor opportunities to expand our business and would love to be considered for your forthcoming event.

At Oink we offer catering services suitable for Festivals and outdoor shows, as well as Private Functions such as Weddings, Parties and Corporate Events.

Our …

name: Purezza
desc:
Purezza is the UK's first vegan pizzeria, built upon the heritage of hundreds of years of quality craft, but with a vision for a better world in the future, welcome to the home of modern pizza. 

Purezza is renowned for its innovative recipes, high-quality ingredients and delicious stone-baked sourdough pizza. Our new pizza van allows us to bring our award-winning vegan pizza to you.

name: Shawarma Bros
desc:
Shawarma Wraps are a healthy pleasure and an old-fashioned Lebanese classic.  The tempting aroma of the marinated meat slowly roasting on an upright spit and the crunch of the freshly cut cabbage to the crisp of the chips are irresistible.  
We do things properly from sourcing the best quality meat to the way our dishes are presented.

name: Mezzo - Italian Street Food
desc: Mezzo was founded in 2020 by Alice, born and raised in Rome and relocated to London for love. Alice always had a passion for cooking since when she started helping Nonna in the kitchen cooking up a storm for the "famiglia".

name: The Authentic Souvlaki
desc: If you get to ask a Greek what is his second favorite dish from back home, you will have the same answer: the Souvlaki wrap! Why the second favorite? Because nothing can beat Yia Yia's stuffed pitas. And this is why we decided to open our authentic Souvlaki place.

name: Good Boy Burger Co.
desc:
With menus that regularly change Good Boy Burger can cater for vegans, vegetarians and carnivores alike and can be found popping up at a local coffee shop or brewery, or holding down residencies at food markets or taking over well-known kitchens.

We always use locally sourced and wherever possible organic produce and have a real passion for what we do.

name: Quinoa Arepa Peru
desc: Quinoa Arepa Peru have been trading since 2011, with a focus on always using the best product to produce tasty and nutritional Peruvian dishes! We care about our planet, we are sustainable, seasonal, with all of our sauces homemade, all made fresh on the day, all tailored to the client.

name: Burger Bros
desc: Est 2020 serving up the best burgers and sides at your local festivals, gigs and events! We’re and American style food truck serving up the best fast food with local produce!

name: Mabiko
desc:
Mabiko, means a "feast," "festival," or a large, joyous gathering with abundant food. 

Our founder and chef, Tapelo, brings the warmth of African soul food, inspired by his roots in Zimbabwe and  a six-month journey across the African continent, learning new cooking styles and flavours. 

We believe in creating hearty, soulful dishes that give people an opportunity to try something new.

name: Pat's Pizza
desc: When you build a pizza oven, you a build community. The best way to nurture a community is through feeding them! We learnt to build pizza ovens, how to make dough and we have been feeding local events and festivals since 2021. We make our own slow-proved dough, using our Sussex sourced heritage grain blend then we traditionally wood-fire our pizzas in our handmade ovens for authentic flavour.

name: The Oxfordshire Pig Roast Company
desc: The Oxfordshire Pig Roast Company, run by Bradley and Carrie-Ann, has been in business for over 12 years, providing hog roast services for more than 600 events, serving at least 60,000 people. The company sources its pigs from a local Oxfordshire butcher, ensuring that all pork is locally sourced.

name: Loaded Fries And Nachos
desc: Established in 2019, Loaded Fries and Nachos is a family run business dedicated to delivering deliciously appetising fast food, using only the best ingredients! Catering for both meat esters and vegans alike our 'Create your own' style menu lets you take the lead in designing your very own mouthwatering dish!

name: Al Taco!
desc:
Hola Amigos...welcome to Al Taco! An awesome looking street food truck slinging out the tastiest street tacos and nachos.
We are a super friendly bunch with a passion for Mexican food and we are sure you will love what we have to offer! 
All our food is handmade with care using only the freshest ingredients and absolutely nothing from a packet.

name: Herbivorous
desc: Hey! We are herbivorous and we make exciting, modern vegan comfort food that’s better for you and better for the planet. We have developed our unique recipes over years and we can’t wait to share our food with you.

name: wefumo
desc:
Founded by Restauranteurs Josh and Max - Wefumo is the next chapter in their burger journey. drawing from their experience after years together in the fast food scene, they're now carving their own path with a business built on friendship, family, quality & passion.
"Styled how we like em" every Wefumo burger is built with attention to detail: soft fresh buns, Meat from the trusted local butchers,…

name: C'est Cheese
desc: Established in 2018 by South-East London based siblings Joshua, Catherine and Robert, C’est Cheese is on a mission to share our delicious halloumi fries, gourmet grilled cheese and scrumptious macaroni with the world!

name: The Big Blu
desc: Born in East Lothian and proudly serving the area for over 10 years, The Big Blu operates from two distinctive vans: a beautifully restored vintage Citroën H van and a modern Citroën Relay converted into a fully equipped kitchen.

name: Bread & Bowl
desc: Bread & Bowl is an indulgent brunch experience, we are food for the greedy! What this means is great portion sizes, high-quality ingredients, and food that is as aesthetically pleasing as it is delicious.

name: CT Event Catering LTD
desc:
About us – 
Here at CT event catering we are one of UKs most versatile events company, with a large fleet of varied units with a combined experience of over 20years. coffee and food units gives us a thorough understanding of what expectations there are at all types of events.

name: Russells Mobile Catering
desc: At Russell’s Mobile Catering, we pride ourselves on delivering top-quality street food with a personal touch. With a 5-star food hygiene rating and years of experience in the industry, we’ve built our reputation on reliability, professionalism, and mouthwatering food that keeps crowds coming back for more.

name: The French Pancake
desc: The French Pancake is a premium mobile catering business based in Hertfordshire, serving authentic French crêpes, Belgian waffles and speciality bean-to-cup coffee from our beautifully converted vintage trailer. Founded by owner Sian, The French Pancake was created from a passion for bringing people together over freshly made food and creating memorable experiences at every event.

name: Churros Hermanos
desc:
Churros Hermanos is two brothers hand making fresh, organic and vegan Churros, drizzled with melted Belgian chocolate to create the perfect crispy and fluffy sweet treat.

We started in 2017 with local street food markets and over the last 6 years we have progressively increased the size of event we have been at and the scale of our operation.

name: Cut + Grind
desc:
Cut + Grind, winners of the UK National Burger Awards 2018, serve up some up some of best gourmet comfort food out there.

The talented team select, cut and grind their burgers in house every day, just as their name suggests, making for a seriously tasty burger.

name: Falvo Artisan Pizza co.
desc:
Falvo Artisan Pizza Co. is a vintage 1978 Renault Estafette that has been transformed into a beautiful wood-fired pizza van perfect for all kinds of events! Their aim is to bring the best artisan pizza to all of the people they serve, whether it be to your private function or a local event.

The wood-fired pizzas that Falvo serve are a delicious alternative to the usual party food.

name: The Green Egg
desc:
At The Green Egg you find an incredible balanced cuisine, able to bring together the most delicious flavours that a caterer can offer.

With The Green Egg Catering & Delivery, your caterer dedicated to a rich and balanced food broadly inspired by Asian cuisine, enjoy many healthy preparations made by our chef and his inimitable talent with love, care and attention.

name: Lost in the Sauce
desc: We are a collection of friends and foodies who have worked in the high-end Film and TV space for years. Supplying speciality coffee and serving up the highest quality food. We are constantly present, from designing and converting the vans to sourcing, cooking and serving the food, we know that our passion is key to serving up the best possible food and experience.

name: El Huichol
desc: We are 'El Huichol ', the only authentic mobile Mexican food van in Cornwall. We are based in Newquay and serve the South West. Our menu is primarily comprised of beautiful Mexican food including tacos, guacamole and quesadillas. We love food and delicious flavour combinations, we can flex to most things as the van is well equipped.

name: Spengler's Deli
desc: Spengler’s Deli is an homage to the great delis of New York City, where a sandwich is a work of art and it’s taken very seriously indeed.

name: The Big Greek Feed
desc:
We are a Greek-Cypriot family run business, wishing to continue bringing our delicious tried and tested family recipes to the UK’s biggest and best festivals. 
We cater for all dietary requirements and source all our ingredients locally wherever possible. Having years of experience in the big festival environments we thrive in a face paced and busy atmosphere and can handle anything thrown at us.

name: Rogues' Kitchen
desc:
Welcome to Rogues Kitchen, where flavour is our game and passion is our driving force. If you're looking for a culinary experience that is as unique as it is delicious, then look no further! Our street food pop-up specializes in BBQ meats and gourmet burgers, crafted with love and packed with flavour.

We believe that food should be accessible to all, but also fun and exciting.

name: Vanilla Pod
desc:
Vanilla Pod presents their beautiful duck egg blue, fully restored vintage retro ice cream van, serving award-winning Great British New Forest soft scoop ice cream and sorbets in waffle and sugar cones and tubs with all the trimmings; flakes, sprinkles, mini mallows and sauces.

No generators running or power is required, the van is fully self-sufficient and can even operate inside, as long as the…

name: PAUL HOLMES MOBILE CATERING LTD
desc:
Paul Holmes catering is a Family run business with over 40 years experience
During this time we have earned a reputation of quality foods, immaculate units, well trained team of staff, and a reliable and trustworthy, work ethic.

Gaining a wealth of up to date legislative knowledge and implementing it across our company throughout this time.

EVENT AND OUTDOOR CATERING YOU CAN TRUST
This range is …

name: Dills street food ltd
desc:
We are a 3rd generation family run street food busines, offering many different menus ranging from Lebanese Shawarmas,  buttermilk fried chicken n chips, Gourmet burgers with skin on fries and hand beer battered fish n chips.

every order is cooked fresh to order with TLC, making sure every customer leaves satisfied.

name: Dorothy’s
desc:
Dorothy's Deli is an independent, family-run Afro-Caribbean brand based in East London. Inspired by generations of family recipes, we bring authentic African and Caribbean flavours to workplaces, office events, and our locations across London.

We specialise in corporate catering and office lunches, while also serving our signature dishes daily at our London locations.

name: Rascal’s Catering
desc:
We started out of lockdown, running a pizza pop up takeaway night from a local pub. Went down really well, doing every Monday and Tuesday night! 

As lockdown eased we then started doing the odd party for friends as we had the mobile ovens, we then started doing bigger events, had a dark kitchen from a pub in Tunbridge wells as well as doing all the mobile events!

name: The Mac Factory
desc:
We’re saying NO MORE to bland, tasteless so-called Mac and Cheese. Once upon a time in America it was great, so great it was served at the founding father’s dinner table. (Trust us, look it up!)

Inspired by New York City, we’re taking it real serious once more.

name: Mama's Jerk
desc:
Mama’s Jerk are an innovative Caribbean street food team serving great tasting Jamaican Jerk inspired cuisine.

Over the years they’ve gathered a huge following for their fiery and succulent 24 hour marinated smoked jerk chicken as well as a number of innovative Jamaican Jerk spiced vegan , vegetarian and fish dishes.

The food is prepared using authentic ingredients to create delicious Jerk flavo…

name: Steak it Easy Limited
desc: Steak-it-Easy was developed 6 years ago. We started trading at live music events at Alexandra Palace with 10,000 capacities. We ran bars at Ally Pally and our love of the street food helped make our decision to start our own. We wanted a product that you didn't see at every festival you go to and Steak was our answer.

name: BABEK Brothers
desc:
The Babek Brothers are two brothers serving up totally delicious Kebabs and Cocktails. They travelled from Istanbul to Lucknow picking up recipes and ideas along the way, using the light breads from Athens, kofta of the Turkish Ocakbasi, pickles from India and worked them together to bring you their awesome kebabs!

Having grown up on a Devon farm, they have a passion for great produce and use onl…

name: Street Food by Sally - Duck
desc: Street Food by Sally is an independent mobile catering company based in East Sussex, created from a love of great food, events and bringing something a little different to the street food scene.

name: Satay Street
desc: Satay Street’s story began in 2009 when they first launched as a street food stall in Brick Lane. They have since built up a loyal following after moving to the busy and vibrant Petticoat Lane Market.

name: Jam Delish
desc:
Jam Delish is a family-run, independent Caribbean vegan restaurant and cocktail bar based in the heart of Angel, Islington.

Founded in 2020 by siblings Jordan and Chyna, the concept was inspired by a desire to share their grandparents’ traditional Caribbean recipes—reimagined through a modern, plant-based lens shaped by their own vegan upbringing.

By blending their passion for vibrant vegan food…

name: George Rogers Catering
desc: Since 1969, our family-run business has been built on passion, dedication, and a commitment to quality.

name: Three Gizas
desc: Three Gizas is the result of three friends' crazy travels across the world, leading them on an epic adventure in Egypt in 2021. It was in the shadows of the Pyramids of Giza that the three first tried Egypt's national dish, Koshari.

name: Blues Catering
desc: We are a Yorkshire based independent caterer specialising in relaxed creative barbeque inspired menus.  Our main wedding breakfast options are rustic wooden sharing boards presented to the tables with a range of your choice of meats, vegetarian and vegan options and sides.  The boards look great and work really well to create a wonderful relaxed atmosphere on the day!

name: Super Fry Guys
desc: Born in lockdown from our back garden providing quality food for the Salford community in a time when everywhere was closed and people couldnt dine out. We started a friday night feed changing the theme each week.

name: Veggie Planet
desc: As event caterers, Veggie Planet offers the finest in healthy, freshly prepared vegan and vegetarian food.

name: Grandad's Sausages
desc:
Grandad’s Sausages is a take on the American classic; the sausages are homemade by the team to their Grandad Bernard’s 50-year-old recipes, which they then top using only the finest locally sourced produce and condiments.

Whether they serve their products from their lovely marquee or our quaint, vintage horse box, it's a guaranteed taste sensation that will leave your taste buds tingling and want…

name: LJ Hugs
desc:
We are the current 2022 British Street Food Awards 'Peoples Choice Winners'.
We've been featured on Million Pound Menu and The Independent newspaper.

name: Tikka Guys
desc: Our journey into the world of Pakistani street food started with a simple yet powerful idea: to bring the vibrant, mouthwatering flavors of Pakistan’s bustling streets to everyone, no matter where they are. Growing up, we were surrounded by the aroma of sizzling kebabs, the rich, spiced gravies, and the comforting warmth of freshly baked naan.

name: Indian food truck by TifinBox
desc: TifinBox, a relaxed Indian restaurant in London, have just converted a beautiful Indian food truck, with an emphasis on great tasting authentic Indian dishes, drinks and speciality wraps.

name: Wild At Heart Street Food
desc: We are a family based events catering company that specialize in gourmet Toasties and luxury loaded fries.

name: The Horse Box
desc:
The Horse Box trailer provides Georgia and Steve with opportunities to go out to new exciting shows, meet new people and test new food ideas. They pop up at events and food scenes across the county and beyond.

In The Horse Box, their speciality focus is handcrafted, organic flatbread tacos.

name: Electric Grubb
desc: Hello, my name is Steven Pessoa, the founder of Electric Grubb. I named this restaurant 'Electric Grubb ' as it really connected me the importance of a healthy eating lifestyle and was also inspired by the idea of 'Electric Food' which consists of the ideas that genetically modified food is not good for the body, and instead people should strive for a more healthy alkaline food base which will pre…

name: Harlem2Manila
desc: We are two young women (Emma & Maria) passionate about food and enjoy creating new recipes. With all the processed food around, we wanted to offer fresh food which has been made from scratch as well as offering plenty of vegan options.  We both spent months travelling around the Philippines (Maria's native country) and fell in love with the street food culture.

name: Sweet Dee's Jerk
desc:
We are Sweet Dee’s Jerk, the UK’s New-Gen Caribbean food and culture brand. A one-stop shop for Caribbean fusion cuisine in London. From our Selfridges kitchen to our homemade sauces, and unique event-catering service, family and community has always been at the heart of the brand from inception in 2017. 
We built our name in our hometown Tooting six years ago and have never left.

name: Busters
desc: At Buster’s, we’re all about delivering the best burgers you’ve ever tasted, right in the heart of Brixton. Our focus is simple: premium Welsh Wagyu beef patties, paired with a few signature touches to create something truly special.

name: Slap & Pickle
desc: Slap & Pickle are a modern Omni diner; serving up amazing hot dogs, burgers, loaded fries and diner treats which never fail to please absolutely everyone.

name: Oggies Wood Fired Pizza Co
desc:
Oggie has experience in the hospitality industry for over 30 years so you can be assured your event will be a success.
Oggies wood fired pizzas was established in 2016 and has gained a great reputation since .We can cater for all types of events from weddings to festivals so can provide a bespoke service where needed.
We offer a varied selection of packages for you to choose from ,including variou…

name: Husk & Honey Granola
desc: Husk & Honey's award-winning range of granola is the ultimate way to kick start the day, served on a range of quality bases, finished with utterly delicious toppings.

name: Renato's Pizza Co
desc:
Renato's Pizza Co is a family run business inspired by simple flavours and recipes which originate from homeland Italy.

The team continue to strive for improvement and strongly believe their passion for food is what allows them to ensure customers are always happy with their service.

Renato’s Pizza Co can cater for a full wedding day from beginning to end, starting with a combination of canapés …

name: Go Go Carib
desc: Originally, GoGo Carib was a home-based Caribbean takeaway which launched during 2019 in the heart of Lewisham.  During the pandemic we engaged with other cultures and communities in London, allowing us to develop into a fusion Caribbean food business.

name: Typhoon Ten
desc: Typhoon Ten started as two friends cooking together in a tiny kitchen, trying to better recipes every week.

name: Goodfella’s Pizza Van
desc: Goodfellas Pizza Van brings authentic wood-fired pizza to events across the UK, inspired by traditional Neapolitan methods and a genuine love for great food. We serve hand stretched pizzas made with quality ingredients, rich sauces, and perfectly balanced toppings, all cooked fresh in our wood-fired oven.

name: The Yeast Brothers
desc: The Yeast Brothers is a pizza company that was founded in 2021 by two Brazilian chefs who have been active in the London pizza scene for several years.

name: Humbledough
desc: Humbledough make raw, edible cookie dough with a conscience. Their product is super simple yet delicious, a scoop of chilled cookie dough topped with their own homemade whipped coconut creams, freeze-dried fruits and chocolatey creations.

name: The Gluck Street
desc:
We are two 26 years-old Italian boys with the passion for food, Pizza  in particular.  

7 years of experience in this field we can confirm that we have worked in various places in Italy and in the UK, coming, one day to the decision to start our own business, with something a little more particular.

name: La Chingada Ltd
desc:
At La Chingada, we stick to what we do best — proper Mexican food made with real ingredients and no shortcuts. Our tacos, quesadillas, and street classics are packed with flavour.

We set up with a colourful gazebo that’s easy to spot and quick to get going. It’s made for fast service and good vibes.

name: Delaneys
desc: Delaney’s is the united brainchild of husband and wife team, Ed and Rosie Delaney, both of whom have a passion for indulging in good food. Delaney’s offers crepes, waffles, churros and fries with unique and imaginative fillings and toppings, both savoury and sweet, and aims to offer something for everyone.

name: Mrs Falafel
desc:
Bringing the best to Glasgow's food scene, Mrs Falafel has always had the stomach of the customer at heart. 

We are the number 1 authentic falafel supplier, providing a series of wraps, bowls, spreads and dips - the best Indonesian cuisine for your event.

name: Lovely Bunch of Coconuts
desc:
From the small island of Mauritius situated in the Indian ocean we introduce to you Lovely Bunch of Coconuts.

We are a mobile street food stall producing Mauritian food, biryani, barbecued meat cooked over open char coal on a  authentic Mauritian street food barbecue, along with home made chutneys and salad.

name: DT Doubles
desc: Double Trouble brings the vibrant taste of Caribbean street food to Peckham and beyond. Founded by Elia Charles and Kieran Lang, we blend Grenadian, St. Lucian, and Guyanese family recipes with creative twists. Our specialty is Doubles — soft flatbreads filled with curried chickpeas — offered in both savoury and sweet varieties.

name: So Solid Sando
desc: So Solid Sando was inspired by a trip to Japan, where the country’s vibrant street food culture left a lasting impression. From bustling markets to small independent vendors, it was the quality, simplicity and attention to detail that sparked the idea of bringing an authentic Japanese street food experience to Hertfordshire.

name: Katsutopia
desc: Katsutopia has been slinging out London's finest homemade Katsu from our iconic 1948 Ford Pick Up Truck since 2016.

name: The One Pizza
desc: We are Esra and Ayse the co-owners of The One Pizza Van which is a mobile pizza business. We are cousins and both live in Wickwar.

name: Micky's - Sandwiches
desc: Micky's is a globally-inspired sandwich shop. Mike started the business as MIRA, with a focus on traditional sandwiches from Napoli, and with careful tweaks to the menu Micky's now specialises in mouth-watering focaccia sandwiches known as some of the best in the North.

name: NATASHKINOltd
desc: Our commitment to using only upcycled sustainable packaging. our highly distinctive pink branding with a cheeky edge. We are the premier Gluten Free/Vegan Matcha Café, Sweets and Sandwiches in London. Our Food Truck is available to travel all over England. All of our cooking is overseen b y Cordon Bleu graduate Christina Cramer.

name: Bella Mia pizza
desc:
Bella Mia Pizza 
It all started at a young age where me Jamie Di Crescienzio frequently visited family in Naples where I’d head down to a villa just south of the Amalfi Coast to spend a few weeks being around my Italian family.

name: Moyo & Brown Events
desc:
We are two best friends that share a passion for food (especially quality fried chicken!)

We offer a full range of fried chicken tenders, burgers and loaded fries. We also always have different specials on the go too, including: Halloumi Burgers and Chick’N waffles (sweet or spicy)!

We have a cool converted horse box into a fully mobile kitchen! We also have a full functioning gazebo set up.

name: Bobata
desc:
Bobata! A family run business carving a niche style into the gourmet street food market by serving unique artisanal sandwiches to the community.

With more than a decade's worth of culinary experience, chef Darina set out on a mission to recreate some of the world's most beloved sandwiches, sourcing quality ingredients from local, sustainable and ethical suppliers.

Inspired by New York’s famous d…

name: Horn Ok Please
tagline: The Taste of India in London
desc: The real tastes and textures of India are found in the stalls and vans serving up mouthwatering panipuri, crunchy bhelpuri, or spicy pav bhaji. Horn Ok Please (HOP) was established in June 2011 to transport this from the streets of India to the streets of London. More than just food, HOP aims to provide a portal to a culture where street food is an integral part of everyday life.

name: Twisted Toppings Pizza
desc:
Twisted Toppings Pizza is a family business, run by husband and wife team, Hollie & Tony with the help of their family. 

We are passionate about creating and serving the tastiest, freshest wood fired pizza.

name: Pork & Co
desc: Personally I have now been in hospitality for 35 years. I have been responsible as an Operations Manager for 15 restaurants in Central London and successfully ran my own fine dining restaurant called "Deeson's British Restaurant" for many years in Canterbury.  Deeson's was primarily supplied by my own smallholding which I ran alongside the restaurant.

name: Carib Catering
desc: Caribbean Jerk is an outstanding outdoor catering service that provides both traditional Caribbean cuisine and a street-food menu with a Jamaican twist! With over 30 years of experience we're professionals at providing delicious food and upholding impeccable hygiene standards.  We offer a huge range of home cooked dishes using spices and seasonings from the Islands!

name: Rambling Roots
desc:
Rambling Roots is a plant-based mobile caterer based in Norwich, run by Hannah and Ben. We serve up wholesome, fresh and tasty food to folks at festivals and events around East Anglia and beyond.

We aim to provide real, wholesome and hearty food choices for people, with fresh and interesting flavours inspired by global cuisines. Food that everyone can enjoy whether they’re vegan or not.

name: SALEM RESTAURANT LTD
desc: Located just off Rye Lane on Parkstone Road, Yemanes is a beloved Peckham institution operating from a vibrant, graffiti-clad food van. This family-run stall has built a cult following for its authentic North African soul food, serving as a gritty, unpretentious staple in an ever-changing neighbourhood.

name: Zout
desc: At Zout Food, we are passionate about creating the most delicious, vibrant and health-conscious Moroccan-inspired dishes for your next event. Our team of experienced chefs have over 10 years of experience working in restaurants both here and abroad, and are dedicated to using only the freshest, locally sourced produce from small producers and independent businesses.

name: The Good Foods Group
desc:
The Good Foods Group
We are THE company that is all about THE food! We offer various menus for various venues! From private parties, through weddings and corporate functions to big and cheerful festivals and events. We speak the language of food meaning we turn your ideas into mouthwatering real deal.

name: Oh My Sausage
desc: If you're looking for authentic German sausages topped with flavour-packed sauerkraut crispy onions and more, you're in the right place! Oh My Sausage serve outrageously good sausages made with only the best ingredients. What's more, they're served from one of their two brilliant setups so you can choose from either a rustic or modern style.

name: W&W
desc:
I’m very passionate about offering fantastic food from vintage vehicles . 
I have managed to keep every original feature with Annie bar a few seats .
The bus is all electric with the best fryers on the market . 
Annie is fully equipped with everything needed to be completely self sufficient other than power .

name: The Pizza Trailer
desc:
The Pizza Trailer serve up traditional hand-stretched Neapolitan pizza straight from their gorgeous wood-fired oven, housed within their restored vintage horse trailer. 

All of their dough is handmade from Caputo 00 flour (the very best) and is allowed to rest for at least 36 hours, giving you incredibly light and fluffy dough which is easily digestible. 

All of their toppings, such as their del…

name: Bespoke Event Catering
desc: Born from a love of great street food and a drive to create memorable experiences, our business has grown from a single unit to several all while staying true to our core values of quality, creativity, and customer care.

name: Arepita LTD
desc:
Arepita is a WoW, totally new! experience for our customers. We will surprise your guest making you the host of the year.

We offer an Exotic, New and Unique experience with a 100% inclusive menu, for any age, any occasion, any style, any budget and ANY dietary requirements.

We have a vast variety of options Gluten Free,  Meat lovers, Pasta lovers, Vegan and Vegetarian.

Inside, outside settings …

name: Wow Churros
desc:
Wow Churros serve freshly made vegan churros coated in cinnamon sugar with the option of adding their delicious chocolate and caramel sauce.

Olive is their beautiful Citroen van and looks stunning at all events particularly as she is bright orange!

name: Barries
tagline: Vegan Nuggets, Chips and Homemade Slaw
desc: Barries Mayo is a vegan mayo startup that is bringing a variety of trailblazing flavours to the market.

name: Exile Cooks
desc:
Exile Cooks are a small group of friends & ex-colleagues bringing their own eclectic brand of global street food & relaxed, paired back fine dining to Scotland’s central belt in the form of various unique kitchen residencies & franchises, pop ups, private events & food shacks.
Headed up by Paul O’malley, who brings almost 25 years of experience in top kitchens throughout the UK, Exile Cooks have s…

name: The Gourmet Griddle
desc:
The Gourmet Griddle is a street food catering company based on a free-range farm in Tunbridge Wells, offering Aberdeen Angus burgers and other steak cuts.

The farm strongly believes in animal welfare. The cattle are 100% free-range and grass-fed.

name: Fritterly Fritters
tagline: No Gluten, Dairy, Soya or Egg
desc: My journey started in Berlin back in 2013. I had been living there since 2012 as a photographer.  Naumann Drei is a bar that is situated downstairs to the apartment where I was living, so I would often go there to do some post production work over a latte or Hefeweizen.

name: Il Camino
desc:
Italian and Greek food specialists, fresh and hand made products from the tradition, inspired by family receipts.

Three partners that have spent most of their life in hospitality business working in restaurants, a lot of experience in cooking and serving.
Il Camino, our trading name, meaning the chimney or the fire place, it's the place where our mothers used to cook for the whole family, and we …

name: Myo’s  Noodles Japanese fusion
desc:
Great! Here's a refined version of your bio with your business name included:

Welcome to Myo’s Japanese Fusion, where authentic Japanese flavors meet innovative street food! With over 8 years of experience, I am passionate about bringing the vibrant tastes of Japan to your local community.

name: Big Doggs
desc:
Big Doggs are trying to alter the UK's opinion of hot dogs from childhood memories of pale sausages that don’t resemble any kind of high quality meat!

Their menu is based on US regional varieties of classic dogs.heir beef frankfurter is high quality, high welfare, fully traceable 94% meat and their vegan frank has had amazing feedback from vegans and meat eaters alike, the majority of menu option…

name: The Chef’s Grill
desc: Our seasoned team of professional chefs boasts over 25 years of expertise in the catering industry, ensuring an unforgettable gastronomic experience for your guests.

name: New York'shire Pizza Co.
tagline: Oven to your belly with Love
desc:
New York'shire Pizza Co was born, Aug 2020.

NYPCo is a mobile wood-fired pizza service that provides delicious pizzas for various events such as wedding receptions, birthday parties, corporate events, and food/music festivals.

name: Events Kitchen
desc: At Events Kitchen, we deliver vibrant, high-quality mobile catering designed to elevate every event. Built on a passion for fresh food and seamless service, we bring restaurant-level dining directly to your venue.

name: Load 'o' Waffle
desc:
We are a family run business based in Wellington, Somerset. We have a combined experience of over 25 years in catering both here in the UK and in Belgium. One of the owners has had training in a Michelin star restaurant in Belgium.

From our beautiful converted horse box we serve fresh Belgian waffles with fresh local ingredients. We serve both sweet and savoury. The chicken waffle is divine.

name: Smashed
desc:
At Smashed, we believe that the London burger scene has become stagnant, repetitive and quite frankly, boring. 

Too much of the same competition: thick patties, piled high with ungainly toppings housed in a brioche bun has led to the market becoming overly saturated with little innovation and change. 

We are disrupting the market by bringing an entirely new burger concept to consumers.

name: Roly Poly Eats Ltd
desc:
Welcome to Roly Poly.

Started in 2010 and now ONE of the names of Street Food and with an incredible back ground.  Falling back on our butchery heritage we're passionate about every thing Meat!

name: Mac Daddy
desc:
We are immensely proud to have been awarded the title of Street Food Trader of the Year, serving our delectable, gooey Mac n' Cheese from our uniquely converted cargo bike kitchens or festival and our private event set ups.

We also serve up our incredible 4 cheese grilled toasties.

name: Tokyo Kitchen
desc: Tokyo Kitchen was born from a love of authentic Japanese street food and the vibrant festival culture that surrounds it. Drawing inspiration from the bustling food stalls of Tokyo, we set out to bring comforting, honest Japanese flavours to events across the UK.

name: Collectors Coffee
desc:
Three things make us stand out from the rest:

1. Our Coffee: We have our very own blend of beans, "The Collectors Blend". Roasted by the B-Corp Certified Chimney Fire Coffee just down the road from us in Surrey.

2. Our super speedy service: We have fine tuned the art of dealing with the festival crowds.

name: Buffets & Barbecues
desc: Buffets & Barbecues are a family run business with over 25 years experience delivering some of the most delicious barbecues and buffets around.

name: The Vurger Co
desc: The Vurger Co are revolutionising fast food through the power of plants and have two very popular permanent restaurants in Shoreditch and Canary Wharf.

name: The Roasted Martini
desc: We’re a family-run mobile catering business, founded in 2022 after years of working in hospitality and within the coffee roasting industry. We started with a small mobile coffee van, bringing our passion for great coffee and friendly service to events across the country.

name: Pan Gastro
desc:
We are Pan Gastro! We are based on the border of Cumbria and Lancashire. 

We specialise in a variety of street food, including Mexican tacos, Greek gyros, smash burgers and kebabs.

We come from an experienced hospitality background and have always been in love with food and travel.

name: Uncle Glenn's Caribbean Food LTD
desc:
We are Uncle Glenn's Caribbean Food.
Based in Bournemouth Dorset, we bring the love, soul and delicious flavours of the Caribbean to your event.

name: Mother Clucker
desc: We are Mother Clucker. We serve tea brined, buttermilk soaked, twice battered fried chicken across the UK. We clucking love flippin’ and dippin’ our strips, burgers, and sides for you with sauces that you can’t find anywhere else. Drench your chicken in Lime Mayo or Mother Clucker Pepper Sauce – or both!

name: Tin Roof Pizza
desc:
The idea behind Tin Roof Pizza was born out of a real passion for Neapolitan pizzas. After spending many working holidays in Italy, owner Barny decided to bring his passion for great Neapolitan pizzas back to the UK.

He uses only the finest ingredients, and hand stretch each pizza for that genuine Neapolitan crust.

name: DSY Wingz
desc: We offer delicious chicken wings in a variety of awesome homemade flavours. Our mission is simple, provide a healthy option without compromising taste. Being from a fitness background we understand how important it is to have a healthy option which is why our food is always air fried so you can enjoy your wing guilt free! We also offer boneless options and a selection of sides.

name: Original Patty Men
desc: We started out 10 years ago in street food and grew our events business as well as opening 3 stand alone sites in and around Birmingham. We noticed the city was missing a well sourced independent burger vendor and decided to quit our jobs and tackle the issue head on! Since then we haven't looked back and we continue to grow the business.

name: Love Sum Dumplings
tagline: Fresh Dumplings Made in the UK
desc: Love Sum is a modern dumpling brand founded by Sandy Tang, a Macau-born food entrepreneur and finalist on MasterChef UK and MasterChef Asia.

name: Taquiza
desc: At Taquiza, we bring the vibrant and authentic flavours of Mexican street food to your event. Specialising in delicious tacos, small plates, and traditional Mexican dishes, we offer a unique culinary experience that will leave your guests craving more.

name: Benvenuti
desc:
At BenVenuti we love to identify ourself as an independent Food Boutique. We do offer premium Italian products, including our own production of regional delicacies. 

BenVenuti  is the fusion of Gianluca and Simone vision of the home made traditional Italian family’s food.

name: Crumpys Smoke Shack
desc:
**Crumpy’s Smoke Shack – Authentic BBQ & Smash Burger Food Truck**

Crumpy’s Smoke Shack is a mobile street food business serving authentic smoked meats, BBQ and freshly made smash burgers.

name: Doh'hut Leeds
desc: These guys are taking the North by storm by serving up delicious handmade gourmet donuts made fresh every day.

name: Khon Thai
desc:
Khon Thai is more than a family business, it's a love story. 

They are a husband and wife team, Petch & Elsa, who met in a London street food market and have been stir frying noodles in flaming woks, side by side, since 2015. Petch was practically born into street food after his mother, Toi, started Khon Thai in North London over 20 years ago.

name: Make A Meal Of It
desc: We are a family run mobile catering business with over 30 years of experience in delivering high quality food at events across the UK.

name: Rendang! Thank you ma'am
desc: I don’t know if the story really starts with me trying rendang for the first time at a food market in London, or if it was that my job in international development took me to some incredible corners of the World.

name: Nomadic Pizza
desc:
Nomadic Pizza was launched during lockdown in 2020. Owned and run by Dan & Natalie, a famil y run team, we constantly update our product to consistently produce an exceptional pizza.

We make all of our dough in-house. We slowly ferment this for at least 30 hours before stretching and topping. There is a marked difference between frozen vs fresh dough.

name: KraPow LDN
desc:
After traveling through Asia and falling in love with Thai street food, Paul wanted to bring these amazing tastes to the people of London, and with that, KraPow LDN was born.

KraPow aims to excite the palates of London foodies with the very best, cutting-edge Thai - and we think they are doing a cracking job of it!

They're making a stand against overly rich and dull Thai that you might be used t…

name: Nomadough
desc:
Our story began at Kings Cross in 2020 on one of our returns to dry land, from working abroad in the yachting industry. We bought a notepad, started a spider diagram, and Nomadough was born…. Alex being the Nomad, Libby baking the dough.

Libby was born on a farm in Essex, growing up with a love of British countryside and the use of local produce.

name: Crooked Kitchens
desc: Le Crooked Canard is a family-run business built on a love of great food and great occasions. What started as a small passion project in 2018 has grown into something we’re incredibly proud of — but it still feels like yesterday we decided to take the leap and start this adventure.

name: JURKISH
desc: Founded by Nazlı Ramadan, Jurkish is a vibrant culinary tribute to her Jamaican and Turkish-Cypriot heritage. This unique fusion was born from a desire to move beyond traditional stereotypes, blending the bold, Caribbean spices of her father’s roots with the herby, Mediterranean soul of her mother’s.

name: Juici Jerk
desc: Combining their British and West-Indian heritage with a love for food, Juici Jerk are spreading a new age taste of the Caribbean by offering a fresh take on this colourful cuisine.

name: The BBQ Project
desc:
The BBQ Project do exactly what the name suggests, tasty barbecue food cooked low and slow, jam packed with love and passion!

Using locally produced produce, our amazing team cook delicious traditional style BBQ with an English twist. Our crew bring unique aspects to each dish using both meat, fish & vegan centrepieces for each one.

name: The Shellfish Pig
desc: The Shellfish Pig is an award-winning street food business hailing from the culinary mecca that is Cornwall.

name: Dapao Fusion Kitchen
desc:
Dapao is a community-minded kitchen, doing wood-fired pizzas, curries and wraps.

We’re a husband and wife team, and we love doing this - and that comes through at your event.  Christina did her chef training in Singapore, so aside from traditional European flavours, you'll see Singapore-flavours (Chinese, Malay and Indian).

name: With Fire
desc: With Fire is a catering company focusing on the art and theatre of cooking using fire and smoke. They are event caterers who have a passion for all things wood fired. The passionate team provides authentic food, using seasonal ingredients cooked over real fire.

name: KoKoDoo
desc:
Here at KOKODOO we are all about that Authentic Korean Fried Chicken! Each batch of our fried chicken is prepared fresh to order, hand-battered korean-style, then smothered in our unique proprietary range of sauces formulated by our Korean co-founder and head chef, Mary who boasts over 30+ years of professional East Asian culinary experience!

Our Korean fried chicken was an Award-Winner at the 20…

name: South Manny Flavaz
desc:
🍔 From Streets to Feasts: Our Sizzling Journey 🍔

What started as a fryer and a dream has evolved into a finger-lickin' phenomenon! With 7 years of dishing out perfection, SMF has conquered the hearts (and stomachs) of Manchester's food scene. Our secret? A passion for quality, an obsession with crunch, and a dash of magic that makes every bite unforgettable.

🎉 Cluck Yeah, Let's Party!

name: Murphy's Pakora Bar
desc: Murphys Pakora Bar opened in '89 before being closed and reopened by the son of the former owner. We bring something different to the indian cuisine! We have recently acquired a food truck van to bring our fusion street food and desi style street food to around the country. We can do more refined catering events also.

name: The Fat Crust
desc: Hi! We are The Fat Crust, a South London based pizza company specialising in 'Canotto' style, contemporary Neapolitan pizza (trust us, it's the next big thing!). We make authentic, show-stopping pizzas with distinctively light and puffy crusts.

name: Carnival Brazilian Street Food
desc: Carnival Brazilian Street Food is dedicated to bringing the flavors of Brazilian street food and the spirit of the Brazilian carnival to the UK.

name: Kell’s Kitchen
desc: Kell’s Kitchen was established in 2020 and has successfully been trading at multiple events for over 2 years including large scale festivals, multi-site Christmas events, provided long term catering for film studios and traded at regular markets as well as servicing corporate events.

name: Temple of Soul
desc: Temple of Soul is on a mission to take you through a journey of the flavours of the Middle East and touch your soul.

name: LUNCH'D LTD
desc:
Super delicious Grab & Go packages for brand activations, meetings & events.

Born in 2014 in founder Oli's tiny South Coast flat kitchen in Poole, Dorset Lunch'd has grown from homemade lunches for one local agency into one of the UK's go-to caterers for brands, agencies and production teams.

name: Magga Magga
desc: A private chef and catering service that you'll remember and tell all of your friends about. If you're looking for something slightly different and wanting to experience fresh and exciting flavors then Magga Magga is the right choice for you.

name: Wrappers Delight
desc:
We are Wrappers Delight, the festival gourmet wrap specialist Fresh and tasty festival food, home of the Bad Boy Wrap

Fun, tasty and healthy festival food you can wrap your hands around on the move.

Above all John and Henry Lovell enjoy good food, and a fun festival spirit.

John has spent many enjoyable years selling food at festivals all over the country, and Henry owns the much loved “Chickpe…

name: Food on Focus
desc:
Food on Focus is a unique business model with an Umbrella of diversities! 
From street food, finer dining, private chef service, event catering and even food photography, we have the background and experience to create a moment to remember.

name: Casa 00
desc:
About Casa 00
Casa 00 is the sister company of Officina 00, renowned as one of the top fresh pasta restaurants in London, delivering an unmatched culinary experience that brings the rich flavours of Italy to the city. Casa 00 is bringing their artisanal pasta dishes to the event industry with a bespoke set up, designed like a traditional Italian market stall.

name: 800 Degrees Pizza
desc: A family run pizza company we took over in 2023, serving thin and crispy pizzas cooked in our bespoke wood fired ‘Dragon Ovens’.

name: Butchies
desc:
Butchies reckon they make the best fried chicken burger in London and, when you’re third in the list of Time Out’s top street vendors as voted by the readers, it’s hard to argue!

In the past they’ve worked for corporate clients such as Nike, Heineken and the cast of the new Star Wars film so if you book Butchies for your event, you’re in great hands.

They're also able to serve their incredible b…

name: Lucky Gyros
desc:
Lucky Gyros offers freshly prepared Greek Gyros & Souvlaki from a beautiful vintage Citroen H Van! 

Our team of chefs prepare all food on site fresh, and can cater for all dietary requirements, allergens and preferences with the perfect blend of Healthy options and indulgent treats too!

We strike the perfect balance of high quality street food with super efficient output, thanks to our concise m…

name: DÁPPA - Ice Cream Made From Nuts!
desc: East London born and bred since 2019, DÁPPA is revolutionising ice cream with its thick, rich & outrageously creamy soft serve made from nuts. Forget everything you've learned about Mr Whippy and prepare for a whole new experience... DÁPPA offers its best-in-class Madagascan Vanilla soft serve in a classic branded cup or black charcoal cone.

name: Thyme2Dine
desc:
Thyme2Dine is a family-run catering company that believes in great food and great service.

They fully understand the stresses involved with organising an event and so they make a huge effort to relieve as much of this stress as possible by providing a professional service with well-trained staff.

They have rustic-style 1960’s rice horse box trailer that has been lovingly restored and converted i…

name: The Oven
desc:
Event Catering specialist's covering festivals, weddings, parties, private & corporate events what ever the occasion we have you covered. 
Imagine guests mingling as wood-fired ovens emit tantalizing scents, creating an inviting atmosphere. Our skilled chefs craft gourmet pizzas on-site, using only the freshest ingredients, ensuring each slice is a culinary masterpiece.

name: Only Jerkin'
desc: Only Jerkin' is one of London and Birmingham's best loved street food traders that champion Caribbean flavours with their famous fried chicken and sides (veggie and vegan options available). Renowned for slinging the crispiest nuggets in town, Only Jerkin' trade all over the UK and never fail to bring the feel good vibes through flavour and music.

name: Caroline's Little Kitchen
desc: Caroline's Little Kitchen is a mobile vintage Citroen HY van serving delicious mouth watering sweet and savoury crêpes. They are available to hire for weddings, the evening part of your wedding, catering events and private parties in Wiltshire, Berkshire, Gloucestershire and surrounding counties.

name: Bayou
desc:
Bayou is bringing the taste of Louisiana to the UK with our fun take on the classic New Orleans flavours, this is real Cajun Soul Food!

We're about representing the NOLA vibe with big flavours, smoking BBQs and good times. Our big yellow truck covered in neon lights could make you think you're on Bourbon Street.

name: Severn Valley Roasts
desc:
Severn Valley Roasts have been catering since 1994.
We specialise in the traditional way of catering, whilst adhering to modern food standards and regulations. Our company proudly sports a 5 star Food Hygiene Rating.

From a farming background in the heart of Shropshire, Alan has been a qualified butcher for the past 30 years.

name: Taste Tibet
desc: A BBC Good Food Magazine ‘hidden foodie gem’ and Guardian Top Ten picks for Oxford, Taste Tibet is a very rare find!

name: El Pollote
desc: El Pollote was born from the bold spirit of Latin America and the hustle of London street food. Founded by a Venezuelan couple, we started out frying wings at local food festivals and quickly became known for our unapologetic flavours and rebellious energy. After winning over crowds at events like KERB’s Bucket List and Wingfest, we took the leap and opened our first permanent site in Soho.

name: Ted's Tacos
desc: Ted's Tacos was created by brothers Tom and Ed Houlbrooke who are farmers, chefs, food lovers and experience event traders. Ed is the chef and Tom is the farmer.

name: STAKEHAUS
desc:
STAKEHAUS is about one thing: STEAK! STEAK! STEAK!... Okay that was 3 x things but you get the gist. We serve THE BEST British beef with hand-cut UK potatoes.
Since 2015 we have focused on providing a restaurant quality meal in a place you may not expect to find it.

name: 'AS THA GOT BEEF?
desc:
‘AS THA GOT BEEF? is a small family business offering Sheffield inspired dishes. 

Think hendos caramalised onion burgers and loads of other tasty unique dishes. We've created a secret seasoning that leaves you coming back for more every time! 

We're complete foodies and have created a business full of dishes we feel passionately about.

name: CHI CHI + THE PASTA FAMILY
desc:
Chi Chi & The Pasta Family is an award-winning fresh pasta kitchen based in London, bringing restaurant-quality Italian food to events, offices and celebrations. We specialise in handmade pasta cooked fresh on site, served with rich, flavourful sauces that have earned multiple Great Taste Awards.

What sets us apart is speed without compromise.

name: Pastry Innovations
desc:
Pastry Innovations are the leaders in dessert innovation and creativity. Headed by Helen Clark, Le Cordon Bleu trained chef who has worked in some of the best restaurants in London such as The Ivy and Michelin starred La Trompette, they provide innovative desserts to restaurants, original products to shops and now offer unique event and virtual experiences to clients across the UK. 

Focused on cr…

name: 081 Pizzeria
desc:
we like to call ourselves an 'authentic Neapolitan pizzeria with an urban twist' who take pizza very seriously...

Born in Napoli. Raised in Peckham.

name: STB Events Ltd
desc:
Shoot The Bull brings gourmet food to places where most traditional restaurants can’t. 

The team bring their food for you to enjoy, in any location required. Taking the restaurant to the street! Their menu can be adapted and changed and they can even serve a mean breakfast.

name: Pasteis de Nata ( Maria Nata)
desc:
Maria Nata serve authentic, award-winning Natas freshly-baked daily using the finest recipe and natural ingredients.

Hailing from Portugal, Natas are delicious custard tarts that have become a global sensation. Maria Nata’s founder, Antonio, has great experience working in distributing incredible Portuguese food and drink to the UK.

name: The Little Fish Hut
desc:
The Little Fish Hut is a family-run catering company from Cornwall established in 2015. Starting out with their unbelievably good fish and chips, they decided to add to their offering and can now offer BBQ, paella, afternoon tea and more.

They’ve catered over 120 weddings as well as being regulars at large festivals in the South West.

name: Snarling Hog
desc: Welcome to Snarling Hog, a small family catering business run by a Head chef with over 30 years experience in the industry. We cater to special occasions including full wedding and evening meals, corporate events, sporting events & high volume outdoor events. Our highly experienced chefs serve up tasty high-quality street food from our vintage food truck.

name: Lovage & Rosemary
desc:
The Lovage & Rosemary food truck was created through the owners’ love for cooking, nature and travels. They believe good food connects people and will always serve well-prepared food cooked with love!

Their food truck is really unique and would definitely be a talking point at any event.

name: Hog Squad
desc: We are a professional catering company based in Hampshire, IOW & West Sussex with over 20 years experience in catering. our chef’s are fully qualified and have health and hygiene certificates. We are fully insured. We use refrigerated vans, and our pigs are free range and our produce is locally sourced where possible. We offer everything from a Hog Roast to Paella to a sit down meal with canapés.

name: Fig & Fleur Ltd
desc: Fig & Fleur was created from a simple idea: to create dishes we are genuinely proud of and share it with customers who value quality, creativity and great experiences.

name: Caché At Home
desc:
Caché At Home is the food and hosting arm of Caché LDN, bringing stylish, beautifully presented catering to weddings, corporate events, private parties and celebrations across London and the surrounding areas.
Our offering ranges from luxury grazing tables and charcuterie spreads to Mediterranean buffets, canapé-style catering, individual grazing cups, sharing platters and bespoke event menus.

name: Firedog
desc:
Firedog have been slinging delicious gourmet imported dogs for the past 3 years. They have traded at everything from massive music festivals to smaller corporate gigs and recently were hired to cater for Actor Chris Pine at his wrap party (he came back for seconds).

They are also residents at Scotland’s biggest Street Food Market Big Feed.

name: Jam Rack Jerk
desc:
Jam Rack Jerk is here to ‘entertain your taste buds’ with our classic range of Caribbean meals. We specialise in outdoor catering like festivals, carnivals and barbeques. We also cater for events and parties. Jam Rack Jerk is a family who love to cook delicious meals but hate to keep it all to themselves.

We hold true to the authentic taste of the ‘jerk’ flavours ‘straight outa Jamaica’.

name: The Block
desc: We're George and George, a duo of friends turned business partners, stemming from our school days. With a combined experience of 15 years in the hospitality industry, our passion for street food has inspired us to embark on a new venture. We've opened a quaint yet vibrant spot dedicated to serving up delectable sandwiches and mouthwatering loaded fries.

name: Canoodle
desc:
One of the original innovators of the street food scene in the UK right back in the early 90s, the brilliant Canoodle serve up a wonderful mix of Asian food that's as delicious as it is eclectic.

They were founded by the amazingly talented Chris Wiggin, who's literally spent decades perfecting his Thai, Vietnamese, Malaysian, Korean and Cambodian recipes, which he's keen to stress are so much mor…

name: Greenbox Food Co
desc:
We've set out to make the next century as delicious and sustainable as possible.
The British food scene creates huge amounts of climate emissions, pollution and bad-practice mass animal agriculture.

The surge in plant-based cuisine has typically been fast-food oriented and not aimed at optimal balanced diets.
​
We provide the gold-standard of plant-based catering for organisations, businesses & p…

name: Northern Slice
tagline: We Do One Thing and Do it Well
desc:
We are Northern Slice, a community-oriented pop-up pizza shop dedicated to spreading good vibes and engaging with our customers. Our top priority is crafting delicious, ultra-fresh pizzas right before your eyes.

At the heart of our pizza-making philosophy is simplicity.

name: Kolamba
desc:
At Kolamba, we’re not just serving food, we’re serving a journey!

Our story began with a simple idea - take the deep, soulful flavours we grew up with and combine them with the creativity of modern fusion cooking.

name: FUPBURGER
desc:
Tom Shiers is the owner of a cult internet phenomenon called The Fry Up Police, who has a mad obsession with top quality food, with his favourite being the perfect burger.

The obsession obviously starts and ends with the great British fry up, something that they believe they have extra-special skills in providing, but they can also serve super decadent and oozy burgers that always go down serious…

name: Shaws Iberian Ltd
desc:
Founded in 2019 by Monty and William, two friends passionate about good food and wine, Shaws Iberian import our own wines and foods direct from Spain and present it in a convivial lively atmosphere at our Wine and Tapas Bar.
We cater for events of all sizes from small family celebrations and weddings through corporate events and hospitality to large public events such as the Badminton Horse Trials…

name: Sauls
desc:
Sauls of Spratton Ltd is a family run business that was first established in 1926.  Today our business comprises of a traditional butcher shop, a food production facility where we produce all our own produce and 8 outdoor food and drink outlets.  
We have two airstream food trucks, one specialises in traditional hog roast and brisket, the other beautiful steak and fries.

name: Coal & Curry
desc: Coal & Curry is a one-of-a-kind BBQ and Curry catering company, founded in 2023 from a deep love for cooking, entertaining, and creating meaningful experiences.

name: The Argentine Barbecue Company
desc:
The Argentine Barbecue Company can bring the taste and theatre of an authentic Argentine ‘asado’ to your event!

Whether you’d like a whole lamb, a rack of ribs or some succulent Argentine steak, Andrew and his team have menus to satisfy any barbecue aficionado. Their passion for food means they’re always on hand to discuss all of your menu ideas and create a truly bespoke and special experience.

name: Fish & Frites
desc: Fish & Frites are a mobile fish and chip van that is proud to serve local fresh produce from the East Neuk of Fife. They aim to provide a fresh, quick and friendly service.

name: Freshly Made Doughnuts
desc:
All our doughnuts are cooked fresh to order and come with a selection of different sugars ranging from traditional sugar along with cinnamon, chocolate and renowned strawberry sugar!

With over 25 years experience at large festivals, county shows and local events we are a super friendly team who can deal with large volumes of people at a fast pace which is important at any large event.

We also se…

name: The Land Doughver
desc: The Land Doughver are a mobile, wood-fired pizza company that pride themselves on being able to bring fun to every event that they do.

name: Mulberry Catering Co
desc: Mulberry Catering Co is a fresh new catering company dishing-up food bursting with flavour and service dripping with charisma. Our ethos is simple. No really, that’s it, it’s ‘simple’. Our menus combine crowd-pleasing classics, sharp presentation and straightforward pricing.

name: Our Roti Island
desc: Our menu is a Caribbean based cuisine with a twist, fusing small elements of different cuisine from across the world within our menu. All the meat and chicken that we source for our dishes, are all Halal based. We take great pride improving upon your favorite Caribbean dishes in new and creative ways.

name: Tibetan Memories
desc: Tibetan Memories, a mobile catering family, is continuing to expand their Street Food presence after a successful 2024 trading at mainly conscious, sober events. Shangchub Drolma (Elissa), Namdi’s wife, does the back of house administration while Kunsang Drolma and Kalsang Norlha play happily at her feet with mother and daughter Welsh rescue cats Nancy and Petunia. A true family business.

name: Birria Bella
desc:
We are Birria Bella, A converted orange 1973 Peugeot J7 serving a Birria based menu.

We serve Birria Tacos, Nachos, Burritos and Fries. The meat is locally sourced and braised for a number of hours in our own secret broth, the nachos hand cut and freshly fried and the chips are hand cut and twice cooked by ourselves.

name: Lovely Paella
desc:
We are a Spanish Street Food Catering company, we have been up and running for twelve years now and we love it!
We specialize in Paellas although we cook any kind of Spanish dishes for Weddings and private functions.
We pride ourselves in using locally sourced products and normally provide a wide range of options for the customers; our chicken is Halal, the Paellas are gluten free, nut free and da…

name: Phat Khao
desc:
Phat khao is a business born in covid 2020. 
Using my skills as a trained chef and my Thai heritage combined to produce Authentic Thai street food with a modern twist. 
As a child i worked music festivals on my mother's Thai food trailer which inspired me to become a chef. Later when covid struck i started my own journey in the street food world.

name: blidanos mexican food
desc: We use the freshest ingredients to bring traditional Mexican recipes like burritos, tacos, and quesadillas to life, so whatever the event you're planning we have both the proven track record and ingredients to make sure your guests can enjoy the authentic taste of Mexican street food.

name: The 3 Little Pigs Souvlaki
desc:
The 3 Little pigs souvlaki is a 1977 VW that has been converted into a Greek Grill on the go. Their concept is all about tradition and quality for their customers.

They run a charcoal BBQ, where they cook their delicious handmade pork, chicken and feta cheese vegetarian souvlakia. Absolutely everything they serve is handmade, even the pita bread!

name: La Roulotte by Magica
desc: La Roulotte is a small independent company founded by French Chef Guillaume Gillan and French maître d’hotel Jean-Charles Carry.

name: Cleopatra's Kitchen
desc:
Cleopatra’s Kitchen uses flavours from their Egyptian heritage to bring delicious shawarma, kebabs and falafel back to Birmingham!

Adib grew up eating shawarma and was inspired by a close friend to turn this into a business. He’s now regularly serving at Aston Villa and Digbeth Dining Club, specialising in lamb and chicken shawarma with falafels as an option for vegans.

name: Moskito Spanish Bites
desc:
Moskito Spanish Bites serve up utterly delicious traditional Spanish Tapas from a gorgeous vintage horse box trailer.

They buy their ingredients from local suppliers and certain products come directly from Spain and the menu includes some seriously delicious things including their calamari, breaded and served with a homemade green lime mayonnaise - we couldn't recommend it any more.

Aside from t…

name: The Hog Co
desc:
Great British, Red Tractor Pork, serving to the 10s of 000’s a year.  In rolls, Crackling, Stuffing & Apple Sauce, with the option of our Garlic & Herb Roast Potatoes. 

We have multiple outlets available depending on your size of event we have our Large Purpose built event trailer, Our Classic Vintage Citroen HY Van and we have 2 Large Gazebos, and our Small Gazebo.

name: Ginger Wings
desc: We are 32 Time award winning Ginger Wings. Grown from in a bar in Marlow, to our own bricks and motor in 2025 and business has been unbelievable since.

name: Honest Supper Club
desc:
Honest Supper Club specialise in South Asian and Middle Eastern cuisine. To make it easier for you, we have a range of menus to choose from on our website: www.honestsupperclub.co.uk

We have a 5* facebook /google and hygiene rating and pride ourselves on quality. From  small private parties to large weddings with table service, we've got you covered.

name: Yum & Bass
desc: Yum & Bass Street Food has a simple concept and that is to elevate salads to a whole new level; leaving mind, stomach and soul satisfied. They provide simple yet delicious, energy-rich meals, high in flavour and nutrition.

name: Bask Street Boys
desc:
Bringing the flavours of the streets of Basque Country to the UK. 

We are the first and aonly Basque food trader in the UK, we started by selling only taloas in small street food market in London back in 2024 to big festivals and concerts, like Leeds Festivals and Ozzy Osbourne's last goncerts in Birmigham.

name: Hippy Happy Hoppers
desc: Hippy Happy Hoppers is a unique street food stall situated in the beautiful beachside town of Croyde, providing  yummy healthy food for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

name: Scottabocca
desc:
With a name that translates to 'Burnt Mouth', we're not just serving made-to-order pizzas; we're delivering an experience that's so fresh from the oven that you'll be tempted to eat them before they've even had a chance to cool down.

Based in Liverpool's Sefton Park, our upcycled Peugeot J7 isn't just a vehicle - it embodies the same craftsmanship and passion we pour into our food.

name: Kalai London
tagline: We have a can do attitude!
desc: My name is Chris, and I am the founder and owner of Kalai London. I have been in the catering business for over 7 years, and I have a passion for creating delicious food and memorable events.

name: Bare Bones Pizza
desc: Established 2014 we serve 10″ Wood Fired Pizzas from our converted vans. We travel the UK serving our Neapolitan style pizzas. You can find us at street food venues, like the famous Digbeth Dining club, festivals like Camper Calling, concerts like Lionel Ritchie and Elton John and shows like RHS Malvern Spring Festival.

name: Bangwok Pad Thai
desc:
For the past ten years, Dong has been wok-ing up a storm at festivals, fueled by the same passion he started with: feeding people some seriously tasty Thai food. 

We're all about nailing just one thing - our famous Pad Thai. Customers keep coming back, proclaiming it's the best they've ever had. Our secret? Slow-fried onion and garlic goodness, plus lashings of tamarind.

name: Nice n cheesy
desc:
Artisan grilled cheese served in a vintage van. Available for event hire, weddings, and more, providing a bespoke offering whatever the function.

Jo and Paul have long been caravan enthusiasts, dragging their daughters on many a caravan holiday across the UK. With the hope of following their grilled cheese sandwich dream, they spent 2 years lovingly restoring their vintage 70’s Bluebird caravan.

name: Chi-town Dogs
desc:
Chi-town Dogs are bringing the hungry mouths of London a taste of the iconic Chicago-style food that owner Anthony Clifton grew up with, with the focus being on the much-loved American-style hot dog!

Keeping it simple, these guys offer their delicious Chicago-style Hot Dogs as well as Chilli Dogs, which are served straight from their blue food truck.

name: Rossis ices
desc:
Welcome to Rossis Ices

Rossi's Ices is a Yorkshire based family run Ice Cream Van Hire company who have been retailing Ice Cream to local events, communities and shows throughout the North of England. 
We have been established for over 25 years, therefore have a wealth of knowledge and experience at a huge variety of events.

name: Big Apple Hot Dogs
desc:
Bringing the authentic taste of the streets of New York City to your event! Big Apple cook up outrageously delicious dogs using only high quality, local ingredients and proper meat, with absolutely no gluten or bulking agents - you’ll get none of the nasty bits you might find in other sausages.

They use free-range pork, prime beef, and their pillowy buns come fresh from a local family bakery.

name: Dirty Apron
desc: Dirty Apron is female lead, London based catering company, specialising in stylish casual dining and quality street food.  We cater large and small events alike, and are always happy to create bespoke menus to suit your event perfectly. We make food with care and creativity with great tasting offerings designed with your needs in mind.

name: Gourmet Street Kitchen
desc: We are Gourmet Street Kitchen, based in the South West. We have two festival setups, one of which specialises in serving up gourmet mac & cheese, gourmet hotdogs and loaded fries (believe us when we say that these aren’t your average mac, dogs and fries!) and the other specialising in serving up Cornflake Fried, Buttermilk Chicken.

name: Sauce and Sips
desc: Sauce & Sips is a fresh, independent food business bringing together bold Indian and Jamaican-inspired flavours with the comfort of proper street food. Our menu is all about big flavour, generous portions and sauces that make every bite memorable.

name: DSC Event Catering
desc:
We are a family run business who has been suppling food at uk events for over 30 years.

Our Lighthouse Fish & Chip unit has become famous in itself at a lot of major UK Events as a focal point and a meeting point for the public.
Our Fish is cooked fresh on site using MSC cod and freshly battered cooked until golden brown and served the traditional way with steak cut chips and a slice of lemon.

O…

name: Sweeney's Pizzeria
desc:
Sweeney’s Pizzeria serves real, awesome Neapolitan Wood Fired Pizza using fresh dough, made daily by us.  We source the very best ingredients from Italy and locally to Suffolk, which we skillfully and passionately use to create our delicious pizzas.

Here at Sweeney's Pizzeria we love everything Pizza.

name: Edelwurst Catering
desc:
