We are an established event catering business based in the Northeast Scotland. 
We have two Airstream food units from which we provide German Street Food and Crispy Aromatic Duck options. 
We currently offer two distinct menu options:
         Unit 1 - German Street Food – Choices of Bratwurst sausages served in a bread sub roll.

name: Jump To The Beet
desc:
Taking only the finest ingredients, Jump To The Beet make awesome Mexican inspired street food. Everything on the menu is 100% plant-powered, made from scratch, fresh, colourful and full of vibrant flavours.

Strutting their stuff from their handcrafted market stall, these guys pack a punch with their tantalising tacos and jumping playlist of funk, soul and 80s music on rotation.

name: Jimmy's Burgers
desc:
Jimmy’s is a London-based burger  brand serving bold, crowd-pleasing food for private events, corporate parties, festivals, pop-ups, screenings and celebrations.

Our menu is built around juicy burgers, hot dogs, wings and chicken and fries with a simple, fast-service setup designed to keep queues moving and guests happy.

name: Piña Al Carbon
desc:
Piña Al Carbon, or Piña "Over Coal" was born as an offshoot from Piña in Sheffield, UK. 

Piña sits as one of the top taqueria and tequila bars in the country, based in the heart of Neepsend, serving award-winning tacos alongside a range of authentic antojitos (translating to 'little bites). An ever-changing menu of seasonal flavours, providing a great catalyst for a social environment.

name: One Love Kitchen
desc: One Love Kitchen is a Caribbean Restaurant like no other. We are a family-owned business and pride ourselves on offering authentic Caribbean food - excellence is at the heart of what we do.

name: I Love Toasties
desc:
Everybody loves a good Cheese Toasties!! We believe this to be true so we set out with a simple ethos, to serve delicious Toasties using the finest quality ingredients. Our menu caters for simple pallets and those that like to be a bit more adventurous! 

We are a small family run team.

name: Nortons BBQ Kitchen
tagline: BBQ & Low n Slow Smoked Meats
desc:
Introducing Nortons Kitchen, where craft meets catering in the world of entertainment and events. We are your one-stop destination for a flavorful journey that enriches every moment, from film and TV production sets to the lively atmosphere of events and festivals.

At Nortons Kitchen, we pride ourselves on three pillars of excellence:

Craft Services for Film and TV Production: Our dedicated team…

name: FRICO
desc:
Frico is our new street food concept, born from the experience of Roma Eat and designed to bring something truly original to Cardiff .
We specialize in Detroit-Style pizza in a 7" format , 9" classics pizzas.

name: The Hungry Cowboy LTD
desc:
The Hungry Cowboy is not your traditional smoked meat company, smoking the meat is only the beginning.

We take high quality, slow-smoked meats and transform them into bold, cowboy-inspired dishes packed with flavour, colour and character.

Our menu ranges from award-winning nachos and burgers to Texas dirty fries, loaded mac ’n’ cheese and smoked-meat rolls.

name: J & I catering
desc: J & I Catering is a family-run catering business built on a love of great food, good coffee, and creating relaxed, feel-good experiences wherever we set up. What started as a shared passion for quality street food and vibrant festival culture has grown into a business that puts flavour, freshness, and people first.

name: Get Plucked
desc:
"We dream of a world where chickens can cross the road without having their motives questioned."

That’s why we only use free-range chicken and the freshest, finest ingredients; all expertly prepared to make every bite plucking delicious.

Can’t decide on grilled or fried?

name: Ray Mekhi’s Oxford
desc: At Ray Mekhi’s Oxford, we serve up mouth-watering smash burgers and loaded fries made fresh with high-quality ingredients. Every burger is smashed to perfection on the grill - juicy, flavorful, and made to order - while our fries come fully loaded with bold toppings and sauces you won’t forget.

name: The Wood Shed
desc: The Wood Shed is a beautifully restored and converted vintage trailer which would fit perfectly at any wedding venue or party or corporate event.

name: What The Fish
desc:
What the Fish (WTF) is renowned for our simply delicious, traditional, home-style cooked fish.

Our current food is the accumulation of many years of work across a variety of formats.

name: Yorkshire Hot Dog Co.
desc: The Yorkshire hot dog company is a family-run outdoor catering street food stall specialising in delicious gourmet hot dogs. Emma and Jonathan have been donning a flat cap and sizzling their amazing hot dog sausages at events and festivals up and down the country since 2012.

name: For Fish Sake
desc:
Unique fish and chips, fish burgers and fish fingers. Unique as per the spices we add to the batter and making it Halal, which most places don't.

As a couple we started this business, but from different countries but have had English people tell us it's the best fish and chips they have ever tried.

We have had a shop in the new establishment in Camden Market called Hawley Wharf, but due to the b…

name: Brasa Street Food
desc: Brasa Brazilian Street Food brings the bold flavours of Brazilian barbecue to events across the North East.

name: Thin & Crispy - Artisan Turkish Pizza
desc:
Experience a new level of freshness, innovation, and uniqueness at Thin & Crispy. We take pride in providing you with the ultimate indulgence in the form of our Fresh, Crispy, and Hot Turkish pizzas, known as Lahmacun, expertly wrapped with our signature salads and sauces.

But that's not all - our offerings go beyond pizzas.

name: Cluckin‘ Taiwan Fried Chicken
desc:
1.
We operate both physical restaurants and a mobile business, including trailers and gazebos. Our restaurants specialize in authentic Chinese cuisine, particularly Cantonese and Sichuan dishes, with many branches across London.

name: Street Greek Camden
tagline: When We Say Fresh, We Mean It!
desc: Street Greek recipes derived from secret scrolls, protected for generations by the Gods of Olympus and kept in the safety of Gardenopolis. The scrolls were stolen from Zeus, by Hades in a resentful rage of the culinary dystopia that he had to endure in the Underworld.

name: For Mice & Men
desc:
For Mice & Men was a far-fetched idea hatched in 2014 by a wily Brit (Vic) & her  counter-part/balance Tim (USA). Thanks to a mixture of luck & love, we're happy to say we're still at it & still enjoying this little passion project of ours 8+ years on.

Our specialty is the humble grilled cheese sandwich made with local Cheddar cheese, organic sourdough & handmade butter.

name: The Cheese Wheel
desc: The Cheese Wheel specialises in crafting fresh, high-quality fettuccine pasta daily. What sets us apart is the interactive and captivating experience we offer our customers: the process of creating pasta is done entirely in front of them, beginning with cooking the pasta in our homemade sauces and culminating in a unique preparation using a giant Parmesan cheese wheel.

name: The Safari Pizza Co
desc:
The Safari Pizza Co are a mobile wood-fired pizza supplier available for events of all shapes and sizes.

They have a pizza oven fitted into their converted Land Rover and use it to supply classic pizza combinations as well as their unique mix of African and Safari theme pizza ideas which include ostrich, biltong, peri-peri chicken and chakalaka sauce.

Turning up with the funky branding on their …

name: Street Food South West
desc: Street Food South West was created in 2015 by two very experienced chefs to go out on there own and deliver gourmet street food and excellent service to festivals and private catering. we have developed a unique style of quality and service as we have gone from strength to strength diversifying through the pandemic to come out stronger on the other side.

name: Curry Squad
desc: Curry Squad are a nationally acclaimed, multi-award winning, artisan Indian Street Food catering company based just outside of London.

name: Fine Street Events
desc:
We have traded in the events and catering industry for over 25 years we have built up an extensive list of award-winning street food traders who we can now call on to help create an event like no other.

If you are looking for street food traders for Markets, Festivals, Weddings or even a BBQ at home we can provide them.

name: FlipnFast
desc: We flip crepes for everyone! With a range of sweet & savoury options, all of our crepes are vegan and gluten free. We also carefully cater for other dietary requirements. Not only are our crepes safe for those with dietary requirements, they are also delicious! Our look stands out too, our pod and gazebo are colourful, eyecatching and professional looking.

name: Halloumi Bite
tagline: Everyone Likes a Bit of Greek
desc:
A purpose fitted, vintage style food truck, serving authentic Greek food to local communities, businesses, and local food markets around South West Surrey. Available for private hire and events. 

Who is behind Halloumi Bite and the idea!

Dimitri Sarris is Greek Cypriot born, now a proud family man living in leafy Surrey.

name: BBQ Dreamz
desc: BBQ Dreamz is a Filipino inspired street food company, serving dishes ranging from crispy fragrant pork belly to grilled aubergine satay curry.

name: The Filled Churros
desc:
We are a family business, registered in 2024, located in East Grinstead, West Sussex, but Rodrigo has been in the street food market since 2012, with extensive experience at Greenwich Market London.
We have the necessary certificates and licenses to work at events.

name: The Calzone Kitchen
desc: The Calzone Kitchen specialise in deliciously oozy artisan folded pizzas and you'll be wandering why all pizzas aren't served like this when you've had your first taste!

name: Holy Macaroni!
desc: Holy Macaroni! is brought to you by renowned street food caterers, Vudu Food. They began in 2014 and have been slowly increasing their repertoire ever since. They are very conscious to be sustainable and cater for as many dietary requirements as they possibly can. Holy Macaroni by Vudu Food is phenomenal: it's rich, creamy, and insanely cheesy. And what's more...

name: Event Eateries
desc: We are a family-run business with a deep passion for exceptional food, and above all, an unwavering commitment to quality. Our ethos is rooted in delivering the finest culinary experiences by sourcing and preparing premium ingredients with care and pride.

name: Bark 'n' Render
desc:
Bark ‘n’ Render was set up with a vision of creating a unique offering that filled a gap in the market with high quality, informal catering. 12-hour, oak smoked brisket was our most popular offering and something that was new to the wedding food world (and very welcomed!).

This soon developed into offering formal sit-down menus alongside our informal options.

name: Turo Turo
desc: 'Turo Turo' was established in August, 2018. It was founded by Rex De Guzman, a chef and aspiring entrepreneur. It has been his mission to popularise Filipino cuisine in the UK since 2014 and has done this by running numerous successful popup restaurants and catering for events serving high quality, modern Filipino food.

name: Hakko House
desc: Hakko House is a family-run Japanese street food company born from making sushi at home during lockdown.

name: Piggie Smalls food co.
desc:
our gold airstream is beautifully presented both especially at night
our food is all made by our award winning chef, simon
we have traded at some of the largest and most prestigious festivals in the uk
we source responsibly, have amazing smiley staff who know what's expected and are well presented
we open early and close when there is no-one left to serve
most dietary groups are catered for includ…

name: 3Bros Burgers
desc: Founded in 2020, 3Bros began with three friends in their early twenties who shared a passion for great food and business. The concept took shape at Honeybee Café in Woodingdean, Brighton, with one clear goal: to build the ultimate burger using the best local ingredients.

name: Planet Doughnut
desc: Here at Planet Doughnut, we bake heavenly handcrafted doughnuts that are a little different and simply out-of-this-world.

name: Firenze Pizza
desc:
We are a father / daughter Horsebox Pizza company. We specialise in Neapolitan style pizza. We will take care of your event from start to finish and are happy to bespoke a menu for you.
We pride ourselves in using the best authentic Italian ingredients we can get hold of.

name: Yum Dogs
desc:
Yum Dogs was established in 2020 after Steve had the genius idea of combining his two favourite things, a delicious fresh yum yum doughnut with soft serve ice cream! After many years of working in Michelin starred kitchens as a pastry chef, a pop up dessert bar was the perfect addition to the Hodge and Huggett brand.
Yum Dogs are the ultimate sweet treat with many flavour combinations...

name: Hector & Harriet
desc:
Hector & Harriet were established in 2015, an independent family run business who have built their principles on serving up exceptional quality food and drinks that create a long-lasting impression and memorable customer experience.

Hector & Harriet want their clientele to recognise their dedication to providing premium quality and tremendous levels of service from their highly skilled, passionat…

name: You Me Sushi
desc: Established in 2008 YouMeSushi is the perfect place to experience Japanese cuisine in London - We are passionate about Japanese food and we believe in eating well. Our aim is to prepare high-quality sushi, katsu curry, rice bowls, noodles, and other Japanese favourites using only the finest ingredients.

name: Lulabelles Ice Cream
desc:
Add a touch of unforgettable vintage charm and award-winning luxury ice cream to your next event.
At Lulabelles Ice Cream, guests love choosing from our extensive range of flavours and watching their ice creams being individually hand crafted with luxury toppings and sauces to tantalise their taste buds.

We bring a picture-perfect dessert experience straight to your venue.

name: MANS MARKET
desc: Mans Market is an accessible, new age, hip Chinese restaurant/ bar concept, developed in Leeds but inspired from Hong Kong.  Our restaurant was born in 2016, in 2021 came the Mans Market Food Truck.

name: Rolly's Ice Cream
desc: Rolly’s Ice Cream is Scotland’s premier, hand crafted ice cream roll company. Established in 2017 and inspired from South-East Asia, this simple concept utilises an ice pan to crystallise ice cream 'rolls' right in front of your eyes. It brings a whole new level of enjoyment to ice cream.

name: Wild Dough Mobile Pizzeria
desc: Wild Dough is a small family-run mobile wood-fired pizza catering business providing incredible pizzas to parties and events across Cambridgeshire.  We bring the sights, sounds, and aromas of our authentic mobile wood-burning pizza oven to your private event or community gathering.

name: Parmogeddon
desc:
What is a Parmo?! For anyone living outside of Middlesbrough this may be what you’re thinking and that’s where Parmogeddon come in!

Parmogeddon are determined to show the rest of the country how heavenly a parmo is. Fried chicken covered in a rich, creamy béchamel and then topped with a serious helping of melted, gooey cheese, creates a match made in heaven!

name: Zucca Brazilian deli
desc:
Zucca was founded by Edilso Schwab and Wagner Fogaca. We sell one of the most popular street food or snack in Brazil, it is called COXINHA. 
Traditionally, coxinha is made of a savoury choux dough stuffed with chicken, panned and deep-fried. 
Nowadays, we have more than 10 different flavours including beef brisket, jackfruit, heart of palm and much more.

name: Kitchen Garden Pizza Company
desc: Our pizzas come fresh from the Kitchen Garden, where we bring the finest seasonal ingredients to our wood-fired pizzas.

name: Lo & Slo
desc: We are Lo & Slo, an award-winning street food and live-fire business based in Derry, Northern Ireland. Founded in 2018, our work is rooted in a simple idea: good food starts with good ingredients and time well spent. Our style is influenced by American barbecue, brought to life using the best of Irish produce.

name: THE GREAT PIE SHOP LTD T/A BARNABY SYKES PIE MAKER
desc:
What we do
We are passionate makers of delicious hand-made pies using locally sourced ingredients, served with generous portions of creamy mash or lush chunky chips, proper gravy and mushy peas.

name: Frida's Food Box
desc:
Frida’s Food Box serve an incredibly tasty Mexican inspired menu that’s completely vegan! 

From their converted 1960’s rice horsebox, husband and wife team Frida’s Food Box, serve a vegan menu inspired by the flavours of Mexico. Menu items include vegan chilli that can be served in a wrap or on top of tortilla chips, as well as a spicy bean stew and even vegan chorizo.

name: Yiro
desc:
The fantastic Yiro serve up award-winning utterly delicious hugely filling Greek Souvlaki wraps with an Asian twist.

Head chef Billy comes from a Greek family, but utterly obsessive love of Asian cuisine has led to him embracing his roots and passion in his amazing food.

name: Catering Uno
desc: We are a family run business operating since 2005. We have previously had catering contracts with Black Park and Gunnersbury Park cafes. Our current focus is mobile ice cream units and attending concerts, sport events and council events.

name: The Toasty Badger
desc:
The Toasty Badger was started in 2018 by Kim Gourd. Kim’s aim is to create 'a toastie like no other' by using the best ingredients all sourced solely from the UK. Our award-winning sourdough bread has zero additives and preservatives and is guaranteed to fill you up!

You can choose from three different wheels of cheese, Devon Cheddar, Shropshire Blue and Cornish Brie.

name: Asha's Events
desc: Asha’s Events is the celebration of culinary excellence and unforgettable experiences. Our dedication to quality and innovation has earned us numerous accolades and a reputation as one of the premier dining destinations.

name: Coqfighter
desc:
Born out of frustration at the lack of high quality fried chicken options in London, Coqfighter began as a night for friends at Troy, Tristan and Deacon’s apartment in South London.

Having spent the beginning of the decade living in Melbourne, they’d enjoyed many hot summer nights eating plates of Korean fried chicken, served with ice cold beers in the city’s bustling Chinatown district.

Nights …

name: Nagomi Japanese Food
desc:
We are trading Japanese healthy food . We are different to others. When we going to festivals we are hi lights. And also we deliver good customer service and great tasty food. 
About our history we work Japanese restaurants nearly 20 years after pandemic we lost our job. And we decided to start our food trailer. We are currently work with shubman gill and did the Pinner funfair.

name: Funky Elephant
desc:
From A-List Celebrity Parties to Backstage at Reading Festival and Weddings to Music Videos. Funky Elephant are becoming one of the most exciting Street Food companies in the UK.

We supply fresh, premium-tasting Caribbean Fusion at a quick pace.

name: Pepper Group Limited
desc: Rollin Dogs is a street food concept built on a simple idea: take a classic favourite and do it properly. Born from a love of bold flavours and honest comfort food, we set out to elevate the humble hot dog into something memorable. What started as a passion project quickly grew into a mobile food experience focused on quality, consistency, and good vibes.

name: Sommi Pizza
desc:
After my mother sadly passed away nearly two years ago, the eldest of seven Sommi children, born to Anglo-Italian parents, Alfonso and Winnifred  Sommi, I decided to fulfil one of my passions, as well as celebrate her life.

Last year I bought a van, got it converted and re-trained as a pizza chef.

name: Noodles
desc: Noodles is all about bringing together the very best of the plethora of comforting Asian flavours, from the far-east to the south! From our wok tossed noodles to our crumb coated sweet and sour chicken, every dish is lovingly crafted using the best ingredients and techniques to offer our customers the very best experience.

name: Hanoi Kitchen
desc:
Having scoured the streets of Hanoi and tasted every dish along the way, we persuaded our favourite traders to teach us the best Vietnamese street eats so that we could bring them home to you in the UK.

Our recipes strike the perfect balance between hot, spicy, fresh and fragrant and are garnished generously with lime, garlic, ginger and chilli.

name: Carbon
desc:
Carbon is an eclectic charcoal grill restaurant in the heart of London's Soho and Covent Garden and they are now available for events!

Their menu is a combination of delicious grilled meat, chicken, fish and vegetables from selected countries freshly cooked over a wood charcoal grill with traditional garnishes.

name: Auld Hag
desc:
Our passion stems from a love for Scottish scran.  "Scran" is food - the kind that makes you feel really good and gives you a proper feed.

I'm Gregg and I'm from Glasgow.  I set this up with my partner, Maddi.  The whole ethos behind the business is about showcasing some of Scotland's greatest produce - haggis, beef, langoustines, raspberries, cheese and beer to name a few things.

name: Kabala Kitchen
desc: Kabala Kitchen is a Bristol-based catering company that specialises in serving up plant-based versions of comfort food classics.

name: Afghan Caravan
desc: Afghan Caravan is a family-owned food business with a ‘street food meets gourmet fusion’ approach, founded by a mother–daughter duo to bring Afghan cuisine to wider communities and reshape how it is experienced. Through bold, Silk Road–inspired dishes, we preserve our culinary traditions while inviting people to connect with the warmth and richness of Afghan culture.

name: Do It. Greek
desc:
At Do It. Greek, we’re passionate about bringing the authentic flavours of Greece & Cyprus direct from our pop up food stand. From our perfectly grilled souvlaki to our homemade feta dip, every dish we serve is crafted with fresh ingredients with the aim of feeling full with healthy food.

Founded by Thasos and Erin, the idea sparked while planning their own wedding.

name: Papa's Goodies
desc:
Hi there,

We are Papas Goodies, a catering  business that provide fantastic fresh food.

We currently able to provide; Falafels, waffles, pancakes, coffee and alcoholic beverages. 

There is no event too big nor too small for us! We are completely mobile as we serve out of a trailer and can be positioned anywhere for your events.

name: Crêpes à la carte
desc: Eva and Thomas are originally from Brittany, France, where galettes (savoury buckwheat crêpes) and crêpes are a true staple of everyday life.

name: Fikre Kitchen
desc: Family-run Fikre Kitchen celebrates and shares our Ethiopian cultural heritage through our rich, traditional cuisine.

name: Rick’s
desc:
Rick’s offer a variety of North African and Mediterranean food, all made from scratch by their talented team and served from their awesome wooden set-up.

They serve delicious salads as well as wraps, burgers and tagine. Their signature burger is not to be missed, served with an aubergine jam beef patty served with applewood cheese and pickles.

name: KATIES CORNISH HOT POTS LTD.
desc: We like to think of ourselves as committed foodies as opposed to just  being in the business of selling food. It is very important  to love the dishes you create tweaking and refining them for optimum flavor.

name: Riceminster Paellas
desc: Riceminster specialise in Valencian and other genuine Paellas as the team are from the Valencia region in Spain which is, in fact, the birthplace of paella!

name: Fiery Celt
desc:
Fiery Celt showcases seasonal ingredients and dishes that combine traditional cooking methods curing and smoking with British and Celtic ingredients from Scotland, Ireland, Wales and Cornwall with a modern twist. 

Their dishes are not only tasty but they use the best ingredients that this country has to offer and their menu changes seasonally so that they are always using produce when it's at its…

name: Guid Grazin
desc:
Our owner Jack, a Michelin trained Chef, brings his background in fine dining to bring a premium street food offering to your event. We're not re-inventing the wheel, we just use quality fresh ingredients along with a bit of love and passion to create some really delicious food.
Served from our beautiful shiny custom made Red Airstream trailer, we will look the part at any event.

name: Little Jamaica Caribbean Kitchen
desc: Little Jamaica brings the vibrant flavour's of the Caribbean straight to your table. We specialize in authentic, home-style dishes inspired by traditional island recipes, prepared with love and the freshest ingredients.

name: Smoky Gaucho on Wheels
desc: The brilliant Smoky Gaucho cook up delicious low and slow food, inspired by their homeland of Southern Brazil and 'Gaucho flavours', a traditional term for South American cowboys.

name: RAD BURGER
desc:
Since 2014, Rad Burger has been blowing people away with their phenomenally beautiful and lip-smackingly good burgers!

Ben and his team painstakingly search for the very, very best ingredients, whether it’s their free-range meat supplier or their homemade sauces, and every detail of what they do is always absolutely spot on.

name: Peru Sabor
desc:
My name is Harry Goicochea, a Chef who is passionate about introducing the flavours and traditional cuisine of my native country Peru to the UK. 
We started up Peru Sabor earlier in 2013

A bit about us and what we do

We sell Peruvian street food, specifically Anticuchos, with authentic Peruvian chilli sauces.

name: Cafe Mundo
desc:
Cafe Mundo delivers bold, vibrant smoothies built for festival life. Bult on over a decade of major event experience, we know how to serve fast, keep queues moving and maintain serious quality under pressure.

Our made-to-order smoothies are packed with traceable Grade A fruit and veg, 100% vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free. A refreshing, feel-good hit that cuts through long days and late nights.

name: Taco Picante
desc:
We keep things simple with good tacos, made well. Whether it’s a wedding, birthday or a corporate event, we’ll help you build a menu that suits the occasion, all served from our vintage airstream!
Think meltingly tender cochinita pibil, birria that means business, and handmade salsas that know how to throw a punch.

name: What a Melt
desc:
What A Melt distinguishes itself by specializing in grilled cheese sandwiches with homemade dipping sauces. Our menu focuses on perfecting this classic comfort food, offering a unique and memorable experience for festival attendees.
As a female-owned street food business, What A Melt brings diversity and empowerment to any event.

name: Fire & Smoke Catering
desc:
Fire & Smoke Catering is a professional catering service that specializes in hog and lamb roast, wood-fired pizza, mobile bar, and BBQ services. We pride ourselves on using the freshest ingredients and the best equipment to deliver high-quality food to our clients.
Our hog and lamb roast is a popular choice for those looking to host a rustic, outdoor event.

name: Streat Latin food
desc:
We are a Venezuelan pop up kitchen with a Mexican twist, taking pride in serving healthy, Halal, GLUTEN FREE tasty flavours.
We offer Venezuelan dishes such as Gluten free Arepas,  Tequeños( cheesy sticks), empanadas, rice bowls with black beans, guacamole, rice, red cabbage fried plantain and salsa, Tacos, Churros, tres leches cake.

Streat Latin Arepas focus on making all food healthy and fresh,…

name: Alla Greek
desc:
We are a Neo- Traditional Greek Street Food vendor who specialise in blending a sense of tradition with modern creativity and cultural pride. 
We offer a variety of vegan, vegetarian, gluten free and other dietary-friendly options. Our fresh meats, organic veggies, handmade sauces and of course the smell of chargrilled souvlaki will draw the crowd eager to indulge.

name: Namaskaram London
desc: Namaskaram London is a full-on celebration of South India’s boldest, most soulful cooking—think tangy tamarind, fiery gunpowder, ghee-soaked dosas, and deeply spiced curries, all rooted in the culinary traditions of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. We bring these regional flavors to life at events across London, from vibrant cultural festivals to intimate weddings and high-end corporate gatherings.

name: Wiltons Oyster Barrow
desc: Right back In 1742, George William Wilton started his business as a lone oysterman operating his barrow out of the London's Haymarket.

name: Naked Bowls
desc: Naked bowls offers breakfast lunch and dinner options, all of our bowls are naturally gluten and dairy free, are big on flavour and full of textures.

name: MyPie
tagline: Classic Pie & Mash With a Modern Twist
desc:
MYPIE have a passion to serve quality food. They give the classic pie and mash a modern twist. Each pie is lovingly handmade using British produce. MYPIE have won over 30 awards at the British Pie Awards since they started in 2014.

MYPIE serve British food that, when combined with the tastes of chef Chris Brumby’s Australian routes, has a uniquely Australian twist.

name: Leather & Willow Authentic Wood Fired Pizza
desc: We supply delicious authentic wood fired pizza for all occasions, whether its your big day, a milestone birthday or your just hosting a party everyone would be jealous of, we can help. We use nothing but the best Italian sourced ingredients from our San Marzano tomatoes all the way down to our fior di latte mozzarella. We have a strong passion for making pizzas the right way...

name: Fresh From Desh
desc:
Fresh From Desh serve delicious home-cooked Indian food that is always served with a smile. Based just outside of London, these guys are available for events of all shapes and sizes.

They serve unbelievably tasty chicken, lamb and paneer wraps as well as vegetable pakoras, vegetable samosas and their chilli chicken and rice, which is not to be missed!

name: Gaucho - Meat & Bun
tagline: Meat and Bun Burgers by Gaucho
desc:
Our stunning new airstream can be branded for events as any one of three brands - M, Gaucho or Meat and Bun by Gaucho - all with a unique menu offering

Meat and Bun offers a modern burger and sandwich menu, inspired by this narrative and the flavoursome ingredients that naturally go alongside it, brought to you by the same team behind Gaucho Restaurants.

name: Royal kebab catering
desc: *Royal Kebabs Catering Van* is a premier mobile catering service specializing in delicious kebabs, shawarma, burgers, and grilled delicacies, all served with a side of excellence. With over 20 years of experience in takeaway and food service, we are passionate about delivering fresh, flavorful meals with a royal touch.

name: The Grub Shed - Loaded Fries
desc: We’re a Hereford based business that prides itself on producing awesome Loaded Fries. Our potatoes are cooked in 100% rapeseed oil, dusted with a homemade seasoning and loaded with mouth watering toppings.

name: Panini Paradise
desc: Panini Paradise is a London-based grilled cheese and toastie pop-up created by Francesco, an Italian chef with nearly 20 years of experience in professional kitchens. After years of cooking in restaurants, the idea was simple: bring people together with comforting, high-quality food made from carefully chosen ingredients.

name: FABBRO - Ice Cream, DJ & Sound System
desc:
Soft Serve Ice Cream with the option of a DJ playing from the roof! Get your party started FABBRO style!

Our Japanese daihastu hijet minivan can fit in many small places such as gardens and courtyards and is the perfect addition to any party.

Our DJ plays tunes from the roof which is always fun if you need a party atmosphere! 

We can cater for small parties or large events.

name: The Lids Catering&CO
desc:
We are a Unique Homemade Pie and sides business , not only offering some of the most unique flavoursome pies you'll ever taste but we also have some of the most amazing dessert pie options as well as a breakfast pie option also.

Our unit is completely Unique from anything else out there being a bright green vintage Citroen van with all the bells and whistles , We can also tailor make pies to spec…

name: Sonny’s Homemade Pasta
desc: Hey! I'm jude, i take great pride in introducing you to Sonny’s Homemade Pasta. For years now I have been making my own pasta, and last year my wife and I went to Sicily for our honeymoon, along with our son, Sonny! Well, Sonny fell in love with pasta and I vowed I would learn to replicate the world class pasta the Sicilians were feeding us. I got home and I got to work.

name: Saltio Mexican
desc:
A little about us:
Saltio was founded in 2021 by myself and Tom after long and successful careers in the hospitality industry. We took on a rundown restaurant on Worthing seafront and transformed it into one of the South’s leading Mexican eateries — known for vibrant flavours, relaxed vibes, and a true passion for great food.

Now, we’re taking that same energy on the road.

name: ZHUG
desc: At Zhug, we're not just about food; we're about crafting unforgettable experiences. Our journey began with a deep passion for Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisine, and we've transformed that love into an exceptional catering service.

name: Bindas Eatery
desc:
Bindas Eatery are taking the capital by storm with their delicious Twisted Indian Eats. Bindas Eatery recently won the Westfield food entrepreneur competition and completed their first pop up residency there.

Mehak, the founder of Bindas Eatery, is a self-taught chef, her food is all fresh and is second to none. They make delicious burgers, rolls, rice boxes and more!

name: Browski Burger
desc:
The amazing Browski Burger serve up authentic American hand-pressed burgers from their beautiful vintage Peugeot van. The call it Dan Le Van and the design is based on a typical NY diner!

Each burger patty is handmade on a hot plate using traditional techniques to create a crust that locks in the juices and adds that extra element of texture and flavour.

name: Pizza & Dumplings
desc: Introducing Pizza & Dumplings, where the world of pizza and dumplings collide in a symphony of flavor and innovation. With a passion for culinary excellence, we craft each pizza and dumpling with the finest ingredients and utmost care, ensuring every bite is a delightful experience.

name: The Mac Shac
desc:
Gourmet Mac and Cheese Bakers; slingin' the best baked mac in Europe since 2014. 

The Ribble Event & Bar Co are regulars on the event circuit, with our street food stall ‘The Mac Shac’, attending music, food and drink festivals all over the UK. The Mac Shac is a baked macaroni cheese, (mac and cheese), pop up street food stall.

name: Good Karma Kitchen
desc:
My name is Janeeka and I have a small business called Good Karma Kitchen. 
We provide delicious plant based Indian street food and have recently renovated a brand new food truck over the past 7 months!

I developed a love for cooking from my Baa (gran) and when I went vegan at 15, she would effortlessly veganise her delicious recipes to cater for me.

name: Stroodles - Sustainable, Immersive Experiences
desc: At Stroodles, we believe that events should be more than just gatherings—they should be memorable, meaningful, and make a positive impact. Our mission is to present sustainability so it doesn't feel like a chore—it should taste, crunch, and stir like fun!

name: Three Cuts Burgers
desc: With over 15 years of hospitality experience husband and wife team, Eryn and Caroline, embarked on a journey to create the ultimate burger experience. Hence ‘Three Cuts Burger’ was born after deciding to close the doors to their restaurant in December 2022 and focus on the street food side of the business.

name: Chulo's Cookies
desc:
We are Chulo's Cookies. We make the UK's BEST Stuffed Cookies. We are founded and based in Scotland with shops in Glasgow and Edinburgh, but also pop up at events across the country, as well as having a strong online presence.

We offer Stuffed Cookies for events, pop ups and corporate in a few different looks. We can do a table set up, gazebo or even pre packaged depending on your needs.

name: Aamir's Pakistani Streetfood Kitchen
desc: I am a fully qualified chartered Architect with a huge passion for cooking. I am a British born Pakistani who loves to experiment in the kitchen. Everything I know in terms of cooking has come from hours shadowing my Ammi-Ji in the kitchen.

name: The Pig Apple
desc:
Like any great idea, the Pig Apple was devised in 2014 during a chat amongst friends over cold pint! 

Ben, who was the man with the idea, wanted to create a Hog Roast that wasn't just a butcher in a tent carving pork into floury baps! For him, presentation was just as important as the quality of the food. Several pints later and a decision on a catchy name, The Pig Apple was born!

name: McFlys Chicken
desc:
MOUTH WATERING LOADED WINGS, BUTTERMILK CHICKEN BURGERS AND ZESTY SLAWS… AN ABSOLUTE TASTE EXPLOSION.

McFly’s Chicken, a new and exciting chicken wing and burger concept offering an irresistible selection of saucy tenders,  loaded chicken wings, buttermilk burgers, fresh salads and zesty slaws

We pride ourselves on using locally sourced, fresh quality products to create sensational flavours.

name: Brinkleys Event Catering
desc: Brinkleys Event Catering is a dynamic, Oxfordshire-based company providing exceptional catering services across the UK. From vibrant festivals and historic heritage sites to large-scale shows and corporate events, we bring a professional, flexible approach tailored to each occasion.

name: Banh Mi and Son
desc:
Coming from the hospitality industry which include working in the kitchen of chef Alexis Gauthier I fancy a change. 

While visiting Broadway market It was there that I discovered the street food scene and tasted a delicious Banh Mi. I decided to do my own version. Not looking for authenticity but rather to make food in tune with the local taste and culture of London.

name: Notty BaBa
desc: Notty BaBa began with a simple idea: to take the food, flavours and way of eating I grew up with in Beijing and make them my own. Food was always about more than eating, it was about bringing people together.

name: Smoke Tin Kitchen
tagline: Delicious BBQ Meats Cooked Over Wood & Coal
desc:
A caterer with a difference. Smoke Tin Kitchen cook everything over wood and charcoal on their fire pit or in their wood-fired oven and serve it from their great looking horsebox.

Think large cuts of meat hanging above the fire and vegetables cooking in the embers. All served from their beautifully converted horsebox kitchen.

name: Pasta is Ready
desc: ‘Pasta is Ready!’ is a familiar shout that most Italians have heard from a young age to announce that it's time to sit around the table for lunch!

name: Brick lane bagel company
desc:
Our bagels are baked from the famous brick lane bakery.  Behind the food-to-go menu is a nostalgic mix of Irish salt beef brisket, oak-smoked salmon, and our brand signatures. Featuring a wide array of fillings, ingredients are sourced from some of the finest suppliers of food in the country.

Along with shops we have an array catering units from the bagel beast our converted removal truck.

name: Bite Me Burger Co
desc:
Bite Me Burger Co believes that good things come in small packages. They also believe that more is more, so they have created delightful mini-burgers so you can order a couple, a few or stack ‘em high and sample the whole menu!

The delicious pick ‘n’ mix mini-burgers are served in duo, trio, quad and dozen sharing boxes - they are perfect for parties and events.

name: Prestige Doughnuts
desc:
Prestige Doughnuts is a Cambridge-based dessert supplier that offers a multi-faceted approach to enjoying your favourite sweets!

For the dessert lover, Prestige creates a variety of fresh, homemade artisan doughnuts that can be customised based on individual tastes.

name: Pearl and Groove
desc:
I’m Serena and I started Pearl & Groove bakery in 2013. Back then the ‘free from section’ was plain, brown and practically medical. There was nothing indulgent or exciting, let alone tasty. 

So I made it my mission to add colour, flavour and bloody good cake to the party. By using the BEST possible ingredients, small batch baking and a whole lotta love.

name: Dolcetti Ice Cream Company
desc: Traditional Italian Gelato and Sorbets hand made in Cotswolds free from Palm Oil, Whey Powder, Artificial flavourings, Colourings, Gluten, Eggs and Ground Nuts. All served in Vegan cones and all packaging 100% recyclable. Local sourced ingredients with milk processed on a daily basis to produce each new batch.

name: Bam Bam Fries
desc:
Bam Bam Fries provide the ultimate loaded fries wether it be for a festival, sporting event, country show, wedding or corporate event.

With a fully customisable menu we would also offer our classic toppings such as bbq pulled pork, nacho cheese, piri piri chicken, chicken tenders on a selection of fries; skin on’s, sweet potato and halloumi fries.

All of our packaging is fully biodegradable from…

name: Pizza Loco
desc:
Pizza Loco serve up the poofiest crust in Yorkshire cultivated by one lofty bloke and a Pizza Locomotive! Pizza Loco bring a completely unique mobile dining experience to all kinds of events such as weddings, birthdays, corporate events and festivals.

You and your guests will be blown away when they see the steaming hot Neapolitan pizza coming out of the firebox!

name: Napoli on the Road
desc:
My name is Michele, I'm an Italian guy with an extremely passion for food and pizza.

I opened my street food business in 2016 called Napoli on the Road, and with my beautiful little piaggio ape i toured around London making real neapolitan pizza with my wood fire oven!

name: Just Steak in-it
desc: We are a premium steak & fries truck selling the best of British beef, chicken, lamb, we offer unusual cuts of steak, Spider steak/Bullet steak/Tres-Major/Flatirion/Onglet to mention a few. We are a steakhouse restaurant based in Mold, Flintshire. North Wales.  We recently purchased a purpose built food truck.

name: Free the Chilli
desc:
Our Story
The beginning:

The story began when mates Jonny and Jamie met at Uni and formed a connection over a shared love of good music and good times. After a while it became clear that we had many things in common, including food and chilli sauce. For a while we weren’t fussy and any spicy morsel would do fine...

name: Island Poké
desc: Island Poke bring to you their delicious, fresh poke (pronouced poké) - a classic Hawaiian dish of cubed, marinated fish.

name: Rasa
desc: RASA is the brainchild of Petty Elliott. It is the Indonesian word for ‘taste’ - not only in the direct sense relating to food, but embracing the aesthetics and intuition associated with the art and traditions of the people who live across this diverse and tropical archipelago.

name: Patty & Press Burger Joint
desc: Get your fix of delicious street food from our experienced team with over 8 years in the business. Our philosophy is straightforward: simple, done well.

name: Say Cheese
desc:
We are Say Cheese - we make the ooziest, gooey-est, vegan mac and cheese, stacked with a variety of tasty toppings, served from a bright and cheerful stall, that will lighten your day and make you smile.
We started our food business in January 2023, we are avid festival-goers and proud (vegan) foodies and we were looking for a way to make festivals and events part of our lives whilst also promotin…

name: Dub Pan
desc:
DUB PAN BRINGS A TRULY AUTHENTIC TASTE OF MODERN JAMAICA TO LONDON.

Home of the famous Jammin' Jerk. With sites across the capital, we have brought to London our famous Jamaican jerk, with meats marinated for 24 hours in our secret blend of herbs and spices, before being grilled and smoked slowly over charcoal in a steel drum.

name: Brisket Brothers
desc:
A passion for wood fire cooking and the best ingredients we could source was the ethos surrounding the creation of The Brisket Brothers.

Created in 2022 we started smoking our own brisket and pork in our imported wood fired smoker.

name: Veg Heads Catering
desc:
We are Veg Heads! Our inception takes us back to November 2018, when we rocked the Saffron Walden markets with our first wholefoods burger menu. 

Since then, we have gone from strength to strength. We had a collaborative day cafe with a vegan doughnut business in Southend for a year, alongside regular street food events, festivals and private events.

name: Bear’s Kitchen
desc: Jack & Cristina have lovingly converted a vintage horse box to create their baby; Bear’s Kitchen. They cook up simply mouthwatering jackfruit burritos, sweet potato quesadillas, daily specials and more. They also have a range of drinks including homemade lemonade, horchata and their amazing virgin mockingbird margarita!

name: Pink pasta pizza truck
tagline: We hand roll, toss, and sizzle
desc: We are a half Italian half English family team, we have grown our business around everything we love over the last 15 years, exploring, tasting and learning what’s best for our customers.  We have brought the taste of Italy to our beautiful pink truck, everything we is created by ourselves, from our pasta and pizza to our truck.  Hand painted, hand crafted and seasoned to perfection.

name: The Chipsmyth
desc:
We are The Chipsmyth, a street food business specialising in ‘Hand Cut Chips with Delicious Toppings’. You can find us all over the place really. We love to travel around the country to different food festivals and events. We have even featured in the British Street food Awards twice!

Our food is all homemade and freshly made on the day.

name: Nom Nom Ltd
desc: nom nom has traded for over a decade at the biggest uk events, from Glastonbury, F1, common wealth games, twickenham, airshows and streetfood events. we have the experience and knowledge to provide quality food at pace in the busiest of environments.

name: Soffles
desc: Inspired by pitta our menu includes Nachos, Quesapittas and Tacos.  We replace the traditional tortilla chips with pitta chips then our quesapittas are made with a fresh pitta flatbread that is then grilled and for the taco base you will find pitta  .

name: Cluck n' Cow
desc:
At Cluck N’ Cow, we pride ourselves on providing an exceptional food experience wherever we go. Taking what we have learned 
at Folkestone Harbour, we’ve developed our brand into a flexible catering company that can deliver the same quality, flavour 
and energy to events of all sizes.

name: Events by bespoke
desc: The Pantry Catering & Events is a Derbyshire-based catering company delivering exceptional food and service for events of every size. From intimate private parties and weddings to corporate dinners, awards ceremonies and large-scale festivals, we provide bespoke catering tailored to each occasion.

name: Hip Hop Food Shop
desc: Our brand is called Hip Hop Food Shop as we believe the culture of hip hop and street food are interlinked, Both bring people together and are full of colour, flavour and sound. Hip hop started out by  sampling the best parts of two records to bring something new to the masses, and this is what we strive to do.

name: The Gravy Train Poutine
desc: Tom and twin brother Ben run a street food stall called 'The Gravy Train' - selling some of the darn finest poutine in the United Kingdom! Tom and Ben became obsessed with poutine ever since it first passed their lips when they lived in Canada.

name: Fat Dads Kitchen
desc:
Suppliers of locally grown, organic produce - or working with a number of Charities to help battle Food Poverty within Bristol. 

After 24 years working in Pharmaceuticals, a Prostate Cancer diagnosis rocked me to my core - a subsequent Mental Breakdown made me realise that something needed to change.

name: Jalisco Social Club
desc: The Jalisco Social Club is a community where Mexico’s culinary and cultural delights are celebrated. Everything we do is inspired and in collaboration with the best of Mexico.

name: Hup
desc:
Whether you’re craving irresistible sweet and savoury crêpes, or heavenly coffee, we’ve got something to satisfy every appetite.

We are a passionate catering business  specialising in delicious sweet treats, speciality coffee and mouth-watering hot food.

Hup Street Food County Down, we pride ourselves on using quality ingredients and serving up food that’s made with care.

name: Coffee Guru
desc:
We do everything from roasting, to serving all our own 100% traceable coffee from farm to cup. We use only the best ingredients in all of our toasties 

We pride ourselves in being quick and efficient in service while also keeping with the quality, catering for all needs vegan, gluten intolerant, lactose intolerant.

We are very high on sustainability & reducing our carbon footprint, we only use 1…

name: Pellizco
desc: Pellizco was founded by Daniel Pinch in 2020, during lockdown as a street food operation from our orange trailer in Sheffield.

name: Crabworks
desc:
The 2 owners, Alex & Finley are Whitstable born and raised lads who have a passion for delicous and fresh food. Crabworks was born from a spontaneous pop up in our home town that contiunued on way passed the planned time frame. 

Our menu of fresh seafood small plates was a hit with the towns day trippers & visitors and since we launched has become a popular destination in Whitstable Harbour.

name: The Taco Trailer
desc: We sell a variety of authentic Mexican tacos inspired by our travels, and use local Sheffield ingredients to bring our food to life. Our best seller is the 10 hour slow cooked beef birria tacos, but we offer a variety of flavours including vegetarian and gluten free options. All of our fillings, sauces and salsas are homemade. Our tortillas are made fresh every week for each event.

name: The Olive Bar
desc: Family run since 1996, we provide olives, oysters, oils and various other bits sourced from all over Europe where we have been trading on Portobello Rd Monday to Saturday. Barnes and Primrose Hill.

name: The Oxford Foodies
desc: The Oxford Foodies are a family run street-food business trading from their lovingly restored, beautiful Citroen HY. Their van, ‘Eric’ is French, charming and is available for all kinds of events!

name: Mobile Pizza
desc:
Established in 2024, our journey is rooted in years of experience in the catering industry, where we cultivated a passion for crafting delicious, high-quality pizzas that bring people together.
We also only use the finest ingredients available to us to make the occasion extra special.

name: Tropical Sushi
desc: Tropical Sushi serve their fantastic sushi from their market stall or food truck depending on what you’re after for your event.

name: Chai Junction
desc:
HOT KATHI ROLLS FROM KOLKATA INDIA -
 We do Indian Hot Kathi Rolls and Chai(Authentic Indian brewed Tea). Hot Kathi Roll is Flat bread Paratha coated with egg, choice of fillings which could be Chicken, Paneer V (Indian Cottage Cheese), Lamb Seekh, Chana VG (Chickpeas) and topped with salad, squeeze of Lime, homemade tamarind and mint coriander sauces.

name: Hook & Cook Streetfood
desc: After 15 years working in hotels, events and award winning restaurants the streets were calling my name. Hook & Cook was born after being at a festival and hearing traders talking about local produce, ethical and sustainable measures but seeing fish being really underrepresented.

name: Libertine Burger
desc:
Libertine launched as a street food van in 2017. Since then we’ve opened two bricks and mortar restaurants, launched a nationwide burger kit delivery service and served up burgers at some of the UK’s biggest festivals from our new, bigger van.

We’ve won awards, received accolades and Libertine Burger has become synonymous with quality, great-tasting burgers.

name: Camille's Catering
desc: Camille's Catering is a Caribbean Events Catering company dedicated to producing the best authentic Caribbean dishes that take your taste buds on a journey of decadence. As a family-run business with over 10 years of catering experience creating beautiful memories using food, we are the preferred caterer for small, intimate, and large events such as weddings or festivals.

name: il forno
desc: We are il forno, a family run bussiness open for 4 years, serving authentic Sicilian style pizza's. We cook our pizza's in a wood fired oven, giving the most perfect thin and crispy base.

name: Babu Bombay Street Food
desc:
Babu Bombay Street Kitchen serve authentic Bombay street food and homestyle curries. They are the innovators of the Great Naanwich. They use local Scottish ingredients by fusing Scottish influences within their food.

Babu Bombay Street Kitchen are never traditional but always original and authentic. They are a powerhouse of flavours.

name: Fatté
desc:
From performing with Gorillaz to serving with the same passion at Fatté, Omran brings creativity and heart to everything he does. Originally from Syria, he came to the UK in 2016 as a refugee and made London his home. Since then, he has performed on stages like Glastonbury, worked in
restaurants, markets, bars, and coffee shops, and honed his skills as a chef and barista.

name: MorMor
desc: MorMor creates contemporary & healthy Middle Eastern, North African and Mediterranean inspired street food and more.

name: Feed fried chicken
desc:
FEED FRIED CHICKEN

High-Volume Festival Fried Chicken

Feed Fried Chicken is a Midlands-based street food brand specialising in high-impact, high-volume fried chicken service at major UK festivals and events.

Our signature product is cornflake-coated chicken strips delivering a bold, golden crunch that stands out in busy festival environments.

name: The Spanish Buffet Ltd
desc:
VALENCIA TO WALES: AUTHENTIC SPANISH CATERING & TRADITIONS

1. OUR BRAND STORY: FROM VALENCIA WITH LOVE

Originating from the coastal region of Valencia, Spain—the undisputed birthplace of Paella—our business is built on centuries of culinary heritage.

name: BURGER BAR
desc:
Burger Bar is an independent East London street food business based at Hackney Bridge. 

We created the brand after years of running busy street-food kitchens and feeding thousands of people at events across the UK. 

We love proper burgers and were tired of everything becoming smashed, flattened and practically see through.

name: The Dorset Food Co
desc:
DORSET FOOD, DONE RIGHT.

For too long we’ve all had to make do with traditional catering where we are served up stuffy plated menus from safe and outdated a, b or c options.

name: Hope Street Kitchen
desc: Hope Street Kitchen (HSK) is a Manchester-based food enterprise born from a deep love of West African and Caribbean culinary tradition. Founded with a clear sense of purpose, HSK set out to bring bold, authentic flavours to new audiences while creating real opportunities for young people facing barriers to employment.

name: Heck Food
desc:
Heck make damn good sausages, burgers and balls. They travel the country with their hot van spreading the Heck love! All of their products are gluten-free and are made with only the leanest cuts of meat which makes for the most delicious sausages.

They are a family and friends run business and believe that this has been the perfect recipe for success!

name: Kochchi
desc:
Kochchi (pronounced ko.chee) is the first Sri Lankan street food business in Scotland. Our vision was created when two passionate foodie friends got together and converted a rice horse box to serve Sri Lankan street food from our trailer hatch. 
We (Shehan and Suki) were born in Sri Lanka but live in Glasgow where we first met back in 2009.

name: The Pizza Box Co
desc:
We have been trading for 4 years now, offering delicious Wood fired Pizza from our converted van. We cater for all events however big or small,  bringing restaurant quality pizza to your event.

Our beautiful converted van will bring the wow factor to any party, feeding your guests delicious Neapolitan pizza using only the finest ingredients.

name: The Sauce
desc:
Most of the food out there is alright. But what happens when alright isn’t cutting it anymore? 

Yes, we do burgers. Chicken Burger, Crab Burgers, Beef Burgers, Venison Burgers and even Falafel Burgers. Our sauces are the enhancing heroes. The ‘icing on the cake’.

name: Lovely Buns
desc: Lovely Buns is a plant-based bakery specialising in cakes, brownies, cookies and cake truffles. They pride themselves on not compromising when it comes to flavour with their vegan bakes and presentation is always key!

name: Three Sisters Bake
desc:
Three Sisters Bake is a family run; female led bakery business based just outside Glasgow - headed up by three cake obsessed sisters! We founded in 2011 and published our first cookbook in 2014 with publisher Hardie Grant. 

We hand bake in small batches and supply a wide range of cakes; traybakes; brownies; blondies and giant empire biscuits.

name: Will's Kitchen
desc:
Will's Kitchen's stalls have been trading in Portobello Market since 2021. We are currently trading 3 stalls which are Chinese Food, Falafel and Oriental Food in Portobello Market.

We also trade near office premises for lunch times at various locations in London on weekdays. We offer the swift service to our customers during their short lunch break.

name: Mozzarella Fellas Pizza
desc:
Based in St Albans, Hertfordshire, but with the ability to travel up to 100 miles, Mozzarella Fellas is a mobile pizzeria specialising in catering for Weddings, Birthdays, Corporate events, Bar Mitzva's and much more!

Operating out of a professionally wrapped, converted van equipped with a hand made Italian clay oven, we can hand stretch, top, cook ands serve up to 40 x 12-inch pizzas per hour wh…

name: Oishī Don
desc:
We are Oishī Don, Japanese donburi specialists, serving up delicious and affordable rice bowls to the London masses. We aim to bring comfort and joy through the flavours of Japanese cuisine!

We're a Walthamstow couple who have a real passion for food, Shane is a professional chef and Liz is a keen foodie.

name: Soul Fuel
desc: Bringing the vibrant flavors of the Caribbean to the streets, Soul Fuel serves up Jamaican-inspired street food that’s freshly prepared and always delivered with a smile. Our dishes are rooted in traditional recipes, infused with bold spices, and cooked with love—offering a true taste of island life. From jerk chicken and plantain to hearty vegan options, every bite is designed to transport you.

name: Nulla Mors Vegan Smokehouse
desc:
Looking for awesome handmade vegan grub to wow at your event served with a smile? 

We can make you: Vegan Ribs, Brisket and Jackfruit smoked over hickory. Burgers, Vegan Fried Chicken, Vegan Mac n Cheese and all the sides you could ask for at a 10/10 BBQ. 100% Handmade in our all vegan kitchen in North London.

Need food early?

name: The Fat Flamingo
desc:
Hey I'm fin and I run The Fat Flamingo!
We essentialy provide street good catering to all manner of events from weddings to music festivals. There's a few set ups we have but we mainly run events out of our smashing looking horsebox.  We tend to lean to South American and classic Americana dishes but are very open to do whatever takes your fancy!.

name: Paellaria
desc: At Paellaria we bring the great flamenco atmosphere of our Andalusian home back to England, using some of the biggest paella pans in blighty, our dancing chicas and chicos use time honoured methods to cook up massive and tasty paella’s for punters all across the uk.

name: The Braai Guy
desc: We are a South African inspired food truck serving gourmet BBQ food based in the beautiful South Hams in Devon. After working in one of South Africa’s leading hotels I decided to bring the food and culture back to the UK. We serve local and seasonal produce that is cooked simply over fire.

name: Belly Of The Beast
desc:
Introducing Belly Of The Beast, where we specialize in crafting sandwiches that are sure to satisfy your taste buds...

Experience the delight of biting into a sandwich made with our freshly baked, Italian Deli-style sub rolls. Each bite is an explosion of flavours, as we fill our sandwiches to the brim with the finest, high-quality ingredients.

name: Chocomelt Station Ltd
desc: Chocomelt Station Cardiff offers a premium dessert experience focused on fresh fruits and high-quality Belgian chocolate.

name: Plant.Eat.Licious
desc:
For years, we have wanted to grow our passion of cooking plant-based and vegan friendly dishes into a sustenable business, that would inspire others who are either committed Vegans or vegan-curious! 
The pandemic brought us the time, space and motivation to grow our idea into a successful family-based business.

name: Muffin Man & Co
desc: Muffin Man & Co make delicious homemade English filled Muffins. Everything is made from scratch, from the bacon jam to the hash browns. They have sourced the very best ingredients to make their muffins, their smoked eel and salmon is from a small smokery in Lincolnshire.

name: Big Fat Indian Kitchen
desc:
Big Fat Indian Kitchen serves the most authentic , healthy Indian street food. The reason behind the name  Big Fat Indian Kitchen is because of our 
''BIG PORTIONS and FAT FLAVORS''.

name: Amore pizzetta
desc:
We are amore pizzetta!

We are a family orientated business and take an interest in all of our customers and what their needs are.

So it all started on our parents conservatory saying "I'm so sick of nowhere selling dairy free desserts for Maison and kylo" this being my then 2 year old and 5 year old who have milk allergies.

name: Fold Me Close
desc: Neapolitan style pizza - always made with our own handmade dough. Our slow rise dough produces the authentic Napoli style airy crust with characteristic char.

name: Macman
desc: MacMan makes sensational mac'n'cheese, fresh slaws and delicious dips, serving up a unique dining experience born of a love for hearty comfort food and a closely guarded family recipe.

name: Not Only Thursday
desc: In 2022, the founders of Malaysian street food, Eat Lah, established Not Only Thursday, a passion project that infuses Asian-inspired flavors into fried chicken. We're constantly experimenting with new flavors and can cater to your specific requests - just ask us!

name: Born & Raised
desc:
Born & Raised are all about sourdough pizzas, cooked fresh to order in their Land Rovers’ wood-burning oven. Established in 2012, they have catered at many festivals, weddings, parties and corporate events across the country.

They are passionate about sourcing the very best seasonal ingredients.

name: Pete's Pizzas
desc:
Pete’s Pizzas have been serving delicious handmade wood-fired pizza at weddings, festivals and all around Suffolk for over three years. 

A husband and wife team, Pete’s Pizzas take care in every detail. Whether it’s the quality of the pizza itself, their service or their carbon footprint, Pete’s Pizzas go the extra mile to make sure your overall experience is exceptional.

name: Penny's Pizza
desc:
At Penny’s Pizza, we believe food (especially PIZZA!) brings people together. Making us an incredible addition to your event. 

All of our ingredients are fresh and organically sourced and imported from Italy. 

At Penny’s Pizza we choose to operate under a pop up tent, which allows us to be in the heart of your event and not limited to a van in your driveway.

name: Shoop Soup
desc: From Tel Aviv to London via Paris Shoop Soup passionately believes in real homemade good food. Serving up Middle Eastern inspired soups, salads and sandwiches with some tasty homemade Borekas and pastries, and specialising in falafel.

name: Ramyum
desc: We are RamYum, a family-run street food business founded by chef Phoebe and joined by her father-in-law Keiron, who leads customer service.

name: The Farmer's Mistress
desc:
The Farmer’s Mistress truly believe a balanced lifestyle is a healthy lifestyle. They create natural, wholesome, nutrient-rich yet indulgent dishes by selecting the highest quality, fresh produce to create exciting options for all no matter what your dietary requirements are.

Indulge in food that’s looks and tastes too naughty to be good for you.

name: HOKO
desc:
Hong Kong Cafe HOKO takes a creative and modern approach of the classic HK food menu from 1950s, that traces its origins to British colonial rule in the 1950s.

Our energetic team at HOKO represent a mission to share authentic Asian flavours and tell the cultural stories of Hong Kong.

name: Flying Pig Pizza Company
desc: The Flying Pig Pizza Company is a mobile wood-fired pizza oven van, based in Leyland and operating across the North West.

name: Chéz northeast Ltd
desc: At Chéz, we bring premium street food to weddings, corporate events, private parties and festivals across the North East.

name: The Whisk And Pickle Wood Fired Kitchen
desc:
We Specialise in wedding, corporate and private hire catering. Serving epic wood fired pizzas and our signature gooey brownies!

The Pizzas

We make epic wood fired pizzas, each one is hand stretched, not a rolling pin or dough roller insight!

name: Drums & Flats
desc: Drums & Flats was born after friends Khamisi and Daniel started cooking their food for their friends and family out of their kitchens at home.

name: Street Pig
desc:
Street Pig are an award-winning BBQ themed street food company. They serve a range of delicious dishes including BBQ baby back ribs, BBQ Pork, BBQ rump steak with chimichurri sauce and grilled halloumi and aubergine in a toasted brioche.

They make absolutely everything themselves which creates big and fresh flavours.

name: Flock Fried Chicken
desc: Flock Fried Chicken by Chef Jonas Lodge brings a premium twist to Southern fried style chicken delivering the perfect crunch and crust in our signature gluten free spiced coating. We work with the best suppliers to deliver an elevated offering made complete using our house made hot honey.

name: Vegan Filth
desc: Vegan Filth was opened in May of 2020 in the height of lockdown. Myself (Natasha) and partner, Dalton saw a demand in our local area for Vegan Junk Food. I have always had a fascination with American junk food leading me to create my own food blog of recipes and do local demonstrations of how to prepare delicious vegan food.

name: Jimm's Ice Cream Co.
tagline: Yummie Ice Cream just for You.
desc:
Jimm's Ice Cream Co. are an East London based Ice Cream operator, established in 2017. However, we have been in the Ice Cream trade for over 20 years, providing services to events, commercial partners and private hire.

We now have a small fleet of modern Ice cream vans offering the latest innovations in technology and sustainability.

Our customers will be pleased to know that we continually achi…

name: Fat Snags
desc:
Cheeky chaps Fat Snags specialise in the highest quality, gourmet hot dogs which they'd love to serve up at your event!

The dogs are stuffed with with the famous, handcrafted Lashford’s Sausages from Birmingham and are served either from their super cool horse box trailer or their market stall-style set-up.

Everything is sourced as locally as it can be and they use only the highest quality produ…

name: Dorset Pedaling Pizza Co
desc: We serve quality wood fired pizzas from our beautiful yellow vintage horse box ‘Bella’.  We have five years experience in every kind of event, both small and large including corporate, festivals, parties, weddings, campsites and more.

name: Beige and Bougie Creperie
desc: Welcome to Beige and Bougie, the unrivaled crepe supplier in London. What makes us different is our unwavering commitment to excellence and our passion for creating exceptional crepes. Each crepe is a work of art, skillfully prepared by our talented artisans with the finest ingredients sourced from local suppliers whenever possible.

name: Leaf or Sizzle
desc:
Back in 2018 we found an ex-german military ambulance for sale, we purchased it, drove it back home to England and went to work converting it into a food truck.

Now my brother and I craft delicious dishes in collaboration with local, sustainably sourced ingredients.

name: Little Urban Chef
desc: Little Urban Chef was born in 2012 whist on holiday in Agde, Llangudoc-roussillon, France. Inspired by the array of fresh produce on the weekly food market and 18 years of experience as a chef I decided to bring my version of paella to the street food markets in London.

name: Muchi
desc: At Muchi, we set out to celebrate the amazing Japanese mochi. Since launching in November 2021, we’ve been blowing our customers’ minds with our unique range of delicious, innovative mochi-based desserts and snacks.

name: Louisianna Smoke House
desc:
Louisiana Smoke House brings authentic American BBQ to events across the UK, delivering not just incredible food, but a full country-style experience. From the sounds of country music to our themed setup and signature hats, we create an atmosphere that stands out at any event.

Our menu is built around true low-and-slow cooking.

name: Miz street food
desc:
We are a independent catering company serving restaurant quality Mexican street food with big flavours, specialising in a range of tasty Tacos & Burritos all using locally sourced ingredients for the heart of the South West
2026 - We have a new food truck!

name: The Splitscreen Ice Cream Co
desc:
We serve mouth-watering, award-winning ice cream from our seriously cool and iconic Volkswagen vintage vans and trailer.

About us

Based on the North Norfolk coast in a small town called Holt, The Splitscreen ice cream Company has been running for over 12 years but was taken over by us at the start of 2021.

name: Smashed Tomato
desc:
We are a team of two – The ‘Chief Smasher’ and ‘Miss Tomato’!

He can cook – boy can he cook, he is calm and collected, doesn’t stress and is used to feeding a crowd.

name: Dak Kochi Express
desc: Dak Kochi Express began life in Incheon, South Korea, where we developed our signature house-made sauces and built a loyal following for our chargrilled chicken skewers. That success gave us the confidence to bring Dak Kochi Express to the UK for the very first time.

name: The Horsebox Diner
desc: The Horsebox Diner is a 1950's inspired mobile American diner. They serve a variety of diner favourites from their beautifully converted vintage horsebox.

name: So Delicious
desc:
We are a family business, we do this about 15years in Greece and 4 year now we continue in UK to serve fresh delicious food.
Our passion is the street food, we serve every day delicious smash burgers and amazing signature hot dogs. The other section is France crepes and Pancakes.
We cook and serve our food in a new air stream style food treiler.

name: The Pod Street Food Trailer
desc: We offer delicious locally sourced hand pressed burgers topped with maple smoked pulled pork, bbq brisket or our famous scotch bonnet salsa served in a soft brioche bun with fresh lettuce, homemade ranch slaw, pickles and American cheese. We also have a tasty homemade chilli, chickpea and ginger burger suitable for both vegetarians and vegans.

name: Bagel Factory
desc: The first Bagel Factory opened in Endell Street, London 1987. The basement was converted into a bakery, the ground floor into a shop, the first floor an office with the owner living in the flat above. Now, all these years later we have over 50 outlets in Uk and Irland at most major travel hubs such as underground stations and train stations, shopping Malls and  financial districts.

name: Four Gables Events
desc: At Four Gables Events, we create exceptional catering experiences for both corporate, private and wedding events across Sussex, Surrey, Kent and London.

name: Oak Oven Pizza Co
desc:
Oak Oven Pizza Co started catering for events in 2019 as a hobby business. 
Our pizzaiolo James has definitely found his calling and quit teaching in 2022 to focus on this full time.

Our sourdough stonebaked pizzas are 12" so large enough to share (or not!) and are cooked in an Italian wood fired oven to get that delicious authentic taste.

name: Rhythm Kitchen
desc:
Experience the vibrant tastes of the Caribbean at Rhythm Kitchen, your authentic culinary destination! We take pride in presenting three exceptional products designed to delight your taste buds and cater to the discerning needs of London's corporates.

Step into the world of Caribbean Afternoon Tea, a delightful fusion of island-inspired delicacies and classic British traditions.

name: Yam Good
desc:
Yam Good creates Vietnamese cuisine inspired by generational family recipes. On occasion we seek inspiration and influences from neighbouring asian countries to deliver an unforgettable sensory experience, which is often imitated but rarely equalled.

Traditionally Vietnamese yet modern, Yam Good provides great tasting dishes with fresh ingredients in a playful way.

name: Curry Love Streetfood
desc: We are a Brighton based streetfood caterer providing colourful plates of food that taste as good as they look.  The inspirations that shaped our own street-food business came from experiences travelling both abroad and closer to home; Curry Love owes as much to the street stalls of South East Asia as it does to the spirit of the festival scene.

name: Cobble Kitchen
desc: Cobble Kitchen can offer delectable local, seasonal and soulful food at any event. You can choose from their delicious menu of rustic and relaxed ‘picnic’ style food for your birthday, gathering or office lunch.

name: Filigrillz
desc:
Filigrillz is a lively, energetic and fun filipino street food brand that specialise in grilled ,fresh and bangin’ filipino BBQ.
We serve rice box and  wraps  of high quality  marinated meat  (chicken ,pork belly ) cooked on site ,served with rice salad and home made sauces.
We are based in east london ,  established mid 2019, We started trading at central london for office lunch service , now we …

name: Tide & Thyme
desc:
We opened our coffee hut and pizzeria in the summer of 2023, right on the beach in Portscatho, Cornwall. Over the past few years we have transformed our small space to a hub for locals and a must stop for tourists. 

With over a decade of barista experience, we have fine tuned our cafe offerings to appeal to everyone. From our perfectly creamy flat whites to our strawberry iced matchas.

name: Get Sticky
desc:
At Get Sticky, our philosophy is simple: life is better with pudding. Created by two professional chefs from the North East, we serve handcrafted desserts from our purpose built food truck. We believe if you're going to do dessert, do it properly.

Our menu is all about comforting classics with a Get Sticky twist.

name: Dough Man's Land
desc:
Two brothers from Glasgow with a passion for food, people, and the great outdoors decided to do something about their shared interests, and so one night over beer and pizza, Dough Man's Land was born!

We have two units - one is a custom-built horsebox which is great for small gatherings and weddings. Our other unit is what we refer to as our 'festival rig'.

name: Katsu King
desc:
We are Katsu King, serving up some of London’s finest Katsu curry, doing it our way, in a burrito, fries box, rice box or salad box. Don’t like spice, skip the fresh chillies, coriander tastes like soap, leave it out. 

Our founder, Michael, developed Katsu King after waving good buy to his award winning London cafe post Covid.

name: Vintage Shakes Ltd.
desc: We are a family run business specialising in providing the best quality products and services. We started our business in 2016 and have attended hundreds of events since re visiting many events again every year.

name: Flour Power Pizza Parlour
desc:
After undertaking training to become professional pizzaiolas in Florence, Simon and Rebecca returned home to Cornwall and launched Flour Power Pizza Parlour to share their healthy, unique pala pizza!

What better way to feed the Cornish community and visitors than from their eye-catching van, which is the colourful centrepiece of any wedding, private party or coastal music festival.

name: The guildable manor
desc: We pride ourselves on our passion for food. Our reputation has grown because we refuse to compromise on quality. Originally from Borough market, now relocated to Devon, we started out this venture to bring an excellence in the whole food experience which we are proud to put our name to. Our enthusiasm spills over into our customer service.

name: The Whole Cheese
desc:
The wonderful Whole Cheese was founded in 2012 by cheese maker Simon Bowden, who was desperate to take his passion to events across the country.

They provide a selection of divine cheese dishes including their famous Somerset rarebit served with jalapeno slaw, a Somerset-based three cheese board, a selection of posh cheese on toast, baked camembert and even a tiered cheesecake made out of differe…

name: Dipped Cookie Co
desc:
Got it! Here’s a modern and fun backstory for your cookie business:

Our story started with a serious sweet tooth and a not-so-serious idea: why not turn late-night cookie experiments into something everyone could enjoy? Armed with a mixer, a few wild flavor combos, and a love for sharing snacks, we started baking for friends.

name: Gyoza Guys
desc:
Chef Amir Pem brings you his award winning Gourmet Gyoza’s. A classically trained chef to Global Music Artists decided to start his own Gyoza Business in 2015 and is based out of the Famous Maltby Street Market

We cater for a variety of events be it corporate, wedding or in your back garden.


We play the best tunes whilst you wait for your freshly prepared gyoza and we have a very friendly but p…

name: The Crackling Hog
desc:
Catering company local to the Bristol area, with meat sourced from an award winning local butcher, using local farmers! This is great for our BBQ!

We provide a hog roast, cooked on site using a traditional spit roast. This ensures the best tasting, succulent meat as well as providing a bit of theatre for your event. It also guarantees the crispiest crackling!

name: Patty & Bun
desc:
Patty & Bun create fresh, honest and world-famous burgers. Their ethos is super simple: use the best quality ingredients they can get their hands on, supporting British produce wherever possible.

As you’ll probably know from their brilliant restaurants and pop-ups, Patty & Bun keep the menu short and sweet, doing burgers right.

name: Woodstock Pizza
desc:
Woodstock Pizza are here to bring a slice of the wood-fired life to Greater Manchester and beyond. 
Our home is on Stockport Road in Marple, but our outdoor catering is still hugely popular and we still love nothing more than bringing good pizza to your party!

Woodstock Pizza take fresh dough made to our own recipe, top it with quality ingredients straight from Italy and cook it at over 400 degre…

name: Thomas price mobile catering
desc:
We are a hands on family run business with knowledge passed down for four generations. 

We are very hard working and professional, with a great team behind us, there aren’t many obstacles we can’t overcome to deliver the best product when it counts.

name: Cowsheds Catering
desc:
