Cowsheds Catering is a very diverse catering business. We offer a range of catering to sporting events, education organisations, private clients and corporate customers.

Our clients and customers choose our air stream catering trailer for the ideal catering solution.

name: Throwback Toasties
desc:
As a fully-flexible, mobile, and independently owned street food company, Throwback Toasties is the perfect catering option for festivals, weddings, and events. 

The owners of Throwback Toasties have two things in common: 1) a passion for gooey cheese toasties and 2) an obsession with all things throwback. One unhealthy obsession at a time you say?

name: Slice Shop
desc: We form part of the well-known national bar operator Revolution Bars Group who operate the brands Revolution, Revolucion de Cuba, Peach Pubs, Founders & Co. and PlayHouse.

name: Guerrilla Kitchen
desc:
Guerrilla Kitchen are an epic street food trader that specialise in Gua Bao which are light and fluffy steamed buns. They are filled with delicious meat, fish or vegetarian combinations. Absolutely everything is cooked to order and the buns take just 5-6 minutes to make so there won’t be long queues for the food!

Provenance is at the forefront of Guerrilla Kitchen’s business.

name: Pizza Home
desc: We are an Italian restaurant fist we opened in 2002 in Earl’s Court  since then I personally have been in the kitchen for 19 years.  And I love it we have won best pizza in London in 2013  during my career I have made pizzas for some big celebrities and it has been an amazing experience in my life we get people drive from different parts of London to come and eat our pizza.

name: Hettys Hen House
desc:
Did you know, Hettys Hen House is part of the Passion & Soul Food Family. Alongside a number of casual eating sites in North Somerset, we also operate a 4000sq ft bakery & production kitchen
based in Weston Super Mare.

name: Doh Bois
desc:
"It's like a doughnut and a pizza had a baby" 

Doh Bois was born 4 years ago as a beautiful experiment in the back of a little doughnut shop in the valleys where Ben was stretching out doughnuts and experimenting and he thought "man I bet this would be a great street food dessert".

A already busy business meant that Doh Bois lived on the back burner for years, but Ben kept coming back to it, tim…

name: DeadGood Burrito
desc:
DeadGood Burrito pride themselves on serving freshly made to order Mexican street food that delivers bags of flavour. They make everything they can in house using the best ingredients that they can get their hands on.

All of their salsas, sauces and marinades are made from scratch to their own unique recipes, something they believe is the reason that they stand out from the rest.

name: Yardbirds Chicken
desc:
The brilliant Yardbirds Chicken have brought Harlem to Birmingham with their authentic fried chicken burgers and loaded fries.

Since establishing themselves in 2018, the Yardbird Chicken team take their utterly delicious fried chicken all around the country for street food events, parties, weddings and festivals.

name: Born Sloppy
desc: Born sloppy is a small catering business with Delicious one of a kind food, friendly service and a strong eco conscience.

name: The Green Grill
desc: The Green Grill serve up utterly unique vegan burgers, the like of which have yet to be seen on the UK food scene!

name: Greek Food
desc: We are passionate about serving authentic Greek food with the unmistakable flavour that only a charcoal grill can create. Our story began with a love for traditional family recipes, fresh ingredients and the warm hospitality for which Greece is famous.

name: Slice Culture Pizza
desc:
Slice Culture Pizza is based at Track Brewing Co Taproom in Manchester. 
We serve crispy taproom pizza. 
We can cater for corporate events and parties with low minimum quantity orders. 
We’re happy to accommodate you at the brewery. 
Alongside our pizza there will be a minimum spend at the bar which will need to be organised with Track Brewing Co.

name: Cotswold Salt Beef
desc: The founders of Cotswold Salt Beef both lived in London and when they left what they really missed was a good Salt Beef Sandwich.

name: Blondies Kitchen
desc:
Blondies Kitchen are the UK's first and only Milk & Cookie Bar, serving up American-style, freshly baked cookies as well as raw edible cookie dough and so much more.

Our cookie flavours are endless.

name: Gourmet Warriors
desc:
Hi, we are Gourmet Warriors. We are a group of food-obsessed friends who have spent most of the last decade eating, drinking and cooking our way through the world’s best cuisines and street foods together.

In April 2022, with a sold-out Bristol launch party, we set out on our culinary journey.

name: Underdogs
desc:
Underdogs are simply about great quality hot dogs, using fresh local ingredients that are all sourced within 30 miles of Bristol. For too long hot dogs have been seen as the underdog of quality fast food, Underdogs want to change that perception!

Their hotdogs are smoked over applewood chippings using 100% free range British pork shoulder, that is sourced from Gloucestershire.

name: Jollof Kingdom
desc: Jollof Kingdom is a Ghanaian restaurant operating London. It started in 2020 on a small scale providing lunch to office workers upon request.

name: Pizza Peddlers
desc: The brilliant Pizza Peddler's serve up utterly delicious pizzas, made to order, from their beautifully restored vintage van.

name: Bonni’s Pizza
desc:
From our 1970's converted horse-box, we create authentic Neapolitan pizza to villages around North Wales during the week, providing the perfect opportunity to sample our pizzas . 

Using the finest imported ingredients from Italy, we hand make our bases every day, ensuring our pizzas are to the highest standard... just like you would find in Naples. 

Why not hire us for your special occasion?

name: K & C Yarwood
desc: K & C Yarwood third generation family ice cream business. We are a professionally run event service, specialising in farmhouse ice cream and vintage ice cream vans. We have grown from a few ice cream vans doing the local rounds throughout Shropshire, to an event leader in providing a bespoke service of ice cream at national events with 100,000 attendance.

name: Clog & Pancake
desc: We specialise in authentic mini dutch pancakes, otherwise known as Poffertjes! We serve our fresh pancakes from our converted vintage horsebox, which goes down a treat at each and every occasion. All of our ingredients are carefully sourced and hand picked so you have the freshest and tastiest dessert.

name: Waffle Doodle-Doo
desc:
Waffle Doodle-Doo are bringing Savoury Waffles and Bagels to the hungry mouths of London. They are doing an awesome job of it so far - they were finalists in this years British Street Food Awards!

Their signature chicken and waffle served with honeycomb butter is definitely not one to be missed, at least once you get over the initial shock of seeing fried chicken on a sweet waffle!

name: Paella Sunset
tagline: Big pan paella cooked on site
desc:
Based in Abergavenny, South Wales, Paella Sunset serve delicious, healthy and filling food made to order. 

Freshly cooked paella is their speciality, made in giant pans onsite. They import their ingredients from Spain from a range of people they have made contact with over the years.

name: Kuruma Poke
desc:
We have been working in hospitality over ten years and our sushi chef has more than eight years experience in Japanese cuisine and specialise in sushi ( nigiri, maki, temaki and sashimi) 
We are focusing on quality of our sushi and Poke Bowl. We use authentic Japanese ingredient imported from Japan.

name: Dee's Basement
desc:
Dee's Basement is a confectionery studio founded by Dee Omole based in East London. We specialise in unique, nostalgic style cakes and postal desserts available across the UK.  

With events coming back we are also offering our bespoke dessert creation service which is an interactive service allowing guests to create their own desserts from a variety of bases, and toppings.

name: Fire-N-Crust
desc: Fire-N-Crust are a small but very experienced catering Company based between Kent and East Sussex and covering all the surrounding areas. Fire-N-Crust offer authentic pizza as well as delicious BBQ catering.

name: Garden of Afruika
desc:
Garden of Afruika is a community focused, Afro-Caribbean vegan food brand. We pride ourselves on serving fresh, healthy food which also hits the spot in terms of taste! Vegan or not, we guarantee the flavours will leave you satisfied. 

We serve really tasty dishes including jerk oyster mushrooms, jollof rice, roti & curry, plantain and many more.

name: Kōfuku
desc: Kōfuku was born out of our love for Japanese and Latin-American cuisine. Our signature sushi tacos feature a seaweed shell lined with sushi rice and fuses the best fillings, ingredients and sauces to excite your taste buds. Our poké-style bowls have a rice base, with various ingredients, all of which go great together.

name: Rebel Burger
desc: Rebel Burger is a bold, unapologetic, 100% plant-based burger business built for festivals and high-energy events.

name: SP Event Catering
desc: I set up Sp Event Catering trading as Coffee Shack after Covid. Previously I was working in the industry for 25 years working at some of the biggest events in the UK. Selling our family business to Compass in 2002 my brother and I then set up another event catering company in 2009 until covid .

name: Bocados
desc: Bringing together flavours from across the world, Bocados is passionate about delivering high quality, delicious food. Established in 2021, we are a growing, family-run business with a genuine love for food at our core; a passion that we love sharing far and wide. We are mobile and can be found in our truck - lovingly named Juan -  doing our thing and providing friendly, efficient service.

name: The Agile Rabbit
desc: Everything at The Agile Rabbit is done properly and with passion, from the pizzas and drinks to choosing what musicians will make the atmosphere just right. There’s audiovisual equipment and Wifi available and the space can host up to 120 people standing. Jazz bands and DJs are available on request.

name: Sarnie Social
desc:
Sarnie Social was born from a simple mission: connecting people and communities over the very best hot sandwiches ever made. We are obsessed with bread and so we decided to invent our own! 
After hundreds of trials we came up with our SRN SCL signature pocket. A fluffy, soft, rustic pocket with character, style, and strength to hold a lot of filling and sauce without breaking apart.

name: The Chicken Hatch
desc:
Based in Hertfordshire and ran by the talented chef and owner Danny since 2012, The Chicken Hatch don’t take any shortcuts when it comes to your food and service, creating some of the best fried chicken in the country!

Everything they make is homemade, from their own recipe buttermilk fried chicken, house slaw, amazing range of sauces and tasty pickles.

name: Paellas Olé
desc: We are Paellas Ole - a restaurant bringing the wonderful flavours of España directly to your doorstep in London as well as catering for events, markets and festivals! As two friends living away from home who are highly passionate about our cultural cuisine, we decided that it was about time our area had traditional Spanish food ready and available to order.

name: The Moo Shack
desc: The Moo Shack is a Lebanese street food truck founded by a chef whose career in professional kitchens began in Baghdad in the 1990s. After moving to Germany in 2000, he spent many years working in Lebanese restaurants and later became Head Chef in Cologne.

name: Suay Design
desc: United by a passion for creativity and design, David and I recognised a gap in the market for unique  jewellery that resonates with both men and women. Determined to challenge convention, we assembled a small, skilled team of artisans from home and abroad. Together, we design and craft distinctive pieces that balance contemporary style with timeless craftsmanship.

name: Steel Smoking
desc:
Steel smoking is a the brain child of Michael Rowell, who after taking inspiration in his travels though America for the past eight years has dedicated his life to the art of everything smoked! (Smoked food that is of course).
Today Still Smoking is armed with a small fleet of smokers; our largest a 16ft  ,what a lovely kit 
We smoke anything and everything as long as it’s up to our standards.

name: The Dragon Flame
desc: The Dragon Flame, a small caterer company business offering live cooking and smoking meats and vegetarian products. Using an excellent Savage fire cage BBQ and a special handmade six skewered rotisserie able to fit six to eight whole rolled pork belly’s at the time; we work with high-quality selected UK Farmers from North Yorkshire delivered to London.

name: Covs Pie And Mash
desc:
Specialising in PIES! We have a great selection of pies to cater everyone's taste buds and dietary requirements, including vegeterian and vegan pies. (see photo for our famous pie menu). 

All pies are served with Mash with different options to compliment the dish. 
-Crispy onions, gravy and rocket. 
-Gravy, Mushy peas.
-Traditional london LIQUOR.

name: Jus' Winging It
desc:
Jus’ Winging It is all about bold flavours, top quality ingredients and taking street food to the next level. Born from a love of fried chicken and a drive to create the best wings out there, we’ve won multiple Wingfest awards for our homemade sauces, proving that flavour is at the heart of everything we do.

What sets us apart is our homemade, award-winning sauces that make every bite stand out.

name: Sultan Gozleme
desc: Sultan Gözleme is a family-run Turkish street food business bringing authentic, freshly rolled gözleme to markets, festivals and private events across London and the South East. What started as a passion for sharing genuine Turkish flavours has grown into a name known for freshly griddled flatbreads made the traditional way — rolled thin, filled generously, and cooked right in front of you.

name: Sunshine Pizza Oven
desc:
Sunshine Pizza uses slow-proved organic dough and home-made, organic sauce to make delicious, hand-stretched wood-fired pizzas topped with high quality ingredients for all tastes and requirements.

Based in the Peak District, they have a number of great set-ups including a spectacular pizza van and three beautiful mobile ovens.

Over the past 7 years their efficient, friendly teams have catered at…

name: Voodoo Chicken
desc:
Voodoo Chicken transports you to New Orleans, the home of great food and good times. Through rigorous research, testing, trials and hard work we have developed a unique and freshly made menu that gives you a taste of the magic.

We are the leading New Orleans-inspired street food trader serving the highest quality grilled chicken and sides.

name: Alpine Poutine
desc:
We are a Windsor based Canadian street food stall specialising in loaded poutines. 
Our core product is a traditional poutine consisting of seasoned chips, real canadian cheese curds, and homemade gravy. We also have a variety of fully loaded poutines including buffalo chicken, maple bacon, and garlic mushrooms.

name: Piddaji
desc:
Piddaji are bringing the people of London their tasty, homemade Turkish Pide. Pide is a type of Turkish flatbread that is, in this case, cooked in a pizza oven served with all kinds of tasty fillings.

Their pides are cooked to perfection in their wood-fired pizza oven and are filled with a choice of four different fillings including our favourite, their garlic beef Turkish sausage with sautéed mu…

name: Smashing Plates
desc:
At Smashing Plates, we pay homage to our heritage with mouthwatering pitta wraps made with the finest ingredients and a super fresh take. Our menu is accessible, with options for everyone, including gluten-free, plant-based alternatives and a children's menu.

Our ambition is to offer the real Greek street food experience using the best ingredients.

name: Mexicorn
desc:
Welcome to Mexicorn: Bold Mexican Flavours with a Gut-Friendly, Allergen-Safe Twist

Founded with a deep love for vibrant Mexican cuisine and the healing power of fermentation, Mexicorn emerged to bring unforgettable, flavourful street food experiences to Folkestone, Kent, East Sussex, and South and East London.

Our Backstory & Who We Are:
Our story begins with our founder, Jen.

name: Milandy Pizza
desc:
We are British farmers with a vision, we took our old Land Rover Defender "Milandy" retired her from life on the farm, reconditioned her and gave her a new purpose.... to supply pizza to the nation!

​Tasty, nutritious and completely unique, Milandy serves up delicious Pizza to guests who are sick and tired of the same old options.

name: Chulo
desc: Chulo is a vibrant street food business born from a passion for bold flavours, great hospitality, and unforgettable food experiences. Founded with the idea of bringing people together through fresh, exciting dishes, Chulo combines high-quality ingredients with a fun and modern street food vibe.

name: Lickalix
desc: Lickalix create homemade, natural, organic, whole fruit ice lollies that they’d love to bring along to your event in their gorgeous van, called Kenny!

name: Phata Phat
desc:
Phata-Phat serves your not-so-traditional Indian food.

We have been inspired by growing up in a British-Indian 90s household and have created moreish menus that take taste buds to another level! Our inspiration also comes from travel and this is reflected in our cooking.

name: freshly ground coffee co
desc:
We are a family run business with a very hands on approach
With over 40 years experience in the mobile catering/event industry and nearly 25 years in the coffee market

We have several different units to choose from
All very well equipped to service the busiest events
Traditional domed high output coffee unit vintage coffee and crepe van
Vintage hot dog van
A wooden house for  Christmas events
Whi…

name: Mexikings
desc: Discover pre-Hispanic Mexican food through Mexikings traditional Burritos, Rice boxes, and Nachos, which are inspired by ingredients and cooking methods commonly used by the Aztecs in central Mexico. Mexikings offer an authentic Mexican catering service from their pretty, clean gazebo.

name: The Raclette Bar
desc:
Le Rac Shack are undeniably the masters of melting! They are the UK’s favourite Alpine street food company and can be found travelling around the country going from event to event lovingly grilling whole wheels of Raclette cheese straight onto crushed potatoes and french fries!

Their Raclette cheese comes from Annecy, near Lake Geneva - for those who don’t know, Raclette is a type of cheese that …

name: The Wood Oven
desc:
OUR OVEN WAS BUILT METICULOUSLY

THE INGREDIENTS WERE CHOSEN LOVINGLY
​
OUR STORY ABOUT LOVE OF PIZZA’S UNFOLDS DAILY

Owners Jacob and Sit created their story on the first day they met. Jacob was meant to have an interview for Sit’s Event business, Eventologists, but instead he got his car stuck in a muddy field and Sit went to the rescue.

name: Westlands BBQ
desc:
Westlands Catering is a family-run business dedicated to delivering exceptional food experiences for events of all sizes. We offer a range of mobile catering units designed to suit different venues and requirements.
Our Specialties

Slow-Smoked Meats
We specialise in premium beef and pork, slow-smoked to perfection and served on a bed of crispy fries.

name: The Jolly Hog
desc: The Jolly Hog are a small family business from Bristol who run several catering trailers including a large Airstream trailer.

name: La Petite Ferme Street Food
desc:
La Petite Ferme is a cozy Bistro & Wine Bar, showcasing traditional recipes, made passionately with artisanal produce.  We've been established since 2015 and we are well known for our service and food quality. 

We offer all types of catering event, from large corporate to smaller private ones. Our specialities is French cuisine & wines.

name: Open Sesame
desc:
Background: Hi! We are Chris & Claire of Open Sesame. 
We are classically trained chefs who are making a new, modern kind of kebab, fusing flavours from the Middle East and around the world with our own low ‘n slow smoking and BBQ techniques, spice rubs and hand crafted sauces.
 
Food Ethos: We only use the best, local ingredients, native breed meat, and make everything from scratch, on site every…

name: PIEROGI COMPANY LTD
desc:
We started our business in south London in 2007 as a small manufacturer of Polish food specialities specializing in famous Polish dumplings called PIEROGI.
Since then we sell:
-Our own hand-made Polish pierogi dumplings with different fillings (meat, vegetarian and vegan).

name: Al Chickone
desc:
Al Chickone serve some of London’s best buttermilk fried chicken, dusted in a secret blend of herbs and spices and then fried to golden perfection!

The team created the idea for Al Chickone whilst holding a sugar waffle cone and wondering what they could put in there. The rest is history.

name: Mumbai Mix
desc:
The story behind Mumbai Mix 
Mumbai Mix is a street food business specialising in vegan and vegetarian Indian food that. It is run by a food-loving team of mother and two daughters - Mohini, Deshna and Dimple. Mumbai Mix was founded by Deshna in 2014 who at the time was working as a business analyst and was made redundant from her job.

name: Pizza Polizia
desc:
Riding in style with our bespoke Tuk Tuk and armed with a wood fired, stone based ceramic oven we are fully equipped to add some panache to your event.
 
Specialising in Neapolitan style pizza with a traditional focaccia base. We partner with local farmers and food producers to deliver some mouth watering toppings with a low carbon foot print.

name: Crudo Cevicheria
desc: Crudo Cevicheria is London’s first build-your-own Cevicheria. A husband and wife team from Miami, who after moving to London missed having Ceviche and realised it was only available in London’s high-end restaurants.

name: Hungry Hog BBQ
desc:
Hungry Hog BBQ proudly offer fantastic catering services for your personal or business needs! They specialise in hog roasts, a British classic that always goes down well at events, as well as delicious BBQ food.

They can, however, offer much more than that and they are more than willing to explore options and ideas with you.

name: kreame
desc:
We make our own traditional fudge and confectionary using locally sourced Ingredients.

This is a serious bit – even fudge folk can be grown up when they need to be. And we’re clear about Our Purpose – it’s Making Life Sweeter – making nice things and making things nicer for all along the way. Just like Jim taught us.

name: Wangz
desc:
Welcome to Wangz, with our secret ingredient and unique cooking style we have created a blend of fine dining & comfort food unlike anything else on the market.
Our philosophy of food is that no corners should be cut and everybody deserves the highest quality of produce, preparation and presentation.

name: What’s on the menu ish
desc: What’s On The Menu Ish? was created to bring a fresh, modern twist to the traditional Caribbean food scene, while staying true to the rich flavors and culture of authentic island staples.

name: Rusty's - 'Food Made With LOVE'
desc:
Rusty's Food Made with Love, is a passion of ours. And we truly doing this with all of our hearts. 
Our vegan trailer serving up delicious homemade Middle Eastern cuisine and phenomenal triple-cooked French fries.

Rusty's Food Made with Love is a one-of-a-kind food trailer that has quickly become a go-to spot for foodies and vegans alike.

name: Jbtreatcarts
desc: At JBtreatcarts, we pride ourselves on providing an exceptional experience that is not only delicious but also visually stunning.

name: Homeland Hunan
desc:
My Homeland is a province named Hunan, located central south of China, an area famous for its spicy chillies, tangy pickles and smokey meats - the explosion of flavours in Hunan cuisine is guaranteed to get your taste buds tingling!
My grandma often looked after me as a kid, and my best memory from growing up has to be coming home from school to the smell of her cooking.

name: Dugans
desc:
DUGAN’S is a London-based BBQ and street food business specialising in high-quality food, great flavour and generous portions. Our BBQ is cooked over an open fire, giving our food an authentic grilled taste and a unique experience for guests.

We offer a selection of BBQ dishes including chicken and pork skewers, sausages, ribs, fresh salads and homemade sauces.

name: Claw
desc: Shellfish maestros CLAW started life slinging crab rolls at markets 2015, with the mission of encouraging Londoners to eat more crab and other British seafood so they could appreciate its true brilliance.

name: Rendang and Rice
desc: Hello, I'm Jasmin and I run a small independent street food business in Camden, London called 'Rendang + Rice'. My dream has always been to own a food business where I can create a platform for my family's incredible Indonesian recipes. We specialise in high quality, authentic Indonesian food - the rendang curry is my grandma's recipe!

name: Nan's Van & Kitchen
desc:
The Nan’s Van & Kitchen team pride themselves on their freshly prepared, home-cooked food served from a very cool converted 1970s Rice Horsebox. They can produce a variety of different menus, cuisines, main meals and desserts. 

Where possible, the team like to work with clients to design their menu.

name: Sussex Chef
desc: The brilliant Sussex Chef use only the finest ingredients available to them to serve up some of the most delicious event food around.

name: The Wandering Yak
desc:
The Wandering Yak is an award-winning street food truck based in Cambridge with a focus on serious flavour, delivered using fresh and vibrant ingredients inspired by the delicious flavours of the Middle East!

They do street food - and fast food - differently, going (far) beyond just meat in a bun.

name: Dope Birdz
desc:
Home of the dopest Chicken & Hip Hop, Dope Birdz are distributing some of the most unique and illicit flavas in the game!

From wings, chicken & waffles, ribs, halal and vegan options...we've got something for everyone!

Having been awarded a Great Taste Award 2021 for our Cuban Link (Jalapeno Mojito) Sauce and WingJam 2021 2nd Place for Most Unique and Delicious Wings, Dope Birdz are looking to s…

name: Punk Tacos
desc:
Punk Tacos serve fresh Mexican street food from their uber cool vintage Renault van. It's the perfect taqueria on wheels! Their food takes inspiration from the bold and fresh flavours of Mexico. They’ve lovingly recreated original Mexican recipes while adding their very own ‘punk’ take.

They cater for all events including weddings, corporate events, celebrations and festivals.

name: Carne
desc:
CARNE offer traditional and, not to mention, absolutely delicious Mexican tacos! They serve their traditional street food in the style of a ‘taqueria’ found in the heart of Mexico City. 

Their selection of tacos range from their signature pork ‘al pastor’ taco to their delicious ancho mushroom taco, all served with soft corn tortillas and homemade red salsas.

name: TNT Mexican
desc:
TNT Mexican, is proud to bring to the Street Food, authentic Mexican flavours. Cooking from scratch every time, the freshness can be tasted in every bite, from our Burritos, Tacos, Quesadillas and Boxes. 

Charles believes in serving only great-quality, local British produce. and takes immense pride in the provenance of his dishes.

name: Juice Junkiez & Rice
desc: Juice Junkiez & rice is a family run business that has been quenching thirsts and filling bellys since 2017. We originally started out going to food exhibitions and festivals (eg.

name: Meat & Greet
desc: Meat & Greet has been trading at music festivals and sporting events since 2013. Our goal has always been twofold. To create and serve the best burger experience and to do it from cool looking vans and trailers. Our brand new addition is a bespoke build from Amobox, the UK's leading manufacturer in this space.

name: Burger & Beyond
desc: Essex-born and London-based, we’re a burger truck turned raved-about restaurant in the heart of Shoreditch. To find the perfect patty, we drew inspiration from burger joints all over the world, from London to Miami, Vegas to LA, Berlin to NYC.

name: Fired
desc: Fired is a mobile catering company based near Sheffield. We're a Father & Son team, specialising in Neapolitan inspired pizza. We set up just before the first lockdown in March 2020 and with the easing of restrictions, our business has gone from strength to strength over the past 12 months.

name: La Grotta Pizza Truck
desc:
Ciao

My name is Andrea and I am the owner of La Grotta Pizza Truck, my mobile pizzeria & restaurant. I am one of the only 100% Italian owned and operated food businesses in the south west. We started life as the first ever pizzeria/trattoria to open in Bristol in the early 1980’s called La Grotta.

Why choose us to cater for your event?

name: Dough LoCo
desc: We're a family run business with both a restaurant and an events stall. We have some of the best Pizzaiolo's working for us and they know how to bang out some wicked pizza... they can even put on a dough spinning show for you! We use authentic ingredients and make all our dough in house..

name: Nanizi's
desc:
We go by the name 'Nanizi's' which means 'Grandma's' in Bengali. We specialize in street food business, corporate lunches as well as private catering events. 

We offer traditional home-made Bangladeshi food adapted to the setting of the food service. Our street food offering comprises of rice bowls and flaky paratha wraps, while our corporate lunches offer a sit-down eating style.

name: Caper & Berry Pizza Defender
tagline: Wood Fired Pizza Served From a Land Rover
desc: Looking for something a bit different? Caper & Berry offer a range of extras that promise to make your event unforgettable. They are perfect for weddings, parties, and corporate events! The Caper & Berry wood fired country Land Rover defender has been converted into a stone baked pizza oven.

name: Pancrepes
desc: We are a mobile French creperie based in the South west of England, serving up a deliciously modern take on the traditional French classic. Owned by twin brothers Jake and Tom, and established in 2012. Our main goal from the start was to take crepes to the next level.

name: Bonne Franquette
desc: Making an impression at an event starts with the food. Yann chooses not to follow trends, instead creating his own style of elevated plates inspired by his French heritage and brought up to date for modern dining. Working with exclusive concierge services and catering for a maximum of 50 guests at a time allows him to focus on sustainability and quality.

name: Purbeck Ice Cream
desc: Multi award winning Purbeck Ice Cream is made on our farm overlooking Corfe Castle on the Isle of Purbeck; using fresh Purbeck milk, thick Dorset double cream, British sugar and an abundance of only the best natural ingredients.

name: The bok shop
desc: Brightons finest fried chicken, started in 2016 through the need for better chicken wings in Brighton. We produce everything ourselves. The breader that coats our chicken is blended fresh everyday with the purest flour and rich mix of herbs and spice's,  as is all our sauces. The sauces are made from fresh delicious ingredients and honed to perfection by our specialist sauce chef.

name: Berkeley Streets
desc:
From Kitchens to Community: The Story Behind Our Food Trailer
After years of building five successful restaurants in Ashbourne and London, our passion for food, and for people, has only grown stronger. Each of our restaurants carries its own identity, shaped by the creativity and commitment of our incredible teams. But we wanted to take things a step further.
This year, we hit the road.

name: From The Ashes BBQ
desc: Three chefs who from the impact of the corona virus and then lockdown, were left unemployed. We came together and thought why not do something we are passionate about together?

name: Livity Plant-Based Cuisine
desc:
Livity Plant-Based Cuisine is run by identical twins and professional chefs Kareema and Kaleema. With over 10 years professional experience, the twins took inspiration from classic Jamaican dishes to begin their own vegan business. 

Based in South London, the team specialise in Ital cuisine - completely vegan, whole-food Caribbean favourites.

name: Pheonix Crew Catering Ltd
desc: Hi im Ste and im new the the streetfood scene ive been a Chef for 30 years at major event such as CHELTENHAM GOLD CUP, ROYAL ASCOT , EPSOM DERBY, OPEN GOLF, MILLENNIUM STADIUM, GOODWOOD FOS & REVIVAL RACECAR & RACECOURSE EVENTS EVERTON FC FOR 3 YEARS AS  lead chef and the M&S BANK ARENA IVE BEEN WORKING MASSIVE EVENTS FOR THE LAST 16YEARS AT ALL THESE PLACES AND DECIDED TO GO OUT ON MY OWN WITH TH…

name: Yaay Yaay
tagline: say Yaay to everyday Thai food
desc:
Yaay Yaay is what happens when passionate food lovers get together and decide to share their talents with the world. Everything is made fresh and ready to take on the go at your convenience.

The essence of Thai food is all about balance – achieving the perfect harmony between sweet, sour, hot and salty.

name: Almada Portuguese Bakery
desc: Our mission is to create amazing quality Portuguese sweet and savoury food using exclusive recipes developed by us, a husband and wife team of bakers.

name: Le Chalet
desc:
Le Chalet is an Alpine seasonal street food business from Cheeky Catering, the guys behind Cheeky Burger and Papi Chulo . 

Introducing Le Chalet, the epitome of alpine street food cuisine, specializing in mouthwatering raclette and fondue bowls paired with delectable grilled smoked sausages.

name: Paisley Flour Catering
desc: At Paisley Flour, we believe that every work or life event deserves to be celebrated with food that feels as special as the occasion itself.

name: BEEF ON THE BLOCK
desc:
BEEF ON THE BLOCK was born out of a love for good quality steak and for the street food industry. Their mission is simple: to make well sourced and quality Steak and Chips for the people of the Midlands.

Regardless of the nature of the event, all of their beef is sourced from the award-winning, official supplier to the Royal Family; Aubrey Allen, their chips are all hand-cut potatoes from Lower B…

name: Urban Indian
desc: Urban Indian - From the heartland with love. Urban Indian takes Indian street food to new levels, smoke, spice and love combine to create fragrant Indian staples.

name: Ninjō Noodle Bar
desc:
Ninjō Noodle Bar has been serving freshly cooked Asian street food at local street markets, festivals, weddings and events since 2012. 

Our team is inspired by the desire to create healthier, Wok Fresh dishes that are full of flavour and appeal to those who appreciate quality, unique ingredients and the flexibility to have their meal cooked just for them.

name: Dumpling Shack
desc:
Since 2014, the amazing Dumpling Shack have been taking the capital by storm with their outrageously delicious dumplings! They use only the freshest ingredients have now unsurprisingly created a loyal following at Broadway Market and on social media.

They completely hand-make their utterly brilliant tasting dumplings that also look utterly divine and cook them up right in front of your guests.

name: The Cheesecake Bar
desc:
The Cheesecake Bar by Cheshire cheesecakes offers a unique cheesecake experience in allowing clients to get involved with the making of their very own cheesecake.

With their amazing biscuit wall, each guest will be able to fill their own pot from a selection of 10 different biscuit bases including custard creams, Oreos, chocolate chip cookies and more.

name: Greek expectations
desc: Established in 1997, we are a family run business that serves amazing Greek Cypriot cuisine, catering for meat, vegetarian and vegan palettes.  We have worked all across the country at a variety of events from weddings to anniversaries, Glastonbury to The Boat Race.

name: Toastie
desc:
My name is Lucy and I run TOASTIE, a small, family-run street food business that has been serving freshly grilled cheese toasties at festivals and outdoor events for over 20 years.

We would love to be considered as a food trader for your event.

At Toastie, we’re passionate about serving simple, delicious food made with quality ingredients.

name: MEXCLUB
desc:
We are mexican company bringing the authentic mexican flavours.
Our name is Mexclub and we been trading for 5 years in festivals, markets, private events, wedding and different kind of events. We do one of the best tacos in london and we love to share our culture and authentic flavours.
We not only make tacos, we do as well tortas, flautas, pozole and all kind mexican food.

name: STRAWBS
desc:
We sell locally grown, hand picked, fresh Cornish strawberries presented in a combustable cup covered in luxury Belgian chocolate.

The chocolate is melted using a special machine which pumps the chocolate out of a tap right in front of the customers eyes which they love to watch.

We also offer cups of marshmallows as well as a special (and delicious) Dubai chocolate strawberries.

name: Plant the Seed
desc:
We are Plant the Seed - we make incredible vegan food, not just for vegans!

We started as a sandwich delivery service, bringing joy to our neighbours by bikes during the first lockdown, and we got such an overwhelmingly good response that we never stopped!

name: The Jerk Pit
desc: We take you straight to the streets of Kingston with an authentic Jamaican street food experience, our succulent jerk chicken is marinated for 24 hours then smoked on our jerk bbq for maximum flavour. We offer sides such as traditional rice n’ peas, mango salsa, purple slaw and more!

name: Chacarero London
desc:
We are a family-run business born from a simple idea: to connect with our community through something that was missing — authentic, high-quality Argentine food. 

What started as a small idea grew through online orders and local farmers’ markets, where the response from the community showed us we were onto something special.

name: Welsh Italian Pizza Co
desc:
Authentic hand made neapolitan pizzas from our wood fired pizza oven. We cater functions, events & celebrations.

Based in South Wales and covering Swansea, Bridgend, Rhondda, Newport, Cardiff, Torfaen, Monmouthshire and the Vale of Glamorgan and further. We have catered for events across the UK and Europe.

name: Oyster & Caviar Meister
desc:
If you are looking for something truly memorable with a certain ‘Wow’ factor to add to your party or event; Oyster & Caviar Meister offers a unique and theatrical culinary experience!

They have Oyster Meister, the original wandering service. They will mingle amongst your guests shucking, dressing and serving the finest oysters available.

name: Squid Inc.
desc: Megan has a passion for simple, fresh, tasty food. Joe has a passion for deep fried calamari. Together, they run Squid Inc.

name: The Cheese Truck
desc:
The beautiful Cheese Truck is dedicated to celebrating all that’s amazing about British cheese. They work closely with their producers, sourcing all their good stuff direct from UK-based farms making cheese in a traditional and thoughtful way.

Their aim is to share their delicious food (the grilled cheese sandwiches are genuinely some of the most amazing things we’ve ever tasted) with as many peo…

name: Urban Yak
desc:
From the foothills of the mighty Himalayas to the vibrant streets of London, Urban Yak are an authentic Nepalese-Tibetan street food company with their own unique twist.

Everyone has heard of the Himalayas and the mystique it holds, and for those who go their adventure normally starts in Kathmandu, the enchanting capital of Nepal.

name: PIG OUT
desc:
PIG OUT is bringing saucy, succulent and downright delicious hotdogs to events and festivals around the UK. 

Their menu focuses on a range of internationally themed hotdogs and fries, think toppings like truffle mac and cheese, crunchy Katsu curry, or in homage to German sausage kings - lashings of sauerkraut and gherkin. No matter how you like your dogs, Pig out has you covered.

name: Flanco Pizza
desc:
Welcome to Flanco Pizza where everything is handmade from our delicious tangy pizza bases to our beloved converted horsebox design making pizza dreams come true!

Get beamed up and transported to the land of 🍕 at your wedding or private event this summer.

Choose the classic Flanco Pizza menu or even design your own!
We hope you'll love our hand-painted converted horsebox trailer that add a real t…

name: Bites Tours
desc:
Bites Tours specialises in small group and private food tours in London, Manchester and Liverpool. 
We support locally owned businesses as we take our guests on walking and eating tours around some of our favourite spots.
Sharing stories and tales about the areas we explore and enjoying delicious dishes as we go. 
Our mission is to make our guests feel a part of the city that they are exploring.

name: Little Blue Pizza
desc: Little Blue Coffee and Pizza is a catering company based in Bath in England's Somerset region. This team specialises in handmade Neapolitan-style pizzas cooked to perfection in a woodfired oven. At the heart of their business is a much-beloved vintage 1960s horsebox trailer.

name: The Gentleman Smoker
desc: Our mobile BBQ Smoke House specializes in smoked food, cooked at a temperature of 120°C over ash charcoal and wood, resulting in a deliciously moist dish that melts in the mouth.

name: Whipped
desc:
Here at Whipped, we pride ourselves in using the best quality seasonal produce from local suppliers. Offering luxury soft serve ice cream, flavoured with the best produce that Cornwall has to offer and adorned with hand crafted sauces and confectionary!

Whipped specialises in soft serve sundaes like our spring-time favourite, the Lemon & Rhubarb; Lemon Curd soft serve, Rhubarb Sauce, Sponge Finge…

name: Prime Thyme Kitchen
desc:
Independent Street Food Trailer and Van available.

5 years experience of delivering high quality menus at events such as large scale festivals, corporate lunches, sporting events and weddings.

Our Van was designed with intimate gigs in mind - whether that's a corporate lunch, your wedding or any other special event, our chefs would speak with you and plan a bespoke menu for your day with your sp…

name: Ceylon Kothu
desc: Here at Ceylon Kothu we make unique and famous Sri Lankan street food. For example we serve the best and the most famous Sri Lankan street food on the streets Kothu Parotta. Also we serve devil rolls and parotta with curry which are authentic to Sri Lanka. After working in Sri Lanka i decided to bring out the flavours of Sri Lanka to the world so thats why I started Ceylon Kothu.

name: Neapori Pizza Ltd
desc:
Neapori Pizza is a unique food catering company, specialising in high end Neapolitan pizza with East-Asian inspired fusion flavours.

We are a small friendly team- with a passion for serving good food. Our background stems from serving pizza in our bricks and mortar pizzeria, perfecting our product for over 2 years.

name: Oatopia Events Limited
desc: At Oatopia, we’re all about simple, feel-good food made fresh every day. From expertly brewed barista coffee and warming bowls of porridge to our handmade artisan flapjacks and golden sourdough toasties, everything is crafted to keep you going. We also blend fresh smoothies packed with real ingredients – perfect for a boost on the move.

name: Benissimo
desc: Welcome, we're Ben and James, owners of Benissimo. We offer fresh, stone-baked pizzas. Based in Norfolk, we provide a unique mobile pizza catering service that is perfect for weddings, birthdays, corporate events, and more.

name: Tigellae
desc: Welcome to Tigellae’s travelling trattoria! They offer professional, bespoke mobile catering and bar services from Manchester and beyond, serving traditional Italian dishes.

name: Mangia Pasta & Burger
desc:
Mangia Pasta & Burger 
It was born from the Italian Chef founder's passion for the food and  is the fusion between Italian & American culture . Base in London we use just Best Ingredients to make our dishes . We stick with the tradition . We Offer catering  and private event with our mix of dishes from starter to dessert .

name: Habibi’s
desc:
Habibi’s serve beautiful, nutritious and delicious Middle Eastern street food with the intention that good food is always all-inclusive and brings people together. 

Habibi’s was born after their founder Tess wanted to share her love of Middle Eastern street food. All of Habibi’s menu is either vegetarian or vegan with flavour combinations that are indulgent but also bright and healthy.

name: Swegan Kitchen
desc: Swegan Kitchen is a family run business, we provide Scandinavian inspired vegan street food. Expect traditional street food staples with a Scandinavian twist as well as some Swedish street food classics.

name: Mozzarellanation
desc: After travelling through Italy, the team returned with a desire to recreate the amazing tastes and experiences that they had discovered in Italy.

name: Le Coq
desc:
Le Coq is a family run business that was born back in 2020 after decades in working within the food and hospitality industry.
We pride with our high quality and exquisite menu which is always cooked to absolute perfection and served with a smile. Our meals have always been the rumour of each event we have catered for. Along with the buttermilk fried chicken we offer options for vegetarians.

name: Dessert Royalty
desc:
Dessert Royalty is a high-impact dessert brand delivering indulgent, crowd-pleasing treats at scale. Our menu features made-to-order crêpes, warm cookie dough, iced coffee, premium milkshakes, french toast, fruit refreshers, and chocolate-covered strawberries—alongside inclusive vegan, gluten-free, and halal options so everyone can be part of the experience.

Founded and operated by a husband-and-…

name: Burger Theory
desc:
Burger Theory has over 8 years of experience in serving their incredibly original and juicy burgers at major outdoor events, weddings and private parties, offering an entire menu dedicated to delicious Vegan alternatives.

The idea was born in 2012 when the team burst onto Bristol’s street food scene with small festivals and pop-up restaurants.

name: The Dough Shack
desc:
We are The Dough Shack, a food truck company operating in Surrey and Southwest London. We specialize in wood-fired pizzas, and we pride ourselves on our ability to serve high-quality food quickly and efficiently.

We are excited about the opportunity to participate in Festivals throughout 2025.

name: Poptails by LAPP
desc: Poptails by LAPP was born during Spring 2016. The team started out in London and now are the very first brand of gourmet-cocktail-sorbets that is now available in France and the UK!

name: JERK NATION
desc:
• We are an American bbq smoke house inspired street food company with a twist of Jerk.
Specializing in smoked boneless chicken and bay back pork ribs, all done in our authentic and homemade jerk rub and marinades.
• We smoke our meats on the Traeger pellet fed smoker and finish on the chargrill Komodo ceramic egg. 
• Our chicken is Halal friendly!

name: The Peppered Pig
desc:
The Peppered Pig are a mobile catering trailer serving gourmet burgers are made with 6oz patties that are handmade at our local butchers. 

In their range of food, they have a choice of steak, steak & chilli, lamb & mint, chicken & lime and pork & apple.

name: Petit Bou
desc: Petit Bou is the grab-and-go extension of Monsieur Bou, bringing high-quality, flavour-packed food to busy professionals and workplaces.

name: Weirdough Pizza
desc:
Weirdough Pizza deliver the perfect catering experience for your event or special day with their delicious wood-fired pizza! 

After living in Italy and falling in love with their famous cuisine, Weirdough’s founder Claire decided to convert a horsebox and kit it out with a pizza oven.

name: SPQR PIZZA
desc: SPQR Pizza brings a whole new concept of Pizza, based on the old tradition of Rome. In the Italian capital, it's very common to find thin and crispy pizza, but in London is not like that.

name: Churros Susanna
desc:
Churros Susanna is a family run, mobile street food business, who has specialised in authentic churros and chocolate. we have handmade, cooked and served our treats to the masses for over 15 years, with the perfected recipe being passed down for centuries.

Our churros and chocolate are vegetarian, vegan without the chocolate and always cooked with love (just like our grandmother always did).

name: The Patty Truck
desc:
The Patty Truck - the first of it's kind bringing the finest Jamaican Patties to all your events, weddings and festivals all over the UK.

This unique street food truck provides delicious, flakey Jamaican patties with a variety of fillings. 

The Patty Truck Team are passionate about what they do and committed to maintaining the very highest food service standards.

name: The Bon Vivant Events Company Ltd
desc:
After several years in the mobile bar industry, The Bon Vivant moved over to catering in 2023. Starting with our Crumble stand we brought something unique and new to the festival scene with our Sweet and Savoury Crumbles.
After a successful first year we upgraded our set up to the stunning airstream trailer we use today. We also introduced out second stand Hash Brown Town!

name: Kouei
desc:
We are interested to do the festivals. In the past, we traded at the secret garden party, standon calling, bst hyde park, bbc2 radio, hyper Japan, we out here festival, love box, and street food market around London.
We have been doing this for last 15years. Selling authentic Japanese food from festival pitches. 
We have a good reviews.

name: Texas Smoker
desc: Having travelled extensively in the United States, with immediate family based in the South for over 30 years, we realised that the UK needed some American influence on food at festivals and events.

name: Lalita's
desc:
At Lalita’s, we specialise in delicious vegan and gluten-free Keralan (South Indian) street food. We are committed to promoting health and sustainability in every aspect of our food and operations. 
All our dishes are vegan and gluten-free, supporting a wide range of dietary needs and contributing to overall wellbeing.

name: Pronto Pizza
desc: Pronto Pizza is a Neapolitan style pizza truck hailing from Edinburgh, Scotland. We offer hand stretched, sourdough pizzas cooked fresh in our Ooni Pizza Ovens. Coming from an Italian background, it was only natural for founder, Michael Notarangelo, to launch a pizza concept alongside his other successful street food ventures.

name: Jollof Mama
desc:
Jollof Mama specialises in Modern Nigerian Street Food, we use traditional ingredients to create authentic flavours with a modern twist. 

We have a lot of  experience in delivering services for corporate events, office pop ups, festivals  and special occasions.   

We have catered for many leading brands and organisations such as ASOS, Goldman Sachs, Bank Of England, Nike, Sony and many more.

name: The Big Melt
desc:
The Big Melt was founded by cheese loving sisters, Sonya & Nikki, who are currently melting hearts across London with their mouthwatering toasties!

They serve utterly delicious grilled cheese toasties using only the best of British produce - mature cheddar cheese that comes directly from their producer's family farm in Somerset and bread that’s specially baked for them by a local artisan baker in…

name: Parc'd Up
desc:
Parc’d Up serve their fantastic food from their bright and colourful Parc'd Up Caterpod! They are experts at catering for guests with dietary requirements and can cater for gluten-free, vegan and vegetarian in their menus.

All of the ingredients they use are sourced locally and prepared in their store according to your requirements and choices.

name: Stacked Burgers
tagline: Chuck Steak Burgers With Unique Twists
desc: Stacked Burgers are a handmade, chuck steak burger company trading on Brick Lane and at events across the country.

name: Taco Mo
desc: Hi , my name is Lorenzo Maderas formally head chef at Sushisamba. Started my own business during lockdown. Taco Mo is a street food, offering different types of flavourful tacos.

name: Country Bumpkins Catering
desc:
Fresh, Hearty, Homemade Food Made Easy For All Events Big and Small!

Country Bumpkins Catering is a unique mobile catering business offering excellent quality dishes made from locally sourced and home grown produce!
We are able to cater for all events big & small and offer bespoke menus of your choice to make your event or party the best one yet!

A range of our most popular dishes we provide inc…

name: Pyala Kebab Roll
desc:
Pyala Kebab Roll provide the best quality food in the quickest time possible. They serve fresh authentic Pakistani street food in the form of a Paratha Kebab Roll which is a hand-rolled, lightly fried bread served with a filling, such as chicken or lamb, and topped with delicious traditional sauces and salads.

Pyala Kebab Roll serve some seriously tasty Pakistani food including their ridiculously…

name: Barnyard Birds
desc:
Barnyard Birds is a beautifully restored roaming street food van that serves some of the best locally sourced chicken and duck around! They have taken their kitchen to the streets in the back of a converted and seriously cool 1979 Renault Estafette van.

The team were all tired of working kitchens and craved something slightly different.

name: The Forest Boost
desc: I, Alessandra, have spent years trading at markets and food festivals, which led me to launch The Forest Boost, a healthy eating and drinking business heavily influenced by Brazilian culture.

name: Banging Burritos
desc: At Banging Burritos we have the best Cali-Mex food the UK festival circuit has to offer! An array of freshly prepared salads, sauces & chillis served in a variety of meal options - providing delicious goods for any taste/dietary requirements.

name: Motu Indian Kitchen
desc:
Brought to you from the mastermind team behind Michelin-starred Gymkhana, Trishna and the award-winning Hoppers, Motu Indian Kitchen serve up some of the most indulgent and original Indian food you’ll ever taste.

Motu, which translates to ‘Fat Man’ in Hindi, was set up by the Sethi siblings, who’ve put their own spin on British Indian classics, such as the phenomenal ‘Kashmiri Lamb Shank Roganjos…

name: Sicilian Donkey Pizza
desc: We are a small, family-run business offering a quality and cost-effective mobile catering service. Our chef, Umberto, is a professional chef from Sicily who has over 20 years experience in restaurant kitchens and as a private chef. During lockdown he developed our unique and acclaimed sourdough pizza base.

name: JSD Catering
desc: We are a family-run mobile catering business built on a shared love of great food and bringing people together. What started as cooking for friends and family quickly grew into a passion for serving the wider community. Our team is made up of close relatives who each bring their own skills, personality and energy, creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere wherever we go.

name: Street Crepes
desc:
After over 10 years baking and cooking in fine dining restaurants, two cosmopolitan chefs are ready to take part in a new exciting chapter which will see them preparing savoury galettes, sweet crepes, desserts and much more with a smile.

Our savoury pancakes are naturally vegan and gluten free, and we fill them with freshly cooked seasonal products.

name: Wild Street Kitchen
desc:
It’s not just the taste of the food we serve up that sets Wild Street Kitchen apart, but the quality of the ingredients we source.

We're a street food business using wild and foraged produce.

name: Salt + Smoke
desc: Salt + Smoke specialises in traditional dishes cooked over fire. Focusing on local produce prepared and plated in front of your guests Salt + Smoke showcase rustic but refined dishes. With a passion in both the farming and catering world, Ben, founder and chef, harnesses fire as the fuel for food at your event. This includes Asado lamb, spit roast pork as well as flame licked vegetarian dishes.

name: Spaghetti Sisters
desc:
USP and what we do

Spaghetti Sisters is an authentic fresh pasta stall; we use the best, local and free-range ingredients to make our pasta and sauces fresh on site. We took inspiration for our stall from fresh pasta parlours in Italy, and allow customers to choose their preferred pasta and their favourite sauce.

name: Jerk Junction
desc: Jerk Junction is a Manchester-based Caribbean food business providing street food and catering for public events, private bookings, and corporate clients.

name: Bad Boy Pizza
desc:
BBPS. FAMILY ROOTS. BAD BOYS BY NAME, GREAT LADS BY NATURE.

Bad Boy Pizza Society started back in Southampton in 2018. We set out to review pizzerias and gain exclusive discounts for ourselves and our friends by booking out resturants. In doing so, what began as a joke, quickly became a fully-fledged passion.

name: Bone Daddies
desc:
We opened the first Bone Daddies ramen joint back in 2012 on Peter St in Soho. London. Serving up hot homemade broth, fit noodles and fried chicken. We’ve grown a bit since then but what we’re all about hasn’t changed at all – real Rock ‘n’ Roll ramen.

We keep it honest and make our food from scratch to ensure it’s the highest quality – we don’t compromise on that, ever.

name: Monsta Pizza
desc:
Monsta Pizza serves hand-made, hot and original pizza using their own perfected sourdough recipe. 

Monsta Pizza is a collaboration between two dads - a pizza chef named Chris and a creative named Chris. It’s more than just another pizza place, it’s a concept created out of a frustration for the lack of imagination and quality for hungry, bored families.

name: Ben & Jerry's Ice Cream
desc:
Ben & Jerry's believes business has a responsibility to give back to the community. We make the best possible ice cream in the nicest way possible. 

What makes us special is the people dedicated to making sure every scoop of Ben & Jerrys delivers a tastebud-boggling odysseys great enough to take you all the way to the state of euphoria. Every time.

name: Truffle Burger
desc:
Our aim is to elevate the humble burger to a higher state of deliciousness! 
In the four years since starting out, we have grown to three permeant sites in Central London, regular semi permanent public event pop ups such as a summer long alfresco restaurant on the Southbank, and an offering at Winter Wonderland and of course a solid roster of festivals.

name: The Burger Truck
desc: The Burger Truck was born in 2020. We smash our burgers using dry aged beef from Meat Matters who supply to only a handful of burger restaurants, street food vendors and are very selective on the end user he chooses.

name: Pulled
desc: To Pulled, perfection means taking things nice and slow. They take British Free Range meats and roast them on a low heat, for a long, long (long) time.

name: London Catering Services
desc:
No summer is complete without a traditional ice cream van.  

The iconic British Ice Cream van is known throughout the world as the epitome of summer.  Serving up delicious scoops, lollies and soft ice cream to one and all.

We do Ice Cream the Cornish way.  Following the same processes and methods since 1930 the ice cream is continued to be made the same way for almost 100 years.

name: Victoria’s Ice Cream Cart
desc:
Victoria’s luxury Ice Cream Carts, are the perfect addition to your event if you are looking for something unique. 

You can enjoy an unlimited amount of ice cream for 2 hours, with choice of up-to 6 flavours of real dairy ice cream.

name: The Pizza Project
desc: Let The Pizza Project bring a slice of happiness to your event. Right before your eyes, their expertly trained chefs will hand-stretch, prepare, cook, slice and serve up delicious Neapolitan style pizzas onto stylish, rustic chopping boards at your event.

name: B.Tap Baron
desc:
We are a much loved restaurant in central Cambridge and was founded in 2017.

We have had a great success with the University of Cambridge MayBalls and are now catering for large scale events including BBQs, canapes as well as smaller more intimate affairs.

name: Veli'cious
desc: I’m Costi, the chef behind Veli’cious – a family-run food trailer built on my love for proper food and years of experience in the kitchen. After more than two decades working in restaurants, I wanted something of my own, where I could focus on quality and spend more time with my family.

name: Rodeo Doughnuts
desc:
Howdy y'all! We're so glad you found us!
Since 2017, we’ve been creating, decorating and delivering great tasting doughnuts!
Rodeo Doughnuts are handcrafted doughnuts with quirky names inspired by celebrities. All our doughnuts are made in our dedicated doughnut bakery and sold in-store or online. Six core doughnut flavours are accompanied by a changing menu of weekly and seasonal specials.

name: Don Luigi
desc:
Hailing from the tiny region of Molise, owners Maria Mugnano and Alessio De Laureto have brought some of the areas' best-loved dishes to the capital, introducing Londoners to a brand new taste of Italy and it is going down an absolute storm!

Fried Calamari is Don Luigi’s signature dish (and our absolute favourite) and is served piping hot with a drizzle of lemon juice.

name: Chapati Man
desc: Chapati Man was created by husband and wife team, Chris and Andrea, back in 2007. The idea came when Chris took some leftover curry in a wrap to work and realised just how much potential there was behind it.

name: Waffle On
desc:
Officially speaking, the amazing Waffle On produce no less than London’s very best waffle! So say the Evening Standard and here at Togather towers we can certainly back that up.

Founded back in 2012 by the amazing Eddie Ruffett, these guys have been reminding us that waffles are the ultimate when it comes to comfort food.

name: Nazari
desc:
A delicious fusion of middle eastern and Mediterranean flavours. So Moorish!

Al-Andalus Moorish street food. Emphasis on natural, organic produce, sourced locally wherever possible.

name: No Frickin Chicken
desc: We are an American style foodie trailer, serving delicious vegan fried 'chicken' and burgers. We rock up at Festivals, such as Download, Isle of Wight Festival, Greenman, Vegan Campout, just to name a few!

name: the butchers bakehouse.
desc:
We are the butchers bakehouse a family run bakery in the heart of St Columb Major. 
We started in covid 2020 in the old butchers. Since opening in 2020 we found that the demand for quality bakes goods was in high demand. Now we have two more branches in Wadebridge and in Porthleven. 

All our goods are handmade by us using traditional techniques and with no artificial chemicals added.

name: Absurd Bird
desc:
'Chicken By Birth, Crazy By Nature', Absurd Bird brings the soul-warming comfort food of the American South to London and beyond. They promise honest grub, good value and a twisted take on Southern classics.

Absurd Bird serves absolutely mouthwateringly-good buttermilk fried chicken either on its own or in a delicious brioche bun.

name: Hey Macaroni
desc:
Gourmet Mac & Cheese with a fun-filled approach to serving customers.

Let’s start with the food… Mac & Cheese is the ultimate comfort food and a firm festival favourite. Fact. At Hey Macaroni, we’ve spent years crafting and honing the perfect recipe (we call it Cheese Science).

name: The Wee Taqueria
desc:
Bringing authentic  Mexican Tacos to the streets of Scotland and beyond in our vintage horse box. Everything is cooked from scratch and found as locally as we can get it!  
We have a background  in working in the arts and hospitality which is the perfect combination for presenting our amazing tacos. 
We are approachable and passionate & care about food and people.

name: Ochsmoke
desc: At Ochsmoke, we are a family run business with a passion for BBQ, specializing in creating home made quality smoked meats. With over a decade of experience working in the busiest kitchens in London, we have honed our skills and perfected our recipes to bring you the very best in smoked BBQ cuisine.

name: Sim's Crepes
desc: Sim's Crepes is a premium dessert trailer serving freshly made French crêpes, Belgian croffles, and Spanish churros, crafted using high-quality ingredients and cooked fresh to order.  Whether you're serving 30 guests or several thousand, our experienced, friendly team provides a professional, reliable service from start to finish.

name: Panzerotto Blues
desc:
Panzerotti are the coolest and most popular Italian street food from Puglia in Southern Italy. In Italy, Panzerotto is popular and trendy because it is a different and original way to eat pizza on the go - you can hold it in one hand and enjoy a beer in the other!

Panzerotti are 10 inches of sourdough made into a delicious pizza pocket.

name: Smoky Gaucho
desc: The brilliant Smoky Gaucho cook up delicious low and slow food, inspired by their homeland of Southern Brazil and 'Gaucho flavours', a traditional term for South American cowboys.

name: Clean Kitchen Club
desc:
Clean Kitchen is on a mission.
 A mission to bring sustainable fast food to the mainstream market by creating cleaner takes on the modern timeless classics such as burgers, healthy nutritious bowls, salads, acai bowls and smoothies.

name: The Scrape
desc: We specialise in beautifully prepared, locally sourced flank steak. Our signature, crowd-pleasing menu features tender, perfectly grilled steak sandwiches and incredibly crispy skin-on loaded fries. What truly sets us apart from the crowd are our vibrant, homemade sauces made completely from scratch—from our fresh, zesty Chimichurri to our rich, velvety hot Peppercorn sauce.

name: Bournville Waffle Company
desc: The Bournville Waffle Company was founded by Jenny and Des in 2013. Since then they have traded at many of the UK’s best festivals and events, selling waffles with unusual toppings from their lovingly restored and converted Mustang caravan. They are available for festivals, street food events and private hire.

name: This Fine Day
desc: Friends and original owners Paul and Rob met way back in the hazy days of the early 90’s working for Prue Leith at Hampton Court Palace.

name: Corn Ribs
desc: Hi , my name is Lorenzo Maderas formally head chef at Sushisamba. Started my own business during lockdown. Corn Ribs is street food, offering different types of flavourful vegan corn ribs.

name: Yum Bug
desc: Yum Bug is a small company, based in North London, that is on a mission to create a more sustainable food system through taking edible insects mainstream. Insects are one of the most sustainable proteins in the world and we believe they can play a big role in our fight against climate change. Yum Bug was started by co-founders Leo and Aaron in Leo's parents' garage cooking up insect recipes.

name: Roasthost
desc: We are a take away Roast Dinner company based in Brighton and have been trading since 2020 - opening just 3 weeks before the first lockdown and still here to tell the tale! We specialise in bringing a perfect roast dinner straight to your door via our delivery partners.

name: Twisted Catering Ltd
desc:
We are a super passionate business who loves serving great food! We've sourced the very best ingredients to produce the best quality product; we only use suppliers that share our values and support local where possible.

We have a few different units but by far our most popular and successful stalls are our Greeks (Greek Street) and our Burger breakfast unit (What’s your Beef), both concepts suppo…

name: Get the Greek
desc:
A bit about us,

Sylwia and I (Alex) are both in the restaurant industry for big brands in Ops roles. We wanted to bring our knowledge and love to something to call our own and with my Greek heritage it seemed a perfect fit.

For years there have been lots of Greek player entering the market but I've never thought they did it justice.

name: Marley’s Flavours
desc: At Marley’s Flavours, we are deeply committed to delivering exceptional service and the highest quality authentic food. We pride ourselves on our “flavours”. Offering a selection of food to suit all audiences, from our signature jerk chicken to heart warming slow cooked specialties like curry mutton, to boneless chicken bites, and vegan options..

name: The kitchen catering company
desc:
We are a family run business that as been working with stadiums, festivals ect for over 30years. 
We pride ourselves on quality of taste and service of our foods.
We always go out of our way to deliver a quality service to customers and client's.
We only ever use branded sauces and would never substitute them for a cheaper branded option.
We travel throughout the UK at major stadiums, including Fo…

name: Keystone Pizzeria
desc: Keystone Pizzeria is a mobile service offering authentic wood-fired pizza. They are an established family business based in Somerset, but their custom-designed Mercedes van allows them to travel and offer their services around the country at weddings, events, private functions and festivals.

name: Doughboyz Ltd
desc:
Hi!

Our names are Alex & Connor and we are "Doughboyz", a couple of best mates based in Epsom, looking forward to feeding your friends and family, and making your event a wild success!

We offer wood fired, fresh to order calzones, pizza and garlic breads (which started as a side dish but after being informed multiple times we make the "best garlic bread in the world", a large portion of our time…

name: Wingmans
desc: Wingmans is a multi award winning chicken wing concept and the UK's first Authentic Wingery. Wingmans specialise in everything chicken with emphasis on the all beloved chicken wing, freshly tossed in one of our award winning signature sauces and accompanied by mouthwatering American style sides.

name: Fodder
desc:
Fodder are a family run business based in Somerset led by the highly Fred Mostyn, a fully trained chef, whose experience spans from Michelin standard restaurants to private households in the UK, Europe and Asia. 

They are a flexible and high-quality catering provider operating from their beautiful vintage Peugeot van however they can also offer catering with a gazebo or from a private kitchen.

name: No.3 Pizza
desc:
Our Story
It all started during the second lockdown in November 2020, a tough time for everybody and with no work in the hospitality sector, Chef Cam was window cleaning to help pay the bills. He missed being in the kitchen, Dad had a huge pizza oven in the garden so we started selling pizzas from our house (No.3) in Walton on Thames.

name: Original Fry Up Material
desc:
Original Fry Up Material is a free-range and fresh vintage food truck, specialising in all day, handmade and high end classics inspired by our love the best of British caff's with a little influence from the bustling diner joints of the US. 

Only the highest quality ingredients treated right.

name: Buffalo Joe's
desc: Buffalo Joe’s specialise in American BBQ food and cook up some of the best of burgers and wings in London.

name: Dog n Bon Street Food
desc: Dog n Bon Street Food brings you the very best gourmet hot dogs, loaded fries and bon bons. What's a bon bon? It's a little deep fried ball of deliciousness, stuffed with a variety of fillings such as haggis or cheese. We have worked hard to source the finest ingredients, we use premium beef frankfurters that we import from Germany to ensure the most authentic flavour.

name: SO41 Catering
desc:
Set up in 2019 SO41 Catering is the brain child of Matt & Lisa Doe and is named after the postcode that we have grown up and lived in for the past 30 plus years. 

Matt's passion is food, with 20 years experience working across many aspects of the industry the highlights being cooking for the royal family at Chelsea Flower Show.

name: Mexitaco
desc: We are an independent street food business specialising in vibrant, authentic Mexican cuisine, built from a passion for bold flavours and fresh ingredients. Our journey began with a simple goal: to bring high-quality, street-style Mexican food to events across the UK.

name: Cake Couple Bakery
desc:
Hi we are Jack and Abby and we have a 5 year old daughter together called Lillie. We have been baking together full time for about 5 years now but Abby has had the business running part time for over 10 years. 
We love to bake new flavours and creations and also meet new people at events. 
Our favourite things to bake are cookie pies and celebration cakes.

name: Mojo Crêpes
desc: Mojo Crêpes allow you to add the authentic French Crêpe experience to your event. Their crêpe mix is handmade from scratch using a perfected traditional French recipe.

name: 7bone Burger
desc: The business was founded in 2013 with one clear mission – to shake up the gourmet burger market outside of London (Burgers should never be termed gourmet in 7bone Burger’s humble opinion) and deliver the best dirty burgers in town.

name: PO BOI’S
desc: PO BOI’S is a high-concept Louisiana soul food cantina born from a "dream team" of South West hospitality veterans. Our story begins in the kitchens of The Rum & Crab Shack in St Ives and across three of Bristol’s most celebrated independent pubs.

name: Eat Fantastic
desc:
Eat Fantastic: Taco Kitchen
Our journey began in 2014 after travelling the lengths of the Mexican border and falling in love with the street food scenes of LA and Austin. Inspired by the bold, vibrant flavours we’d experienced, we returned home, took over the local pub, and started serving up tacos to a growing crowd of regulars.

name: Stripclub Streetfood
desc:
The cheeky chaps at Stripclub Streetfood serve up delicious stripped smoked meats over smashed patties in buns and serve them up with delicious sauces and *nostalgia alert* loaded smiley faces.

The amazing food is served from a stunning white and pink food truck that definitely won’t fade into the background at an event.

On their menu, they have an amazing beef burger made with smoked and stripp…

name: The Sweet Spot
desc: My name is Dempsey, and I come from a family that has been part of the events and fairground industry for generations. Having grown up around markets, festivals, and events, I've spent my working life helping family and friends run successful stalls and create memorable experiences for customers.

name: Jerk Village
desc: We at Jerk Village will provide an innovative yet authentic Jamaican food experience. We create our own seasonings packing our food with unquestionable flavour. Our varied menu suits those wishing to experience our food and are experienced to serve at high volume. We cater customers with dietary requirements as we have gluten free, halal, vegetarian and vegan options included.

name: Veni & Son
desc: Veni & Son are event caterers that cover all aspects of the event industry and have a particular passion for game. Their curbside offers game in a new innovative way.

name: gg street food
desc:
We are a family-run street food company supplying high-quality food units to events and festivals across the UK and Ireland. With years of experience on the festival circuit, we continuously develop new menus, concepts, and immersive food experiences designed to suit a wide range of audiences and event styles.
We operate year round.

name: Poor Boys
desc: At Poor Boys, we bring the bold, soulful flavours of New Orleans to the heart of South West London. Inspired by the iconic Po' Boy sandwich, our journey began with a love for Southern comfort food and a desire to serve something different.

name: Black Milk
desc:
Black Milk is Manchester, and more recently Soho's go-to destination for milkshakes, desserts and all things indulgent! They have a few locations around the country and they are now available for events.

The Black Milk team create an impact, for you and your guests with an unforgettable experience from start to finish.

name: Stockers Catering
desc: Opened in 2021, Stockers Is a customised merchandise sprinter street food truck. Chef owner and company ceo Danny is a high end chef,  with 15 years of experience in the catering industry working in some of the best pubs & restaurants & helping other pubs cost & launch menus with my recipes & methods.

name: Geordie Banger Company
desc: 3rd generation gourmet sausage makers from the banks of the River Tyne. We pride ourselves on quality and have created products that stand out from the crowd. Recipes from all generations as given us a product range of over 30 different types of sausages all with a Geordie twist. The company has been going for 10 years now and the brand has made a strong name for its self in the North East.

name: Hot Dog Mafia
desc:
At Hot Dog Mafia, we believe a hot dog should never be ordinary. It should be bold, honest, and crafted with respect for tradition and ingredients. That’s why every bite you take is the result of passion, craftsmanship, and a promise to always choose quality over shortcuts.

We are Jorge and Paula – both chefs, both food lovers, and both obsessed with quality and flavour.

name: Wood Fired Wonders
desc:
Wood Fired Wonders is run by husband and wife team Katie and Alex. With over 30 years combined experience in the catering industry, they have a real passion for food and service and take great pride in their business.

Their journey to become a street food business began in 2014 whilst road-tripping in Italy.

name: Tastylicious
desc: Tastylicious is a premier catering company in London with over 10 years of experience. Our team of skilled chefs has worked with top restaurants in the city. We specialize in catering for corporate events, markets, weddings, and other large or small gatherings.

name: Other Side Fried
desc:
The original chicken OG's. 10 years in the Fried chicken  game

GOD TIER FRIED CHICKEN quoted by Nicola Coughlan. 

all sauces produced by us, breading developed in house and still made by us to date. NO BOOKER SAUCES. 

All our fried chicken is brined, buttermilked, double dipped in dredge then fried to perfection. 

We are also owners of a new concept called BUSTER'S.

name: Social by Max
desc: Social By Max launched in 2018 as a local supper club series. ‘Socials’ have been held in intimate venues across Acton; including a neighbourhood wine bar, a local pub, a private home and an exclusive rooftop terrace. In 2021, Max (Massimo) hosted a seven-month pop up at The Rocket Pub serving craft burgers, sharing plates, premium steaks and Sunday Roasts.

name: BOB's Lobster
desc: BOB’s Lobster is out to make seafood affordable and fun, by bringing a casual, visual and playful twist to traditional dishes.

name: KOLKATI
desc: KOLKATI serve up epic taste sensations discovered on the streets of Kolkata, North India. Their delicious best in show is the ‘Kati Roll’ - a flaky, egg-fried paratha bread filled with masala chicken or paneer, house sauces, fresh garnish and a squeeze of lime.

name: Lucky Unicorn
desc: Our food brand is a testament to simplicity and a genuine passion for Asian cuisine, particularly Japanese favorites like egg-fried rice and Osaka's famous okonomiyaki.

name: Joe Eats
desc:
Joe Eats established in 2020. 
We specialise in Fried Chicken Sandwiches & Wings. 
Our chicken is marinated in buttermilk and coated in our home made flour mix which is packed full of flavour to ensure that the coating is nice and crispy and the chicken is juicy and tender. We have a variety of sauces to complement the chicken.

name: Caper & Berry Street Food
desc: Caper & Berry are no strangers to great events. They have done everything from intimate dinners to large-scale weddings and now have a beautiful Citroen H Van that they can take to events.

name: Gallo Catering Service
desc: I'm an Italian chef with a single purpose, creating events and taking my clients on culinary journeys.
